强迫；迫使（过去式/过去分词）
令人信服的；引人入胜的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 compellere，由 com-（加强）+ pellere（驱动）构成
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ pel（推）→ 一起推你 → 强迫

meanings.exampleEn: Turn the knob clockwise to increase the volume.
meanings.exampleZh: 顺时针转动旋钮以增大音量。

meanings.exampleEn: The clockwise rotation of the Earth causes the sun to appear to move across the sky.
meanings.exampleZh: 地球的顺时针自转使太阳看起来在天空中移动。

etymology.origin: 由 clock（钟）和 -wise（方向）组合而成，指钟表指针转动的方向
etymology.tip: 钟表指针走的方向就是顺时针方向

related.zh: 逆时针方向地；逆时针方向的

meanings.exampleEn: The Christian community in this region has long been known for its charitable institutions and unwavering commitment to social justice.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区的基督徒社区长期以来以其慈善机构和对社会正义的坚定承诺而闻名。

meanings.exampleEn: Despite facing fierce competition, he remained a Christian in all his dealings, refusing to compromise his integrity for profit.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管面临激烈竞争，他在所有交易中始终是一个正派人，拒绝为了利益而损害自己的诚信。

meanings.exampleEn: The Christian doctrine of redemption has shaped the ethical framework of many Western societies.
meanings.exampleZh: 基督教的救赎教义塑造了许多西方社会的伦理框架。

meanings.exampleEn: It was very Christian of her to forgive the colleague who had publicly humiliated her.
meanings.exampleZh: 她原谅了那个当众羞辱她的同事，真是十分宽厚仁慈。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 Christos（受膏者），经拉丁语 Christianus 进入英语
etymology.tip: Christ（基督）+ -ian（...的人）→ 信仰基督的人；引申为“正派人”

related.zh: 像基督的；具有基督精神的

meanings.exampleEn: The climax of the movie came when the hero finally confronted his enemy.
meanings.exampleZh: 电影的高潮出现在英雄最终面对敌人的时刻。

meanings.exampleEn: The climax of her career was winning the Nobel Prize in Literature.
meanings.exampleZh: 她职业生涯的极点是在文学领域获得诺贝尔奖。

meanings.exampleEn: The speaker used climax to arrange her arguments in ascending order of importance.
meanings.exampleZh: 演讲者使用层进法，将她的论点按重要性递增的顺序排列。

meanings.exampleEn: The tension in the courtroom climaxed when the verdict was announced.
meanings.exampleZh: 当判决宣布时，法庭上的紧张气氛达到了高潮。

meanings.zh: 使达到高潮；使达到顶点
meanings.exampleEn: The director climaxed the performance with a spectacular fireworks display.
meanings.exampleZh: 导演以一场壮观的烟花表演使演出达到高潮。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 klimax，意为“梯子、阶梯”，后引申为逐步上升达到顶点。
etymology.tip: climax 可拆分为 climb（爬）+ max（最大），爬到最大高度就是高潮/极点。

related.zh: 反高潮；令人扫兴的结局

meanings.exampleEn: Many professionals commute from the suburbs to the city center every day.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多上班族每天从郊区通勤到市中心。

meanings.exampleEn: The company allowed employees to commute their unused vacation days into cash.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司允许员工将未使用的假期折算成现金。

meanings.exampleEn: The governor commuted the prisoner's death sentence to life imprisonment.
meanings.exampleZh: 州长将该囚犯的死刑减为终身监禁。

meanings.exampleEn: Her daily commute takes about an hour and a half by train.
meanings.exampleZh: 她每天乘火车通勤大约需要一个半小时。

variants.zh: 通勤；交换；减轻（过去式/过去分词）
通勤；交换；减轻（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 commutare（彻底改变、交换），由 com-（加强）+ mutare（改变）构成
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ mut（改变）+ e → 互相改变位置 → 交换、通勤

meanings.exampleEn: Her technical competence in programming earned her a promotion.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在编程方面的技术能力为她赢得了晋升。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 competere，由 com-（共同）+ petere（追求）构成，原意为“共同追求”，后引申为“能力、胜任”。
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pet（追求）+ ence（状态）→ 共同追求目标所需的状态 → 能力、胜任。

meanings.exampleEn: The compact design of the new smartphone makes it easy to carry in a pocket.
meanings.exampleZh: 这款新智能手机紧凑的设计使其易于放入口袋携带。

meanings.exampleEn: The machine compacts the trash into small blocks for easier disposal.
meanings.exampleZh: 这台机器将垃圾压紧成小块，以便于处理。

meanings.exampleEn: The two nations signed a compact to promote mutual economic cooperation.
meanings.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项协定，以促进彼此的经济合作。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 compingere（组合、固定），由 com-（共同）+ pangere（固定、插入）构成
etymology.suffix: -pact 为词根部分，无独立后缀
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pact（固定）→ 把东西固定在一起 → 紧凑的；压紧；契约（把双方固定在一起）

meanings.exampleEn: The ship sailed along the rugged coast, battling fierce winds and towering waves.
meanings.exampleZh: 这艘船沿着崎岖的海岸航行，与狂风巨浪搏斗。

meanings.exampleEn: The driver turned off the engine and let the car coast down the steep slope.
meanings.exampleZh: 司机关掉发动机，让汽车沿着陡坡滑行而下。

phrases.zh: 从大西洋到太平洋；横贯大陆

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 costa（肋骨、侧边），经古法语 coste 进入英语，原义为‘侧面、边缘’，后引申为‘海岸’。
etymology.tip: coast 像大地的‘肋骨’——海岸就是大陆的侧边。

meanings.exampleEn: The completion of the bridge was delayed by the severe weather conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座桥的完工因恶劣的天气条件而被推迟。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 complere（填满，完成），由 com-（加强）+ plere（充满）构成
etymology.suffix: -tion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: com（加强）+ ple（充满）+ tion（名词）→ 完全充满 → 完成

commonplace.zh: 寻常事；老生常谈；普通的东西

meanings.zh: 寻常事；老生常谈；普通的东西
meanings.exampleEn: It is a commonplace that the Internet has changed the way we communicate.
meanings.exampleZh: 互联网改变了我们的交流方式，这是老生常谈。

meanings.exampleEn: Smartphones have become so commonplace that even children own them.
meanings.exampleZh: 智能手机已变得如此普遍，连孩子们都有。

etymology.origin: 由 common（普通的）+ place（地方）复合而成，最早指“普通的地方”，后引申为“寻常事物”
etymology.tip: common（普通）+ place（地方）→ 普通地方随处可见 → 寻常事、平凡的

meanings.exampleEn: She ran a comb through her tangled hair, wincing at the knots.
meanings.exampleZh: 她用梳子梳理缠结的头发，因打结而皱眉。

meanings.exampleEn: The rooster's bright red comb stood erect as it crowed at dawn.
meanings.exampleZh: 黎明时公鸡啼叫，鲜红的鸡冠竖立着。

meanings.exampleEn: Before the interview, he meticulously combed his hair to present a professional image.
meanings.exampleZh: 面试前，他一丝不苟地梳理头发，以展现专业形象。

meanings.exampleEn: The police combed the entire forest for traces of the missing hiker.
meanings.exampleZh: 警方彻底搜查了整片森林，寻找失踪徒步者的踪迹。

variants.zh: 梳理；彻底搜查（第三人称单数）
梳理；彻底搜查（过去式/过去分词）
梳理；彻底搜查（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 camb，意为梳子；属基础词汇，无明显词根词缀
etymology.tip: comb 的形状像梳齿，联想“梳子”即可

meanings.exampleEn: The central bank circulated the new banknotes throughout the country to stabilize the economy.
meanings.exampleZh: 中央银行在全国流通新纸币以稳定经济。

meanings.exampleEn: The cooling system circulates water through the engine to prevent overheating.
meanings.exampleZh: 冷却系统使水在发动机中循环以防止过热。

meanings.exampleEn: The news circulated quickly on social media before the official statement was released.
meanings.exampleZh: 在官方声明发布之前，这条新闻在社交媒体上迅速传播。

variants.zh: (使)流通/循环/传播的过去式和过去分词
(使)流通/循环/传播的现在分词

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 circulare（形成圆环），源于 circus（圆环）
etymology.tip: circ（圆环）+ -ulate（使）→ 使成环状运动 → 循环、流通

meanings.exampleEn: The two reports are not directly comparable because they use different methodologies.
meanings.exampleZh: 这两份报告因使用不同方法而不可直接比较。

meanings.exampleEn: No other athlete in the league is comparable to her in terms of versatility.
meanings.exampleZh: 在全面性方面，联盟中没有其他运动员能比得上她。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 comparabilis，由 comparare（比较）派生，com- '共同' + par '相等' + -abilis '可……的'
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ par（相等）+ able（可……的）→ 能放在一起比较的，比得上的

meanings.exampleEn: The United Nations Charter outlines the fundamental principles of international relations.
meanings.exampleZh: 联合国宪章阐述了国际关系的基本原则。

meanings.exampleEn: The king granted a charter to the merchants, allowing them to trade freely.
meanings.exampleZh: 国王授予商人特许状，允许他们自由贸易。

meanings.exampleEn: The new bank received its charter from the federal government.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家新银行获得了联邦政府颁发的执照。

meanings.exampleEn: The travel agency arranged a charter for the group to fly directly to the island.
meanings.exampleZh: 旅行社为团队安排了一次包机直飞该岛。

meanings.exampleEn: They chartered a helicopter to survey the remote area.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们包租了一架直升机去勘测偏远地区。

meanings.exampleEn: The university was chartered by the state government in 1865.
meanings.exampleZh: 这所大学于1865年获得州政府特许设立。

variants.zh: 包租；特许设立（过去式/过去分词）
包租；特许设立（现在分词）

phrases.en: the Charter of the United Nations

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 chartula（小纸片），经古法语 chartre 进入英语；原指官方文件或契约，后拼写受 chart 影响变为 charter。
etymology.tip: charter 与 chart（图表）同源，都是“写在纸上的东西”→官方文件→宪章/特许状。

meanings.exampleEn: The company plans to augment its workforce by hiring more engineers.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司计划通过雇用更多工程师来增加员工队伍。

meanings.exampleEn: The population of the city continues to augment each year.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座城市的人口每年持续增长。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 augmentare（增加），源自 augere（增加）
etymology.suffix: -ment 表示行为的结果或手段（在拉丁语中构成名词，英语中直接用作动词）
etymology.tip: aug（增加）+ ment（名词后缀）→ 使增加，记住“增加”即可

meanings.exampleEn: The company must compensate workers for injuries suffered at work.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司必须对在工作中受伤的工人进行赔偿。

meanings.exampleEn: Nothing can compensate for the loss of one's health.
meanings.exampleZh: 失去健康是无法弥补的。

meanings.exampleEn: He was generously compensated for his extra efforts.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的额外付出得到了丰厚的报酬。

variants.zh: 补偿；赔偿（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 因某事赔偿某人；为某事给某人报酬

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 compensare，由 com-（加强）+ pensare（称量，支付）构成，本义为“把两边放在一起称量平衡”，引申为“补偿”。
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pens（称量）+ ate（动词）→ 把两边放在一起称量平衡 → 补偿

composite.zh: 合成的；混合成的；菊科的

meanings.exampleEn: The sculpture is made of a composite material that combines metal and plastic.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座雕塑由一种金属与塑料结合的合成材料制成。

meanings.exampleEn: Daisies belong to the composite family, which includes many flowering plants.
meanings.exampleZh: 雏菊属于菊科，该科包含许多开花植物。

meanings.exampleEn: The new aircraft wing is a composite of carbon fiber and epoxy resin.
meanings.exampleZh: 新型机翼是碳纤维和环氧树脂的复合材料。

variants.zh: 混合；合成（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 compositus，由 com-（共同）+ ponere（放置）的过去分词 positus 构成
etymology.suffix: -ite = 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ posit（放置）+ ite → 把多种东西放在一起 → 合成的

meanings.exampleEn: The engine consists of hundreds of components, each playing a crucial role in the overall performance.
meanings.exampleZh: 发动机由数百个元件组成，每个元件对整体性能都起着至关重要的作用。

meanings.exampleEn: The component parts of the machine are designed to be easily replaced for maintenance.
meanings.exampleZh: 机器的组成部件被设计成便于维护时更换。

variants.zh: 元件；组件；成分（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 componere（放在一起），由 com-（共同）+ ponere（放置）构成
etymology.suffix: -ent = 具有……性质的（形容词后缀），也可作名词后缀表示“……的人/物”
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pon（放）+ ent（的）→ 放到一起的东西 → 组件、成分

meanings.exampleEn: The professor asked us to submit a composition on the impact of social media by Friday.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授要求我们在周五前提交一篇关于社交媒体影响的作文。

meanings.exampleEn: This symphony is regarded as one of the finest musical compositions of the 20th century.
meanings.exampleZh: 这首交响曲被认为是20世纪最优秀的音乐创作之一。

meanings.exampleEn: The chemical composition of the compound determines its physical properties.
meanings.exampleZh: 该化合物的化学组成决定了它的物理性质。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 componere（put together），由 com-（一起）+ ponere（放置）构成，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ition = 名词后缀，表示行为、过程或结果
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ pos（放）+ ition（名词）→ 把东西放到一起 → 组成、创作、作文。

meanings.exampleEn: The magnificent cathedral dominates the city skyline with its towering spires.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座宏伟的大教堂以其高耸的尖塔主宰着城市的天际线。

phrases.zh: 有座堂的城市；主教座堂所在地

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 kathedra（座位，主教座），经拉丁语 cathedra 和教会拉丁语 cathedralis 进入英语
etymology.tip: cata（向下）+ hedr（座位）+ al → 主教坐镇的地方 → 大教堂

meanings.exampleEn: The cock crowed at dawn, rousing the entire village from its slumber.
meanings.exampleZh: 公鸡在黎明时啼叫，把整个村庄从沉睡中唤醒。

meanings.exampleEn: The cock pheasant strutted through the underbrush, its iridescent plumage gleaming in the sunlight.
meanings.exampleZh: 雄雉昂首阔步地穿过灌木丛，其彩虹色的羽毛在阳光下闪闪发光。

meanings.exampleEn: He turned the cock of the radiator to release the excess steam, but the valve was jammed.
meanings.exampleZh: 他拧开散热器的龙头以释放多余的蒸汽，但阀门卡住了。

meanings.exampleEn: After years of relentless ambition, he finally became the cock of the walk in the corporate hierarchy.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过多年不懈的野心，他终于成为公司层级中称王称霸的头目。

meanings.exampleEn: The dog cocked its ears at the faint sound of footsteps approaching from the dark alley.
meanings.exampleZh: 狗竖起耳朵，倾听从小巷暗处传来的微弱脚步声。

meanings.exampleEn: He cocked the pistol and aimed at the target with unwavering precision.
meanings.exampleZh: 他扳起手枪的击铁，以毫不动摇的精准度瞄准目标。

variants.zh: 公鸡；雄禽；龙头；头目的复数
使竖起；扳起（第三人称单数）
使竖起；扳起（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 表示轻蔑（以拇指抵鼻摇动）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；源自古英语 cocc，为模拟公鸡啼叫的拟声词。

meanings.exampleEn: The compression of digital files allows them to be transmitted more quickly over the internet.
meanings.exampleZh: 数字文件的压缩使其能够更快速地在互联网上传输。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 comprimere（com-共同 + premere 压），经由古法语和英语演变而来
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ press（压）+ ion（名词）→ 把东西压到一起 → 压缩

meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers showed great courage in combat.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵们在战斗中表现出极大的勇气。

meanings.exampleEn: The government is taking new measures to combat inflation.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府正在采取新措施来对抗通货膨胀。

variants.zh: 与…战斗；对抗（第三人称单数）
与…战斗；对抗（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 combattre，源自拉丁语 com- + battuere（打），原义为“互相打”。
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ bat（打）= 互相打，即战斗。

compulsory.zh: 被强制的；强迫的；义务的

meanings.zh: 被强制的；强迫的；义务的
meanings.exampleEn: Compulsory education is a fundamental right for every child in this country.
meanings.exampleZh: 义务教育是这个国家每个儿童的基本权利。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 compulsus，是 compellere 的过去分词，由 com-（共同）+ pellere（推）构成
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ puls（推）+ ory（的）→ 一起推着你做 → 被强制的、义务的

meanings.exampleEn: All visitors must comply with the safety regulations.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有访客必须遵守安全规定。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 complere（填满，完成），经古法语 complir 进入英语
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ ply（充满）→ 共同填满要求 → 顺从

meanings.exampleEn: He turned up the collar of his overcoat to shield his neck from the biting wind.
meanings.exampleZh: 他竖起大衣的衣领以保护脖子免受刺骨寒风的侵袭。

meanings.exampleEn: The dog's collar contains a microchip that stores the owner's contact information.
meanings.exampleZh: 狗的项圈里有一个存储主人联系信息的微芯片。

meanings.exampleEn: The police collared the fugitive after a brief chase through the crowded streets.
meanings.exampleZh: 警方在拥挤的街道上短暂追捕后逮捕了逃犯。

variants.zh: 抓住；逮捕（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 collare（颈圈），源自 collum（脖子）
etymology.suffix: -ar（名词后缀，表示与脖子相关的东西）
etymology.tip: coll（脖子）+ ar（东西）→ 围着脖子的东西 → 衣领/项圈

meanings.exampleEn: The human brain is a complex organ that scientists are still trying to fully understand.
meanings.exampleZh: 人脑是一个复杂的器官，科学家仍在努力全面理解它。

meanings.exampleEn: The new shopping complex includes a cinema, a gym, and dozens of restaurants.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座新的购物综合体包括一家电影院、一个健身房和几十家餐厅。

meanings.exampleEn: His inferiority complex often prevents him from speaking confidently in public.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的自卑情结常常使他在公共场合无法自信地讲话。

meanings.exampleEn: In chemistry, a complex is formed when a central metal ion bonds with surrounding molecules or ions.
meanings.exampleZh: 在化学中，当中心金属离子与周围的分子或离子结合时，就形成了络合物。

variants.zh: 综合体；情结；络合物（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 complexus，由 com-（一起）和 plectere（编织）构成
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ plex（编织）= 编织在一起 → 复杂的；综合体

commission.zh: 委任状；任官令；所委职责；佣金

meanings.exampleEn: The sales representative received a 10% commission on every deal she closed.
meanings.exampleZh: 销售代表每成交一笔交易可获得10%的佣金。

meanings.exampleEn: The officer proudly displayed his commission signed by the president.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位军官自豪地展示了总统签署的委任状。

meanings.exampleEn: The commission was established to investigate the causes of the financial crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 该委员会为调查金融危机的原因而设立。

meanings.exampleEn: Her commission was to negotiate a peace treaty between the two warring nations.
meanings.exampleZh: 她所委职责是斡旋两个交战国家之间的和平条约。

meanings.exampleEn: The university commissioned a renowned architect to design its new library.
meanings.exampleZh: 该大学委托一位著名建筑师设计新图书馆。

variants.zh: 委任，委托（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 commissio，由 com-（共同）+ mittere（送）构成，原指‘一起送出’，后引申为‘委托、委任’
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ miss（送）+ ion（名词）→ 把任务‘送’给某人共同完成 → 委任；佣金

meanings.exampleEn: The government finally conceded that the policy had failed.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府最终承认这项政策已经失败了。

meanings.exampleEn: After hours of negotiation, neither side was willing to concede.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过数小时的谈判，双方都不愿意让步。

variants.zh: 承认；让步（第三人称单数）
承认；让步（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concedere，由 con-（完全）+ cedere（走；让）构成
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ cede（让）→ 一起让一步，即“让步；承认”

meanings.exampleEn: The concept of time is fundamental to human experience.
meanings.exampleZh: 时间概念是人类经验的基础。

variants.zh: 使概念化；将…构思为概念

phrases.zh: 营销观念；市场营销概念

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concipere（共同获取、构想），由 con-（共同）+ capere（拿取）演变而来
etymology.suffix: -cept（源自 capere 的变体，表示“拿取”）
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ cept（拿取）→ 把众多想法“拿到一起”形成概念

meanings.exampleEn: The induction coil converts low-voltage current into high-voltage pulses.
meanings.exampleZh: 感应线圈将低压电流转换为高压脉冲。

meanings.exampleEn: A coil of rope lay on the deck, ready for the mooring operation.
meanings.exampleZh: 甲板上放着一卷绳索，准备用于系泊作业。

meanings.exampleEn: The sudden resignation of the director threw the whole department into a coil.
meanings.exampleZh: 主任的突然辞职使整个部门陷入骚动。

meanings.exampleEn: She coiled the wire around the cylinder to form an electromagnet.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把电线缠绕在圆柱体上以形成电磁铁。

meanings.exampleEn: The python coiled silently in the dim light, waiting for its prey.
meanings.exampleZh: 巨蟒在昏暗的光线中静静地盘绕着，等待猎物。

variants.zh: 卷，盘绕（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 尘世的纷扰；人生的烦恼

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 colligere（收集），经由古法语 coillir 进入英语；原指把绳子收拢成圈，后引申为盘绕、卷。
etymology.tip: coil 是 collect 的远亲：把散乱的绳子“收集”起来就成了“卷/盘绕”。

meanings.exampleEn: The conception of time as a linear progression is deeply rooted in Western culture.
meanings.exampleZh: 将时间视为线性进程的观念深深植根于西方文化中。

meanings.exampleEn: The architect's conception of the new library integrates modern design with environmental sustainability.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位建筑师对新图书馆的构想将现代设计与环境可持续性融为一体。

meanings.exampleEn: Advances in medical science have made conception possible for many couples who were previously infertile.
meanings.exampleZh: 医学科学的进步使许多原本不孕的夫妇得以受孕。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concipere（共同拿取，构想），由 con- + capere 演变而来
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ cept（拿取）+ ion（名词）→ 把想法共同“拿住”并固定下来 → 概念、观念

meanings.exampleEn: The report comprises three main sections, each addressing a different aspect of the issue.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份报告包含三个主要部分，每部分针对该问题的不同方面。

meanings.exampleEn: Women comprise nearly half of the company's senior management team.
meanings.exampleZh: 女性几乎构成了公司高级管理团队的一半。

variants.zh: 包含；构成（第三人称单数）
包含；构成（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 comprehendere 的过去分词 compris，意为“抓住、包含”
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ prise（抓住）→ 把各部分抓在一起 → 包含、构成

meanings.exampleEn: It is necessary to compare the two reports before drawing any conclusion.
meanings.exampleZh: 在得出任何结论之前，有必要比较这两份报告。

meanings.exampleEn: Poets often compare life to a journey full of ups and downs.
meanings.exampleZh: 诗人常把人生比作充满起伏的旅程。

meanings.exampleEn: No other product can compare with this one in terms of durability.
meanings.exampleZh: 在耐用性方面，没有其他产品能与这款产品相比。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 comparare，由 com-（共同）+ par（相等）构成，意为“放在一起比较”
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ par（相等）→ 把两者放在一起看是否相等 → 比较、对照

meanings.exampleEn: His conceit about his own intelligence made him unpopular among colleagues.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对自身智力的自负使他在同事中不受欢迎。

meanings.exampleEn: The poet's conceit of a perfect world was beautiful but unrealistic.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位诗人关于完美世界的空想虽然美好，却不切实际。

meanings.exampleEn: The young manager's conceit led him to ignore all practical advice.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位年轻经理的狂妄使他无视一切切实可行的建议。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concipere（构想，容纳），由 con- + capere 演变而来；conceit 是 conceive 的变体。
etymology.tip: con-（一起）+ ceit（拿）→ 把想法都拿到自己身上 → 自负、空想。

meanings.exampleEn: In the absence of electricity, the solitary candle became the sole source of illumination, its flame dancing in the draft.
meanings.exampleZh: 在没有电的情况下，那支孤零零的蜡烛成了唯一的光源，火焰在气流中舞动。

phrases.en: burn the candle at both ends
phrases.zh: 过分消耗精力；起早贪黑
与……相比；配得上（常用于否定句）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 candela，源自 candere（发光，燃烧）
etymology.suffix: -le（源自拉丁语 -ela，名词后缀，表示物）
etymology.tip: cand=发光/白，蜡烛(candle)发光，候选人(candidate)穿白袍。

meanings.exampleEn: The bridge is made of reinforced concrete, which can withstand tremendous pressure.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座桥由钢筋混凝土建造，能够承受巨大的压力。

meanings.zh: 具体的；实在的；混凝土制的
meanings.exampleEn: We need concrete evidence to support this hypothesis rather than mere speculation.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们需要具体的证据来支持这一假设，而非仅仅依靠推测。

meanings.exampleEn: The workers concreted the backyard to create a stable foundation for the shed.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们用混凝土覆盖后院，为棚屋建造稳固的地基。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concretus，是 concrescere 的过去分词，意为“共同生长、凝结在一起”
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ crete（生长）→ 长在一起 → 凝结成混凝土；引申为“具体的”

compatible.zh: 能共处的；可并立的；适合的

meanings.zh: 能共处的；可并立的；适合的
meanings.exampleEn: The new software is fully compatible with the existing operating system.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个新软件与现有的操作系统完全兼容。

phrases.zh: 和谐的关系；相容的关系

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 compatī（共同承受），由 com-（共同）+ patī（忍受）构成
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pati（忍受）+ ible（可……的）→ 能共同承受的 → 能共处的；兼容的

commercial.zh: 商业的；商用的；商品化的

meanings.zh: 商业的；商用的；商品化的
meanings.exampleEn: The commercial success of the film surprised even its producers.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部电影的商业成功甚至令其制片人感到惊讶。

meanings.exampleEn: The company launched a new commercial to promote its latest smartphone.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司发布了一则新的商业广告来推广其最新款智能手机。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 commercium（贸易、交易），由 com-（共同）+ merx（商品）构成
etymology.suffix: -ial = 具有……性质的，形容词后缀
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ merc（贸易）+ ial（形容词后缀）→ 共同进行贸易的 → 商业的

meanings.exampleEn: The instructions were so complicated that even the experts found them difficult to follow.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些说明如此复杂，以至于专家都觉得难以遵循。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 complicare（折叠在一起），由 com-（一起）和 plicare（折叠）构成。
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ plic（折叠）+ ated → 折叠在一起 → 错综复杂的

related.zh: 明确的（ex-向外+plic-折叠，展开的）
暗示（im-向内+plic-折叠，折叠进去）

meanings.exampleEn: The counterfeit coins were so meticulously crafted that even experts found them difficult to detect.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些伪造硬币制作得如此精细，连专家都难以辨别。

meanings.exampleEn: In many cultures, coins have served not only as a medium of exchange but also as a symbol of political authority.
meanings.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，钱币不仅充当交换媒介，还象征着政治权威。

meanings.exampleEn: The royal mint was authorized to coin gold sovereigns bearing the monarch's portrait.
meanings.exampleZh: 皇家造币厂被授权铸造印有君主肖像的金币。

meanings.exampleEn: The scientist coined the term "ecosystem" to describe the intricate interactions between organisms and their environment.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位科学家创造了“生态系统”一词，用以描述生物与其环境之间复杂的相互作用。

variants.zh: 铸造；创造（第三人称单数）
铸造；创造（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.en: the other side of the coin
two sides of the same coin

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 coigne（楔子、角），后指铸造硬币的模具，最终源自拉丁语 cuneus（楔子）
etymology.tip: 硬币由模具冲压而成，模具形似楔子（cune），记住 coin 与 cuneus 同源

meanings.exampleEn: The professor's lecture on quantum mechanics was far beyond the comprehension of most undergraduates.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授关于量子力学的讲座远远超出了大多数本科生的理解范围。

meanings.exampleEn: The term 'ecosystem' has a broad comprehension that includes both living organisms and their physical environment.
meanings.exampleZh: “生态系统”一词具有广泛的包含性，涵盖了生物体及其物理环境。

phrases.zh: 难以理解；超出理解范围

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 comprehendere（抓住，包含），由 com- + prehendere 构成
etymology.suffix: -sion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ prehend（抓住）+ sion（名词）→ 一起抓住意思 → 理解

comprehensive.zh: 广泛的；有理解力的；综合的

meanings.exampleEn: The government has launched a comprehensive reform of the healthcare system.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已启动对医疗体系的全面改革。

meanings.exampleEn: She is a comprehensive reader who can grasp complex theories quickly.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是一位有理解力的读者，能迅速掌握复杂的理论。

meanings.exampleEn: The university offers a comprehensive curriculum covering both arts and sciences.
meanings.exampleZh: 这所大学提供涵盖文科和理科的综合课程。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 comprehendere，由 com- "一起" + prehendere "抓住" 构成，原义为“抓住全部”，后引申为“全面的、综合的”。
etymology.prefix: com- = 共同，一起；加强语气
etymology.suffix: -ive = 形容词后缀，表示“有……性质的”
etymology.tip: com（全部）+ prehend（抓住）+ ive（的）→ 全部抓住的 → 全面的、综合的

meanings.exampleEn: The architect conceived a bold new design for the city library.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位建筑师为市图书馆构思了一个大胆的新设计。

meanings.exampleEn: She conceived that there must be a simpler solution to the problem.
meanings.exampleZh: 她认为这个问题一定有更简单的解决办法。

meanings.exampleEn: After years of medical treatment, she finally conceived.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过多年的治疗后，她终于怀孕了。

variants.zh: 构思；认为；怀孕（过去式/过去分词）
构思；认为；怀孕（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concipere，由 com-（一起）+ capere（拿取）构成
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ ceive（拿取）→ 把想法“拿到一起”就是构思；把生命“拿到一起”就是怀孕。

meanings.exampleEn: The government granted the company a concession to operate the railway for 30 years.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府授予该公司经营铁路30年的特许权。

meanings.exampleEn: Both sides had to make concessions to reach a peace agreement.
meanings.exampleZh: 双方不得不做出让步以达成和平协议。

meanings.exampleEn: His concession of defeat came after the final vote count was announced.
meanings.exampleZh: 在最终计票结果公布后，他认可了失败。

phrases.zh: （影院、球场等地的）小卖部，售货摊

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concessio，由 con-（共同，加强）+ cedere（走，退让）构成，原意为“共同退让”，后引申为“让步、特许”等义。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ cess（走）+ ion（名词）→ 大家一起“退让” → 让步；引申为“特许、认可”。

meanings.exampleEn: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
meanings.exampleZh: 水由氢原子和氧原子组成。

meanings.exampleEn: The poet composed an elegy in memory of his deceased friend.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位诗人为纪念亡友创作了一首挽歌。

meanings.exampleEn: Beethoven composed his Ninth Symphony when he was completely deaf.
meanings.exampleZh: 贝多芬在完全失聪时创作了他的第九交响曲。

meanings.exampleEn: She took a deep breath to compose herself before the interview.
meanings.exampleZh: 面试前她深吸一口气以使自己镇定下来。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 componere（com- 共同 + ponere 放置），后经法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pos（放）+ e = 把东西放到一起 → 组成；写作、作曲也是把词句或音符放到一起。

common.zh: 通常的；共同的；通俗的；公共的

meanings.exampleEn: It is common for students to feel anxious before an important exam.
meanings.exampleZh: 学生在重要考试前感到焦虑是常见的。

meanings.exampleEn: The two countries share a common interest in maintaining regional stability.
meanings.exampleZh: 两国在维护地区稳定方面有着共同的利益。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel was written in a common style so that ordinary readers could enjoy it.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说以通俗的风格写成，以便普通读者能够欣赏。

meanings.exampleEn: The park is a common area where residents can relax and exercise.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个公园是居民可以放松和锻炼的公共区域。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 communis，由 com-（共同）和 munis（承担义务的）组成，原意为“共同承担义务的”。
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ mun（义务）→ 共同承担义务的 → 共同的；公共的

conductor.zh: 领导者；指挥者；售票员；向导

meanings.exampleEn: The conductor of the orchestra skillfully led the musicians through the complex symphony.
meanings.exampleZh: 管弦乐队的指挥者熟练地带领乐手们完成了这首复杂的交响曲。

meanings.exampleEn: The bus conductor collected fares and issued tickets to the passengers with practiced efficiency.
meanings.exampleZh: 公交车售票员熟练地收取车费并向乘客发放车票。

meanings.exampleEn: As a mountain conductor, he guided the climbers safely through the treacherous glacier route.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名山地向导，他带领登山者安全地穿过了那条危险的冰川路线。

variants.zh: 传导性的；有传导能力的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conducere（共同引导），由 con-（共同）+ ducere（引导）构成
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ duct（引导）+ or（人）→ 把大家共同引导到一起的人 → 指挥者、向导

competent.zh: 能干的；胜任的；有效的；足够的

meanings.exampleEn: She is a highly competent manager who can handle multiple projects simultaneously.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是一位非常能干的管理者，能够同时处理多个项目。

meanings.exampleEn: He is not competent to drive such a heavy vehicle without proper training.
meanings.exampleZh: 未经适当培训，他不能胜任驾驶这种重型车辆的工作。

meanings.exampleEn: The court ruled that the evidence was competent to support the verdict.
meanings.exampleZh: 法院裁定该证据足以支持判决。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 competere，意为“共同追求、相遇、合格”，由 com-（共同）+ petere（追求、寻求）构成。
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pet（追求）+ ent（的）→ 能共同追求目标的 → 胜任的

meanings.exampleEn: The spy concealed the classified documents in a false-bottomed suitcase.
meanings.exampleZh: 间谍将机密文件隐藏在手提箱的夹层里。

meanings.exampleEn: She tried to conceal her disappointment with a forced smile.
meanings.exampleZh: 她强颜欢笑，试图掩盖自己的失望。

meanings.exampleEn: He concealed the truth about his past from his colleagues.
meanings.exampleZh: 他向同事隐瞒了自己过去的真相。

variants.zh: 隐藏；掩盖；隐瞒（过去式/过去分词）
隐藏；掩盖；隐瞒（现在分词）
隐藏；掩盖；隐瞒（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 celare（隐藏），经古法语 conceler 进入英语
etymology.tip: con（完全）+ ceal（藏）→ 完全藏起来，即隐藏

meanings.exampleEn: The sculptor carved a magnificent eagle out of the marble block.
meanings.exampleZh: 雕塑家用大理石石块雕刻出一只雄鹰。

meanings.exampleEn: She carved the roasted turkey into thin slices for the guests.
meanings.exampleZh: 她为客人们把烤火鸡切成薄片。

variants.zh: 雕刻；切开（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 ceorfan（切割），源自原始日耳曼语 *kerfan，最终源自 PIE 词根 *gerbh-（刻、划）
etymology.tip: carve 与 graph 同源，都有“刻划”之意；雕刻就是刻划。

meanings.exampleEn: The composer spent three years writing the symphony that would define his career.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位作曲家花了三年时间创作这部将定义他职业生涯的交响乐。

meanings.exampleEn: As a prolific composer of essays, she often explored the intersection of art and politics.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一位多产的散文作家，她经常探讨艺术与政治的交叉领域。

meanings.exampleEn: The diplomat acted as a composer between the two warring factions, seeking a peaceful resolution.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位外交官充当两个交战派系之间的调停者，寻求和平解决方案。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 componere（放在一起，组成），经由法语 compositeur 进入英语
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ pos（放）+ er（人）→ 把音符放在一起的人 → 作曲家

meanings.exampleEn: He was proud to fight alongside his compatriots in the war.
meanings.exampleZh: 他为自己在战争中与同胞并肩作战而感到自豪。

etymology.tip: com（共同）+ patri（祖国）+ ot（人）→ 同属一个祖国的人 → 同胞

meanings.exampleEn: He was widely respected as a loyal comrade who never hesitated to share the burden of hard work.
meanings.exampleZh: 他作为一名忠诚的同志广受尊敬，从不犹豫分担繁重的工作。

etymology.origin: 来自法语 camarade，源自西班牙语 camarada（同室者），最终来自拉丁语 camera（房间）

etymology.tip: 同住一个房间的人 → 同志、伙伴

meanings.exampleEn: The conflict between personal ambition and family responsibility tormented him for years.
meanings.exampleZh: 个人抱负与家庭责任之间的冲突折磨了他多年。

meanings.exampleEn: The two nations finally resorted to armed conflict after decades of failed negotiations.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过数十年失败的谈判，两国最终诉诸武装冲突。

meanings.exampleEn: His political views often conflict with the mainstream opinions of his colleagues.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的政治观点常常与同事的主流意见相抵触。

variants.zh: 冲突；抵触（第三人称单数）
冲突；抵触（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confligere（互相打击），由 con-（共同）+ fligere（打击）构成
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ flict（打击）→ 互相打击 → 冲突

meanings.exampleEn: Effective communication between team members is essential for the success of any complex project.
meanings.exampleZh: 团队成员之间有效的交流对于任何复杂项目的成功都至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: The new satellite system has greatly improved global communication in remote areas.
meanings.exampleZh: 新的卫星系统极大地改善了偏远地区的全球交通联络。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 communicare（分享、交流），源自 communis（共同的）
etymology.suffix: -ation = 表示行为、状态或结果的名词后缀
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ mun（服务/义务）+ ication（名词后缀）→ 共同参与、互相分享 → 交流、通讯

complexity.zh: 复杂；复杂性；复杂的事物

meanings.exampleEn: The complexity of the problem made it difficult for the engineers to find a quick solution.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个问题的复杂性使工程师们难以迅速找到解决方案。

meanings.exampleEn: Modern society is full of complexities that require interdisciplinary knowledge to understand.
meanings.exampleZh: 现代社会充满复杂的事物，需要跨学科知识才能理解。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 complexus，由 com-（共同）+ plexus（编织）构成，原意为“交织在一起的”，后引申为“复杂的”。
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ plex（编织）+ ity（名词）→ 编织在一起的状态 → 复杂；复杂性。

configuration.zh: 结构；表面配置；外形；配置

meanings.exampleEn: The configuration of the new office building was designed to maximize natural light.
meanings.exampleZh: 新办公楼的结构设计旨在最大限度地利用自然光。

meanings.exampleEn: You need to check the system configuration before installing the software.
meanings.exampleZh: 安装软件之前，你需要检查系统配置。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 configurare，意为“按模式形成”
etymology.suffix: -ation = 名词后缀，表示行为或结果
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ figur（形成）+ ation（结果）→ 共同形成的样子 → 结构、配置

meanings.exampleEn: The complete investigation of the incident took over three months.
meanings.exampleZh: 对这起事件的完整调查花了三个多月。

meanings.exampleEn: His complete disregard for the rules shocked all the committee members.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对规则的彻底漠视令所有委员会成员震惊。

meanings.exampleEn: The project is now complete and ready for final review.
meanings.exampleZh: 该项目现已完成，准备接受最终审查。

meanings.exampleEn: She managed to complete her thesis two weeks ahead of schedule.
meanings.exampleZh: 她设法提前两周完成了论文。

meanings.exampleEn: A second language will complete your professional qualifications.
meanings.exampleZh: 掌握第二语言将使你的专业资质更加完整。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 complere，由 com-（加强）+ plere（填满）构成
etymology.tip: com（完全）+ ple（填满）+ te → 完全填满，引申为“完全的；完成”

meanings.exampleEn: The professor asked the students to give a concise summary of the research findings.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授要求学生们对研究结果做一个简洁的总结。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concisus，是 concidere 的过去分词，由 con-（加强）+ caedere（切）构成，原义为“切碎的”，引申为“简明的”。
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ cis（切）→ 把多余部分切掉 → 简洁的

meanings.exampleEn: The scientist drew a firm conclusion from the extensive experimental data.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位科学家从大量的实验数据中得出了确切的结论。

meanings.exampleEn: The conclusion of the novel left readers with a sense of hope and reflection.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说的结尾给读者留下了希望与反思。

meanings.exampleEn: His conclusion about the market trend was based on incomplete statistics.
meanings.exampleZh: 他关于市场趋势的推论是基于不完整的统计数据的。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concludere（共同关闭、结束），由 con- + claudere 构成
etymology.suffix: -sion = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ clud（关闭）+ sion（名词）→ 把所有论据一起关闭、收拢 → 得出结论

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient manuscript was completely destroyed by the fire.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份古代手稿被大火完全摧毁了。

meanings.exampleEn: I am completely convinced that the proposal will be approved by the committee.
meanings.exampleZh: 我十分确信该提案将获得委员会批准。

meanings.exampleEn: The diplomatic mission was accomplished completely, strengthening bilateral relations.
meanings.exampleZh: 这次外交使命圆满地完成，加强了双边关系。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 completus，由 com-（加强）+ plere（充满）构成，意为“填满的、完全的”
etymology.tip: com（完全）+ plet（充满）+ ly（副词）→ 完全充满地 → 完全地

meanings.exampleEn: He confessed that he had stolen the money from the safe.
meanings.exampleZh: 他承认自己从保险柜里偷了钱。

meanings.exampleEn: She confessed her sins to the priest before the ceremony.
meanings.exampleZh: 仪式前她向神父忏悔了自己的罪过。

meanings.exampleEn: The suspect finally confessed to the crime after hours of interrogation.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过数小时审讯，嫌疑人最终坦白了自己的罪行。

variants.zh: 承认；供认（confess的过去式和过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confiteri，由 con-（完全）+ fateri（承认，说）构成
etymology.tip: con（完全）+ fess（说）= 把话完全说出来，即“坦白、承认”

confront.zh: 使面对；对抗；遭遇；使对质

meanings.exampleEn: The government was confronted with a severe economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府面临着严重的经济危机。

meanings.exampleEn: She decided to confront her fears and speak in public.
meanings.exampleZh: 她决定直面自己的恐惧，在公开场合发言。

meanings.exampleEn: The expedition confronted many unexpected difficulties in the desert.
meanings.exampleZh: 探险队在沙漠中遭遇了许多意想不到的困难。

meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer confronted the witness with the contradictory evidence.
meanings.exampleZh: 律师用相互矛盾的证据与证人对质。

variants.zh: 面对；对抗（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confrontari，由 com-（共同）+ frons（前面）构成，意为“共同面对”
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ front（前面）→ 一起到前面 → 面对、对抗

meanings.exampleEn: Her confidence in her ability to succeed never wavered despite the setbacks.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管屡遭挫折，她对自己能够成功的信心从未动摇。

meanings.exampleEn: The manager placed great confidence in his team's judgment.
meanings.exampleZh: 经理非常信任他团队的判断力。

meanings.exampleEn: She told me the news in strict confidence, so I cannot reveal it to anyone.
meanings.exampleZh: 她极其机密地告诉我这个消息，所以我不能向任何人透露。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confidere（完全信任），由 con- 和 fidere 组合而成
etymology.suffix: -ence = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: con（完全）+ fid（信任）+ ence（名词）→ 完全信任自己 → 信心

meanings.exampleEn: The building was designed in strict conformity with local safety regulations.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座建筑的设计严格遵守当地安全法规。

meanings.exampleEn: His behavior shows a remarkable conformity to the customs of the community.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的行为与这个社区的习俗表现出惊人的一致。

variants.zh: 因循守旧的；遵守习俗的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conformare（使成形，使一致），由 con- + formare 构成
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ form（形式）+ ity（状态）→ 共同的形式 → 一致、相似

meanings.exampleEn: The algorithm can compute the optimal route in a matter of seconds.
meanings.exampleZh: 该算法能在几秒钟内计算出最优路线。

meanings.exampleEn: We need to compute the potential cost of the project before making a decision.
meanings.exampleZh: 在做出决定之前，我们需要估算该项目的潜在成本。

variants.zh: 计算；估算（过去式/过去分词）
计算；估算（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 computare，由 com-（加强）+ putare（计算，思考）构成
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ put（计算）→ 一起计算，就是“计算”

meanings.exampleEn: The hiker relied on a compass to navigate through the dense forest.
meanings.exampleZh: 徒步旅行者依靠指南针在茂密的森林中辨别方向。

meanings.exampleEn: This issue is beyond the compass of the present discussion.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个问题超出了当前讨论的范围。

meanings.exampleZh: 这位女高音惊人的音域使她能够轻松唱出最高音。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 compasser，源自拉丁语 com- + passus（步），原意为“用步测量”，后引申为“范围”，并指代“指南针”。
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pass（步）→ 一起步量出范围，引申为“指南针”。

meanings.exampleEn: The confrontation between the two political leaders escalated into a heated debate.
meanings.exampleZh: 两位政治领袖之间的对抗升级为一场激烈的辩论。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confrontari（面对），由 con-（共同）和 frons（前额、正面）构成
etymology.suffix: -ation = 表示行为、状态、结果的名词后缀
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ front（前面）+ ation（名词）→ 共同站到前面 → 对抗、对质

meanings.exampleEn: It is difficult to comprehend the vastness of the universe.
meanings.exampleZh: 很难理解宇宙的浩瀚。

meanings.exampleZh: 这项研究涵盖了广泛的主题。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 comprehendere，由 com-（加强）+ prehendere（抓住）构成
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ prehend（抓住）→ 一起抓住意思 → 理解；包括

meanings.exampleZh: 敌人集中的火力迫使我军撤退。

meanings.exampleZh: 浓缩橙汁比天然橙汁更方便，但新鲜度稍差。

etymology.tip: con（共同）+ centr（中心）→ 共同向中心聚拢 → 集中的；浓缩的

meanings.exampleEn: The judge condemned the criminal to ten years in prison.
meanings.exampleZh: 法官判处该罪犯十年监禁。

meanings.exampleEn: The international community condemned the government's violent crackdown on peaceful protesters.
meanings.exampleZh: 国际社会谴责政府对和平抗议者的暴力镇压。

variants.zh: 判刑；谴责（第三人称单数）
判刑；谴责（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 condemnare，由 com-（加强）+ damnare（定罪，伤害）构成
etymology.tip: con（加强）+ damn（定罪）→ 强烈定罪 → 判刑；谴责

meanings.exampleEn: The new regulations will complicate the process of obtaining a visa.
meanings.exampleZh: 新规定将使获取签证的过程复杂化。

meanings.exampleEn: His sudden illness complicated the already difficult situation.
meanings.exampleZh: 他突然生病使本已困难的局面更加恶化。

variants.zh: 使复杂化；使恶化（第三人称单数）
使复杂化；使恶化（过去式/过去分词）
使复杂化；使恶化（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 complicare（折叠在一起）
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ plic（折叠）+ ate（使）→ 折叠在一起 → 使复杂

meanings.exampleEn: The once prosperous colony gradually declined after gaining independence.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个曾经繁荣的殖民地在获得独立后逐渐衰落了。

meanings.exampleEn: A colony of settlers arrived on the new continent in search of religious freedom.
meanings.exampleZh: 一支移民队抵达新大陆，寻求宗教自由。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 colonia（殖民地），源于 colere（耕种、居住）
etymology.suffix: -y 名词后缀，表示地点或状态
etymology.tip: col（耕种）+ -y（名词后缀）→ 移民队去耕种新土地的地方 → 殖民地

meanings.exampleEn: The complex instructions confused the new employees, leaving them uncertain about how to proceed.
meanings.exampleZh: 复杂的说明使新员工感到困惑，让他们不确定该如何进行。

phrases.zh: 使问题复杂化；搅乱问题

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confundere，由 con-（共同）+ fundere（倾倒、注入）构成，原意为“混在一起倒”，后引申为“使混乱、使困惑”。
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ fuse（流）→ 各种东西流到一起，混在一起 → 使混乱、使困惑。

meanings.exampleEn: Please accept my heartfelt congratulation on your remarkable achievement in the national contest.
meanings.exampleZh: 请接受我对你在全国比赛中取得杰出成就的衷心祝贺。

variants.zh: 祝贺（复数形式，常用于口语）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 congratulari，由 com-（共同）+ gratulari（表示感谢、祝愿）构成，其词根为 gratus（令人高兴的；感激的）
etymology.suffix: -ation（名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果）
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ grat（高兴）+ ation（名词）→ 大家一起分享高兴的事 → 祝贺

meanings.exampleEn: The latest evidence confirms the scientist's hypothesis about climate change.
meanings.exampleZh: 最新证据证实了这位科学家关于气候变化的假说。

meanings.exampleEn: Please confirm the exact date of the meeting before we make travel arrangements.
meanings.exampleZh: 在我们安排行程之前，请确定会议的具体日期。

meanings.exampleEn: The board will confirm the new CEO at its annual meeting next week.
meanings.exampleZh: 董事会将在下周的年会上批准新任首席执行官。

meanings.exampleEn: Winning the championship confirmed the team's position as the strongest in the league.
meanings.exampleZh: 赢得冠军使该队巩固了其作为联赛最强队伍的地位。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confirmare，由 con-（加强）+ firmare（使坚固）构成

meanings.exampleEn: The company's main competitor has just launched a more affordable product.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司的主要竞争对手刚刚推出了一款更实惠的产品。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 competere，意为‘共同追求、竞争’，由 com-（共同）和 petere（追求）组合而成。
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pet（追求）+ itor（人）→ 共同追求同一目标的人 → 竞争者。

meanings.exampleEn: As a committed communist, he devoted his entire life to the struggle for social equality.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名坚定的共产主义者，他将毕生精力奉献给了争取社会平等的斗争。

meanings.exampleEn: The communist ideology emphasizes collective ownership of the means of production.
meanings.exampleZh: 共产主义意识形态强调生产资料公有制。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 communis（公共的），后经法语 communiste 进入英语

etymology.tip: commun（共同）+ ist（人）→ 主张财产共有的人 → 共产主义者

meanings.exampleEn: It is essential to combine theoretical knowledge with practical experience in scientific research.
meanings.exampleZh: 在科学研究中，将理论知识与实践经验结合起来至关重要。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 combinare，由 com-（共同）+ bini（两个）构成
etymology.tip: 把两个（bin）放在一起（com）就是结合

meanings.exampleEn: The worker demanded compensation for the extra hours he worked.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人要求为他加班的时间获得补偿。

meanings.exampleEn: The court awarded the victim substantial compensation for the emotional distress.
meanings.exampleZh: 法院判给受害者巨额精神损害赔偿金。

meanings.exampleEn: His compensation package includes a high salary and stock options.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的薪酬待遇包括高薪和股票期权。

phrases.zh: 失业救济金；失业补偿金

etymology.root: pens = 称量；支付（引申为衡量、补偿）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 compensatio，由 com-（共同）+ pensare（称量）构成，原指“使两端平衡”，后引申为“补偿”。

etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pens（称量）+ ation（名词）→ 共同称量使平衡 → 补偿

meanings.exampleEn: She felt confident that her years of preparation would finally pay off in the upcoming competition.
meanings.exampleZh: 她确信自己多年的准备最终会在即将到来的比赛中得到回报。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confidere（完全信任）的现在分词 confidens
etymology.suffix: -ent = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: con（加强）+ fid（信任）+ ent（的）→ 非常信任自己 → 自信的

meanings.exampleEn: The collective wisdom of the group proved invaluable in solving the complex problem.
meanings.exampleZh: 集体的智慧在解决这个复杂问题时证明是无价的。

meanings.exampleEn: In the sentence "A swarm of bees flew by", "swarm" is a collective noun.
meanings.exampleZh: 在句子“A swarm of bees flew by”中，“swarm”是一个集合名词。

meanings.exampleEn: The agricultural collective was responsible for the distribution of resources among its members.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个农业集体负责在其成员之间分配资源。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 colligere 的过去分词 collectus，由 com- (一起) + legere (选择，收集) 构成
etymology.prefix: col- = 共同，一起（com- 的变体）
etymology.tip: col(一起)+lect(选择)+ive(形容词) → 把选择的东西聚到一起的 → 集体的

meanings.exampleEn: The programmer spent hours compiling the source code into an executable file.
meanings.exampleZh: 程序员花了数小时将源代码编译成可执行文件。

meanings.exampleEn: The editor compiled the scattered manuscripts into a coherent volume.
meanings.exampleZh: 编辑将零散的手稿编辑成一部连贯的文集。

meanings.exampleEn: The scholars compiled an authoritative dictionary of ancient Chinese.
meanings.exampleZh: 学者们编纂了一部权威的古汉语词典。

meanings.exampleEn: The researcher compiled data from over 200 surveys.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究人员收集了200多份调查的数据。

variants.zh: 编译；编辑；编纂；收集（过去式/过去分词）
编译；编辑；编纂；收集（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 compilare（收集、掠夺），由 com-（共同）+ pilare（堆压）构成。
etymology.tip: com（一起）+ pile（堆）→ 把东西堆到一起 → 汇编、编译

meanings.exampleEn: In today's globalized economy, only the most competitive enterprises can survive and thrive.
meanings.exampleZh: 在当今全球化的经济中，只有最具竞争力的企业才能生存和发展。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 competere，由 com-（共同）+ petere（追求）构成，原意为“共同追求”，后引申为“竞争”。
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ pet（追求）+ itive（的）→ 共同追求同一个目标 → 竞争的

meanings.exampleEn: The political cartoon in the newspaper satirized the government's new policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 报纸上的政治漫画讽刺了政府的新政策。

meanings.exampleEn: The artist cartooned the celebrity as a cunning fox in his latest work.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家在他最新的作品中把那位名人画成一只狡猾的狐狸。

variants.zh: 为…画漫画（过去式/过去分词）
画漫画（现在分词/动名词）

etymology.origin: 来自意大利语 cartone（厚纸、纸板），由 carta（纸）扩大而来，后经法语进入英语，指纸板上的草图，引申为卡通画。
etymology.tip: cart（纸片）+ oon（大）→ 画在大纸板上的草图 → 卡通画

meanings.exampleEn: The entire faculty gathered to congratulate the outstanding graduates on their remarkable achievements.
meanings.exampleZh: 全体教师聚集在一起，祝贺杰出的毕业生们取得的卓越成就。

phrases.zh: 因某人做了某事而祝贺他/她

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 congratulari，由 con-（共同）和 gratulari（表示喜悦）组合而成，原意为“共同分享喜悦”。
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ gratul（喜悦）+ ate（动词）→ 共同分享喜悦 → 祝贺。

meanings.exampleEn: Her conscience would not let her remain silent about the injustice she witnessed.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的良心不允许她对亲眼目睹的不公保持沉默。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conscientia，由 con-（共同）+ scire（知道）+ -ence 构成，原意为“共同知晓、内心知晓”。
etymology.suffix: -ence = 名词后缀，表示性质或状态
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ sci（知道）+ ence → 自己内心共同知道对错 → 良心

meanings.exampleEn: The conqueror imposed his own laws upon the defeated nation.
meanings.exampleZh: 征服者将他的法律强加于战败国。

phrases.zh: 征服者威廉（英国历史上的诺曼底公爵）
征服人心者；令人倾慕的人
以征服者自居；摆出胜利者的姿态

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conquirere（共同寻求，获得），经由古法语 conquereor 进入英语
etymology.tip: con（加强）+ quer（寻求）+ or（人）→ 不断寻求并夺取的人 → 征服者

coherent.zh: 互相耦合的；清晰的；明了的；凝聚性的

meanings.exampleEn: The professor's lecture was so coherent that even the freshest students could follow the complex theory without difficulty.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授的讲座条理清晰，连最新生都能毫不费力地理解这个复杂的理论。

meanings.exampleEn: After the accident, the witness was too shocked to give a coherent account of what had happened.
meanings.exampleZh: 事故发生后，目击者受到太大惊吓，无法清晰明了地讲述所发生的事。

meanings.exampleEn: A coherent team is more likely to overcome setbacks and achieve long-term goals.
meanings.exampleZh: 一个有凝聚力的团队更有可能克服挫折并实现长期目标。

meanings.exampleEn: Laser light is coherent because all the waves maintain a fixed phase relationship with one another.
meanings.exampleZh: 激光是相干的，因为所有光波彼此之间保持固定的相位关系。

phrases.zh: 连贯的整体；统一的整体

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 cohaerere 的现在分词 cohaerens，由 co-（共同）+ haerere（粘着）构成
etymology.tip: co（共同）+ her（粘）+ ent（的）→ 粘在一起的 → 连贯的；凝聚的

meanings.exampleEn: The engineer tried to conform the design to the latest safety standards.
meanings.exampleZh: 工程师试图使设计符合最新的安全标准。

meanings.exampleEn: All employees must conform to the company's code of conduct.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有员工必须遵守公司的行为准则。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conformare，由 con-（共同）+ formare（形成）构成，意为“使形状相同”。
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ form（形状）→ 使形状相同 → 使一致、符合。

meanings.exampleEn: The university conferred an honorary degree on the renowned scientist.
meanings.exampleZh: 大学授予这位著名科学家荣誉学位。

meanings.exampleEn: Regular exercise confers numerous health benefits.
meanings.exampleZh: 经常锻炼带来诸多健康益处。

variants.zh: 授予；带来（第三人称单数）
授予；带来（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.tip: con（一起）+ fer（带来）→ 把意见带到一起商议，或把荣誉带给某人 → 授予、带来

breeze.zh: 微风；煤屑；轻而易举的事

meanings.exampleEn: A gentle breeze rustled the leaves in the quiet garden.
meanings.exampleZh: 一阵微风吹过，安静的花园里树叶沙沙作响。

meanings.exampleEn: The workers spread coke breeze over the icy path to improve traction.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们把焦炭煤屑撒在结冰的路面上以增加摩擦力。

meanings.exampleEn: Passing the driving test was a breeze for her after years of practice.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过多年的练习，通过驾照考试对她来说轻而易举。

meanings.exampleEn: She breezed into the meeting room, exuding confidence and charm.
meanings.exampleZh: 她轻盈而自信地走进会议室，散发出自信和魅力。

meanings.exampleEn: He breezed through the final exam without even opening a textbook.
meanings.exampleZh: 他连课本都没翻开就轻松通过了期末考试。

variants.zh: 轻盈而自信地走（第三人称单数）
轻盈而自信地走（过去式/过去分词）
轻盈而自信地走（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 轻松通过，轻而易举地完成

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

conscious.zh: 有意识的；知觉的；觉察的

meanings.exampleEn: She made a conscious decision to change her lifestyle after the illness.
meanings.exampleZh: 病后她做出了一个有意识的决定，要改变自己的生活方式。

meanings.exampleEn: The patient remained fully conscious throughout the operation.
meanings.exampleZh: 手术过程中病人始终保持完全知觉。

meanings.exampleEn: He was acutely conscious of the criticism hidden in her praise.
meanings.exampleZh: 他敏锐地觉察到她的赞美中暗含的批评。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conscius（知道的，意识到的），由 con- + scire（知道）构成
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ sci（知道）+ ous（的）→ 共同知道 → 有意识的

meanings.exampleEn: The team won five consecutive games before suffering a defeat.
meanings.exampleZh: 该队在遭遇失败之前连续赢得了五场比赛。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 consequi（跟随）的过去分词 consecutus，后经英语化为 consecutive
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ secut（跟随）+ ive → 一个接一个跟着来 → 连续的

related.zh: 随之发生的；作为结果的

meanings.exampleEn: The community center offers free vocational training to unemployed residents.
meanings.exampleZh: 社区中心为失业居民提供免费职业培训。

meanings.exampleEn: The community at large was deeply concerned about the safety of the new nuclear plant.
meanings.exampleZh: 广大公众对新核电站的安全深感担忧。

meanings.exampleEn: The monastery practiced a community of goods, with all possessions held in common.
meanings.exampleZh: 该修道院实行财产共有，所有财物共同持有。

meanings.exampleZh: 国际社会谴责冲突地区侵犯人权的行为。

meanings.exampleEn: She tried to console her friend after the devastating loss of his job.
meanings.exampleZh: 在朋友痛失工作后，她试图安慰他。

meanings.exampleEn: The pilot adjusted the settings on the console before takeoff.
meanings.exampleZh: 飞行员在起飞前调整了控制台上的设置。

meanings.exampleEn: We had a long discussion concerning the new policy.

meanings.exampleZh: 不断上升的失业率非常令人担忧。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concernere（混合，筛在一起），由 com-（一起）+ cernere（筛，分开）构成，后经古法语进入英语。

meanings.exampleEn: His actions are not consistent with his words.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的言行不一致。

meanings.exampleZh: 她一直坚持不懈地努力改进这个项目。

meanings.exampleZh: 这两个陈述是并立的，在逻辑上可以共存。

meanings.exampleEn: The material is consistent enough to withstand extreme pressure.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种材料足够坚固，能够承受极端的压力。

consistently.zh: 坚固；坚实；一致；始终如一

meanings.zh: 一贯地；始终如一地；一致地
meanings.exampleEn: She has consistently argued that education is the key to solving social inequality.
meanings.exampleZh: 她一贯主张教育是解决社会不平等问题的关键。

meanings.exampleEn: The economic crisis was a direct consequence of reckless financial policies.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场经济危机是鲁莽金融政策的直接后果。

meanings.exampleEn: The new bridge connects the two cities, greatly facilitating transportation and economic exchange.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座新桥连接了两座城市，极大地促进了交通和经济交流。

meanings.exampleZh: 该软件可以将大文件压缩成更小的尺寸而不损失质量。

meanings.exampleEn: She applied a cold compress to her swollen ankle to reduce the pain.
meanings.exampleZh: 她将冷敷布敷在肿胀的脚踝上以减轻疼痛。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 constare，由 con-（共同）+ stare（站立）构成，意为“站在一起，保持不变”。

meanings.exampleEn: He constantly complains about the heavy workload.
meanings.exampleZh: 他不断抱怨繁重的工作量。

meanings.exampleEn: She complained to the manager about the defective product.
meanings.exampleZh: 她向经理投诉产品有缺陷。

meanings.exampleZh: 囚犯控诉他遭受了酷刑。

meanings.exampleEn: The new skyscraper was conspicuous among the old buildings in the city center.

meanings.exampleEn: The company commenced operations in 2005.

meanings.exampleEn: The conquest of fear is the first step toward true freedom.
meanings.exampleZh: 战胜恐惧是迈向真正自由的第一步。

meanings.exampleEn: The Roman conquest of Britain brought profound cultural changes.
meanings.exampleZh: 罗马对不列颠的征服带来了深刻的文化变革。

meanings.exampleEn: The general displayed his conquests before the cheering crowd.
meanings.exampleZh: 将军在欢呼的人群面前展示了他的战利品。

phrases.zh: 诺曼征服（1066年诺曼底公爵威廉对英格兰的征服）

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor asked for the patient's consent before performing the surgery.

meanings.exampleEn: Human consciousness is the most complex phenomenon in the universe.
meanings.exampleZh: 人类意识是宇宙中最复杂的现象。

meanings.exampleEn: The patient gradually lost consciousness after the severe blow to his head.

meanings.exampleZh: 20世纪60年代的社会运动唤醒了她的政治自觉。

meanings.exampleZh: 她通过不懈的练习设法克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。

meanings.exampleZh: 这支黑马队伍在一场激动人心的决赛中战胜了卫冕冠军。

conservative.zh: 保守的；守旧的；有保存力的

meanings.exampleZh: 他对社会改革的保守态度常常令他的年轻同事感到沮丧。

meanings.exampleEn: The conservative nature of this chemical prevents the material from decaying rapidly.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种化学物质具有保存力，能防止材料迅速腐烂。

meanings.exampleEn: As a staunch conservative, he opposed most progressive tax policies.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为坚定的保守者，他反对大多数累进税政策。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conservare（con- 共同 + servare 保持），后经古法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ serv（保持）+ ative（的）→ 共同保持传统不变 → 保守的

meanings.exampleEn: The modern consumer is increasingly concerned about the environmental impact of the products they purchase.
meanings.exampleZh: 现代消费者越来越关注所购产品对环境的影响。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 consumere，意为“取用、消耗、浪费”，由 con-（加强）+ sumere（拿取）构成。
etymology.tip: con（加强）+ sum（拿取）+ er（人）→ 不断拿取商品的人 → 消费者。

meanings.exampleEn: The amplitude of the philosopher's intellectual vision was unmatched in his era.
meanings.exampleZh: 哲学家思想视野的广阔在他那个时代无与伦比。

meanings.exampleEn: The amplitude of evidence presented in the trial left no room for doubt.
meanings.exampleZh: 审判中呈现的充足证据不容置疑。

meanings.exampleEn: The amplitude of the seismic waves was measured to assess the earthquake's intensity.
meanings.exampleZh: 地震波的幅度被测量以评估地震的强度。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 amplitudo，由 amplus（广大）+ -tudo（名词后缀）构成
etymology.suffix: -itude = 表示性质、状态（名词后缀）
etymology.tip: ampli（广大）+ tude（状态）→ 广阔、幅度；联想 ample（充足）记住“充足”义

meanings.exampleEn: We must take immediate measures to conserve the endangered species in this region.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们必须立即采取措施保护该地区的濒危物种。

meanings.exampleEn: She spread some homemade conserve on the freshly baked bread.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把自制的果酱涂在刚烤好的面包上。

variants.zh: 保护；保存；节约（第三人称单数）
保护；保存；节约（过去式/过去分词）
保护；保存；节约（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conservare，由 con-（加强）+ servare（保持）构成
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ serve（保持）→ 大家一起保持，就是节约、保护

meanings.exampleEn: The new edition of the dictionary contains over 10,000 newly coined words.
meanings.exampleZh: 这本词典的新版本包含一万多个新造词。

meanings.exampleEn: Firefighters struggled to contain the rapidly spreading wildfire.
meanings.exampleZh: 消防员奋力控制迅速蔓延的野火。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 continere（con- 共同 + tenere 握持），后经古法语进入英语
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ tain（握持）→ 把东西握在一起 → 包含、容纳、控制

meanings.exampleEn: She works as a management consultant for a multinational corporation.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在一家跨国公司担任管理顾问。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor acted as a consultant to the government on environmental policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位教授担任政府环境政策的征询意见者。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 consultare（咨询，商议），是 consulere 的反复动词形式
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ sul（商议）+ ant（人）→ 共同商议的人 → 顾问

meanings.exampleEn: After careful consideration, the committee decided to postpone the project.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过仔细考虑，委员会决定推迟该项目。

meanings.exampleEn: He showed great consideration for his elderly neighbors by helping them with their groceries.
meanings.exampleZh: 他非常体贴年长的邻居，帮他们搬运杂货。

meanings.exampleEn: Cost is an important consideration when choosing a new smartphone.
meanings.exampleZh: 选择新智能手机时，成本是一个重要的考虑因素。

etymology.root: sider = 星（源自拉丁语 sidus）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 considerare，由 con-（加强）+ sidus（星）构成，原义为“观察星象”，后引申为“仔细考虑”。
etymology.suffix: -ation = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ sider（星星）→ 一起观星象来决策 → 考虑

meanings.exampleEn: The old woman had a benign smile that put everyone at ease.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位老妇人露出慈祥的微笑，使大家感到自在。

meanings.exampleEn: Fortunately, the tumor was benign and required no aggressive treatment.
meanings.exampleZh: 幸运的是，肿瘤是良性的，不需要激进治疗。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 benignus，由 bene（好）和 gignere（生，产生）组合而成
etymology.suffix: -ign = 形容词后缀（拉丁语 -ignus），表示性质
etymology.tip: bene好 + gn生 → 天生好，即善良的；良性肿瘤也是“好”的肿瘤

meanings.exampleEn: The government's concern for the welfare of the disabled has been widely praised.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府对残疾人福利的关心受到了广泛赞扬。

meanings.exampleEn: The rising unemployment rate has become a major concern for the government.
meanings.exampleZh: 不断上升的失业率已成为政府的主要忧虑。

meanings.exampleEn: The new regulations concern all enterprises engaged in cross-border e-commerce.
meanings.exampleZh: 新规定涉及所有从事跨境电子商务的企业。

meanings.exampleEn: It concerns me that he has not replied to any of my emails.
meanings.exampleZh: 他没有回复我的任何邮件，这让我很担忧。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concernere，由 com-（一起）和 cernere（筛，分开）组成，原义“混合筛选”，后引申为“涉及、关心”。
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ cern（筛）→ 把事物筛到一起产生关联，与你相关才会关心。

meanings.exampleEn: The customer filed a formal complaint about the misleading advertisement after the company refused to offer a refund.
meanings.exampleZh: 在公司拒绝退款后，顾客就误导性广告提出了正式投诉。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 complainte，源自拉丁语 complangere（com- + plangere "捶胸，悲叹"）
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ plaint（捶胸）→ 一起捶胸顿足地抱怨

meanings.exampleEn: The philharmonic orchestra gave a magnificent concert at the national theater last night.
meanings.exampleZh: 昨晚，爱乐乐团在国家剧院举行了一场精彩绝伦的音乐会。

meanings.exampleEn: The two countries acted in concert to impose sanctions on the aggressor.
meanings.exampleZh: 两国一致行动对侵略者实施制裁。

meanings.exampleEn: They concerted their efforts to address the pressing environmental issues.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们协调努力解决紧迫的环境问题。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concertare（协调，竞争），由 com-（共同）+ certare（竞争，努力）构成；后经意大利语 concerto 指和声、音乐会。
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ cert（确定）→ 共同确定 → 一致，和谐；引申为音乐会（众人和声）。

meanings.exampleEn: Climate change poses a serious challenge to global food security.
meanings.exampleZh: 气候变化对全球粮食安全构成了严峻挑战。

meanings.exampleEn: The rebel leader challenged the government's authority by calling for a general strike.
meanings.exampleZh: 叛乱领袖通过号召总罢工来挑战政府的权威。

meanings.exampleEn: The sentry's challenge made the stranger stop and state his business.
meanings.exampleZh: 哨兵的盘问使陌生人停下来说明来意。

meanings.exampleEn: The police challenged the suspect about his whereabouts on the night of the crime.
meanings.exampleZh: 警方盘问嫌疑人关于案发当晚的行踪。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 calumnia（诬告、欺骗），经古法语 chalenge 演变
etymology.tip: challenge 与 calumny 同源，记住‘挑战’源于‘要求澄清/盘问’

meanings.exampleEn: The court's ruling constrains the government from acting arbitrarily.
meanings.exampleZh: 法院的裁决迫使政府不能任意行事。

meanings.exampleEn: Lack of funding constrains the development of scientific research.
meanings.exampleZh: 资金不足限制了科学研究的发展。

meanings.exampleEn: The rebels were constrained in a small cell for months.
meanings.exampleZh: 叛乱者被关押在一间小牢房里数月之久。

variants.zh: 强迫；限制；关押（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 constringere（con- 共同 + stringere 拉紧），经由古法语 constraindre 进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ain 为动词后缀（源自拉丁语 -are 的变体）
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ strain（拉紧）→ 拉到一起 → 限制、约束。

meanings.exampleEn: She looked at the dishonest politician with undisguised contempt.
meanings.exampleZh: 她毫不掩饰地以轻蔑的目光看着那个不诚实的政客。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contemnere（轻视），由 com-（加强）+ temnere（轻视）构成，其过去分词 contemptus 演变为英语名词 contempt。
etymology.tip: con（完全）+ tempt（轻视）→ 完全不放在眼里 → 轻蔑

meanings.exampleEn: The government has taken measures to stimulate domestic consumption.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已采取措施刺激国内消费。

meanings.exampleEn: The consumption of electricity in this region has doubled over the past decade.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区的电力消费量在过去十年间翻了一番。

meanings.exampleEn: In the 19th century, consumption was a common and often fatal disease.
meanings.exampleZh: 在19世纪，痨病是一种常见且往往致命的疾病。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 consumere，由 com-（完全）+ sumere（拿取）构成
etymology.suffix: -tion = 名词后缀，表示行为或结果
etymology.tip: con（完全）+ sumpt（拿取）+ ion → 完全拿取 → 消耗、消费

meanings.exampleEn: The artist's works are highly acclaimed by contemporary critics for their innovative style.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家的作品因其创新风格而受到当代评论家的高度赞誉。

meanings.exampleEn: Unlike many of his contemporaries, the philosopher rejected the prevailing materialism of his era.
meanings.exampleZh: 与他同时代的许多人不同，这位哲学家拒绝了他那个时代盛行的唯物主义。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contemporarius，由 com-（共同）和 temporarius（时间的）组合而成
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ tempor（时间）+ ary（的）→ 共同处于同一时间的 → 同时代的；当代的

meanings.exampleEn: The current economic condition of the country has been severely affected by the global financial crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 该国当前的经济状况受到全球金融危机的严重影响。

meanings.exampleEn: One of the essential conditions for the success of the experiment is precise temperature control.
meanings.exampleZh: 实验成功的基本条件之一是精确的温度控制。

meanings.exampleEn: Living in a remote village gradually conditioned him to a simpler and slower pace of life.
meanings.exampleZh: 在偏远村庄的生活逐渐使他适应了更简单、更缓慢的生活节奏。

meanings.exampleEn: The quality of the raw materials directly conditions the final performance of the product.
meanings.exampleZh: 原材料的质量直接影响产品的最终性能。

phrases.zh: 状况良好；处于良好状态

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 condicere（共同约定），经古法语 condicion 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ dict（说）+ ion（名词）→ 共同说定的东西 → 条件

meanings.exampleEn: He had failed to prepare for the interview; consequently, he was not offered the position.
meanings.exampleZh: 他没有为面试做好准备，所以没有得到那个职位。

variants.zh: 随之发生的；作为结果的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 consequi（跟随），由 con- + sequi 构成，经古法语 consequent 进入英语
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ sequ（跟随）+ -ly → 跟着前面的事情一起发生 → 所以

meanings.exampleEn: The government decided to concentrate all its resources on improving the infrastructure.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府决定将所有资源集中用于改善基础设施。

meanings.exampleEn: It is increasingly difficult for students to concentrate in a noisy and distracting environment.
meanings.exampleZh: 在嘈杂且令人分心的环境中，学生越来越难以集中注意力。

meanings.exampleEn: The mining company concentrates the ore before it is transported to the smelter.
meanings.exampleZh: 矿业公司在将矿石运往冶炼厂之前先对其进行精选。

meanings.exampleEn: This orange concentrate can be diluted with water to make a refreshing drink.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种橙汁浓缩物加水稀释后即可制成清凉饮料。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 concentrare，由 com-（共同）+ centrum（中心）构成
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ centr（中心）+ ate（使）→ 使共同到中心 → 集中

meanings.exampleEn: The laboratory uses specialized containers to store volatile chemicals safely.
meanings.exampleZh: 实验室使用专用容器安全储存挥发性化学品。

meanings.exampleEn: The port handles thousands of containers every day, facilitating global trade.
meanings.exampleZh: 该港口每天处理数千个集装箱，促进全球贸易。

variants.zh: 用集装箱装；使集装箱化

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 continere（共同持有），经由古法语 conteinir，后加名词后缀 -er 表示物
etymology.suffix: -er = 表示物（或执行动作的事物）
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ tain（握）+ er（物）→ 把东西握在一起的东西 → 容器

meanings.exampleEn: The continual noise from the construction site made it impossible for her to concentrate on her studies.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑工地持续不断的噪音使她无法专心学习。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 continuus，由 com-（共同）+ tenere（握住）构成，原义为‘连接在一起的’
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ tin（握住）+ ual（…的）→ 一直握在一起 → 持续不断的

meanings.exampleEn: The complication of the project's logistics delayed its completion by several weeks.
meanings.exampleZh: 项目后勤工作的复杂化使其完成时间推迟了几周。

meanings.exampleEn: Unexpected complications arose during the negotiation, forcing both parties to reconsider their positions.
meanings.exampleZh: 谈判中出现了意想不到的复杂情况，迫使双方重新考虑各自的立场。

phrases.zh: 导致复杂情况；引发并发症

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 complicare（折叠在一起），由 com-（共同）+ plicare（折叠）构成
etymology.suffix: -ation = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ plic（折叠）+ ation（名词）→ 折叠在一起纠缠不清 → 复杂化

commitment.zh: 委托；交押；承担义务；赞助

meanings.exampleEn: She made a firm commitment to support the environmental campaign.
meanings.exampleZh: 她坚定承诺支持环保运动。

meanings.exampleEn: His commitment to the project never wavered despite numerous setbacks.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管遭遇多次挫折，他对项目的投入从未动摇。

meanings.exampleEn: Balancing work and family commitments requires careful time management.
meanings.exampleZh: 平衡工作与家庭责任需要精心管理时间。

meanings.exampleEn: The legal document formalized the commitment of the estate to the trustee.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份法律文件将遗产正式委托给受托人。

phrases.zh: 追求卓越的承诺；对卓越的投入

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 committere（结合、委托），由 com-（一起）+ mittere（发送）构成
etymology.suffix: -ment = 表示行为、结果或状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: com（共同）+ mit（送）+ ment（名词）→ 共同送出承诺，即“承诺、投入”

meanings.exampleEn: The solution can be condensed by boiling off some of the water.
meanings.exampleZh: 通过蒸发掉部分水分，可以使溶液浓缩。

meanings.exampleEn: The author condensed the lengthy report into a concise summary.
meanings.exampleZh: 作者将冗长的报告压缩成一份简洁的摘要。

meanings.exampleEn: You need to condense your speech to fit within the five-minute limit.
meanings.exampleZh: 你需要缩短演讲，以控制在五分钟之内。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 condensare，由 com-（加强）+ densare（使稠密）构成，densus 意为“稠密的”。
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ dens（稠密）+ e → 使稠密到一起 → 浓缩、压缩

meanings.exampleEn: His statement was met with immediate contradiction from the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的发言立刻遭到了听众的反驳。

meanings.exampleEn: There is a clear contradiction between his words and his actions.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的言行之间存在明显的矛盾。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contradictio，由 contra（反对）+ dicere（说）构成
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: contra（相反）+ dict（说）+ ion（名词）→ 说相反的话 → 反驳；矛盾

construct.zh: 构造；建造；对...进行构思；作图

meanings.exampleEn: The government plans to construct a new bridge across the river to ease traffic congestion.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府计划在河上建造一座新桥以缓解交通拥堵。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel is constructed around a complex web of historical events.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说是围绕复杂的历史事件网络构造而成的。

meanings.exampleEn: Researchers constructed a theoretical model to explain the observed phenomena.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究人员构思了一个理论模型来解释观察到的现象。

meanings.exampleEn: Using only a compass and a straightedge, students must construct an equilateral triangle.
meanings.exampleZh: 学生必须仅用圆规和直尺作出一个等边三角形。

meanings.exampleEn: The notion of race is a social construct rather than a biological reality.
meanings.exampleZh: 种族的概念是一种社会构想，而非生物学现实。

variants.zh: 建造；构造（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 construere（堆积、建造），由 com-（共同）+ struere（堆积、建造）构成
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ struct（建造）→ 共同建造 → 构造、建造

meanings.exampleEn: The witness gave contradictory statements that confused the jury.
meanings.exampleZh: 证人给出了相互矛盾的陈述，使陪审团感到困惑。

meanings.exampleEn: His contradictory tone in court undermined his credibility.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在法庭上抗辩的语气削弱了他的可信度。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contradictorius，由 contra（反对）+ dictus（说）构成
etymology.suffix: -ory = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: contra（反对）+ dict（说）+ ory（的）→ 反着说的 → 反驳的；矛盾的

meanings.exampleEn: The evidence presented in the report directly contradicts the witness's testimony.
meanings.exampleZh: 报告中提供的证据直接反驳了证人的证词。

meanings.exampleEn: His actions contradict his stated principles of honesty and integrity.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的行为与他所宣称的诚实正直原则相矛盾。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contradicere，由 contra（反对）+ dicere（说）构成
etymology.tip: contra（相反）+ dict（说）→ 说相反的话 → 反驳、矛盾

contemptuous.zh: 轻蔑的；鄙视的；瞧不起人的

meanings.zh: 轻蔑的；鄙视的；瞧不起人的
meanings.exampleEn: She gave him a contemptuous glance before turning away.
meanings.exampleZh: 她轻蔑地瞥了他一眼，然后转过身去。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contemptus，是 contemnere（轻视）的过去分词
etymology.suffix: -uous = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: con（加强）+ tempt（轻视）+ uous（的）→ 非常轻视的 → 轻蔑的

meanings.exampleEn: The sudden resignation of the CEO threw the company into complete confusion.
meanings.exampleZh: 首席执行官突然辞职使公司陷入完全混乱。

meanings.exampleEn: There is often confusion between the terms "affect" and "effect."
meanings.exampleZh: “affect”和“effect”这两个术语之间经常存在混淆。

meanings.exampleEn: She stared at the map in confusion, unable to find the correct route.
meanings.exampleZh: 她困惑地盯着地图，找不到正确的路线。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confundere（混合、混乱）的过去分词 confusus，由 con-（一起）+ fundere（倒、流）构成。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ fus（流）+ ion → 各种东西流到一起 → 混乱

considerate.zh: 体贴的；体谅的；考虑周到的

meanings.zh: 体贴的；体谅的；考虑周到的
meanings.exampleEn: A considerate manager will always take into account the workload and emotional state of team members before assigning new tasks.
meanings.exampleZh: 一位体贴的经理在分配新任务前，总会考虑团队成员的工作量和情绪状态。

etymology.root: sider = 星；星辰（引申为观察）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 considerare（仔细观察星象以作判断）的过去分词 consideratus，后演变为“考虑周到的”
etymology.suffix: -ate = 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ sider（星）+ ate（形容词）→ 一起观星象、深思熟虑，自然体贴周到

meanings.exampleEn: The results of the experiment were contrary to our initial expectations.
meanings.exampleZh: 实验结果与我们最初的预期相反。

meanings.exampleEn: She is not a pessimist; quite the contrary, she always sees the bright side of things.
meanings.exampleZh: 她不是悲观主义者；恰恰相反，她总能看到事物光明的一面。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contrarius，由 contra（相反）+ -arius（形容词后缀）构成
etymology.suffix: -ary = 形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”
etymology.tip: contra（相反）+ ary（形容词后缀）→ 相反的；记住“contra”就是“反对、相反”的意思。

meanings.exampleEn: The continental climate in this region brings scorching summers and freezing winters.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区的大陆性气候带来炎热的夏季和严寒的冬季。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 continens（连续的，大陆的），由 con- + tenere（持有）构成
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ tin（握住）+ ent + al → 把陆地连在一起的 → 大陆的

meanings.exampleEn: Please analyze the word in the context of the whole passage.
meanings.exampleZh: 请结合整篇文章的上下文来分析这个词。

meanings.exampleEn: The economic crisis should be understood in its historical context.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场经济危机应放在其历史背景中去理解。

meanings.exampleEn: He provided the full context of the dispute before making a judgment.
meanings.exampleZh: 在作出判断之前，他提供了这场争端的完整来龙去脉。

variants.zh: 上下文的；与上下文有关的
在上下文方面；根据上下文

phrases.zh: 在上下文中；结合上下文

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contexere（编织在一起），由 con-（共同）+ texere（编织）构成
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ text（编织）→ 编织在一起的内容 → 上下文

meanings.exampleEn: The two companies have maintained close contact for over a decade.
meanings.exampleZh: 这两家公司十多年来一直保持着密切的联系。

meanings.exampleEn: His job requires constant contact with foreign clients.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的工作需要经常与外国客户交往。

meanings.exampleEn: She has a useful contact in the publishing industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在出版界有一位有用的熟人。

meanings.exampleEn: Avoid direct contact with the toxic substance.
meanings.exampleZh: 避免直接接触这种有毒物质。

meanings.exampleEn: Please contact the administrator if you encounter any technical issues.
meanings.exampleZh: 如果你遇到任何技术问题，请联系管理员。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contactus，由 com-（共同）+ tangere（触摸）的过去分词 tactus 构成
etymology.suffix: -t（来自拉丁语过去分词后缀，表示动作的结果）
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ tact（触）→ 共同触碰 → 接触、联系

related.zh: 完整无缺的；未经触碰的
接触传染的；有感染力的

meanings.exampleEn: The consul arranged for the repatriation of the stranded citizens.
meanings.exampleZh: 领事安排了被困公民的遣返。

meanings.exampleEn: In ancient Rome, a consul held supreme civil and military authority.
meanings.exampleZh: 在古罗马，执政官拥有最高民事和军事权力。

etymology.root: sul（源自拉丁语 consulere） = 商议，咨询
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 consul，原指古罗马执政官，后引申为领事；与 consulere（咨询）有关
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ sul（商议）→ 共同商议的人 → 执政官/领事

meanings.exampleEn: The online booking system makes it convenient for customers to reserve tickets at any time.
meanings.exampleZh: 在线预订系统使顾客可以随时方便地订票。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 convenire（走到一起，适合），由 com-（共同）+ venire（来）构成
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ ven（来）+ ient（的）→ 大家聚到一起都合适 → 方便的

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy has sparked a heated controversy among the public.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项新政策在公众中引发了激烈的争论。

variants.zh: 论争；辩论；论战；争论（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 controversia，由 contra（相反）+ vertere（转）构成，意为“转向相反方向”，引申为“争论”。
etymology.tip: contra（相反）+ vers（转）+ y → 意见转到相反方向 → 争论

meanings.exampleEn: The conventional approach to education often overlooks the creative potential of students.
meanings.exampleZh: 传统的教育方法常常忽视学生的创造潜力。

meanings.exampleEn: She made a conventional remark about the weather to break the awkward silence.
meanings.exampleZh: 她说了句关于天气的客套话，以打破尴尬的沉默。

meanings.exampleEn: The use of this symbol is conventional in mathematical notation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个符号在数学记法中是被约定使用的。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 convenire（聚集、一致），由 con-（共同）+ venire（来）构成，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ vent（来）+ al（的）→ 大家共同来到一起遵守的 → 约定的、传统的。

convert.zh: 皈依者；改变宗教信仰者

meanings.exampleEn: The device can convert solar energy into electricity efficiently.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种设备可以高效地将太阳能转化为电能。

meanings.zh: 皈依者；改变宗教信仰者
meanings.exampleEn: As a recent convert to the faith, she eagerly attended every ceremony.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为最近皈依该信仰的人，她热切地参加每一场仪式。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 convertere，由 con-（共同，加强）+ vertere（转）构成
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ vert（转）→ 一起转到另一个状态 → 转变、转换

meanings.exampleEn: The two companies entered into a cooperative agreement to develop the new technology.
meanings.exampleZh: 两家公司达成了合作协议，共同开发这项新技术。

meanings.exampleEn: The farmers established a cooperative to share the costs of modern agricultural equipment.
meanings.exampleZh: 农民们建立了一个合作社，以分担现代化农业设备的成本。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 cooperari，由 co-（共同）+ operari（工作）构成
etymology.tip: co（共同）+ oper（工作）+ ative（形容词后缀）→ 一起工作的 → 合作的

meanings.exampleEn: The conservation of natural habitats is essential for the survival of endangered species.
meanings.exampleZh: 自然栖息地的保护对濒危物种的生存至关重要。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conservare（con- 共同 + servare 保持、看守），经由古法语和英语演变而来。
etymology.suffix: -ation = 表示行为、状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ serv（保持）+ ation（名词）→ 大家一起保持住 → 保护、保存。

meanings.exampleEn: The international conference on climate change attracted scholars from over fifty countries.
meanings.exampleZh: 这次关于气候变化的国际会议吸引了来自五十多个国家的学者。

variants.zh: 商议；授予（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 记者招待会，新闻发布会

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conferre（聚在一起商议），由 con-（一起）和 ferre（带来）构成
etymology.suffix: -ence = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ fer（带来）+ ence（名词）→ 把大家带到一起 → 会议

meanings.exampleEn: The two companies agreed to cooperate on developing a new renewable energy system.
meanings.exampleZh: 两家公司同意合作开发一种新的可再生能源系统。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 cooperari，由 co-（共同）+ operari（工作）构成
etymology.suffix: -ate = 动词后缀，表示“使成为、做”
etymology.tip: co（共同）+ oper（工作）+ ate（动词后缀）→ 一起工作 → 合作

convenience.zh: 方便；便利的事物；方便的时候

meanings.exampleEn: The convenience of online shopping has changed the way people live.
meanings.exampleZh: 网上购物的方便改变了人们的生活方式。

meanings.exampleEn: The hotel offers every modern convenience, including high-speed internet and a fitness center.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家酒店提供各种现代便利设施，包括高速互联网和健身中心。

meanings.exampleEn: Please call me back at your earliest convenience.
meanings.exampleZh: 请在您方便的时候尽早给我回电话。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 convenire，意为“走到一起；适合”，由 con-（共同）+ venire（来）构成。
etymology.suffix: -ience = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ ven（来）+ ience（名词后缀）→ 大家一起来到合适的地方 → 方便、便利。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee will convene at 9 a.m. tomorrow to discuss the urgent issue.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会将于明早9点集合，讨论这一紧急问题。

meanings.exampleEn: The president convened an emergency meeting to address the financial crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 总统召集了一次紧急会议，以应对金融危机。

variants.zh: 集合；召集（第三人称单数）
集合；召集（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 convenire（走到一起，集合），由 com-（一起）+ venire（来）构成
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ ven（来）+ e → 大家一起来 → 集合、召集

meanings.zh: 随之发生的；作为结果的
meanings.exampleEn: The economic crisis and the consequent unemployment rate caused widespread social unrest.
meanings.exampleZh: 经济危机以及随之而来的失业率引发了广泛的社会动荡。

phrases.zh: 间接损失；随之发生的损失

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 consequi（跟随其后），由 con-（共同）+ sequi（跟随）构成
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ sequ（跟随）+ ent（的）→ 一起跟随而来的 → 随之发生的

meanings.exampleEn: The commander made a strategic decision to withdraw the troops before dawn.
meanings.exampleZh: 指挥官在黎明前做出了撤军的战略决定。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 commander，源自拉丁语 commandare，由 com-（加强）+ mandare（命令、委托）构成
etymology.tip: com（加强）+ mand（命令）+ er（人）→ 发号施令的人 → 指挥官

meanings.exampleEn: The evidence presented in court convinced the jury of his innocence.
meanings.exampleZh: 法庭上出示的证据使陪审团相信他是无辜的。

variants.zh: 令人信服的；有说服力的
令人信服地；有说服力地

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 convincere，意为“彻底征服、证明有罪”，后引申为“说服、使相信”
etymology.tip: con（完全）+ vince（征服）→ 彻底征服对方的思想 → 说服，使相信

meanings.exampleEn: She has been contending against great odds to achieve her dream.
meanings.exampleZh: 她一直在与巨大的困难作斗争以实现自己的梦想。

meanings.exampleEn: The two parties are contending for control of the parliament.
meanings.exampleZh: 两党正在为控制议会而斗争。

meanings.exampleEn: Several teams will contend for the championship this season.
meanings.exampleZh: 本赛季有几支队伍将争夺冠军。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 contendere，由 com-（一起）和 tendere（伸展）组成，原义为“一起伸展、奋力追求”，后引申为竞争、斗争。
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ tend（伸展）= 一起伸展手臂去争夺目标，即“竞争、奋斗”。

meanings.zh: 人造的；勉强的；不自然的
meanings.exampleEn: The ending of the novel felt contrived and failed to resonate with readers.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说的结尾显得很牵强，未能引起读者共鸣。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 controver，源自拉丁语 contropare（比较，构思），由 con- + tropare 构成
etymology.tip: con-（加强）+ trive（发明）→ 刻意发明出来的 → 不自然的，勉强的

meanings.exampleEn: The construction of the new bridge will take two years.
meanings.exampleZh: 新桥的建造将耗时两年。

meanings.exampleEn: The construction of this sentence is grammatically complex.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个句子的结构在语法上很复杂。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient construction still stands firmly after centuries.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古老的建筑物历经数百年依然屹立不倒。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 constructio，由前缀 con- 和动词 struere（建造）构成
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、过程或结果
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ struct（建造）+ ion（名词）→ 共同建造 → 建筑

meanings.exampleEn: The annual convention of the association will be held in Shanghai next month.
meanings.exampleZh: 该协会的年度大会将于下个月在上海举行。

meanings.exampleEn: The two countries signed a convention on environmental protection.
meanings.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项环境保护协定。

meanings.exampleEn: By convention, the chairman is always seated at the head of the table.
meanings.exampleZh: 按照惯例，主席总是坐在桌子的上首。

meanings.exampleEn: It is a social convention that men open doors for women in some cultures.
meanings.exampleZh: 在某些文化中，男士为女士开门是一种社会约定。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 convenire（聚集，集会），由 con-（共同）+ venire（来）构成
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: con（共同）+ vent（来）+ ion → 大家共同来到一起 → 集会、大会；引申为共同遵守的协定、惯例

meanings.exampleEn: The company moved to consolidate its position in the global market by acquiring several smaller rivals.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司通过收购几家较小的竞争对手来巩固其在全球市场的地位。

meanings.exampleEn: The two banks consolidated their operations to form a single financial giant.
meanings.exampleZh: 这两家银行合并了业务，组成了一个金融巨头。

meanings.exampleEn: Several small firms consolidated to compete more effectively against multinational corporations.
meanings.exampleZh: 几家小公司联合起来，以便更有效地与跨国公司竞争。

variants.zh: 巩固；合并（第三人称单数）

phrases.zh: 合并债务（将多笔债务合并为一笔）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 consolidare，由 con-（共同）和 solidare（使坚固）组成
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ solid（坚固）+ ate（使）→ 使一起坚固 → 巩固、联合

meanings.exampleEn: The confession was obtained under constraint, which made it inadmissible in court.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份供词是在强制下获得的，因此法庭不予采纳。

meanings.exampleEn: The constraint of limited resources hindered the project's progress.
meanings.exampleZh: 有限资源的约束阻碍了项目的进展。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 constringere（con- + stringere 拉紧），经由古法语 constreinte 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -t = 名词后缀（构成抽象名词）
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ strain（拉紧）+ t（名词）→ 一起拉紧 → 约束

meanings.exampleEn: The teacher made several corrections to my essay before returning it.
meanings.exampleZh: 老师在我的作文上做了几处订正后才把它还给我。

meanings.exampleEn: Please mark all the corrections in red ink so that I can review them easily.
meanings.exampleZh: 请用红笔标出所有改正的地方，以便我能轻松查看。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 correctio，由 com-（加强）+ regere（引导，使直）构成，经古法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ion 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: cor（加强）+ rect（正）+ ion（名词）→ 把错误彻底改“正”的过程。

conversion.zh: 转变；转换；改变宗教信仰；换位法

meanings.exampleEn: The conversion of solar energy into electricity is a key technology for sustainable development.
meanings.exampleZh: 将太阳能转化为电能是可持续发展的关键技术。

meanings.exampleEn: Her conversion to Buddhism surprised many of her long-time friends.
meanings.exampleZh: 她改信佛教让许多老朋友感到惊讶。

meanings.exampleEn: In logic, conversion is a valid inference that swaps the subject and predicate of a proposition.
meanings.exampleZh: 在逻辑学中，换位法是一种交换命题主词和谓词的有效推理。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 conversio，由 con- 和 vertere（转）构成
etymology.prefix: con- = 共同，一起；加强意义
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: con（一起）+ vers（转）+ ion（名词）→ 一起转过来 → 转变

confidential.zh: 机密的；获他人信赖的；易于信任他人的

meanings.exampleEn: The confidential report was locked in the manager's safe.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份机密报告被锁在经理的保险柜里。

meanings.exampleEn: As a confidential assistant, she was entrusted with many private matters.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名获他人信赖的助理，她受托处理许多私人事务。

meanings.exampleEn: His confidential nature made him an easy target for dishonest people.
meanings.exampleZh: 他易于信任他人的性格使他容易成为不诚实之人的目标。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 confidere（完全信任），由 con-（加强）+ fidere（信任）构成
etymology.suffix: -ential = 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
