meanings.exampleEn: The gardener meticulously pruned the rose bushes to enhance the aesthetic appeal of the courtyard.
meanings.exampleZh: 园丁精心修剪玫瑰丛，以提升庭院的美感。

meanings.exampleEn: As a skilled gardener, he cultivated a variety of exotic flowers that thrived in the greenhouse.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为技艺精湛的花匠，他培育了多种在温室中茁壮生长的珍奇花卉。

meanings.exampleEn: The renowned gardener advocated sustainable landscaping practices that harmonize with local ecosystems.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位著名的园艺家倡导与当地生态系统相协调的可持续景观设计。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 gardin，源于日耳曼语
etymology.suffix: -er（表示从事某职业或活动的人）
etymology.tip: garden（花园）+ -er（人）= 在花园里工作的人，即园丁

meanings.exampleEn: The scientist finally won glory for his decades of quiet research.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位科学家因数十年的潜心研究终于赢得了荣誉。

meanings.exampleEn: The glory of the sunset over the canyon left every visitor speechless.
meanings.exampleZh: 峡谷上空日落的壮丽景象让每位游客都惊叹不已。

meanings.zh: 自豪；得意（常与 in 连用）
meanings.exampleEn: She glories in the fact that her team has never lost a single match.
meanings.exampleZh: 她为自己的团队从未输过一场比赛而感到自豪。

variants.zh: 自豪；得意（第三人称单数）
自豪；得意（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 gloria（荣誉，赞美），经古法语 glorie 进入英语。
etymology.tip: glor- 是“光荣”，联想“光荣(glo)的日子(ry)”。

meanings.exampleEn: The ornate fountain in the city square serves as a popular gathering spot for tourists and locals alike.
meanings.exampleZh: 城市广场上那座华丽的喷泉是游客和当地人都喜爱的聚集地。

meanings.exampleEn: The crystal-clear fountain bubbling from the rocks provided the only source of potable water for the expedition.
meanings.exampleZh: 从岩石间涌出的清澈泉水为探险队提供了唯一的饮用水源。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient manuscript is regarded as the fountain of many modern philosophical ideas.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份古代手稿被视为许多现代哲学思想的源头。

meanings.exampleEn: The underground fountain that feeds this lake has been contaminated by industrial waste.
meanings.exampleZh: 为这个湖泊提供水源的地下泉水已被工业废料污染。

variants.zh: 喷泉；泉水；源头；水源（复数）

phrases.zh: 青春之泉；使人恢复活力的源泉

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 fons（属格 fontis）的派生词 fontanus，经古法语 fontaine 进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ain（名词后缀，表示与...有关的事物）
etymology.tip: fount（泉源）+ -ain（名词后缀）→ 泉源涌出的水，即“喷泉”。

meanings.exampleEn: The glow of the sunset painted the entire sky in shades of orange and pink.
meanings.exampleZh: 落日的余晖将整片天空染成了橙红相间的色彩。

meanings.exampleEn: She felt a warm glow of pride as she received the award.
meanings.exampleZh: 领奖时，她感到一股温暖的自豪感涌上心头。

meanings.exampleEn: The embers still glowed in the fireplace long after the fire had died down.
meanings.exampleZh: 火熄灭很久之后，壁炉里的余烬仍在发光发热。

meanings.exampleEn: Her face glowed with excitement when she heard the good news.
meanings.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她脸上洋溢着兴奋的光彩。

variants.zh: 发光；发热；容光焕发（过去式/过去分词）
发光；发热；容光焕发（第三人称单数）
炽热的；容光焕发的；热烈的
热情洋溢地；容光焕发地

etymology.origin: 古英语 glōwan，意为发光、发热；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: glow 联想“光”在流动，发光发热即 glow。

meanings.exampleEn: The gracious hostess made every guest feel welcome and at ease.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位亲切的女主人让每位客人都感到宾至如归。

meanings.exampleEn: The king was gracious to the defeated rebels and spared their lives.
meanings.exampleZh: 国王对投降的叛军宽厚仁慈，饶了他们一命。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 gratiosus，源于 gratia（恩惠、喜爱）
etymology.tip: grat（恩惠）+ -ious（充满…的）→ 充满恩惠的 → 亲切的、慈善的

meanings.exampleEn: The mountain goat clambered up the sheer cliff with astonishing agility.
meanings.exampleZh: 那只山羊以惊人的敏捷攀上了陡峭的悬崖。

meanings.exampleEn: He was made the goat for the company's financial losses.
meanings.exampleZh: 他成了公司财务损失的替罪羊。

meanings.exampleEn: The lecherous old goat was notorious for harassing young women.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个好色的老色鬼因骚扰年轻女性而臭名昭著。

phrases.en: separate the sheep from the goats

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

golden.zh: 金的；含金的；金色的；贵重的

meanings.exampleEn: The golden ornaments in the tomb attest to the extraordinary craftsmanship of the ancient civilization.
meanings.exampleZh: 墓中的金饰证明了古代文明非凡的工艺水平。

meanings.exampleEn: The setting sun cast a golden glow over the tranquil surface of the lake.
meanings.exampleZh: 落日将金色的余晖洒在宁静的湖面上。

meanings.exampleEn: She seized the golden opportunity to study abroad at a prestigious university.
meanings.exampleZh: 她抓住了这个出国进入名校深造的绝佳机会。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 gylden，由 gold（金）加形容词后缀 -en 构成
etymology.suffix: -en = 形容词后缀，表示“由……制成的；似……的”
etymology.tip: gold（金）+ -en（形容词后缀）→ 金的、金色的，联想“金子做的”就是 golden。

meanings.exampleEn: The general opinion is that the new policy will benefit the economy.
meanings.exampleZh: 普遍的观点认为新政策将有利于经济。

meanings.exampleEn: Please give me a general idea of the project before we start.
meanings.exampleZh: 在我们开始之前，请给我一个项目的大体概念。

meanings.exampleEn: The general commanded his troops to advance at dawn.
meanings.exampleZh: 将军命令他的部队在黎明时前进。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 generalis，源自 genus（种类，种族）
etymology.tip: gen（种类）+ al（的）→ 属于同一种类的 → 普遍的，一般的

meanings.exampleEn: The old fuse blew out when the microwave and the kettle were switched on simultaneously.
meanings.exampleZh: 当微波炉和水壶同时开启时，旧保险丝烧断了。

meanings.exampleEn: The soldier lit the fuse and retreated to a safe distance before the explosion.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵点燃导火线，退到安全距离后才发生爆炸。

meanings.exampleEn: Copper and zinc can be fused to form brass, an alloy with useful properties.
meanings.exampleZh: 铜和锌可以熔合形成黄铜，这是一种具有实用性能的合金。

熔化；融合（fuse的第三人称单数）

etymology.tip: fus=流/熔，保险丝熔断让电流流动，金属熔化融合。

meanings.exampleEn: The following analysis, based on extensive field research, reveals the underlying causes of the phenomenon.
meanings.exampleZh: 以下分析基于广泛的实地研究，揭示了这一现象的根本原因。

meanings.exampleZh: 以下是委员会经过数月审议后提出的关键建议。

meanings.exampleEn: Despite his controversial views, the professor has garnered a devoted following among postgraduate students.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管观点颇具争议，这位教授在研究生中赢得了一群忠实的追随者。

meanings.exampleEn: Following the announcement of the merger, the company's stock price soared unexpectedly.
meanings.exampleZh: 在宣布合并之后，该公司股价意外飙升。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 folgian，意为跟随；加上分词后缀 -ing 构成现在分词/形容词/名词
etymology.suffix: -ing（表示分词/动名词，或构成形容词/名词）

meanings.exampleEn: The rapid advancement of genetics has revolutionized our understanding of hereditary diseases.
meanings.exampleZh: 遗传学的飞速发展彻底改变了我们对遗传性疾病的认识。

meanings.exampleEn: The geographical features of the region have a significant impact on its climate and economic development.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区的地理特征对其气候和经济发展有着重大影响。

etymology.tip: geo（地球）+ graph（写）+ ical（的）→ 描述地球的 → 地理的

meanings.exampleEn: A faint gleam of light penetrated the dense fog, guiding the lost travelers.
meanings.exampleZh: 一丝微光穿透浓雾，为迷路的旅行者指引了方向。

meanings.exampleEn: The polished silverware gleamed under the soft candlelight in the banquet hall.

闪烁；发微光（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 gubernare（掌舵，引申为治理）
etymology.suffix: -ment = 表示行为、结果或状态的名词后缀

meanings.exampleEn: The sunset over the ocean was absolutely gorgeous, painting the sky in vivid shades of orange and purple.
meanings.exampleZh: 海上的日落美得令人惊叹，将天空染成鲜艳的橙色和紫色。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 gorgias（优雅的、时髦的），可能源自古法语 gorge（喉咙），因颈部佩戴珠宝装饰而得名
etymology.tip: 喉咙（gorge）上戴满珠宝，显得华丽灿烂。

meanings.exampleEn: The experienced glider soared effortlessly above the valley, riding thermal currents.
meanings.exampleZh: 经验丰富的滑翔员乘着热气流在山谷上空轻松翱翔。

meanings.exampleEn: The students struggled to grasp the abstract concepts of solid geometry in their advanced mathematics course.
meanings.exampleZh: 学生们在高等数学课程中努力理解立体几何的抽象概念。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 geometria，由 geo（土地）+ metron（测量）+ -ia（名词后缀）构成，原意为“土地测量”，后引申为几何学。

meanings.exampleZh: 车头灯刺眼的光芒使人无法看清道路。

meanings.exampleZh: 她隔着会议桌向他投去充满敌意的怒视。

meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家运用几何图案在画作中营造出一种秩序感和对称感。

goddess.zh: 女神；美女；受崇拜的女性

meanings.exampleZh: 在希腊神话中，雅典娜是智慧与战争女神。

meanings.exampleZh: 这位女演员被誉为银幕女神。

meanings.zh: 油炸食物（常用复数 fries，指炸薯条）

meanings.exampleZh: 他点了一个汉堡，配一份炸薯条和一杯奶昔。

meanings.exampleEn: The glitter of the stars on the lake was breathtaking.

meanings.exampleZh: 钻石在聚光灯下闪闪发光。

meanings.exampleEn: The adhesive properties of glue make it indispensable in woodworking.
meanings.exampleZh: 胶的粘合特性使其在木工中不可或缺。

meanings.exampleZh: 气候变化是一个需要国际合作应对的全球性挑战。

meanings.exampleZh: 这份报告对公司财务业绩提供了一个综合性的视角。

meanings.exampleZh: 外科医生在开始精细手术前仔细地给双手戴上手套。

etymology.origin: 古英语 glōf，基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

phrases.zh: 孙子和孙女；外孙和外孙女

meanings.exampleZh: 那个未解决的问题使他在整个会议期间烦躁不安。

meanings.exampleEn: The flowing water gradually fretted the rocks into smooth pebbles.
meanings.exampleZh: 流水逐渐将岩石侵蚀成光滑的卵石。

meanings.exampleEn: She fretted over the possible consequences of her decision.
meanings.exampleZh: 她为自己决定可能带来的后果而焦虑不安。

meanings.exampleEn: The metal surface fretted under the continuous friction.
meanings.exampleZh: 金属表面在持续摩擦下磨损了。

variants.zh: 使烦躁；磨损（过去式/过去分词）
使烦躁；磨损（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 fretan，由 for-（完全）+ etan（吃）构成，本义为‘吃掉、消耗’，引申为磨损、烦躁。
etymology.tip: for-（完全）+ etan（吃）→ 完全吃掉 → 磨损；心里被完全吃掉 → 烦躁

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient Greeks made significant contributions to philosophy and democracy.
meanings.exampleZh: 古希腊人对哲学和民主做出了重大贡献。

meanings.exampleEn: She has been learning Greek for three years in order to read the New Testament in its original language.
meanings.exampleZh: 她学希腊语已经三年了，为的是阅读原文版的《新约》。

meanings.zh: 希腊的；希腊人的；希腊语的
meanings.exampleEn: The Greek islands attract millions of tourists every year with their stunning landscapes.
meanings.exampleZh: 希腊群岛以其绝美的风景每年吸引数百万游客。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Graecus，源自古希腊语 Graikos（希腊人的自称）
etymology.tip: Greek 中的 Grec- 表示“希腊”，看到 Greek 即联想到“希腊的、希腊人、希腊语”。

meanings.exampleEn: The folds of the curtain created an elegant drape.
meanings.exampleZh: 窗帘的褶层形成了优雅的垂坠。

meanings.exampleEn: The old map was torn along the folds.
meanings.exampleZh: 旧地图沿着折痕撕裂了。

meanings.exampleEn: The shepherd counted the sheep as they entered the fold.
meanings.exampleZh: 牧羊人在羊群进入羊栏时清点数量。

meanings.exampleEn: He folded the document carefully and slipped it into his pocket.
meanings.exampleZh: 他仔细折叠好文件，然后塞进口袋。

meanings.exampleEn: The eagle folded its wings and dived toward the prey.
meanings.exampleZh: 老鹰合拢翅膀，向猎物俯冲。

meanings.exampleEn: The startup folded within a year due to mismanagement.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家初创公司因管理不善在一年内倒闭了。

etymology.origin: 古英语 fealdan，与德语 falten 同源
etymology.tip: fold 本身即词根，意为折叠；unfold 就是展开，enfold 就是包裹。

governor.zh: (美)州长；(英)总督；统治者；管理者

meanings.exampleEn: The governor vetoed the bill, citing fiscal concerns for the state's budget.
meanings.exampleZh: 州长以对州预算的财政担忧为由否决了该法案。

meanings.exampleEn: The colonial governor imposed a series of taxes that sparked widespread resistance.
meanings.exampleZh: 殖民地总督征收一系列税收，引发了广泛的抵抗。

meanings.exampleEn: In ancient times, a governor was expected to maintain order and justice within his province.
meanings.exampleZh: 在古代，统治者被期望在其辖区内维持秩序与正义。

meanings.exampleEn: As the governor of the central bank, she must balance inflation control with economic growth.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为央行管理者，她必须平衡控制通胀与经济增长。

variants.zh: 州长；总督；统治者；管理者（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 gubernare（掌舵，统治），经古法语 governeur 进入英语，原义为‘舵手’。
etymology.tip: govern（统治）+ or（人）→ 统治者；州长就是州的‘掌舵人’。

meanings.exampleEn: The hymn is sung to glorify the divine grace that sustains humanity.
meanings.exampleZh: 这首赞美诗旨在颂扬维系人类的神圣恩典。

meanings.exampleEn: Critics accused the film of glorifying the violent history of the colonial era.
meanings.exampleZh: 批评者指责这部电影美化了殖民时代的暴力历史。

meanings.exampleEn: The biography tends to glorify its subject rather than offer a balanced account.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部传记倾向于吹捧其传主，而非提供客观公正的叙述。

meanings.exampleEn: The architect's innovative design glorified the city's skyline with a majestic tower.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑师富有创意的设计以一座宏伟的塔楼为城市天际线增添了辉煌。

variants.zh: 赞美；美化（第三人称单数）
赞美；美化（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 gloria（光荣）与 -ficare（使成为）的组合，经古法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: glor（光荣）+ -fy（使）→ 使光荣，引申为赞美、美化。

meanings.exampleEn: The Germans are famous for their engineering precision.
meanings.exampleZh: 德国人以工程精准著称。

meanings.exampleEn: She has been learning German for three years and can now read Nietzsche in the original.
meanings.exampleZh: 她学德语已经三年，现在能读尼采原著了。

meanings.zh: 德国的；德国人的；德语的
meanings.exampleEn: German culture has had a profound influence on classical music.
meanings.exampleZh: 德国文化对古典音乐产生了深远影响。

etymology.root: german = 同父母的，真正的（拉丁语）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Germanus，原指同父母的，后指日耳曼人
etymology.tip: German 与 Germany 同源，Germany 是德国，German 是德国人/德语

meanings.exampleEn: My grandmother used to tell me stories about the war when I was a child.
meanings.exampleZh: 我小时候，祖母常给我讲关于战争的故事。

meanings.exampleEn: The fossil is believed to be the grandmother of all modern primates.
meanings.exampleZh: 这块化石被认为是所有现代灵长类动物的女祖先。

phrases.zh: 祖母的脚步（一种儿童游戏）

phrases.en: teach one's grandmother to suck eggs

etymology.origin: 由 grand（大的，隔代的）+ mother（母亲）复合而成；mother 来自古英语 mōdor
etymology.prefix: grand-（表示隔代的，辈分上大一代）
etymology.tip: grand（隔代的）+ mother（母亲）= 祖母，即“上一代的母亲”。

related.zh: 祖父；祖母；外祖父；外祖母

meanings.exampleEn: Visitors are requested to leave their umbrellas in the hall before entering the auditorium.
meanings.exampleZh: 访客被要求在进入礼堂前将雨伞留在门厅。

meanings.exampleEn: The echoing footsteps in the marble hall alerted the security guard to someone approaching.
meanings.exampleZh: 大理石走廊里回荡的脚步声提醒了保安有人正在靠近。

meanings.exampleEn: The commencement ceremony was held in the grand hall, which could accommodate over two thousand graduates and their families.
meanings.exampleZh: 毕业典礼在宏伟的会堂举行，该会堂可容纳两千多名毕业生及其家人。

variants.zh: 门厅；走廊；会堂（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 古英语 heall，意为“覆盖的大厅、住所”，后引申为公共建筑中的门厅、走廊或会堂。
etymology.tip: 联想记忆：h + all，大厅（hall）能容纳所有人（all）。

meanings.exampleEn: A flash of lightning illuminated the entire sky.
meanings.exampleZh: 一道闪电照亮了整个天空。

meanings.exampleEn: A sudden flash of inspiration led to a breakthrough in his research.
meanings.exampleZh: 突然闪现的灵感使他的研究取得了突破。

meanings.exampleEn: The car disappeared in a flash around the corner.
meanings.exampleZh: 那辆车一瞬间就消失在拐角处。

meanings.exampleEn: The lighthouse beacon flashed every ten seconds.
meanings.exampleZh: 灯塔的灯光每十秒闪一次。

meanings.exampleEn: A brilliant idea flashed through her mind during the lecture.
meanings.exampleZh: 讲座期间，一个绝妙的想法在她脑海中闪现。

meanings.exampleEn: He flashed his headlights to warn the oncoming driver.
meanings.exampleZh: 他闪动车灯以警告迎面而来的司机。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；源自中古英语 flasshen，原意为“溅洒”，后引申为“闪光”，属拟声词。
etymology.tip: flash 音似“闪啦”，联想一道光闪过。

meanings.exampleEn: The gross weight of the container is far heavier than its net weight.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个集装箱的毛重比净重重得多。

meanings.exampleEn: The movie's gross scenes made many audience members feel uncomfortable.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部电影中令人恶心的场景让许多观众感到不适。

meanings.exampleEn: The company's gross for the fiscal year exceeded all expectations.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司本财年的总额超出了所有人的预期。

meanings.exampleEn: The blockbuster grossed over one billion dollars worldwide within a month.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部大片在一个月内全球总收入超过十亿美元。

variants.zh: 总收入为（第三人称单数）
总收入为（过去式/过去分词）
更粗俗的；更令人恶心的（比较级）
最粗俗的；最令人恶心的（最高级）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 grossus，意为“厚的、粗大的”，后引申为“总的、毛的”以及“粗俗的”等含义。
etymology.tip: gross 本义“粗大”，粗大的东西往往“总量”大，也容易显得“粗俗”。

meanings.exampleEn: The path was covered with loose gravel, making it difficult to walk.
meanings.exampleZh: 小路上铺满了松散的砂砾，行走起来很困难。

meanings.exampleEn: Workers graveled the driveway to prepare for the winter.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们用砾石铺了车道，为冬天做准备。

variants.zh: 用砾石铺（第三人称单数）

etymology.tip: grave（砾石）+ -el（小）→ 小石子，即砂砾、碎石。

meanings.exampleEn: The connoisseur savored each grape, noting its subtle notes of oak and honey.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位品酒师细细品尝每一颗葡萄，感受其中微妙的橡木与蜂蜜风味。

meanings.exampleEn: The grape, once established, can produce fruit for decades in well-drained soil.
meanings.exampleZh: 葡萄树一旦成活，在排水良好的土壤中可以结果数十年。

phrases.zh: 酸葡萄（比喻因得不到而贬低某事物）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 grape（钩子，葡萄串），原指采摘葡萄用的钩子，后转指葡萄；属基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: grape 音似“格瑞普”，想象格瑞普在葡萄园里摘葡萄。

meanings.exampleEn: The experienced guide led the tourists through the narrow alleys of the ancient city.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位经验丰富的导游带领游客穿过了古城的狭窄小巷。

meanings.exampleEn: A mentor should guide young researchers toward independent thinking rather than merely giving answers.
meanings.exampleZh: 导师应当引导年轻研究者走向独立思考，而不仅仅是给出答案。

variants.zh: 引导；指导（第三人称单数）
引导；指导（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 guider，意为“引导、带领”，与日耳曼语有关。
etymology.tip: 基础词汇，可联想“guide”=“给（g）你（ui）的（de）方向”，即引导方向。

gently.zh: 温和地；温柔地；轻轻地；逐渐地

meanings.exampleEn: She gently criticized his work, offering constructive suggestions.
meanings.exampleZh: 她温和地批评了他的工作，并提出了建设性的建议。

meanings.exampleEn: The nurse gently held the trembling child's hand.
meanings.exampleZh: 护士温柔地握住那个颤抖的孩子的手。

meanings.exampleEn: He gently placed the antique vase on the shelf.
meanings.exampleZh: 他轻轻地把古董花瓶放在架子上。

meanings.exampleEn: The path gently ascends toward the mountain peak.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条小路逐渐向山峰攀升。

phrases.zh: 轻微使用过的；九成新的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语gentilis（属于同一家族的），经古法语gentil进入英语，原义为“高贵的”，后引申为“温和的”；gently由gentle加副词后缀-ly构成。
etymology.tip: gentle（温和的）+ -ly = 温和地；记住“温柔的人（gentle）做事总是轻轻地（gently）”。

meanings.exampleEn: He has a habit of biting his nails when he is nervous.
meanings.exampleZh: 他紧张时有咬指甲的习惯。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 habitus（状态、衣着），由 habere（持有）的过去分词演变而来
etymology.tip: 长期“持有”某种行为方式，就成了“习惯”

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient grove was shrouded in mist, its gnarled oaks standing as silent witnesses to centuries of history.
meanings.exampleZh: 那片古老的小树林笼罩在薄雾中，虬曲的橡树如同几个世纪历史的沉默见证者。

etymology.origin: 古英语 grāf，词源不明，属基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: grove 与 grow 形近，想象树木生长成一片小树林。

meanings.exampleEn: She scooped up a handful of sand and let it trickle through her fingers.
meanings.exampleZh: 她捧起一把沙子，任其从指缝间流下。

meanings.exampleEn: Only a handful of students managed to pass the rigorous examination.
meanings.exampleZh: 只有少数学生通过了这场严格的考试。

meanings.exampleEn: The rebellious teenager is quite a handful for his parents.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个叛逆的少年让他的父母相当头疼。

etymology.origin: 古英语 hand + 后缀 -ful

meanings.exampleEn: The haunting melody of the guitar echoed through the concert hall, evoking a profound sense of nostalgia.
meanings.exampleZh: 吉他的萦绕旋律在音乐厅中回荡，唤起了一种深深的怀旧感。

etymology.origin: 来自西班牙语 guitarra，最终源自希腊语 kithara（里拉琴）
etymology.tip: guitar 是 kithara 的音译演变，看到 guitar 就想到“吉他”。

guilty.zh: 犯罪的；有过失的；自觉有错的；心虚的

meanings.exampleEn: The jury found the defendant guilty of first-degree murder.
meanings.exampleZh: 陪审团裁定被告犯有一级谋杀罪。

meanings.exampleEn: He was guilty of neglecting his duties during the crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在危机期间疏于职守，是有过失的。

meanings.exampleEn: She felt guilty about not visiting her parents more often.
meanings.exampleZh: 她因没有更常看望父母而感到内疚。

meanings.exampleEn: His guilty look gave away the fact that he had broken the vase.
meanings.exampleZh: 他心虚的表情暴露了他打碎花瓶的事实。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 gyltig，由 gylt（罪）+ -ig（形容词后缀）构成
etymology.suffix: -y（形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”）
etymology.tip: gylt（罪）+ y（形容词后缀）→ 有罪的；引申为内疚、心虚

meanings.exampleEn: The new employee was given a comprehensive handbook on the company's policies and procedures.
meanings.exampleZh: 新员工收到了一本关于公司政策和程序的综合手册。

etymology.origin: 古英语 hand + boc，原义为“手边常备的书”
etymology.tip: 手边常翻的书就是手册

meanings.exampleEn: The local grocer stocks a wide variety of organic produce to meet the growing demand from health-conscious residents.
meanings.exampleZh: 当地食品商储备了种类繁多的有机农产品，以满足注重健康的居民日益增长的需求。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 grossier（批发商），源自中世纪拉丁语 grossarius，与 gross（大量的）有关
etymology.tip: gross（大量的）+ -er（人）→ 做大批量买卖的人 → 食品商

meanings.exampleEn: The university received substantial grants from the government to fund its cutting-edge research projects.
meanings.exampleZh: 该大学从政府获得了大量拨款，以资助其前沿研究项目。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee grants scholarships to students who demonstrate exceptional academic merit.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会向表现出卓越学术才能的学生授予奖学金。

variants.zh: 授予；给予；承认（过去式/过去分词）
授予；给予；承认（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 graanter，最终源自拉丁语 credere（信任）
etymology.tip: grant 源于拉丁语 credere（信任），授予（grant）即基于信任（credit）

meanings.exampleEn: The greenhouse maintains a stable temperature for tropical plants throughout the year.
meanings.exampleZh: 温室全年为热带植物保持稳定的温度。

etymology.origin: 复合词，来自古英语 grēne（绿色）和 hūs（房屋），后指用于种植植物的玻璃暖房。
etymology.tip: green（绿色）+ house（房子）= 绿色的房子，即温室。

meanings.exampleEn: Her natural glamour captivated everyone at the gala.
meanings.exampleZh: 她天生的魅力迷住了晚会上的每一个人。

meanings.exampleEn: The glamour of the ancient castle drew countless tourists each year.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古老城堡的迷人美每年吸引着无数游客。

meanings.exampleEn: The witch's glamour plunged the prince into an enchanted sleep.
meanings.exampleZh: 女巫的魔法使王子陷入了魔咒般的沉睡。

phrases.zh: 魅力女郎；迷人的女子（常指模特或演员）
魅力模特（以性感形象为主的模特）

etymology.origin: 来自苏格兰语 glamour，为 grammar（语法）的变体；中世纪时语法常与魔法、巫术联系在一起，后引申为魅力。

meanings.exampleEn: The grey clouds gathered ominously, foreshadowing the impending storm.
meanings.exampleZh: 灰色的云层不祥地聚集，预示着暴风雨即将来临。

meanings.exampleEn: The artist used various shades of grey to create a somber atmosphere in the painting.
meanings.exampleZh: 艺术家使用各种深浅不一的灰色来营造画作中阴郁的氛围。

meanings.exampleEn: Years of stress and anxiety had begun to grey his hair prematurely.
meanings.exampleZh: 多年的压力和焦虑使他的头发过早地变灰了。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 græg，意为灰色；与德语 grau 同源。
etymology.tip: grey 与 gray 是同一单词的英式/美式拼写，记住“英式 grey，美式 gray”即可。

meanings.exampleEn: The government has enacted stricter gun control laws to curb urban violence.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已颁布更严格的枪支管制法律以遏制城市暴力。

meanings.exampleEn: He was gunned down in broad daylight by an unknown assailant.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在光天化日之下被一名身份不明的袭击者枪杀。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The fringe of the city has become a haven for young artists seeking affordable studios.
meanings.exampleZh: 城市边缘已成为寻求廉价工作室的年轻艺术家的避风港。

meanings.exampleEn: Her dress was adorned with delicate golden fringe that swayed with every step.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的连衣裙饰有精致的金色流苏，每走一步都会摇曳。

meanings.exampleEn: She swept her fringe aside to reveal a pair of piercing blue eyes.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把刘海拨到一边，露出一双锐利的蓝眼睛。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 hardi，源自 hardir（使坚硬），与古英语 heard（hard）同源。
etymology.suffix: -y = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: hard（坚硬）+ y（形容词后缀）→ 像坚硬之物一样能承受压力 → 能吃苦耐劳的、坚强的。

meanings.exampleEn: The hasty departure of the delegation left many questions unanswered.
meanings.exampleZh: 代表团的匆匆离去使许多问题悬而未决。

meanings.exampleEn: It was a hasty decision to quit the job without having another offer.
meanings.exampleZh: 在没有其他工作机会的情况下辞职，是一个轻率的决定。

meanings.exampleEn: She regretted her hasty words as soon as she saw his hurt expression.
meanings.exampleZh: 一看到他受伤的表情，她就后悔自己性急时说的话。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 haste，最终源于日耳曼语；hasty 由 haste 加形容词后缀 -y 构成
etymology.suffix: -y = 形容词后缀，表示“有……性质的”
etymology.tip: haste（匆忙）+ y = 匆忙的；做事匆忙就容易轻率、性急。

meanings.exampleEn: The hare darted across the meadow before the hunter could raise his rifle.
meanings.exampleZh: 猎人还没来得及举起步枪，野兔就飞快地穿过了草地。

meanings.exampleEn: Seeing the police car, the suspect hared down the alley at full speed.
meanings.exampleZh: 看到警车后，嫌疑人全速飞奔穿过小巷。

phrases.en: run with the hare and hunt with the hounds

phrases.zh: 疯疯癫癫，像三月野兔一样狂野

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；来自古英语 hara，属日耳曼语族本族词。

grocery.zh: 食品杂货店；食品杂货业

meanings.exampleEn: The local grocery stays open until midnight, catering to residents who need last-minute supplies.
meanings.exampleZh: 那家本地食品杂货店营业到午夜，满足居民临时购物需求。

meanings.exampleEn: She has worked in the grocery for over a decade, managing supply chains and retail operations.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在食品杂货业工作十多年，管理供应链和零售运营。

variants.zh: 食品杂货；grocery 的复数形式

etymology.root: gross = 大的，总的（原指大批量）
etymology.origin: 来自盎格鲁-法语 grosserie，源于 grosser（批发商），与 gross（大批的）有关；原指批发商经营的店铺或商品。
etymology.suffix: -ery = 场所，行业（表示店铺或业务）
etymology.tip: gross（总的）+ -ery（场所）→ 批发商总揽各类货物的地方 → 杂货店

halve.zh: 二等分；对半分享；把...减半

meanings.exampleEn: The company plans to halve its carbon emissions by 2030.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司计划到2030年将碳排放量减半。

meanings.exampleEn: They agreed to halve the profits from the joint venture.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们同意平分合资企业的利润。

meanings.exampleEn: The surveyor used a laser device to halve the irregular plot of land.
meanings.exampleZh: 测量员用激光设备将这块不规则的土地二等分。

variants.zh: 减半；对半分（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 古英语 half 的动词形式，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The two countries have lived in harmony for decades, resolving disputes through peaceful negotiation.
meanings.exampleZh: 两国几十年来和睦相处，通过和平谈判解决争端。

phrases.zh: 与……协调一致；与……和睦相处

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 harmonia，意为‘连接、配合、和谐’，后经拉丁语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -y = 名词后缀，表示状态、性质
etymology.tip: harm（连接）+ -y（状态）→ 各部分连接配合得当 → 和谐、协调。

meanings.exampleEn: Cattle graze peacefully in the lush meadows after the spring rain.
meanings.exampleZh: 牛群在春雨后的翠绿草地上安静地吃草。

meanings.exampleEn: The shepherd grazes his sheep on the hillside every morning.
meanings.exampleZh: 牧羊人每天早晨在山坡上放羊。

meanings.exampleEn: She fell off her bicycle and grazed her knee badly.
meanings.exampleZh: 她从自行车上摔下来，严重擦伤了膝盖。

meanings.exampleEn: The bullet grazed his shoulder, leaving only a superficial wound.
meanings.exampleZh: 子弹擦过他的肩膀，只留下一个表浅的伤口。

variants.zh: 吃草；放牧；擦伤；轻擦（过去式/过去分词）
吃草；放牧；擦伤；轻擦（现在分词）
吃草；放牧；擦伤；轻擦（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 grasian，意为吃草，与 grass（草）同源
etymology.tip: graze 与 grass 同源，想象牛在草地上（grass）吃草（graze）

harmonious.zh: 和睦的；调和的；和谐的；协调的

meanings.exampleEn: The harmonious family atmosphere contributed to the children's healthy development.
meanings.exampleZh: 和睦的家庭氛围促进了孩子们的健康成长。

meanings.exampleEn: The chef skillfully blended the ingredients to create a harmonious flavor.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨师巧妙地融合各种食材，调出调和的风味。

meanings.exampleEn: The symphony presented a harmonious blend of strings and woodwinds.
meanings.exampleZh: 这首交响乐展现了弦乐与木管乐器的和谐融合。

meanings.exampleEn: Urban planning should ensure a harmonious balance between economic growth and environmental protection.
meanings.exampleZh: 城市规划应确保经济增长与环境保护之间的协调平衡。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 harmonia（和谐、匀称），经拉丁语和法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ous = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: harmon（和谐）+ ous（形容词后缀）→ 充满和谐性质的 → 和谐的、和睦的。

meanings.exampleEn: She played a haunting melody on the harp at the concert.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在音乐会上用竖琴演奏了一首令人难忘的旋律。

meanings.exampleEn: He kept harping on the same old grievances instead of moving forward.
meanings.exampleZh: 他不停地唠叨同样的旧怨，而不是向前看。

variants.zh: 唠叨；不停地说（第三人称单数）
唠叨；不停地说（过去式/过去分词）
唠叨；不停地说（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hearpe，与日耳曼语族相关，本义为竖琴。
etymology.tip: harp 音似“哈普”，想象有人弹竖琴时旁边的人却不停唠叨，记住名词“竖琴”和动词“唠叨”。

meanings.exampleEn: His hatred of injustice drove him to devote his life to social reform.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对不公的憎恨促使他毕生致力于社会改革。

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 hatreden，由 hate（憎恨）+ -rede（表示状态、性质的后缀）构成
etymology.tip: hate（恨）+ -red（状态）→ 恨的状态 → 憎恨

hearty.zh: 诚恳的；健壮的；热烈的；丰盛的

meanings.exampleEn: She gave him a hearty welcome that made him feel at home immediately.
meanings.exampleZh: 她诚恳地欢迎了他，使他立刻感到宾至如归。

meanings.exampleEn: The old sailor remained hearty and energetic even at the age of eighty.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位老水手即使八十岁了，依然健壮而充满活力。

meanings.exampleEn: The proposal was met with hearty applause from the entire audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项提议赢得了全场观众热烈的掌声。

meanings.exampleEn: After the long hike, they enjoyed a hearty meal of stew and fresh bread.
meanings.exampleZh: 长途徒步之后，他们享用了一顿有炖菜和新鲜面包的丰盛餐食。

variants.zh: 更诚恳的；更健壮的（比较级）
最诚恳的；最健壮的（最高级）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 heorte，加上形容词后缀 -y 构成
etymology.tip: heart + y = 有心的；用心待人则诚恳，心强体健则健壮，心热则热烈，心满则丰盛。

meanings.exampleEn: The incessant noise from the construction site gave me a throbbing headache.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑工地不间断的噪音让我头痛欲裂。

meanings.exampleEn: Dealing with the complex tax regulations has become a major headache for small business owners.
meanings.exampleZh: 处理复杂的税务法规已成为小企业主的一大头痛之事。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hēafod（头）+ acan（痛）的复合词
etymology.tip: head（头）+ ache（痛）→ 头痛；引申为令人头痛的事

meanings.exampleEn: She took her habitual morning walk along the river before breakfast.
meanings.exampleZh: 她像往常一样，早饭前沿着河边散步。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 habitualis，源于 habitus（状态、习惯），最终来自 habere（持有、保持）
etymology.tip: habit（习惯）+ -ual（...的）→ 习惯的

handout.zh: 施舍物；救济品；分发的印刷品资料；广告物品

meanings.exampleEn: The beggar refused the handout, preferring to earn his living through honest work.
meanings.exampleZh: 乞丐拒绝了施舍物，宁愿通过诚实劳动谋生。

meanings.exampleEn: After the earthquake, the victims relied on government handouts for survival.
meanings.exampleZh: 地震后，灾民依靠政府的救济品生存。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor distributed a detailed handout summarizing the key theories of cognitive psychology.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授分发了一份详细的分发资料，总结了认知心理学的关键理论。

meanings.exampleEn: The company hired students to distribute promotional handouts at the shopping mall.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司雇佣学生在购物中心分发促销广告物品。

etymology.origin: 由古英语 hand（手）和 out（向外）组成的动词短语 hand out 转化而来的复合名词
etymology.tip: 用手（hand）向外（out）分发的东西，就是 handout

meanings.exampleEn: The new car comes with a two-year guarantee against mechanical failure.
meanings.exampleZh: 这辆新车附带两年机械故障担保。

meanings.exampleEn: He offered his house as a guarantee for the loan.
meanings.exampleZh: 他用自己的房子作为贷款抵押品。

meanings.exampleEn: The manufacturer issued a written guarantee to repair any defects free of charge.
meanings.exampleZh: 制造商出具了书面保证书，承诺免费修理任何缺陷。

meanings.exampleEn: Hard work does not guarantee success, but it greatly increases the odds.
meanings.exampleZh: 努力工作并不能保证成功，但会大大增加成功的几率。

variants.zh: 保证；担保（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 garantie，由 garantir（担保）的过去分词演变而来，与 warrant 同源。
etymology.tip: garant（担保人）+ -ee → 担保人给出的承诺，即保证。

meanings.exampleEn: The headmaster announced that the school would adopt a new grading system next semester.
meanings.exampleZh: 校长宣布学校将在下学期采用新的评分制度。

etymology.origin: 由古英语 hēafod（头）与拉丁语来源的 master（主人）合成，指学校中居于首位的人。
etymology.tip: head（头）+ master（主人）= 学校的头儿，即校长。

meanings.exampleEn: The electric heater in the basement keeps the room warm during the freezing winter nights.
meanings.exampleZh: 地下室的电加热器在严寒的冬夜里让房间保持温暖。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hǣtu（热），加后缀 -er 构成名词，表示“发热的器具或人”
etymology.tip: heat（热）+ er（者/物）= 发热的东西，即加热器

meanings.exampleEn: The harsh surface of the stone wall scraped my palm as I tried to climb over it.
meanings.exampleZh: 当我试图翻越石墙时，粗糙的墙面划伤了我的手掌。

meanings.exampleEn: The harsh sound of the alarm clock shattered the peaceful silence of the early morning.
meanings.exampleZh: 闹钟刺耳的声音打破了清晨宁静的寂静。

meanings.exampleEn: The coach's harsh criticism of the team's performance left the players feeling demoralized.
meanings.exampleZh: 教练对球队表现的严厉批评使球员们感到士气低落。

variants.zh: 更严厉的；更刺耳的；更粗糙的
最严厉的；最刺耳的；最粗糙的

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀
etymology.tip: 无词根词缀，可联想“哈嘘”——粗糙刺耳的声音让人想发出嘘声。

meanings.exampleEn: The farmer stored the hay in the barn to feed the cattle during the long winter.
meanings.exampleZh: 农夫把干草储存在谷仓里，以便在漫长的冬季喂牛。

phrases.en: make hay while the sun shines

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；源自古英语 hieg，意为“干草”。
etymology.tip: 发音类似“嘿”，联想：嘿！快把干草收起来！

helpful.zh: 有帮助的；有益的；有用的

meanings.zh: 有帮助的；有益的；有用的
meanings.exampleEn: Her practical advice proved extremely helpful to the new employees during the training period.
meanings.exampleZh: 在培训期间，她切实可行的建议对新员工极有帮助。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 helpan（帮助），后加形容词后缀 -ful 构成
etymology.tip: help（帮助）+ -ful（充满）→ 充满帮助的 → 有帮助的

meanings.exampleEn: The glazed ham was the centerpiece of the festive dinner table.
meanings.exampleZh: 那盘上过糖釉的火腿是节日晚餐餐桌上的主菜。

meanings.exampleEn: The dog bit the ham of the fleeing deer, leaving a deep wound.
meanings.exampleZh: 狗咬住了逃跑的鹿的后腿，留下了一道深深的伤口。

meanings.exampleEn: The audience groaned as the ham forgot his lines and stumbled across the stage.
meanings.exampleZh: 观众们发出抱怨声，因为那个笨拙演员忘了台词，在舞台上踉跄。

etymology.origin: 古英语 hamm，本义为“弯曲的河岸地”或“腿弯”，后指动物后腿及火腿。
etymology.tip: ham=后腿→火腿；联想：猪的后腿（ham）制成火腿（ham）。

meanings.exampleEn: The invention of gunpowder revolutionized warfare in ancient China.
meanings.exampleZh: 火药的发明彻底改变了古代中国的战争方式。

phrases.zh: 火药阴谋（特指1605年英国天主教徒炸毁议会的阴谋）
火药茶（一种卷曲如火药粒的中国绿茶）
火药味（喻指战争或冲突的气氛）

etymology.origin: gunpowder 由 gun（枪）和 powder（粉末）复合而成；powder 源自拉丁语 pulvis（灰尘）
etymology.tip: 枪（gun）用的粉末（powder）就是火药；powder 来自拉丁语“灰尘”，联想火药如灰尘般细小。

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor's new treatment successfully healed the patient's chronic wound.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生的新疗法成功治愈了病人的慢性伤口。

meanings.exampleEn: It took several months for his broken leg to heal completely.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的断腿花了几个月才完全痊愈。

variants.zh: 治愈，痊愈（第三人称单数）
治愈，痊愈（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 hælan，源自原始日耳曼语 *hailjan，与 whole、holy 同源
etymology.tip: hal（完整）→ heal 使恢复完整，即治愈

related.zh: 神圣的（源自“完整的、无瑕的”）

meanings.exampleEn: The starving wolf gnawed the frozen carcass with desperate intensity.
meanings.exampleZh: 饿狼绝望地啃咬着冻僵的尸体。

meanings.exampleEn: Years of acid rain have gradually gnawed the ancient stone statues.
meanings.exampleZh: 多年的酸雨逐渐侵蚀了古老的石像。

variants.zh: 咬；啃；侵蚀；消耗（第三人称单数）
咬；啃；侵蚀；消耗（过去式/过去分词）
咬；啃；侵蚀；消耗（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 gnagan，意为“咬、啃”；与德语 nagen 同源。该词为日耳曼语系基础动词，无明显词根词缀。

meanings.exampleEn: The machine parts fit into a narrow groove on the track to ensure smooth movement.
meanings.exampleZh: 机器部件嵌入轨道上的窄凹槽中，以确保平稳运动。

meanings.exampleEn: After years of working in the same company, he found it hard to break out of the daily groove.
meanings.exampleZh: 在同一家公司工作多年后，他发现很难摆脱日常惯例。

meanings.exampleEn: Once the band got into the groove, the audience was completely captivated by their performance.
meanings.exampleZh: 乐队一旦进入最佳状态，观众就被他们的表演完全迷住了。

variants.zh: 开槽；使形成沟槽（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 处于最佳状态；得心应手
进入状态；开始有规律地运作

etymology.origin: 源自古诺尔斯语 gróf（沟、坑），与古英语 græf（坟墓）同源，原始日耳曼语 *graban（挖）
etymology.tip: groove（凹槽）和 grave（坟墓）都源于“挖”，挖出的槽就是 groove。

meanings.exampleEn: Henceforth, all employees must submit their reports by Friday.
meanings.exampleZh: 自此以后，所有员工必须在周五前提交报告。

etymology.origin: 中古英语 hennes forth，由 hence（从此）与 forth（向前）组合而成
etymology.tip: hence（从此）+ forth（向前）= 从此向前，即“自此以后”

meanings.exampleEn: Many people hate the feeling of being watched, even in public spaces.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多人讨厌被人注视的感觉，即使在公共场合。

meanings.exampleEn: The speech was filled with hate and prejudice, which shocked the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 演讲充满憎恨和偏见，令听众震惊。

phrases.zh: 讨厌做某事；不愿做某事

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor's haste to leave the hospital caused him to forget his medical bag.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生匆忙离开医院，结果忘了他的医疗包。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 haste，源于日耳曼语，本义为“暴力、匆忙”。
etymology.tip: haste 与 hurry 同义，联想“黑死”来袭，人们匆忙逃离。

helpless.zh: 无助的；无能为力的；无依无靠的

meanings.exampleEn: The orphan felt helpless when he lost his only guardian.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个孤儿失去唯一的监护人时感到无助。

meanings.exampleEn: She was helpless to prevent the company from going bankrupt.
meanings.exampleZh: 她无力阻止公司破产。

meanings.exampleEn: After the war, thousands of helpless civilians were left in the ruined city.
meanings.exampleZh: 战后，成千上万无依无靠的平民留在了废墟般的城市里。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 helpan（帮助），加上后缀 -less 构成形容词，表示“无法被帮助的”或“没有帮助能力的”。
etymology.tip: help（帮助）+ less（无）→ 没有帮助的 → 无助的。

grab.zh: 抓握；掠夺；强占；东方沿岸帆船

meanings.exampleEn: The detective grabbed the suspect by the collar before he could flee.
meanings.exampleZh: 侦探在嫌疑人逃跑前一把抓住了他的衣领。

meanings.exampleEn: The ruthless conqueror grabbed vast territories under the pretext of spreading civilization.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个残忍的征服者以传播文明为借口强占了广大的领土。

meanings.exampleEn: The sudden grab for power by the military faction plunged the country into chaos.
meanings.exampleZh: 军事派系突然夺权使国家陷入混乱。

meanings.exampleEn: The museum displayed a model of a traditional grab, a sailing vessel once common along the eastern coast.
meanings.exampleZh: 博物馆展示了一艘传统东方沿岸帆船的模型，这种帆船曾常见于东部沿海。

variants.zh: 抓取；掠夺（过去式/过去分词）
抓取；掠夺（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自中古低地德语 grabben（抓住），与古英语 grafan（挖掘）同源
etymology.tip: grab 就是一把抓，看到 grab 就想到‘抓’

meanings.exampleEn: The company faced severe financial difficulties; hence, it was forced to declare bankruptcy.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司面临严重的财务困难，因此被迫宣布破产。

meanings.exampleEn: The kingdom was unified in 221 BC; hence, it entered an era of unprecedented prosperity.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个王国于公元前221年统一，从此进入了前所未有的繁荣时期。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The ashes lay cold in the hearth after the long winter night.
meanings.exampleZh: 漫长冬夜过后，炉床里的灰烬已经冷却。

meanings.exampleEn: She placed the kettle on the hearth to boil water for tea.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把水壶放在灶台上烧水泡茶。

meanings.exampleEn: The family gathered around the hearth to share stories.
meanings.exampleZh: 一家人围坐在炉边分享故事。

etymology.origin: 古英语 heorth；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀
etymology.tip: 直接记忆：炉边 hearth

heavily.zh: 很重地；严重地；难以忍受地

meanings.exampleEn: The box was heavily loaded with books, making it difficult to lift.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个箱子装满了书，很重，很难抬起来。

meanings.exampleEn: The region was heavily affected by the economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区深受经济危机的严重影响。

meanings.exampleEn: The burden of responsibility weighed heavily on his shoulders.
meanings.exampleZh: 责任的重担压得他难以忍受。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hefig（重的），后加副词后缀 -ly 构成 heavily
etymology.tip: heav-（重）+ -ly（...地）→ 重重地、严重地

meanings.exampleEn: The blacksmith struck the red-hot iron with a heavy hammer, sending sparks flying across the forge.
meanings.exampleZh: 铁匠用重锤敲击烧红的铁块，火花飞溅到整个锻炉。

meanings.exampleEn: The carpenter hammered the nails into the wooden beam with practiced precision.
meanings.exampleZh: 木匠以熟练而精准的动作将钉子锤进木梁。

meanings.exampleEn: The rain hammered against the windowpanes all night, making it impossible to sleep.
meanings.exampleZh: 雨点整夜敲打着窗玻璃，让人无法入睡。

variants.zh: 锤击；敲打（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 敲定；推敲出；通过讨论解决
努力做；坚持不懈地做；反复强调

etymology.origin: 古英语 hamor（锤子），属日耳曼语系基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The rescue worker put on a sturdy helmet before entering the collapsed building.
meanings.exampleZh: 救援人员在进入坍塌的建筑物之前戴上了坚固的防护帽。

phrases.zh: 头盔压痕发型（摘下头盔后压乱的头发）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 helmet，是 helme 的指小形式，最终源自日耳曼语。
etymology.tip: helm（头盔）+ et（小）→ 小头盔，即“钢盔/防护帽”。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient city developed around a natural harbor that provided safe anchorage for merchant ships.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古城围绕一个天然港口发展起来，该港口为商船提供了安全锚地。

meanings.exampleEn: The mountain cabin served as a harbor for travelers caught in the storm.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座山间小屋成为暴风雨中旅客的避难所。

meanings.exampleEn: The villagers were accused of harboring fugitives during the war.
meanings.exampleZh: 村民们被指控在战争期间窝藏逃犯。

meanings.exampleEn: She harbored a deep resentment against her former partner.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对前合伙人怀有深深的怨恨。

variants.zh: 庇护；心怀（第三人称单数）
庇护；心怀（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 herebeorg，由 here（军队）和 beorg（庇护所）组成，原意为“军队的庇护所”。
etymology.tip: harbor = har（军队）+ bor（保护）→ 军队保护的地方 → 港口/避难所

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy did serious harm to the local economy.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策对当地经济造成了严重损害。

meanings.exampleEn: Excessive use of antibiotics may harm human health.
meanings.exampleZh: 过度使用抗生素可能危害人体健康。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hearm，意为伤害、悲痛
etymology.tip: harm 本身即词根，记住“伤害”即可

meanings.exampleEn: His hateful glare made everyone in the room feel uneasy.
meanings.exampleZh: 他憎恨的目光让房间里的每个人都感到不安。

meanings.exampleEn: It is hateful to see innocent people suffer for others' mistakes.
meanings.exampleZh: 看到无辜的人因他人的过错而受苦，真是可恨。

meanings.exampleEn: The villain committed a hateful crime against the helpless villagers.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个恶棍对无助的村民犯下了可恶的罪行。

phrases.zh: 令某人憎恨；对某人来说可恨

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hatian（憎恨），后加形容词后缀 -ful
etymology.tip: hate（恨）+ ful（充满）= 充满恨意的，即可恨的

meanings.exampleEn: His haughty demeanor alienated his colleagues at the meeting.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在会议上傲慢的态度使同事们疏远了他。

meanings.exampleEn: She gave a haughty smile when she heard of her rival's failure.
meanings.exampleZh: 听到对手失败的消息时，她露出了骄傲的微笑。

meanings.exampleEn: The poet's haughty vision of art transcended all mundane concerns.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位诗人对艺术的崇高追求超越了所有世俗的关切。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 hautain，源于拉丁语 altus（高）
etymology.tip: haut（高）+ y → 把自己看得高 → 傲慢的

haul.zh: 用力拖拉；拖运；强拉；捕获量

meanings.exampleEn: The workers had to haul the heavy machinery up the steep slope by hand.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们不得不徒手将沉重的机器拖上陡坡。

meanings.exampleEn: Trucks are used to haul goods across the country.
meanings.exampleZh: 卡车被用来在全国各地拖运货物。

meanings.exampleEn: The police hauled the suspect into the interrogation room.
meanings.exampleZh: 警察把嫌疑人强拉进审讯室。

meanings.exampleEn: The fishermen returned with a huge haul of cod from the North Sea.
meanings.exampleZh: 渔民们从北海带回了大量的鳕鱼捕获量。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 haler，意为‘拉，拖’，源自古法兰克语 *halon
etymology.tip: hal（拉）+ 联想‘嗨哟’拉纤声，记住‘haul’就是用力拉

meanings.exampleEn: The archaeologists discovered an ancient grave beneath the ruined temple.
meanings.exampleZh: 考古学家在废墟神庙下方发现了一处古老的墓穴。

meanings.exampleEn: She laid flowers on her father's grave every Sunday.
meanings.exampleZh: 她每个星期天都会在父亲的坟墓前献花。

meanings.exampleEn: The scandal marked the grave of his political career.
meanings.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻标志着他政治生涯的终结。

meanings.exampleEn: His reckless driving nearly sent him to the grave.
meanings.exampleZh: 他鲁莽的驾驶几乎把他送进了坟墓（死亡）。

meanings.exampleEn: The country is facing a grave economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 该国正面临严重的经济危机。

meanings.exampleEn: His grave expression revealed the seriousness of the situation.
meanings.exampleZh: 他严肃的表情揭示了局势的严重性。

meanings.exampleEn: The artist graved a beautiful pattern on the marble slab.
meanings.exampleZh: 艺术家在大理石板上雕刻了一个美丽的图案。

meanings.exampleEn: The tragedy graved a lasting impression on her mind.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场悲剧在她心中铭刻下永久的印象。

variants.zh: 雕刻；铭记（过去式/过去分词）
更严重的；更严肃的（比较级）
最严重的；最严肃的（最高级）

phrases.zh: 死不瞑目；在坟墓里不得安宁

phrases.en: from the cradle to the grave

etymology.origin: 形容词/动词来自拉丁语 gravis（重的）；名词来自古英语 græf（墓穴，原义为挖掘）
etymology.tip: 坟墓（grave）让人心情沉重（grave），因为grave既是坟墓也是严重的

meanings.exampleEn: The manager hastened the staff to finish the report before the deadline.
meanings.exampleZh: 经理催促员工在截止日期前完成报告。

meanings.exampleEn: She hastened to apologize for her careless remarks.
meanings.exampleZh: 她赶紧为自己草率的言论道歉。

variants.zh: 催促；赶紧（第三人称单数）
催促；赶紧（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 haste，进一步源于日耳曼语；hasten 是 haste 的动词形式，加后缀 -en 构成。
etymology.tip: haste（匆忙）+ -en（使）→ 使匆忙 → 催促，加紧。

meanings.exampleEn: His firm grip on the rope prevented him from falling into the abyss.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对绳子的紧握使他免于坠入深渊。

meanings.exampleEn: The worn grip of the old hammer made it difficult to wield effectively.
meanings.exampleZh: 旧锤子的柄已磨损，难以有效挥动。

meanings.exampleEn: A strong grip is essential for rock climbers to conquer challenging routes.
meanings.exampleZh: 强大的握力对攀岩者征服挑战性路线至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: His bone-crushing grip during the handshake betrayed his aggressive personality.
meanings.exampleZh: 握手时他那几乎捏碎骨头的握手方式暴露了他好斗的性格。

meanings.exampleEn: She gripped the steering wheel tightly as the car skidded on the icy road.
meanings.exampleZh: 当汽车在结冰的路面上打滑时，她紧紧握住方向盘。

meanings.exampleEn: The suspenseful novel gripped the readers from the very first page to the last.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部悬疑小说从第一页到最后一页都牢牢吸引着读者。

meanings.exampleEn: The climber gripped onto the narrow ledge to avoid falling.
meanings.exampleZh: 攀岩者紧紧抓牢狭窄的岩架以免坠落。

variants.zh: 紧握；抓牢（过去式/过去分词）
紧握；抓牢（第三人称单数）
紧握；柄；握力；握手方式（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 gripe（抓握），与古英语 gripan（抓）同源。
etymology.tip: grip 即“抓握”，联想：用手紧握（grip）东西。

meanings.exampleEn: The car came to a sudden halt in the middle of the road.
meanings.exampleZh: 汽车在路中间突然停了下来。

meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers halted at the commander's signal.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵们在指挥官发出信号后立定。

meanings.exampleEn: The heavy snow halted the construction of the bridge.
meanings.exampleZh: 大雪使桥梁施工停止了。

variants.zh: 停止；立定（第三人称单数）
停止；立定（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

hazardous.zh: 危险的；冒险的；碰运气的

meanings.exampleEn: The workers were exposed to hazardous chemicals without proper protective equipment.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们在没有适当防护设备的情况下接触了危险的化学品。

meanings.exampleEn: Investing in that unstable market is a hazardous venture that could lead to huge losses.
meanings.exampleZh: 在那个不稳定的市场投资是一种冒险的行为，可能导致巨额亏损。

meanings.exampleEn: He made a hazardous guess at the answer, relying purely on intuition.
meanings.exampleZh: 他纯粹凭直觉碰运气地猜了一个答案。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 hasard，可能源自阿拉伯语 az-zahr（骰子），原指赌博中的偶然性，后引申为危险
etymology.tip: hazard（危险）+ ous（充满）→ 充满危险的

harvest.zh: 收获；成果；收获物；收获期

meanings.exampleEn: The autumn harvest brought an abundance of grain to the village.
meanings.exampleZh: 秋收给村庄带来了大量的谷物。

meanings.exampleEn: Years of research finally yielded a rich harvest of scientific discoveries.
meanings.exampleZh: 多年的研究最终产生了丰硕的科学发现成果。

meanings.exampleEn: The farmers stored the harvest in the granary before the rainy season.
meanings.exampleZh: 农民们在雨季前把收获物储存在粮仓里。

meanings.exampleEn: During the harvest, all hands are needed in the fields from dawn to dusk.
meanings.exampleZh: 在收获期，从黎明到黄昏，田地里需要所有人手。

meanings.exampleEn: The combine harvester can harvest an entire field of wheat in a single day.
meanings.exampleZh: 联合收割机一天之内就能收割完一整块麦田。

meanings.exampleEn: The villagers harvest in the autumn when the crops are fully ripe.
meanings.exampleZh: 村民们秋天庄稼完全成熟时收割庄稼。

variants.zh: 收割，收获（第三人称单数）
收割，收获（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 收获月，秋分前后的满月

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hærfest（秋天，收获季节），源自原始日耳曼语 *harbitas，最终源自印欧语 *kerp-（采摘，收获）
etymology.tip: 词根 carp/kerp 意为'采摘'，harvest 就是秋天采摘下来的成果，联想'秋天=收获'即可记住。

meanings.exampleEn: The historian spent decades deciphering ancient manuscripts to reconstruct the lost civilization.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位历史学家花了几十年时间解读古代手稿，以重建那个失落的文明。

meanings.exampleEn: As a meticulous historian of daily life, she recorded every minor event in the village.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一位细致的日常记事者，她记录了村里每一件小事。

variants.zh: 历史上著名的；有历史意义的
在历史上；从历史观点看

phrases.zh: 地方史学家；当地历史研究者

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 historia，源自希腊语 historía（探究、知识、历史），进一步来自 hístōr（智者、知者）。
etymology.suffix: -ian = 从事……职业的人；与……相关的人
etymology.tip: histor（历史）+ ian（人）→ 研究历史的人 → 历史学家。

related.zh: 历史上著名的；有历史意义的

meanings.exampleEn: The scandal dominated the headlines for weeks.
meanings.exampleZh: 这起丑闻连续数周占据各大新闻头条。

meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper headlined the story as a major breakthrough.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家报纸将此事作为重大突破加以标题报道。

variants.zh: 给……加标题（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 成为头条新闻；被广泛报道

etymology.origin: 由古英语 heafod（头）与 line（行、线）复合而成，原指报纸上端的大字标题行
etymology.tip: head（头）+ line（行）= 放在最顶端的行，即“大标题”

meanings.exampleEn: The detective identified the criminal by analyzing the handwriting on the ransom note.
meanings.exampleZh: 侦探通过分析赎金条上的笔迹认出了罪犯。

meanings.exampleEn: Despite the prevalence of digital devices, handwriting remains an essential skill in education.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管数字设备普及，书写在教育中仍是基本技能。

etymology.origin: 古英语 hand + writan（写）的复合词，后加 -ing 构成名词
etymology.tip: 手（hand）+ 写（writing）→ 用手写出的字迹，即笔迹

historical.zh: 历史的；史实的；历史上的

meanings.zh: 历史的；史实的；历史上的
meanings.exampleEn: The historical significance of this event cannot be overstated.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一事件的历史意义不容低估。

variants.zh: 在历史上；从历史观点上说

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 historicus，源自希腊语 historia（探究、历史）
etymology.tip: histor（历史）+ ical（…的）→ 历史的

related.zh: 有历史意义的；历史性的

heroic.zh: 英勇的；英雄式的；壮丽雄伟的

meanings.exampleEn: The firefighter made a heroic attempt to rescue the child from the burning building.
meanings.exampleZh: 那名消防员做出了英勇的尝试，从燃烧的大楼中救出孩子。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel portrays the protagonist in a heroic light, emphasizing his noble qualities.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说以英雄式的手法描绘主人公，强调他的高尚品质。

meanings.exampleEn: The heroic landscape of the Himalayas left every visitor in awe.
meanings.exampleZh: 喜马拉雅山壮丽雄伟的景色让每位游客都惊叹不已。

phrases.zh: 英勇的努力；巨大的努力

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 heros（英雄），经拉丁语 heroicus 进入英语
etymology.tip: hero（英雄）+ ic（形容词后缀）→ 英雄的、英勇的

meanings.exampleEn: The mountain reaches a height of 8,848 meters above sea level.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座山的海拔高度达8848米。

meanings.exampleEn: At this height, the air is too thin to breathe easily.
meanings.exampleZh: 在这个海拔高度，空气稀薄得让人难以呼吸。

meanings.exampleEn: The army seized the height overlooking the valley.
meanings.exampleZh: 军队占领了俯瞰山谷的高地。

meanings.exampleEn: She was at the height of her career when she decided to retire.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在事业巅峰时决定退休。

phrases.zh: 在……的最高点；在……的鼎盛时期

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hīehþu，与 high 同源
etymology.suffix: -th = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: high（高）+ -th（名词后缀）→ height（高度）

meanings.exampleEn: The soldier let out a grunt of pain as he fell.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵倒下时发出痛苦的咕噜声。

meanings.exampleEn: The pig grunted loudly when it saw the food.
meanings.exampleZh: 猪看到食物时大声发出呼噜声。

meanings.exampleEn: He grunted an apology without looking up.
meanings.exampleZh: 他头也不抬地咕哝着道歉。

variants.zh: 发出呼噜声；咕哝（第三人称单数）
发出呼噜声；咕哝（过去式/过去分词）
发出呼噜声；咕哝（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 grunnettan，拟声词，模仿呼噜声
etymology.tip: 咕噜一声，像猪叫

meanings.exampleEn: A sudden gust of wind rattled the windows and sent leaves swirling across the yard.
meanings.exampleZh: 突然一阵风把窗户吹得格格作响，树叶在院子里打旋。

meanings.exampleEn: His gust for classical music was cultivated during his childhood in Vienna.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对古典音乐的爱好是在维也纳的童年时期培养起来的。

etymology.root: gust = 品尝，味觉（引申为爱好）
etymology.origin: 表示“一阵风”的gust来自古诺斯语gustr；表示“趣味、爱好”的gust来自拉丁语gustus（品尝）。两者同形异源。
etymology.tip: 由“品尝”联想到“爱好”：尝过才知喜好；而“一阵风”可联想为“风的味道”。

meanings.exampleEn: You must grasp the opportunity when it arises, for it may never come again.
meanings.exampleZh: 当机会出现时你必须紧紧抓住，因为它可能不会再来了。

meanings.exampleEn: The lecture was so abstract that few students could grasp its core argument.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场讲座太抽象，很少有学生能理解其核心论点。

meanings.exampleEn: The child's tight grasp on her mother's hand showed her fear of the crowd.
meanings.exampleZh: 孩子紧紧抓着母亲的手，显示出她对人群的恐惧。

meanings.exampleEn: A comprehensive grasp of historical context is essential for interpreting the novel.
meanings.exampleZh: 全面把握历史背景对于解读这部小说至关重要。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hindrian（阻碍），与 behind（在……后面）同源，原义为“在后面拖住”。
etymology.tip: hind（后面）+ r + ance → 在后面拖后腿 → 障碍

meanings.exampleEn: The housewife meticulously budgeted the monthly expenses to ensure the family's financial stability.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位主妇精心安排每月的开支预算，以确保家庭的经济稳定。

etymology.root: house = 房子，家；wife = 妻子，妇女
etymology.origin: 古英语复合词 hūs + wīf，原义为“家中的妻子/女主人”，后专指操持家务的主妇。
etymology.tip: house（房子）+ wife（妻子）= 守在房子里的妻子，即“主妇”。

meanings.exampleEn: The eldest son is the rightful heir to the family estate.
meanings.exampleZh: 长子是家族产业的合法继承人。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 heres（继承人），经古法语进入英语
etymology.tip: her（继承）+ 继承者 = heir，记住“her”就是继承的根。

meanings.exampleEn: The firefighter aimed the hose at the blazing window and sprayed water into the room.
meanings.exampleZh: 消防员将水管对准燃烧的窗户，向房间内喷水。

meanings.exampleEn: In medieval Europe, men often wore woolen hoses as leg coverings beneath their tunics.
meanings.exampleZh: 在中世纪的欧洲，男性常在外袍下穿羊毛长统袜作为腿部遮盖。

meanings.zh: 用软管冲洗；用软管浇灌
meanings.exampleEn: After the picnic, we hosed the muddy car down before returning it to the garage.
meanings.exampleZh: 野餐后，我们用软管把满是泥污的汽车冲洗干净，然后才开回车库。

variants.zh: 用软管冲洗（第三人称单数）
用软管冲洗（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 用水管冲洗；用水管浇湿

etymology.origin: 古英语 hosa，原指长统袜或护腿，后引申为管状物，最终指软管。
etymology.tip: 长统袜（hose）像一条软管（hose），记住“袜子=管子”即可。

meanings.exampleEn: It is a great honour to be invited to deliver the commencement speech at this prestigious university.
meanings.exampleZh: 受邀在这所著名大学的毕业典礼上致辞，是极大的荣誉。

meanings.exampleEn: He was granted the honour of knighthood for his outstanding contributions to medical research.
meanings.exampleZh: 他因对医学研究的杰出贡献而被授予爵士头衔。

meanings.exampleEn: His signature on the contract was his honour, and he never broke a promise in business.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在合同上的签名就是他的信用，在商界他从不违背承诺。

meanings.exampleEn: The ceremony was held in honour of the soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the nation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场仪式是为了向为国捐躯的士兵们表达敬意而举行的。

meanings.exampleEn: We should honour the elderly not only in words but also in our daily actions.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们不仅应在言语上尊敬长者，更应在日常行动中体现尊重。

meanings.exampleEn: The university decided to honour the distinguished scientist with an honorary doctorate degree.
meanings.exampleZh: 该大学决定授予这位杰出科学家荣誉博士学位，以表彰他。

variants.zh: 尊敬；给予荣誉（第三人称单数）
尊敬；给予荣誉（过去式/过去分词）
尊敬；给予荣誉（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 道义上必须的；受道义约束的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 honor（荣誉、尊敬），经古法语 honur 进入英语；英式拼写保留 -our，美式拼写为 honor。
etymology.tip: honor 本身就是词根，意为“荣誉”；记住“honor 荣誉，honour 是英式写法”即可。

related.zh: 光荣的；可敬的（美式拼写）

meanings.exampleEn: The hostess greeted each guest with a warm smile at the entrance.
meanings.exampleZh: 女主人面带温暖的微笑在入口处迎接每一位客人。

meanings.exampleZh: 租客签署新租约后，女房东提高了租金。

meanings.exampleEn: As the hostess of the restaurant, she made all the final decisions on the menu.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为这家餐厅的女老板，她对菜单拥有最终决定权。

variants.zh: 女主人；女房东；女老板（复数）

phrases.zh: 餐车（带保温功能的推车）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 hoste，源自拉丁语 hospes（主人，客人）
etymology.tip: host（主人）+ ess（女性）→ 女主人

hell.zh: 地狱；邪恶势力；苦境；阴间

meanings.exampleEn: The preacher warned that unrepentant sinners would be cast into the fiery depths of hell.
meanings.exampleZh: 牧师警告说，不知悔改的罪人将被投入地狱的烈火深渊。

meanings.exampleEn: The villagers believed that the plague was unleashed by the forces of hell.
meanings.exampleZh: 村民们认为这场瘟疫是邪恶势力释放的。

meanings.exampleEn: The refugees endured a living hell during their arduous journey across the war-torn region.
meanings.exampleZh: 难民们在穿越战乱地区的艰难旅途中忍受着人间地狱般的苦境。

meanings.exampleEn: In ancient mythology, the hero descended into hell to retrieve the soul of his beloved.
meanings.exampleZh: 在古代神话中，英雄坠入阴间以寻回爱人的灵魂。

etymology.origin: 古英语 hel，原意“隐藏的地方”，后指冥界、地狱。

meanings.exampleEn: He groped in the dark for the flashlight he had dropped on the floor.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在黑暗中摸索寻找掉在地上的手电筒。

meanings.exampleEn: We groped our way along the narrow corridor in the pitch-black basement.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们在漆黑的地下室里沿着狭窄的走廊摸索前行。

meanings.exampleEn: The woman accused the man of groping her on the crowded subway.
meanings.exampleZh: 那名女子指控该男子在拥挤的地铁上猥亵她。

meanings.exampleEn: The celebrity was arrested for an alleged grope during the party.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位名人因在派对上涉嫌猥亵而被逮捕。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 grāpian，意为“触摸、抓住”，与 gripe（抓）同源
etymology.tip: grop 像 grab（抓），摸索就是用手抓找

hopeful.zh: 有希望之人；有前途之人

meanings.exampleEn: The latest economic indicators are hopeful for a swift recovery.
meanings.exampleZh: 最新的经济指标预示着经济有望迅速复苏。

meanings.zh: 有希望成功的人；有前途的人

meanings.exampleZh: 参加试镜的每个年轻有前途之人都梦想获得主角角色。

etymology.tip: hope（希望）+ ful（充满）= 充满希望的

meanings.exampleEn: The villagers planted fruit trees on the hillside to prevent soil erosion.
meanings.exampleZh: 村民们在山坡上种植果树以防止水土流失。

etymology.origin: 古英语复合词，由 hill（小山）和 side（侧面）组合而成
etymology.tip: hill（小山）+ side（侧面）= 小山的侧面，即山坡。

meanings.exampleEn: The heat from the furnace was so intense that the metal began to glow.
meanings.exampleZh: 熔炉的热量如此强烈，金属开始发光。

meanings.exampleEn: The heat of the debate escalated as the candidates exchanged sharp accusations.
meanings.exampleZh: 辩论的热度随着候选人互相尖锐指责而升级。

meanings.exampleEn: The researcher measured the animal's heat to study its metabolic rate.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究者测量动物的体温以研究其代谢率。

meanings.exampleEn: In the heat of the argument, he said things he later regretted.
meanings.exampleZh: 在争论的高潮中，他说了一些后来后悔的话。

meanings.exampleEn: The laboratory technician heated the solution to 80 degrees Celsius to accelerate the chemical reaction.
meanings.exampleZh: 实验室技术员将溶液加热到80摄氏度以加速化学反应。

meanings.exampleEn: The metal rod heated rapidly when exposed to the electric current.
meanings.exampleZh: 金属棒暴露在电流中时迅速变热。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

humid.zh: 潮湿的；湿润的；多湿气的

meanings.zh: 潮湿的；湿润的；多湿气的
meanings.exampleEn: The humid climate in the tropical rainforest makes it difficult for sweat to evaporate.
meanings.exampleZh: 热带雨林潮湿的气候使汗水难以蒸发。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 humidus，源于 humere（潮湿），与 humus（土）相关
etymology.suffix: -id = 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
etymology.tip: hum（湿土）+ id（…的）→ 像湿土一样 → 潮湿的

meanings.exampleEn: The humidity in the tropical rainforest is so high that clothes never fully dry.
meanings.exampleZh: 热带雨林中的湿度非常高，衣服永远无法完全干透。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 humidus（潮湿的），由 humor（液体）派生而来
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: humid（潮湿的）+ ity（名词后缀）→ 潮湿的状态 → 湿度

meanings.exampleEn: The traditional Chinese medicine relies heavily on various herbs to treat chronic diseases.
meanings.exampleZh: 传统中药在很大程度上依赖各种药草来治疗慢性疾病。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 herba，意为“草、草本植物”
etymology.tip: herb 本身即“草”，联想“草→药草/香草”即可记住。

hostile.zh: 敌人的；怀敌意的；敌对的

meanings.zh: 敌人的；怀敌意的；敌对的
meanings.exampleEn: The hostile atmosphere in the meeting made it impossible to reach any agreement.
meanings.exampleZh: 会议中充满敌意的气氛使得无法达成任何协议。

phrases.zh: 充满敌意的环境；恶劣环境

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 hostilis，源自 hostis（敌人，陌生人）

etymology.tip: host（敌人）+ ile（形容词后缀）→ 像敌人一样的 → 敌对的

meanings.exampleEn: The hospitality of the local people made our trip unforgettable.
meanings.exampleZh: 当地人的热情款待使我们的旅行难以忘怀。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 hospes（客人/主人），经由古法语 hospitalité 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ality = 表示性质、状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: hospit（客人）+ ality（性质）→ 对待客人的态度 → 款待、殷勤

related.zh: 医院（原指接待旅客/病人的场所）

headlong.zh: 头向前的；仓猝而用力的；轻率的

meanings.exampleEn: The acrobat performed a headlong somersault off the high platform.
meanings.exampleZh: 杂技演员从高台上做了一个头向前的空翻。

meanings.exampleEn: The headlong charge of the cavalry broke the enemy's formation.
meanings.exampleZh: 骑兵仓猝而用力的冲锋冲散了敌人的阵形。

meanings.exampleEn: His headlong investment in the volatile market resulted in huge losses.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在动荡的市场中轻率的投资导致了巨大损失。

meanings.exampleEn: She plunged headlong into the icy water without hesitation.
meanings.exampleZh: 她毫不犹豫地头向前地跳入冰冷的水中。

meanings.exampleEn: The protesters rushed headlong toward the barricade.
meanings.exampleZh: 抗议者们仓猝而用力地冲向路障。

meanings.exampleEn: Don't rush headlong into a decision you might regret.
meanings.exampleZh: 不要轻率地做出你可能会后悔的决定。

phrases.zh: 仓促地投入；轻率地卷入

meanings.exampleEn: The article's heading clearly indicated the author's stance on the controversial issue.
meanings.exampleZh: 文章的标题清楚地表明了作者在这个争议问题上的立场。

meanings.exampleEn: Please include your name and address in the heading before sending the letter.
meanings.exampleZh: 寄信前请在信头写上你的姓名和地址。

meanings.exampleEn: The ship changed its heading to avoid the approaching storm.
meanings.exampleZh: 轮船改变了航向以避开正在逼近的暴风雨。

etymology.suffix: -ing，构成名词，表示行为、结果或相关事物
etymology.tip: head（头）+ -ing，标题位于文章“头顶”，方向即“头”所朝之向。

meanings.exampleEn: She gave her friend a warm hug to show her support during the difficult time.

meanings.exampleZh: 老人紧紧拥抱他的孙子，然后男孩登上了火车。

拥抱；紧抱（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.tip: 看到 horror 就想到“害怕得发抖”，词根 horr 即“颤抖、害怕”。

发出嗡嗡声；哼唱（第三人称单数）

meanings.exampleEn: The herald was sent to deliver the message to the allied kingdom.

meanings.exampleZh: 印刷术的发明是文艺复兴的先驱。

meanings.exampleEn: The dark clouds herald an approaching storm.

hierarchy.zh: 等级制度；僧侣统治；等级体系

meanings.exampleZh: 公司僵化的等级制度常常抑制初级员工的创意。
