meanings.exampleZh: 审计发现了该公司账目中几处违反规则的财务行为。

variants.zh: 不规则的；无规律的；不合法的
规则的；有规律的；定期的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 irregularitas，由 ir-（不）+ regularis（规则的）派生而来
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: ir（不）+ regular（规则的）+ ity（名词后缀）→ 不规则的状态

incidence.zh: 发生；发生率；影响；负担者

meanings.exampleEn: The incidence of such events is unpredictable.
meanings.exampleZh: 此类事件的发生是不可预测的。

meanings.exampleEn: The incidence of lung cancer among smokers is significantly higher.
meanings.exampleZh: 吸烟者中肺癌的发生率显著更高。

meanings.exampleEn: The incidence of the tax reform on household income is still under debate.
meanings.exampleZh: 税制改革对家庭收入的影响仍在争论中。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 incidere（落下，发生），由 in-（向，在上）和 cadere（落下）构成
etymology.suffix: -ence = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: in（向）+ cid（落下）+ ence（名词）→ 事情落到头上 → 发生；发生率

meanings.exampleEn: The introduction of the guest speaker was brief but impressive.
meanings.exampleZh: 对特邀演讲者的介绍简短而令人印象深刻。

meanings.exampleEn: The introduction of new technology has transformed the entire industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 新技术的引进彻底改变了整个行业。

meanings.exampleEn: The introduction of flexible working hours boosted employee morale.
meanings.exampleZh: 采用弹性工作时间提升了员工的士气。

meanings.exampleEn: This course provides a thorough introduction to modern linguistics.
meanings.exampleZh: 这门课程为现代语言学提供了全面的入门介绍。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 introducere（引入），由 intro-（向内）+ ducere（引导）构成
etymology.suffix: -tion = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: intro（向内）+ duct（引导）+ ion（名词）→ 把某人或某物引进来 → 介绍、引进

meanings.exampleEn: Islam is one of the world's major religions, with over a billion followers.
meanings.exampleZh: 伊斯兰教是世界上主要宗教之一，拥有超过十亿信徒。

phrases.zh: 伊斯兰教五功（伊斯兰教的基本宗教义务）

etymology.origin: 来自阿拉伯语 Islām，意为‘顺从（真主）’，与希伯来语 shalom（和平）同源。
etymology.tip: Islam 的核心含义是‘顺从真主’，顺从带来内心的和平。

related.zh: 和平；平安（穆斯林问候语）
穆斯林（Muslim 的旧式拼法）

meanings.exampleEn: The intricacy of the legal procedure confused even the experienced lawyers.
meanings.exampleZh: 法律程序的错综复杂甚至让经验丰富的律师都感到困惑。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 intricare（使纠缠），由 in-（进入）+ tricae（琐碎杂物，纠缠）构成
etymology.suffix: -acy = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: in（进入）+ tric（纠缠）+ acy（状态）→ 进入纠缠状态 → 复杂错综

meanings.exampleEn: The professor's interpretation of the poem challenged the traditional reading.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授对这首诗的解释挑战了传统的解读。

meanings.exampleEn: Her interpretation of the lead role in the ballet was praised by critics.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在芭蕾舞剧中担任主角的演出受到了评论家的赞扬。

meanings.exampleEn: Simultaneous interpretation requires exceptional concentration and linguistic agility.
meanings.exampleZh: 同声传译需要极高的专注力和语言敏捷性。

etymology.root: pret = 价值、价格（引申为中介、解释）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 interpretari（解释、翻译），由 inter-（在...之间）和 pretium（价值）演变而来
etymology.suffix: -ation = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: inter（两者之间）+ pret（价值）+ ation → 在两种语言/文化之间传递价值 → 解释、翻译

meanings.exampleEn: The constant noise from the construction site seriously interfered with my ability to concentrate.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑工地持续不断的噪音严重妨碍了我集中注意力的能力。

meanings.exampleEn: His personal ambitions often interfere with his professional responsibilities.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的个人野心常常与他的职业责任相冲突。

meanings.exampleEn: No country has the right to interfere in the internal affairs of another sovereign state.
meanings.exampleZh: 任何国家都无权干涉另一个主权国家的内政。

meanings.exampleEn: The newly enacted policies interfere with the terms of the existing international agreements.
meanings.exampleZh: 新颁布的政策与现有国际协议的条款相抵触。

etymology.root: fer = 击打（来自拉丁语 ferire）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 inter-（之间）+ ferire（击打），经古法语 entreferir 进入英语
etymology.tip: inter（之间）+ fer（击打）→ 打到中间 → 干涉、妨碍

meanings.exampleEn: The bridge is reinforced with iron and concrete.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座桥用铁和混凝土加固。

meanings.exampleEn: She plugged in the iron to press her silk dress.
meanings.exampleZh: 她插上熨斗电源，准备熨平她的丝绸连衣裙。

meanings.exampleEn: Ancient iron tools were discovered at the archaeological site.
meanings.exampleZh: 考古遗址中发现了古代铁器。

meanings.exampleEn: He has a will of iron and never yields to pressure.
meanings.exampleZh: 他意志坚强，从不向压力屈服。

meanings.exampleEn: It took her an hour to iron all the shirts.
meanings.exampleZh: 她花了一个小时熨烫所有的衬衫。

meanings.exampleEn: The old castle had iron gates that were impossible to break.
meanings.exampleZh: 那座古堡的铁门无法被打破。

phrases.en: strike while the iron is hot

etymology.origin: 古英语 iren/īsern，基础词汇，无明显词根词缀
etymology.tip: iron=铁，铁做的熨斗也叫iron，记住“铁”就能记住“熨斗”。

meanings.exampleEn: The Italian who won the marathon trained at high altitudes in the Alps.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位赢得马拉松的意大利人曾在阿尔卑斯山区的高海拔地带训练。

meanings.exampleEn: She has been learning Italian for three years in order to read Dante's original works.
meanings.exampleZh: 为了阅读但丁的原著，她已经学了三年意大利语。

meanings.zh: 意大利的；意大利人的；意大利语的
meanings.exampleEn: The Italian fashion industry exerts a profound influence on global trends.
meanings.exampleZh: 意大利时尚产业对全球潮流产生着深远的影响。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Italia（意大利），后缀 -ian 表示“属于……的/……人”。
etymology.tip: Ital（意大利）+ ian（人/的）→ 意大利人；意大利的。

meanings.exampleEn: The comprehensive index at the end of the textbook enables readers to locate specific topics quickly.
meanings.exampleZh: 教科书末尾的详尽索引使读者能够快速找到特定主题。

meanings.exampleEn: The index on the pressure gauge points to the exact value inside the chamber.
meanings.exampleZh: 压力表上的指针指向腔室内的精确值。

meanings.exampleEn: The stock market index surged dramatically after the central bank announced new stimulus measures.
meanings.exampleZh: 央行宣布新的刺激措施后，股市指数大幅飙升。

meanings.exampleEn: The literacy rate is often regarded as a reliable index of a country's development level.
meanings.exampleZh: 识字率通常被视为一个国家发展水平的可靠指标。

meanings.exampleEn: The editor indexed all the technical terms in the manual to facilitate quick reference.
meanings.exampleZh: 编辑将手册中的所有技术术语编入索引，以便快速查阅。

variants.zh: 为…编索引（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 index (indicis)，原义为“食指、指示物”，由 in- “朝向” + dic- “说，指示” + -ex 名词后缀构成
etymology.tip: in（向内）+ dex（=dict 说/指示）→ 向内指示的东西 → 索引

irony.zh: 反语；讽刺；具有讽刺意味的事

meanings.exampleEn: The irony of his statement was lost on most of the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 他话语中的讽刺意味大多数听众都没有领会。

meanings.exampleEn: It is a bitter irony that the fire station burned down last night.
meanings.exampleZh: 消防站昨晚被烧毁，这真是一个极具讽刺意味的悲剧。

variants.zh: 讽刺地；具有讽刺意味地

phrases.zh: 戏剧性反讽（观众知情而剧中人物不知）
情境反讽（结果与预期相反）

etymology.root: eiron = 假装无知的人（希腊语）
etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 eironeia，意为‘假装无知’，经拉丁语 ironia 进入英语；与 iron（铁）无关。
etymology.tip: irony 不是 iron（铁）+y，而是源自希腊语‘假装无知’的讽刺，记住‘假装无知说反话’。

related.zh: 讽刺地；具有讽刺意味地

meanings.exampleEn: Many young people choose to invest their savings in index funds to achieve long-term financial growth.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多年轻人选择将积蓄投资于指数基金，以实现长期财务增长。

meanings.exampleEn: She invested a great deal of time and energy in preparing for the certification exam.
meanings.exampleZh: 她花费了大量的时间和精力来准备这场认证考试。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient castle was invested in a thick fog, giving it an air of mystery.
meanings.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡笼罩在浓雾之中，显得神秘莫测。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee decided to invest the new director with full authority to reorganize the department.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会决定授予新主任全权来重组该部门。

variants.zh: 投资；花费；笼罩；授予（第三人称单数）
投资；花费；笼罩；授予（过去式/过去分词）
投资；花费；笼罩；授予（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 投资于；购买；投入（时间、精力等）
大力投资于；在……上投入巨资

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 investire，由 in-（进入）和 vestire（穿衣）组成，原义为“给……穿衣”，后引申出“授予、笼罩”，再引申为“投资”
etymology.tip: in（进入）+ vest（衣服）→ 把衣服穿进去 → 授予、笼罩；把钱“穿”进项目里 → 投资

meanings.exampleEn: They have been intimate friends since childhood, sharing every secret and dream.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们从小就是亲密的朋友，分享每一个秘密和梦想。

meanings.exampleEn: The diary contains her most intimate thoughts and feelings.
meanings.exampleZh: 这本日记记录了她最私人的想法和感受。

meanings.exampleEn: Only a few people were privy to the intimate details of the negotiation.
meanings.exampleZh: 只有少数人知晓谈判的秘密细节。

meanings.exampleEn: He intimated that he would resign if the board rejected his proposal.
meanings.exampleZh: 他暗示如果董事会拒绝他的提议，他就会辞职。

meanings.exampleEn: She was one of his few intimates who knew about his illness.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是少数知道他病情的密友之一。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 intimus（最内部的），是 inter（在……之间）的最高级形式
etymology.tip: in（在内）+ tim（内部）+ ate → 进入内心深处的 → 亲密的

irritate.zh: 激怒；使发怒；使兴奋；使发炎

meanings.exampleEn: His constant complaining began to irritate his colleagues.
meanings.exampleZh: 他不断的抱怨开始激怒他的同事们。

meanings.exampleEn: The caffeine in the coffee can irritate the nervous system if consumed excessively.
meanings.exampleZh: 咖啡中的咖啡因如果过量摄入，会刺激神经系统。

meanings.exampleEn: Dust and pollen can irritate the eyes and cause redness.
meanings.exampleZh: 灰尘和花粉会使眼睛发炎并导致红肿。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 irritare，意为“刺激、激怒”。
etymology.tip: ir（使）+ rit（擦）+ ate（动词）→ 反复摩擦刺激 → 激怒、使发炎。

meanings.exampleEn: The curriculum is designed to integrate theoretical knowledge with practical skills.
meanings.exampleZh: 课程旨在将理论知识与实践技能相结合。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy aims to integrate the fragmented healthcare system into a unified national network.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策旨在将碎片化的医疗体系整合成一个统一的国家网络。

meanings.exampleEn: Many international students find it challenging to integrate into a different culture.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多国际学生发现融入不同文化具有挑战性。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 integrare（使完整），源自 integer（完整的，由 in- '不' + tangere '触摸' 构成，原义为未被触碰的）
etymology.tip: in-不 + tegr-触摸 + -ate，未被触摸的→完整的→使成整体

joyful.zh: 欢喜的；高兴的；令人高兴的

meanings.zh: 欢喜的；高兴的；令人高兴的
meanings.exampleEn: The joyful reunion of the old friends brought tears to everyone's eyes.
meanings.exampleZh: 老朋友们欢喜的重逢让每个人都热泪盈眶。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 joie，源自拉丁语 gaudia，意为“快乐”；后缀 -ful 表示“充满……的”
etymology.tip: joy（快乐）+ ful（充满）→ 充满快乐的 → 高兴的

meanings.exampleEn: The committee was appointed to investigate the allegations of corruption.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会被任命调查腐败指控。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 investigare，由 in- '进入' + vestigium '足迹' 构成，意为追踪调查
etymology.tip: in（进入）+ vestig（足迹）+ ate（动词）→ 顺着足迹追踪 → 调查

invaluable.zh: 无价的；价值无法衡量的

meanings.zh: 无价的；价值无法衡量的
meanings.exampleEn: The archaeologist's discovery proved invaluable to the study of ancient civilizations.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位考古学家的发现对古代文明研究而言价值无法衡量。

phrases.zh: 一笔无价的财富/宝贵资产

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 valere（强壮、有价值），经由古法语和英语演变；in- 表否定，-able 表“可……的”，字面为“不可估价的”，引申为“无价的”。
etymology.tip: in（不）+ valu（价值）+ able（可……的）→ 不可用价值衡量的 → 无价的。注意不是“没有价值”，而是“价值高到无法衡量”。

meanings.exampleEn: The intrinsic value of education cannot be measured solely by test scores.
meanings.exampleZh: 教育的固有价值不能仅用考试分数来衡量。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 intrinsecus（内部的，内在的），由 intra（在内）+ secus（跟随）构成
etymology.tip: intra（在内）+ ic（形容词）→ 内在的，本质的

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor advised isolating the patient to prevent the spread of the virus.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生建议隔离病人以防止病毒传播。

phrases.zh: 使自己脱离；使自己孤立于

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 insula（岛），后经意大利语 isolato 进入英语，意为“使成为孤岛”。
etymology.tip: isol（岛）+ -ate（使）→ 使成为孤岛 → 使隔离、使孤立。

meanings.exampleEn: Her jealousy of her colleague's success drove her to spread malicious rumors.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对同事成功的妒忌驱使她散布恶意的谣言。

etymology.root: zel = 热情，热心（引申为因过度在意而产生的嫉妒）
etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 zelos（热情），经拉丁语 zelus、古法语 gelos、中古英语 jelous，后加名词后缀 -y 构成 jealousy
etymology.suffix: -y 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: zel（热情）+ -ous（形容词后缀）+ -y（名词后缀）→ 对某人或某物过度热情，反而变成嫉妒

journalist.zh: 新闻记者；从事新闻杂志业的人

meanings.zh: 新闻记者；从事新闻杂志业的人
meanings.exampleEn: The journalist risked her life to report the truth from the war zone.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名新闻记者冒着生命危险从战区报道真相。

variants.zh: 新闻业的；新闻工作者的

etymology.origin: 来自法语 journaliste，源自拉丁语 diurnalis（每日的）
etymology.tip: journal（日报）+ -ist（人）→ 每天写日报的人 → 记者

meanings.exampleEn: The ink on the contract had barely dried before the company announced a major restructuring.
meanings.exampleZh: 合同上的墨水还没干透，公司就宣布了重大重组。

meanings.exampleEn: The printer inked the rollers evenly before each sheet was fed through.
meanings.exampleZh: 打印机在每张纸送入前均匀地给滚筒上油墨。

meanings.exampleEn: The two companies have inked a strategic partnership agreement to develop renewable energy.
meanings.exampleZh: 两家公司已签署战略合作协议，以开发可再生能源。

variants.zh: 给...上油墨；签署（第三人称单数）
给...上油墨；签署（过去式/过去分词）
给...上油墨；签署（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 encaustum，最终源自希腊语 enkauston（经加热烧制的墨水），由 en-（在内）+ kaustos（燃烧的）构成，经古法语 enque 进入英语。
etymology.prefix: en- = 在内，进入（已融合进单词）
etymology.tip: en-（在内）+ kaust（燃烧）：墨水是加热烧制出来的，ink 就是墨水。

meanings.exampleEn: The government has implemented a series of measures to increase the efficiency of public services.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已实施一系列措施以提高公共服务的效率。

meanings.exampleEn: There has been a dramatic increase in the number of students studying abroad in recent years.
meanings.exampleZh: 近年来，出国留学的学生人数急剧增加。

meanings.exampleEn: The merchant was solely concerned with his own increase, ignoring the welfare of others.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个商人只关心自己的利益，不顾他人的福祉。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 increscere，由 in-（使）和 crescere（生长）组成；经古法语 encreistre 进入英语。
etymology.tip: in（使）+ crease（生长）→ 使生长 → 增加

improve.zh: 改良；提高...的价值；改善；利用

meanings.exampleEn: The government has implemented a series of policies to improve the soil quality in the degraded farmland.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府实施了一系列政策，以改良退化农田的土壤质量。

meanings.exampleEn: Renovating the historical building will significantly improve its commercial value.
meanings.exampleZh: 翻新这座历史建筑将显著提高其商业价值。

meanings.exampleEn: Regular exercise and a balanced diet can effectively improve people's mental health.
meanings.exampleZh: 规律锻炼和均衡饮食能有效改善人们的心理健康。

meanings.exampleEn: He improved the occasion to express his views on climate change.
meanings.exampleZh: 他利用这一场合表达了他对气候变化的看法。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 emprouer（使获利），由 en-（进入）+ prou（利益）构成，后演变为‘改进’
etymology.prefix: im-（来自 en- 的变体，意为‘使，进入’）
etymology.tip: im-（使）+ prov（利益）+ -e，使进入利益状态，即改良、提高价值

intellectual.zh: 有知识者；知识分子；凭理智做事者

meanings.zh: 知识分子；有知识者；凭理智做事者
meanings.exampleEn: As an intellectual, she often engages in debates about social justice and public policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名知识分子，她经常参与关于社会正义和公共政策的辩论。

meanings.zh: 智力的；理智的；用脑力的
meanings.exampleEn: Reading complex literature is an intellectual exercise that sharpens the mind.
meanings.exampleZh: 阅读复杂的文学作品是一种锻炼智力的活动，能使思维更加敏锐。

variants.zh: 使理智化；从智力角度探讨

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 intellectualis，源自 intellectus（理解），由 inter-（在...之间）+ legere（选择，读）构成
etymology.prefix: intel-（来自 inter-，意为“在...之间”，因后接 l 同化）
etymology.tip: inter（在...之间）+ lect（选择）+ ual（的）→ 能在纷繁信息中选择、辨别的人 → 知识分子

irrespective.zh: 不顾的；无关的；没关系的

meanings.zh: 不顾的；无关的；没关系的
meanings.exampleEn: Irrespective of the weather, the outdoor concert will be held as scheduled.
meanings.exampleZh: 不管天气如何，这场户外音乐会都将如期举行。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 respicere（回头看，考虑）的过去分词 respectus，加上否定前缀 ir- 构成
etymology.tip: ir（不）+ respect（看）+ ive（的）→ 不看的、不考虑的 → 不顾的；无关的

meanings.exampleEn: The interface between the two software modules is designed to be highly intuitive.
meanings.exampleZh: 两个软件模块之间的界面设计得非常直观。

meanings.exampleEn: The new device interfaces with the main computer via a wireless connection.
meanings.exampleZh: 新设备通过无线连接与主计算机对接。

variants.zh: 连接；交互（第三人称单数）
连接；交互（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 由 inter-（之间）+ face（面）构成；face 来自拉丁语 facies（外形、脸面）
etymology.tip: inter（之间）+ face（面）→ 两个面之间的接触面，即界面

meanings.exampleEn: This case is a typical instance of how cultural misunderstandings can lead to conflicts.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个案例是文化误解如何导致冲突的典型例子。

meanings.exampleEn: In this instance, the government's intervention proved to be both timely and effective.
meanings.exampleZh: 在这种情况下，政府的干预被证明既及时又有效。

meanings.exampleEn: The researcher instanced several historical events to support her argument.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究人员列举了几个历史事件来支持她的论点。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 instantia（在场，迫切），由 in- + stare（站立）构成，经古法语 instance 进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ance = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: in（近）+ st（站）+ ance（名词）→ 站在眼前的事物 → 实例、例子

meanings.exampleEn: The Jewish community in this city celebrates its heritage with an annual festival.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个城市的犹太社区每年举办节日庆祝他们的传统。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Judaeus，经由古法语 Jueu 进入英语
etymology.tip: Jew（犹太人）+ -ish（...的）= 犹太人的

jewellery.zh: 宝石；贵重饰物；珠宝；宝石饰物

meanings.zh: 宝石；贵重饰物；珠宝；宝石饰物
meanings.exampleEn: The exhibition displayed a dazzling collection of antique jewellery from the royal dynasty.
meanings.exampleZh: 展览展出了一批来自王室王朝的令人目眩的古代珠宝藏品。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 jouel（宝石、饰物），后接集合名词后缀 -ery，表示“珠宝总称”。
etymology.suffix: -ery = 集合名词后缀，表示“…的总称；场所”
etymology.tip: jewel（宝石）+ -ery（集合）→ 宝石的总称 → 珠宝首饰。

involve.zh: 包括；使陷于；潜心于；包围

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy involves significant changes to the tax system.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策包括对税收制度的重大调整。

meanings.exampleEn: His careless remarks involved him in a heated controversy.
meanings.exampleZh: 他轻率的言论使他陷入了一场激烈的争论。

meanings.exampleEn: She involved herself entirely in the research project for two years.
meanings.exampleZh: 她全身心投入这个研究项目长达两年。

meanings.exampleEn: The dense fog involved the entire valley in a mysterious veil.
meanings.exampleZh: 浓雾像一层神秘的面纱包围了整个山谷。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 involvere（卷入，包裹），由 in-（进入）+ volvere（卷）构成
etymology.tip: in（进入）+ volv（卷）= 卷入其中，即“涉及；使陷于”

meanings.exampleEn: The judge ruled that the contract was invalid due to fraud.
meanings.exampleZh: 法官裁定该合同因欺诈而无效。

meanings.exampleEn: The invalid was carefully attended by a team of nurses.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位病人得到了一组护士的悉心照料。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 invalidus，由 in- "不" + validus "强壮的" 构成，原意为“无力的，虚弱的”。
etymology.suffix: -id = 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
etymology.tip: in（不）+ val（力量）+ id（的）→ 没有力量的 → 虚弱的；病人；无效的。

meanings.exampleEn: The magician's trick seemed to invert the laws of physics, leaving the audience utterly bewildered.
meanings.exampleZh: 魔术师的把戏似乎颠倒了物理定律，令观众完全困惑。

meanings.exampleEn: The enzyme can invert sucrose into glucose and fructose, altering its optical properties.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种酶能将蔗糖转化为葡萄糖和果糖，从而改变其旋光性。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 invertere（翻转，颠倒），由 in-（向内，使）和 vertere（转）组成
etymology.tip: in（向内）+ vert（转）= 向内翻转，引申为颠倒、转化

meanings.exampleEn: He gave his friend a jog to wake him from his daydream.
meanings.exampleZh: 他轻推了一下朋友，把他从白日梦中唤醒。

meanings.exampleEn: She goes for a jog in the park every morning before work.
meanings.exampleZh: 她每天上班前在公园慢跑。

meanings.exampleEn: The sudden noise jogged my elbow, causing me to spill the coffee.
meanings.exampleZh: 突然的响声撞了一下我的胳膊肘，导致我打翻了咖啡。

meanings.exampleEn: He jogs along the riverbank to keep fit.
meanings.exampleZh: 他沿着河岸慢跑以保持健康。

variants.zh: 轻推；轻撞；慢跑（第三人称单数）
轻推；轻撞；慢跑（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 缓慢前进；持续单调地进行

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The journey across the desert was both exhausting and enlightening.
meanings.exampleZh: 穿越沙漠的旅程既令人精疲力竭，又令人深受启发。

meanings.exampleEn: They journeyed through the remote villages of the Himalayas.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们旅行穿越了喜马拉雅山脉的偏远村庄。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 journee（一天的路程），源自拉丁语 diurnum（每日的）
etymology.tip: journey 原指“一天的路程”，联想“一日之旅”即可记住其“旅行”含义。

jealous.zh: 嫉妒的；羡慕的；留心的；戒备的

meanings.exampleEn: He was jealous of his colleague's promotion and tried to undermine her work.
meanings.exampleZh: 他嫉妒同事的晋升，并试图破坏她的工作。

meanings.exampleEn: She felt jealous when she saw her friend's new apartment in the city center.
meanings.exampleZh: 看到朋友在市中心的新公寓时，她感到很羡慕。

meanings.exampleEn: The company is jealous of its reputation and monitors all public feedback closely.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家公司非常留心自己的声誉，密切关注所有公众反馈。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 gelos，源自拉丁语 zelus，最终源于希腊语 zelos（热情、嫉妒）
etymology.tip: zel（热情）+ ous（...的）→ 对某人热情过度，便成了嫉妒

junk.zh: 垃圾；乌七八糟的东西；舢板

meanings.exampleEn: The attic was full of junk that had been accumulating for decades.
meanings.exampleZh: 阁楼里堆满了数十年来积攒的废旧杂物。

meanings.zh: 乌七八糟的东西；廉价货
meanings.exampleEn: Most of the stuff sold at that flea market is pure junk.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个跳蚤市场上卖的大部分东西都是纯粹的乌七八糟的廉价货。

meanings.exampleEn: The old junk sailed slowly across the harbor with its distinctive sails.
meanings.exampleZh: 那艘古老的舢板张着独特的帆，缓缓驶过港口。

meanings.exampleEn: We decided to junk the outdated equipment and invest in new technology.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们决定丢弃过时的设备，转而投资新技术。

variants.zh: 丢弃；废弃（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；可能源自中古英语 junke（旧绳索、碎片），后泛指废旧杂物。

meanings.exampleEn: The jury deliberated for three days before reaching a unanimous verdict.
meanings.exampleZh: 陪审团审议了三天才达成一致裁决。

meanings.exampleEn: An international jury will evaluate the entries in the film festival.
meanings.exampleZh: 一个国际评判委员会将对电影节的参赛作品进行评审。

variants.zh: 陪审团；评判委员会（复数）

phrases.zh: 悬而未决的陪审团（未能达成一致裁决的陪审团）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 jurare（发誓），经盎格鲁-法语 juree 进入英语，指“宣誓的一群人”。
etymology.tip: jur（发誓）+ y（集合）→ 发誓的一群人 → 陪审团

meanings.exampleEn: The protesters demanded justice for the victims of the corrupt regime.
meanings.exampleZh: 抗议者要求为腐败政权的受害者伸张正义。

meanings.exampleEn: There is not much justice in the claim that all humans are naturally selfish.
meanings.exampleZh: 关于所有人天生自私的说法并没有多少合理性。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 justitia，经由古法语 justice 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ice = 表示性质、状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: jus（法律）+ ice（性质）→ 符合法律的性质 → 正义、公正

meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer presented a strong justification for the defendant's actions in court.
meanings.exampleZh: 律师在法庭上为被告的行为提出了强有力的辩护。

variants.zh: 可证明为正当的；有理由的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 justificare（使公正），经由古法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: just（正义）+ -fication（化）→ 使成为正义 → 证明正当、辩护。

related.zh: 可证明为正当的；有理由的

meanings.exampleEn: Please make sure the invoice matches the purchase order before processing payment.
meanings.exampleZh: 请确保发票与采购订单一致后再处理付款。

meanings.exampleEn: We will invoice you for the total amount after the goods are delivered.
meanings.exampleZh: 货物交付后我们将给您开具总金额的发票。

variants.zh: 给…开发票（第三人称单数）
已开票；给…开发票（过去式/过去分词）
开票；给…开发票（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自法语 envoi（发送，寄送），源自拉丁语 via（路）
etymology.suffix: -oice（名词后缀，由 envoi 受 voice 影响演变而来）
etymology.tip: in（进入）+ voy（路）→ 货物上路发货，随之开发票

meanings.zh: 证明…有理；为…辩护；证明…正当
meanings.exampleEn: The end does not always justify the means, especially in ethical decision-making.
meanings.exampleZh: 目的并不总能证明手段的正当性，尤其是在道德决策中。

variants.zh: 证明…有理；为…辩护（第三人称单数）
证明…有理；为…辩护（过去式/过去分词）
证明…有理；为…辩护（现在分词）
可证明为正当的；有理由的

phrases.zh: 为自己辩护；证明自己有理
有理由做某事；做某事是正当的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 justificare，由 justus（正义的）+ ficare（facere 的变体，意为“做、使”）构成
etymology.tip: just（公正）+ ify（使）→ 使公正 → 证明…正当

related.zh: 可证明为正当的；有理由的

meanings.exampleEn: She put the kettle on the stove to boil water for tea.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把茶壶放在炉子上烧水泡茶。

phrases.zh: 另一回事；截然不同的人（或事物）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 cetel，与拉丁语 catinus（深容器、罐）相关；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: kettle 音似“开透”，水壶烧水直到“开透”就能泡茶。

irregular.zh: 不规则物；不合规格之物

meanings.exampleEn: The irregular coastline made navigation difficult for the sailors.
meanings.exampleZh: 不规则的海岸线使水手们航行困难。

meanings.zh: 不规则物；不合规格之物
meanings.exampleEn: The inspector classified the product as an irregular due to its nonstandard dimensions.
meanings.exampleZh: 检查员将该产品归类为不合规格之物，因为其尺寸不符合标准。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 irregularis，由 in-（不）+ regularis（规则的）构成
etymology.prefix: ir-（不，非，在 r 前同化为 ir-）
etymology.tip: ir（不）+ regul（规则）+ ar（的）→ 不规则的

meanings.exampleEn: The new solar panel system can generate up to five kilowatts of electricity per hour.
meanings.exampleZh: 新的太阳能板系统每小时最多能发电五千瓦。

phrases.zh: 峰值千瓦（光伏发电功率单位）

etymology.root: kilo- = 千；watt = 瓦特（以苏格兰工程师詹姆斯·瓦特命名）
etymology.origin: 来自法语 kilowatt，由希腊语词根 kilo-（千）和人名单位 watt（瓦特）组合而成
etymology.tip: kilo（千）+ watt（瓦特）→ 一千瓦特，即千瓦

meanings.exampleEn: The knee joint is the largest joint in the human body and bears most of the body's weight.
meanings.exampleZh: 膝关节是人体最大的关节，承受着身体的大部分重量。

meanings.exampleEn: The two companies issued a joint statement announcing their strategic partnership.
meanings.exampleZh: 两家公司发表了一份联合声明，宣布建立战略合作伙伴关系。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 iunctus（连接），经由古法语 joint 进入英语
etymology.tip: joint 就是“连接”的地方——关节和接合处都是连接点。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor introduced the latest findings in quantum computing to the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授向听众介绍了量子计算的最新发现。

meanings.exampleEn: The government introduced a new policy to curb inflation.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府引入了一项新政策以抑制通货膨胀。

meanings.exampleEn: The company introduced an innovative management system to enhance efficiency.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司采用了一套创新管理系统以提高效率。

meanings.exampleEn: The technician introduced the data into the mainframe for analysis.
meanings.exampleZh: 技术人员将数据输入主机进行分析。

variants.zh: 介绍；引入；采用；输入（第三人称单数）
介绍；引入；采用；输入（过去式/过去分词）
介绍；引入；采用；输入（现在分词）
介绍；引入；采用；输入；序言

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 introducere，由 intro-（向内）和 ducere（引导）组成
etymology.tip: intro（向内）+ duce（引导）→ 把…引进来，即介绍、引入

meanings.exampleEn: The dessert was topped with a layer of transparent jelly that shimmered under the light.
meanings.exampleZh: 这道甜点上面覆盖了一层在灯光下闪闪发亮的透明果冻。

meanings.exampleEn: The fruit mixture will jelly as it cools, forming a thick spreadable consistency.
meanings.exampleZh: 水果混合物冷却后会凝结成胶状，形成浓稠可涂抹的质地。

variants.zh: 使成胶状（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 gelare（冻结），经古法语 gelee 进入英语，后演变为 jelly。
etymology.tip: gel（冻结）→ jelly（冻结而成的果冻）

meanings.exampleEn: The judge delivered a fair judgement after hearing all the evidence.
meanings.exampleZh: 法官在听取所有证据后作出了公正的审判。

meanings.exampleEn: The court's judgement was appealed by the defendant's legal team.
meanings.exampleZh: 被告的法律团队对法院的判决提起了上诉。

meanings.exampleEn: Making a sound judgement requires both experience and critical thinking.
meanings.exampleZh: 做出合理的判断既需要经验也需要批判性思维。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 judicare（审判，判断），由 jus（法律）+ dicare（说）构成
etymology.suffix: -ment 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: judge（判断）+ ment（名词后缀）→ 判断、审判

jeopardize.zh: 危害；使受危困；使陷危地

meanings.zh: 危害；使受危困；使陷危地
meanings.exampleEn: The scandal could jeopardize his chances of being re-elected.
meanings.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻可能会危及他再次当选的机会。

etymology.root: jeopard = 危险（源自法语 jeu parti，意为“胜负难料的游戏”）
etymology.origin: 来自古法语 jeu parti（分成两半的游戏，引申为不确定、危险），后进入英语形成 jeopardy，再加动词后缀 -ize。
etymology.tip: jeopard（危险）+ ize（使）→ 使陷入危险，即“危害”。

kinetic.zh: 运动的；运动引起的；动力学的；活动的

meanings.exampleEn: The kinetic energy of the moving car was converted into heat during the collision.
meanings.exampleZh: 碰撞过程中，运动汽车的动能转化为热能。

meanings.exampleEn: Kinetic analysis reveals how the reaction rate changes under different temperatures.
meanings.exampleZh: 动力学分析揭示了反应速率在不同温度下如何变化。

meanings.exampleEn: The kinetic sculpture responds to air currents, constantly shifting its shape.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座动态雕塑对气流做出反应，不断改变其形状。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 kinesis（运动），经由拉丁语进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ic = 形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”
etymology.tip: kine（运动）+ tic（形容词后缀）→ 与运动有关的 → 运动的；动力学的

related.zh: 电影；电影院（同源，源自希腊语 kinema 运动）

meanings.exampleEn: Her influence in the academic community has grown significantly over the past decade.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在学术界的影响力在过去十年显著增长。

meanings.exampleEn: The wealthy businessman wielded considerable influence over local politics.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位富商对地方政治施加了相当大的权力。

meanings.exampleEn: The rebel group's influence spread rapidly across the region.
meanings.exampleZh: 叛乱集团的势力迅速蔓延到整个地区。

meanings.exampleEn: Social media can profoundly influence public opinion during an election campaign.
meanings.exampleZh: 社交媒体在竞选期间能深刻影响公众舆论。

meanings.exampleEn: The electrician installed a new jack on the wall to connect the heavy-duty equipment.

meanings.exampleZh: 他用液压千斤顶顶起汽车，然后更换瘪胎。

meanings.exampleEn: He's a clever jack who always knows how to solve practical problems.
meanings.exampleZh: 他是个聪明的男人，总是知道如何解决实际问题。

variants.zh: 用千斤顶顶起；提高（第三人称单数）

肌肉发达的；兴奋的（俚语）

phrases.zh: 用千斤顶顶起；抬高（价格等）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；源自人名Jack，后泛指男人，并引申出‘千斤顶’等工具义。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient kingdom was renowned for its magnificent architecture and rich cultural heritage.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个古老的王国以其宏伟的建筑和丰富的文化遗产而闻名。

meanings.exampleEn: In the kingdom of science, curiosity and rigorous experimentation are the keys to breakthrough discoveries.
meanings.exampleZh: 在科学领域，好奇心和严谨的实验是取得突破性发现的关键。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 cyningdom，由 cyning（国王）+ -dom（领域、状态）组成
etymology.tip: king（国王）+ dom（领域）→ 国王统治的领域，即“王国”。

island.zh: 岛；岛屿；孤立地区；安全岛

meanings.exampleEn: The remote island has become a popular destination for eco-tourists seeking unspoiled nature.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座偏远的岛屿已成为寻求未受破坏自然的生态游客的热门目的地。

meanings.exampleEn: In the bustling city, the library is an island of tranquility.
meanings.exampleZh: 在喧嚣的城市里，图书馆是一片宁静的孤岛。

meanings.exampleEn: Pedestrians should wait on the safety island before crossing the busy road.
meanings.exampleZh: 行人过繁忙马路前应在安全岛上等待。

etymology.origin: 古英语 īegland（水中的土地），由 īeg（岛）+ land（土地）组成，后受 isle 影响拼写为 island。
etymology.tip: island = is（看作 isle 岛）+ land（土地），水中的土地就是岛。

meanings.exampleEn: The gang planned to kidnap the billionaire's daughter and demand a huge ransom.
meanings.exampleZh: 这伙人计划绑架那位亿万富翁的女儿并索要巨额赎金。

meanings.exampleEn: The kidnap of the diplomat caused an international crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 外交官遭绑架引发了国际危机。

etymology.root: kid = 小孩；nap = 抓走（nab的变体）

meanings.exampleEn: The government's interference in the internal affairs of other countries was widely condemned by the international community.
meanings.exampleZh: 该国政府对他国内政的干涉受到了国际社会的广泛谴责。

meanings.exampleEn: The interference between personal feelings and professional judgment should be carefully managed.
meanings.exampleZh: 个人情感与职业判断之间的冲突应当谨慎处理。

meanings.exampleEn: Electromagnetic interference from nearby devices can disrupt the accuracy of the experiment.
meanings.exampleZh: 附近设备的电磁干扰会破坏实验的准确性。

etymology.root: fer = 击打（来自拉丁语 ferire）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 inter- "between" + ferire "to strike"，经古法语 entreferir 进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ence = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: inter（之间）+ fer（击打）+ ence（名词）→ 互相击打 → 干涉

meanings.exampleEn: The boxer's jaw was broken in the second round.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位拳击手在第二回合中下颌骨折了。

meanings.exampleEn: He is always jawing about his achievements at every meeting.
meanings.exampleZh: 他每次开会总是喋喋不休地谈论自己的成就。

variants.zh: 唠叨；喋喋不休（过去式/过去分词）
唠叨；喋喋不休（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

intellect.zh: 智力；出众的才华；知识分子

meanings.exampleEn: The intellect is the highest faculty of the human mind, enabling us to reason abstractly.
meanings.exampleZh: 智力是人类心智的最高能力，使我们能够进行抽象推理。

meanings.exampleEn: His remarkable intellect set him apart from his fellow students.
meanings.exampleZh: 他非凡的才华使他在同学中脱颖而出。

meanings.exampleEn: The country's leading intellects gathered at the conference to discuss climate change.
meanings.exampleZh: 该国顶尖知识分子齐聚会议，讨论气候变化问题。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 intellectus，由 inter-（在...之间）和 legere（选择，读）构成，原义为'从中辨别、理解'。
etymology.prefix: inter-（在...之间），在 l 前同化为 intel-
etymology.tip: 在…之间选择（辨别）→ 能理解、思考 → 智力

meanings.exampleEn: She struggled to conceal her inward turmoil during the meeting.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在会议期间竭力掩饰内心的不安。

meanings.exampleEn: The inward curve of the shell creates a natural resonance chamber.
meanings.exampleZh: 贝壳向内弯曲的弧度形成了一个天然的共鸣腔。

meanings.exampleEn: The door opens inward, so you need to pull it toward you.
meanings.exampleZh: 这扇门向内开，所以你需要把它朝自己拉。

meanings.exampleEn: He turned his thoughts inward to examine his own motives.
meanings.exampleZh: 他将思绪转向内心，审视自己的动机。

etymology.origin: 古英语 inweard，由 in（内）+ -weard（向）构成
etymology.tip: in（内）+ ward（朝向）= 向内

jean.zh: 牛仔裤；牛仔布；斜纹棉布

meanings.exampleEn: She wore a pair of faded jeans to the job interview, which seemed too casual for the formal occasion.
meanings.exampleZh: 她穿了一条褪色的牛仔裤去面试，在正式场合显得过于随意。

meanings.exampleEn: The tailor recommended a sturdy jean fabric for the durable workwear.
meanings.exampleZh: 裁缝推荐用结实的牛仔布来做耐用的工作服。

etymology.origin: 来自法语 Gênes（热那亚），因意大利热那亚出产的斜纹棉布而得名
etymology.tip: 热那亚（Genoa）的斜纹布，演变为今天的牛仔裤

meanings.exampleEn: The research team spent countless hours in the lab to verify the experimental results.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究团队在实验室里花费了无数小时来验证实验结果。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 laboratorium，是 laboratory 的缩写形式
etymology.tip: lab 是 laboratory 的缩写，labor=工作，-atory=场所，工作的地方即实验室。

jungle.zh: 丛林；杂乱的一堆；弱肉强食的地方

meanings.exampleEn: The explorers hacked their way through the dense jungle with machetes.
meanings.exampleZh: 探险家用砍刀在茂密的丛林中开辟道路。

meanings.exampleEn: His desk was a jungle of papers and unopened mail.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的书桌上一堆杂乱的文件和未拆封的邮件。

meanings.exampleEn: The corporate world can be a jungle where only the fittest survive.
meanings.exampleZh: 企业界可能是一个弱肉强食的地方，只有最强者才能生存。

variants.zh: 丛林；杂乱的一堆；弱肉强食的地方

phrases.zh: 丛林法则；弱肉强食的规则

etymology.tip: 梵语 jangala（荒野）→ jungle，想象荒野中茂密的丛林。

meanings.exampleEn: The pursuit of knowledge requires not only intelligence but also persistent curiosity.
meanings.exampleZh: 对知识的追求不仅需要智力，还需要持久的好奇心。

meanings.exampleEn: To my knowledge, the conference has been postponed until next month.
meanings.exampleZh: 据我所知，会议已推迟到下个月。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 cnawan（知道）

jewel.zh: 珠宝；贵重物；镶珠宝的饰物

meanings.exampleZh: 王冠上镶嵌着无价的珠宝，每一颗都映照出君主巨大的权力。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient manuscript is a jewel of medieval literature, treasured by scholars worldwide.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部古代手稿是中世纪文学的珍贵财富，受到全世界学者的珍视。

meanings.exampleEn: She wore a jewel in her hair, a delicate ornament that sparkled under the chandelier.
meanings.exampleZh: 她发间戴着一件镶珠宝的饰物，那精致的装饰在吊灯下闪闪发光。

meanings.exampleEn: The artisan jeweled the royal scepter with rubies and sapphires, creating a masterpiece of craftsmanship.
meanings.exampleZh: 工匠用红宝石和蓝宝石为皇家权杖镶上珠宝，创造出一件工艺杰作。

phrases.zh: 王冠上的宝石；最珍贵的东西

meanings.exampleEn: The court appointed her as the legal keeper of the orphan's estate.
meanings.exampleZh: 法院指定她为孤儿财产的法定监护人。

meanings.exampleZh: 作为博物馆档案管理人，他负责保存数百年历史的手稿。

meanings.exampleZh: 夜间看守人巡逻仓库以确保没有闯入者。

etymology.tip: keep（保持）+ er（人）= 保持（守护）的人，即看守人

meanings.exampleZh: 问题的核心在于两个部门之间缺乏有效的沟通。

variants.zh: 核心；中心；精髓；内核（复数）

内核崩溃（操作系统术语）

jupiter.zh: 朱庇物(罗马神话中的主神)；木星

meanings.zh: 朱庇特（罗马神话中的主神）
meanings.exampleEn: In Roman mythology, Jupiter was the king of the gods, ruling over the sky and thunder.
meanings.exampleZh: 在罗马神话中，朱庇特是众神之王，掌管天空与雷电。

meanings.exampleEn: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system, with a mass more than twice that of all the other planets combined.
meanings.exampleZh: 木星是太阳系中最大的行星，其质量超过其他所有行星质量总和的两倍。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Iuppiter，由印欧词根 *dyeu-（天空/神）与 pater（父亲）合成，意为“天父”。
etymology.tip: Jupiter = Ju（天父）+ pater（父亲），天父朱庇特，也是木星。

meanings.exampleZh: 他披上皮夹克，大步走进刺骨的寒风中。

meanings.exampleZh: 实验室要求所有员工在处理危险化学品时穿上防护外套。

meanings.exampleZh: 电缆外层包裹着厚橡胶护套以防止漏电。

meanings.exampleZh: 她对那个流浪汉的仁慈感动了附近的每一个人。

meanings.exampleZh: 经济制裁常被用作对敌对政权施加压力的政治手段。

meanings.exampleZh: 研究团队部署了一台精密仪器来检测大气中的微量污染物。

meanings.exampleEn: The firefighter ascended the ladder with remarkable agility to rescue the trapped resident.
meanings.exampleZh: 消防员以惊人的敏捷爬上梯子，救出了被困的居民。

meanings.exampleZh: DNA分子常被描绘成一个扭曲的梯状物，碱基对构成其横档。

etymology.tip: 联想“ladder”像一级级向上的台阶，寓意一步步攀升。

meanings.exampleEn: The illegal trade in ivory has driven many elephant populations to the brink of extinction.
meanings.exampleZh: 非法象牙贸易已将许多大象种群推向灭绝的边缘。

meanings.exampleEn: The artist chose a delicate shade of ivory to evoke a sense of purity and calm.
meanings.exampleZh: 艺术家选用一种柔和的乳白色调，以唤起纯净与宁静之感。

meanings.exampleEn: The museum displayed an exquisite ivory carving from the Ming Dynasty.
meanings.exampleZh: 博物馆展出的一件精美的明代象牙雕刻品。

meanings.exampleEn: Her ivory silk dress shimmered elegantly under the chandelier light.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的乳白色丝绸连衣裙在枝形吊灯下优雅地闪耀。

phrases.zh: 象牙塔（脱离现实的小天地）

phrases.zh: 膝跳反射的；自动反应的

meanings.exampleEn: His sarcastic comment was an insult to her intelligence.

meanings.exampleZh: 长期接触二手烟是对肺部的损害。

meanings.exampleEn: The manager insulted his subordinates by calling them incompetent.
meanings.exampleZh: 经理称下属无能，侮辱了他们。

meanings.exampleZh: 这种有毒物质损害了肝细胞，造成不可逆的损伤。

phrases.zh: 雪上加霜；在伤害之外又加侮辱

meanings.exampleEn: The actor interpreted Hamlet as a man consumed by existential doubt.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位演员将哈姆雷特诠释为一个被存在主义怀疑所吞噬的人。

meanings.exampleEn: During the international conference, she had to interpret the speaker's remarks simultaneously for the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 在国际会议期间，她必须为听众同声传译演讲者的话。

meanings.exampleEn: His silence was interpreted as a sign of disapproval by the committee.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的沉默被委员会理解为不赞成的表示。

phrases.zh: 为（某人）口译；替（某人）翻译

etymology.root: pret = 价值（来自拉丁语 pretium）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 interpretari，由 inter-（在……之间）和 -pret-（价值）构成，原指在双方之间确定价值、进行调解，后引申为解释、翻译。
etymology.tip: inter（之间）+ pret（价值）→ 在两者之间确定价值 → 解释、翻译

meanings.exampleEn: The intervals between the columns are exactly two meters.
meanings.exampleZh: 柱子之间的间隔正好两米。

meanings.exampleEn: The telescope can measure the interval between distant stars.
meanings.exampleZh: 望远镜可以测量遥远恒星之间的距离。

meanings.exampleEn: He worked for eight hours without an interval.
meanings.exampleZh: 他连续工作了八小时，没有间歇。

meanings.exampleEn: The mechanic checked the interval between the piston and the cylinder.
meanings.exampleZh: 机械师检查了活塞与气缸之间的间隙。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 intervallum，由 inter（在...之间）+ vallum（墙）组成，原指两堵墙之间的空间，引申为间隔
etymology.tip: inter（之间）+ vallum（墙）→ 墙与墙之间的空间 → 间隔

kin.zh: 亲戚；同族；血缘关系；家族

meanings.exampleEn: She is my kin, though we have never met before.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是我的亲戚，尽管我们从未见过面。

meanings.exampleEn: The tribe regards all its members as kin and protects them fiercely.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个部落将所有成员视为同族，并 fiercely 保护他们。

meanings.exampleEn: Their bond is stronger than kin, forged by years of shared hardship.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们的纽带比血缘关系更牢固，是由多年共同患难铸就的。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 cynn，意为家族、种族、亲属关系；与德语 Kind（孩子）同源。
etymology.tip: kin 就是“亲”，记住“亲人=kin”，同根词 kindred 也是亲属。

related.zh: 种类（同源，原义为“家族、类属”）

ironically.zh: 冷嘲地；挖苦地；讽刺地；令人啼笑皆非地

meanings.exampleEn: She smiled ironically at his absurd excuse, knowing full well that he was lying.
meanings.exampleZh: 她讽刺地对他荒谬的借口笑了笑，心知肚明他在撒谎。

meanings.zh: 令人啼笑皆非地；具有讽刺意味的是
meanings.exampleEn: Ironically, the fire station burned down while the firefighters were attending a safety training session.
meanings.exampleZh: 具有讽刺意味的是，消防站竟然在消防员参加安全培训时被烧毁了。

variants.zh: 讽刺的；具有讽刺意味的
讽刺；反语；具有讽刺意味的事

etymology.root: eiron = 假装无知者（希腊语）
etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 eironeia（假装无知），经拉丁语 ironia 进入英语；ironically 由 ironic 加副词后缀 -ally 构成
etymology.tip: ironically = irony（讽刺）+ -ally（副词后缀），记住“以讽刺的方式”就是“讽刺地”

meanings.exampleEn: The landlady refused to return the deposit until the tenant had repaired the damaged wall.
meanings.exampleZh: 女房东在租客修好损坏的墙壁之前拒绝退还押金。

meanings.exampleEn: As a wealthy landlady, she owned vast tracts of farmland across the county.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一位富有的女地主，她在该县拥有大片的农田。

etymology.origin: 古英语复合词 land（土地）+ hlæfdige（女主人），后演变为 landlady
etymology.tip: 土地（land）上的女士（lady）就是女地主/女房东

meanings.exampleEn: The streets were filled with loud lamentation after the sudden loss of the beloved leader.
meanings.exampleZh: 敬爱的领袖突然离世后，街道上充满了悲痛的哀悼声。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 lamentatio，由动词 lamentari（哀悼、悲叹）派生而来。
etymology.suffix: -ation = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: lament（哀悼）+ -ation（名词后缀）→ 哀悼的行为或状态，即“悲叹；哀悼”。

knob.zh: 把手；瘤；旋钮；球形突出物

meanings.exampleEn: He turned the brass knob and the heavy oak door creaked open.
meanings.exampleZh: 他转动黄铜把手，沉重的橡木门吱呀一声开了。

meanings.exampleEn: The old tree trunk was covered with knobs and burls.
meanings.exampleZh: 老树干上布满了瘤和树疤。

meanings.exampleEn: Adjust the volume knob until the music is clearly audible.
meanings.exampleZh: 调节音量旋钮直到音乐清晰可闻。

meanings.exampleEn: The walking stick has a smooth wooden knob at the top.
meanings.exampleZh: 手杖顶端有一个光滑的木质球形突出物。

variants.zh: 有球状突出物的；有节的

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 knobbe，词源不明；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The landlord refused to return the deposit until the tenant repaired the damaged wall.
meanings.exampleZh: 房东拒绝退还押金，直到租客修复了损坏的墙壁。

meanings.exampleEn: In the 19th century, many Irish peasants paid exorbitant rents to their absentee landlords.
meanings.exampleZh: 在19世纪，许多爱尔兰农民向不在地主缴纳高昂的地租。

etymology.origin: 古英语复合词，由 land（土地）和 lord（主人）构成；lord 源自古英语 hlaford，意为“面包守护者”
etymology.tip: 拥有土地（land）的主人（lord）就是地主或房东。

meanings.exampleEn: The research team spent months in the laboratory developing a new vaccine.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究团队在实验室里花了数月时间研发一种新疫苗。

meanings.exampleEn: She was appointed as the director of the linguistic laboratory at the university.
meanings.exampleZh: 她被任命为大学语言学研究室主任。

meanings.exampleEn: The chemical laboratory was required to comply with strict environmental regulations.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家化工厂必须遵守严格的环境法规。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 laboratorium，由 labor（工作）+ -atorium（场所）构成，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: labor（劳动）+ -ory（场所）→ 劳动的地方 → 实验室

meanings.exampleEn: The notorious criminal was sentenced to ten years in jail for his involvement in the fraud scheme.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个臭名昭著的罪犯因参与诈骗计划被判处十年监禁。

meanings.exampleEn: The court decided to jail the corrupt official pending further investigation.
meanings.exampleZh: 法院决定在进一步调查期间监禁这名腐败官员。

variants.zh: 监禁；拘留（第三人称单数）
监禁；拘留（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 经由古法语 jaiole/gaiole 进入英语，源自拉丁语 cavea（笼子）
etymology.tip: jail 音似‘监’，牢狱如同笼子，记住 jail = 监狱

meanings.exampleEn: The surgeon used a laser to remove the tumor with remarkable precision.
meanings.exampleZh: 外科医生使用激光以极高的精确度切除了肿瘤。

meanings.zh: 用激光照射（或切割、雕刻等）
meanings.exampleEn: The factory lasers the serial number onto each metal component.
meanings.exampleZh: 工厂用激光将序列号刻在每一个金属部件上。

variants.zh: 用激光照射（第三人称单数）
用激光照射（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 首字母缩略词，源自 Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation（通过受激辐射的光放大），20世纪60年代进入英语。
etymology.tip: laser 是“Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation”的缩写，记住“激光=受激辐射光放大”即可。

meanings.exampleEn: The knight swore an oath of loyalty to his king before riding into battle.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位骑士在骑马奔赴战场前向国王宣誓效忠。

phrases.zh: 救星；白马王子（字面：身着闪亮盔甲的骑士）

etymology.origin: 古英语 cniht，原指男孩、仆人，后演变为骑士；无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: 古英语cniht原为“男孩/仆人”，后来身份提升为“骑士”，联想：从侍从成长为骑士。

meanings.exampleEn: She kept a detailed journal of her experiences during the expedition.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在探险期间详细记录了每天的所见所闻。

meanings.exampleEn: The scientific journal publishes peer-reviewed research articles monthly.
meanings.exampleZh: 这本科学杂志每月发表经过同行评审的研究论文。

meanings.exampleEn: The Wall Street Journal is renowned for its in-depth financial reporting.
meanings.exampleZh: 《华尔街日报》以其深入的财经报道而闻名。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 diurnalis，经古法语 jurnal 进入英语
etymology.tip: jour（日）+ -al（的），记录每日之事即为日记、日报或杂志

meanings.exampleEn: The latent virus may remain dormant for years before causing symptoms.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种潜伏的病毒可能在引发症状前潜伏数年。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 latere（隐藏）的现在分词 latentem
etymology.tip: lat（隐藏）+ ent（形容词后缀）→ 隐藏着的 → 潜伏的

meanings.exampleEn: The lecturer was interrupted by a sudden burst of laughter from the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 讲师被观众突然爆发的一阵笑声打断了。

meanings.exampleEn: The earthquake interrupted the power supply to the entire region.
meanings.exampleZh: 地震中断了整个地区的电力供应。

meanings.exampleEn: Construction work interrupted the normal flow of traffic on the main road.
meanings.exampleZh: 施工妨碍了主干道上正常的交通流量。

meanings.exampleEn: It is impolite to interrupt when others are speaking.
meanings.exampleZh: 别人说话时插嘴是不礼貌的。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 interrumpere，由 inter-（在...之间）+ rumpere（打破）构成
etymology.tip: inter（在中间）+ rupt（断裂）→ 在中间断裂 → 打断、中断

meanings.exampleEn: Of the two options, the latter is more feasible for the company's long-term development.
meanings.exampleZh: 在这两个选项中，后者对公司的长期发展更为可行。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 lætra，为 late 的比较级形式
etymology.tip: late（晚）加比较级后缀 -er，latter 即“更晚的”，引申为“后者的”。

meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer presented compelling evidence to defend her client in the complex corporate fraud case.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位律师在复杂的公司欺诈案中出示了令人信服的证据为她的当事人辩护。

phrases.zh: 聘请律师（尤指在被调查或面临指控时）
公司法律顾问；企业律师

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 lagu（法律），后接表示“人”的后缀 -yer
etymology.tip: law（法律）+ yer（人）→ 懂法律、从事法律工作的人 → 律师

meanings.exampleEn: The novel is full of political intrigues and betrayals.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说充满了政治阴谋和背叛。

meanings.exampleEn: The mystery of the ancient ruins intrigued the archaeologists.
meanings.exampleZh: 古代遗迹的神秘感引起了考古学家的浓厚兴趣。

meanings.exampleEn: The courtiers intrigued against the king to seize power.
meanings.exampleZh: 朝臣们密谋反对国王以夺取权力。

variants.zh: 激起……的兴趣（第三人称单数）
激起……的兴趣（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 被……深深吸引；对……极感兴趣

etymology.origin: 来自法语 intrigue，源自拉丁语 intricare（使纠缠），由 in- + tricae（琐事，困惑）构成
etymology.suffix: -igue = 名词/动词后缀（源自拉丁语 -icare）
etymology.tip: in（进入）+ tric（纠缠）+ ue → 进入纠缠状态，引申为阴谋或引起兴趣

keen.zh: 锋利的；敏锐的；强烈的；敏捷的

meanings.exampleEn: The butcher's keen blade sliced through the meat effortlessly.
meanings.exampleZh: 屠夫锋利的刀刃毫不费力地切开了肉。

meanings.exampleEn: Her keen observation skills enabled her to detect the subtle changes in the experiment.
meanings.exampleZh: 她敏锐的观察力使她察觉到实验中细微的变化。

meanings.exampleEn: He has a keen interest in environmental protection and actively participates in related activities.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对环境保护有强烈的兴趣，并积极参与相关活动。

meanings.exampleEn: The athlete's keen reflexes allowed him to react instantly to his opponent's move.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位运动员敏捷的反应使他对对手的动作立即做出反应。

variants.zh: 更锋利的；更敏锐的；更强烈的；更敏捷的
最锋利的；最敏锐的；最强烈的；最敏捷的

etymology.origin: 古英语 cene（勇敢、敏锐），与德语 kühn 同源

meanings.exampleEn: The successful landing of the spacecraft on Mars marked a milestone in human space exploration.
meanings.exampleZh: 航天器在火星上的成功登陆标志着人类太空探索的一个里程碑。

meanings.exampleEn: The ferry pulled into the landing, where dozens of passengers were waiting to board.
meanings.exampleZh: 渡轮驶入码头，那里有几十名乘客正在等候登船。

meanings.exampleEn: The pilot was forced to make an emergency landing due to the sudden engine failure.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于发动机突然故障，飞行员被迫紧急降落。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 land，原义为“陆地、地面”，后引申出“登陆、降落”等含义。
etymology.tip: land（陆地）+ -ing（行为）→ 接触陆地或地面的动作，即“登陆/降落”。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient Latins inhabited the region of Latium before the rise of Rome.
meanings.exampleZh: 古拉丁人在罗马崛起之前居住在拉丁姆地区。

meanings.exampleEn: She has studied Latin for five years and can now read Virgil in the original.
meanings.exampleZh: 她学了五年拉丁语，现在能读维吉尔的原文。

meanings.zh: 拉丁的；拉丁语的；拉丁人的
meanings.exampleEn: The Latin influence on English vocabulary is particularly evident in legal and scientific terms.
meanings.exampleZh: 拉丁语对英语词汇的影响在法律和科学术语中尤为明显。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Latinus，意为“属于拉丁姆的”，拉丁姆是古罗马所在地域。
etymology.tip: Lat-（拉丁姆）+ -in（属于……的）→ 属于拉丁姆的 → 拉丁的、拉丁语。

related.zh: 拉丁美洲人；拉丁美洲的
拉丁美洲女性；拉丁美洲女性的

meanings.exampleEn: The success of the project was largely due to the team's relentless effort.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个项目的成功很大程度上归功于团队不懈的努力。

phrases.zh: 主要由于；很大程度上因为

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 largus（丰富的，大的），经古法语 large 进入英语，再加副词后缀 -ly 构成 largely
etymology.tip: large（大）+ ly = 大量地，记住“大”就想到“大量”。

meanings.exampleEn: The infectious laughter of the children echoed through the empty hall.
meanings.exampleZh: 孩子们富有感染力的笑声在空旷的大厅里回荡。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 hleahtor，与 laugh 同源，属日耳曼语族基础词汇。
etymology.suffix: -ter 构成名词，表示行为或结果
etymology.tip: laugh（笑）+ -ter（名词后缀）→ 笑声；联想：听到 laugh 就想笑，加 ter 就是笑声。

meanings.exampleEn: The old street lamp cast a dim glow over the cobblestone path.
meanings.exampleZh: 那盏旧路灯在鹅卵石小径上投下昏暗的光晕。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 lampas（火炬），源于 lampein（发光），经拉丁语进入英语。
etymology.tip: lamp 是“灯”，联想“灯在发光（lamp）”。

meanings.exampleEn: The expedition carried a full kit for the Arctic journey.
meanings.exampleZh: 探险队为北极之旅携带了全套装备。

meanings.exampleEn: He grabbed his kit and rushed to repair the broken pipe.
meanings.exampleZh: 他抓起工具箱冲去修理破裂的管道。

meanings.exampleEn: A first-aid kit is essential for every hiking trip.
meanings.exampleZh: 急救包是每次远足旅行必备的成套工具。

meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers were kitted out with the latest protective gear.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵们配备了最新的防护装备。

etymology.origin: 词源不详，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: She rinsed her face over the lavatory in the small bathroom.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在小浴室的洗脸盆里洗了把脸。

meanings.exampleEn: The public lavatory was closed for maintenance during the festival.
meanings.exampleZh: 节日期间，公共厕所因维修而关闭。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 lavatorium（洗涤场所），由 lavare（洗）派生而来
etymology.tip: lav（洗）+ -ory（场所）→ 洗涤的地方 → 洗脸盆/厕所

meanings.exampleEn: The enemy troops invaded the border town at dawn, catching the defenders off guard.
meanings.exampleZh: 敌军在黎明时侵入边境城镇，让守军措手不及。

meanings.exampleEn: Thousands of tourists invade the ancient city every summer, overwhelming its narrow streets.
meanings.exampleZh: 每年夏天成千上万的游客拥入这座古城，使其狭窄的街道不堪重负。

meanings.exampleEn: The dictator's decision to invade the neighboring country was condemned by the international community.
meanings.exampleZh: 独裁者侵略邻国的决定遭到国际社会谴责。

meanings.exampleEn: A sense of despair invaded his mind as he realized the magnitude of the failure.
meanings.exampleZh: 当他意识到失败的严重性时，一种绝望感侵袭了他的心头。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 invadere（in- 进入 + vadere 走）
etymology.tip: in（进入）+ vad（走）= 走进来 → 侵入、侵略

laundry.zh: 洗衣店；洗好的衣服；洗涤

meanings.exampleEn: She dropped off her suit at the laundry on her way to work.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在上班途中把西装送到了洗衣店。

meanings.exampleEn: The laundry is still damp, so we need to hang it out to dry.
meanings.exampleZh: 洗好的衣服还是湿的，我们需要把它们挂起来晾干。

meanings.exampleEn: This detergent is specially designed for the laundry of delicate fabrics.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种洗涤剂专为精细面料的洗涤而设计。

variants.zh: 洗衣店；洗好的衣服（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 lavanderie，源于拉丁语 lavare（洗）
etymology.tip: laund-（洗）+ -ry（场所）→ 洗衣场所，即洗衣店

meanings.exampleEn: The leakage of confidential data from the corporation caused a major scandal.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司机密数据的泄漏引发了一场重大丑闻。

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 leken，与古诺尔斯语 leka 有关，本义为“滴、漏”
etymology.suffix: -age = 表示行为、结果或状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: leak（漏）+ age（名词后缀）→ 漏的行为或漏出的东西，即“泄漏”。

meanings.exampleEn: The company is seeking to reduce labour costs by automating production.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司正寻求通过自动化生产来降低劳动成本。

meanings.exampleEn: Skilled labour is in high demand in the manufacturing industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 制造业对熟练劳工的需求很大。

meanings.exampleEn: They laboured all night to finish the project on time.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们通宵努力以按时完成项目。

meanings.zh: 费力地前进；艰难地移动
meanings.exampleEn: The old car laboured up the steep hill.
meanings.exampleZh: 那辆旧车费力地爬上了陡峭的山坡。

meanings.exampleZh: 供求法则决定了自由市场中的价格波动。

meanings.exampleEn: Newton's third law of motion states that every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
meanings.exampleZh: 牛顿第三运动定律指出，每个作用力都有大小相等、方向相反的反作用力。

meanings.exampleEn: In a civilized society, everyone is subject to the law.
meanings.exampleZh: 在文明社会中，每个人都受法律制约。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 lagu，意为“法律”，源自古诺尔斯语 lag（法律、规则）。
etymology.tip: law 直接来自古英语 lagu，记住“法律”即可；由它可派生 lawful（合法的）、lawyer（律师）等。

meanings.exampleEn: The villagers hung colorful lanterns along the street to celebrate the harvest festival.
meanings.exampleZh: 村民们沿街挂起五彩灯笼，庆祝丰收节。

meanings.exampleEn: He carried a lantern into the dark cave to illuminate the ancient murals.
meanings.exampleZh: 他提着提灯走进黑暗洞穴，照亮古老的壁画。

meanings.exampleEn: The lighthouse lantern flashed rhythmically, guiding ships safely through the treacherous strait.
meanings.exampleZh: 灯塔的航标灯有节奏地闪烁，引导船只安全通过危险的海峡。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 lanterna，源自古希腊语 lampein（发光）
etymology.tip: lantern = lan（亮）+ tern（名词后缀），能发光照明的器具就是灯笼/提灯。

meanings.exampleEn: The constitution guarantees every citizen the liberty of speech and thought.
meanings.exampleZh: 宪法保障每个公民的言论和思想自由。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient charter granted the town certain liberties in trade.
meanings.exampleZh: 那份古老的宪章授予该镇某些贸易特权。

meanings.exampleEn: I took the liberty of reserving a table for us at the restaurant.
meanings.exampleZh: 我冒昧地替我们在餐厅预订了座位。

meanings.exampleEn: He committed the liberty of criticizing his superior in public.
meanings.exampleZh: 他冒失地在公开场合批评了他的上司。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 libertas，由 liber（自由的）+ -tas（名词后缀）演变而来，经古法语 liberte 进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ty = 表示性质、状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: liber（自由）+ ty（名词后缀）= 自由的状态，记住“自由”的核心含义。

meanings.exampleEn: The sailor tied a complex knot to secure the cargo during the storm.
meanings.exampleZh: 水手打了一个复杂的结，以便在暴风雨中固定货物。

meanings.exampleEn: A knot of protesters gathered outside the parliament building.
meanings.exampleZh: 一群抗议者聚集在议会大厦外。

meanings.exampleEn: The knot of balancing economic growth and environmental protection perplexes many policymakers.
meanings.exampleZh: 平衡经济增长与环境保护的难题困扰着许多政策制定者。

meanings.exampleEn: He knotted the two ropes together to create a longer line.
meanings.exampleZh: 他把两根绳子打结连在一起，形成一条更长的绳子。

etymology.origin: 古英语 cnotta；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The company accepted liability for the damage caused by its products.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司对其产品造成的损害承担了责任。

meanings.exampleEn: The firm's liabilities exceeded its assets, leading to bankruptcy.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家公司的债务超过了资产，导致破产。

meanings.exampleEn: His liability to sudden anger made him difficult to work with.
meanings.exampleZh: 他容易突然发怒的倾向使他难以共事。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 ligare（捆绑），经由古法语和英语演变为 liability。
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: li-ability：能“绑”住你的东西，就是责任或债务。

related.zh: 宗教（重新捆绑人与神的联系）

meanings.exampleEn: The Allied forces liberated the occupied territories during World War II.
meanings.exampleZh: 二战期间，盟军解放了被占领的领土。

variants.zh: 解放；释放（第三人称单数）
解放；释放（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 liberare（使自由），源于 liber（自由的）
etymology.tip: liber（自由）+ ate（使动）→ 使自由，即“解放、释放”

meanings.exampleEn: The liberation of the oppressed people was the ultimate goal of the revolution.
meanings.exampleZh: 被压迫人民的解放是这场革命的最终目标。

variants.zh: 令人解放的；使人自由的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 liberare（使自由），源自 liber（自由的）
etymology.suffix: -ation 表示行为、状态或结果的名词后缀
etymology.tip: liber（自由）+ -ation（名词后缀）→ 获得自由的过程 → 解放

meanings.exampleEn: She learned to knit a sweater from her grandmother during the winter vacation.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在寒假期间跟祖母学会了编织毛衣。

meanings.exampleEn: The broken bones took several weeks to knit properly.
meanings.exampleZh: 断裂的骨头花了几周时间才愈合结合。

variants.zh: 编织；结合（第三人称单数）
编织；结合（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 cnyttan，与 knot（结）同源
etymology.tip: knit 与 knot 同源，编织就是打结结合

meanings.exampleEn: The shepherd carried the newborn lamb into the warm barn to protect it from the cold wind.
meanings.exampleZh: 牧羊人把新生的小羊羔抱进温暖的谷仓，以保护它免受寒风的侵袭。

meanings.exampleEn: The ewes usually lamb in early spring when the pasture begins to flourish.
meanings.exampleZh: 母羊通常在早春牧草开始茂盛时产羔。

phrases.zh: 任人宰割的人；无辜送死者

etymology.origin: 古英语 lamb，源自原始日耳曼语 *lambaz；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。

meanings.exampleEn: The learned professor could recite ancient Greek poetry from memory.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位有学问的教授能凭记忆背诵古希腊诗歌。

meanings.exampleEn: The journal publishes learned articles on various scientific disciplines.
meanings.exampleZh: 该期刊发表关于不同科学学科的学术文章。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 leornian（学习）的过去分词 learned，后用作形容词
etymology.tip: learn（学习）+ ed（已完成的）→ 已经学了很多的 → 有学问的

meanings.exampleEn: The physicist adjusted the lens to focus the laser beam precisely.
meanings.exampleZh: 物理学家调整透镜以精确聚焦激光束。

meanings.exampleEn: The photographer cleaned the lens before capturing the portrait.
meanings.exampleZh: 摄影师在拍摄肖像前清洁了镜头。

meanings.exampleEn: He replaced the scratched lens of his eyeglasses with a new one.
meanings.exampleZh: 他把自己眼镜上划伤的镜片换成了新的。

meanings.exampleEn: The cataract caused the lens of his eye to become increasingly opaque.
meanings.exampleZh: 白内障导致他眼睛的晶状体变得越来越混浊。

variants.zh: 透镜；镜头；镜片；晶状体（复数）

etymology.root: lens = 扁豆（因透镜形似扁豆）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 lens（扁豆），因透镜的形状与扁豆相似而得名。
etymology.tip: 透镜形似扁豆，记住 lens 就是“扁豆”即可联想出“透镜”。

liable.zh: 有义务的；应负责的；有...倾向的

meanings.exampleEn: The company is liable for any damage caused by its defective products.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司应对其缺陷产品造成的任何损害负责。

meanings.zh: 应受法律制裁的；负有赔偿责任的
meanings.exampleEn: If you violate the contract, you will be liable to pay heavy compensation.
meanings.exampleZh: 如果你违反合同，你将负有支付巨额赔偿的责任。

meanings.exampleEn: People who lack sleep are more liable to make mistakes in complex tasks.
meanings.exampleZh: 缺乏睡眠的人在处理复杂任务时更容易出错。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 ligare（捆绑），经古法语 liable 进入英语，原义为“被捆绑的”，引申为“负有义务的”。
etymology.tip: li（谐音“赖”）+ able（能）= 能“赖”到你头上，即要你负责。

lame.zh: 跛足的；僵痛的；不完全的；金属薄板

meanings.exampleEn: The lame dog struggled to keep up with the other hounds during the hunt.
meanings.exampleZh: 那只跛足的狗在狩猎时艰难地试图跟上其他猎犬。

meanings.exampleEn: After the intense workout, his back felt lame and he could barely bend over.
meanings.exampleZh: 剧烈锻炼后，他的背部感到僵痛，几乎无法弯腰。

meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer presented a lame defense that failed to convince the jury.
meanings.exampleZh: 律师提出了一个不充分的辩护，未能说服陪审团。

meanings.exampleEn: The artisan hammered the gold lame into delicate ornamental strips.
meanings.exampleZh: 工匠将金薄板锤打成精致的装饰条。

meanings.exampleEn: The severe injury lamed the athlete permanently, ending his career.
meanings.exampleZh: 那次重伤使这名运动员终身跛足，终结了他的职业生涯。

variants.zh: 使跛足（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 跛脚鸭（任期将满但失去实权的官员）

etymology.origin: 古英语 lama（跛的），基础词汇，无明显词根词缀
etymology.tip: 联想记忆：lame（累me）→ 腿脚不便，走两步就累。

meanings.exampleEn: The lawn stretches down to the river, meticulously maintained by the estate's gardeners.
meanings.exampleZh: 草坪一直延伸到河边，由庄园的园丁精心养护。

meanings.exampleEn: The bride's gown was made of fine lawn, delicate and translucent.
meanings.exampleZh: 新娘的礼服由上等细麻布制成，精致而半透明。

etymology.origin: 草地义来自古法语 launde（林间空地），可能源自凯尔特语；细麻布义来自法国城市 Laon（拉昂），该地以产细麻布闻名。
etymology.tip: 草坪（lawn）上铺着拉昂（Laon）产的细麻布野餐。

meanings.exampleEn: After years of hard work, she finally enjoys a life of leisure in the countryside.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过多年的辛苦工作，她终于在乡下享受悠闲的生活。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 licere（被允许），经古法语 leisir 演变为中古英语 leisure
etymology.tip: lic=允许，被允许自由支配的时间就是闲暇

meanings.exampleEn: The worker used a long lever to pry the heavy stone out of the ground.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人用一根长杠杆把沉重的石头从地里撬了出来。

meanings.exampleEn: They levered the crate open with an iron bar.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们用铁棍把板条箱撬开了。

variants.zh: 用杠杆撬动（第三人称单数）
用杠杆撬动（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 levier，源自拉丁语 levare（举起），与 levis（轻）相关。
etymology.suffix: -er = 表示工具或动作执行者
etymology.tip: 杠杆（lever）就是用来“举起（lev-）”重物的工具（-er）。

meanings.exampleEn: The portrait is a perfect likeness of her grandmother.
meanings.exampleZh: 这幅肖像画和她祖母一模一样。

variants.zh: 相象；相似物；样子（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 gelic（相似的）加上名词后缀 -ness
etymology.suffix: -ness = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: like（相似）+ ness（名词后缀）→ 相似的性质或状态 → 相象、相似物

meanings.exampleEn: To succeed in this field, you must be dedicated, and likewise, you need to keep learning constantly.
meanings.exampleZh: 要在这一领域取得成功，你必须专注投入，同样地，你还需要不断学习。

etymology.root: like = 相似的；wise = 方式、方向
etymology.origin: 来自中古英语，由 like 与 -wise（表示方式、方向的后缀）组合而成
etymology.tip: like（相似）+ wise（方式）→ 以相似的方式 → 同样地

meanings.exampleEn: There is a strong likelihood that the experiment will succeed if the conditions remain stable.
meanings.exampleZh: 如果条件保持稳定，这项实验成功的可能性很大。

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 liklihod，由 likely（可能的）+ -hood（状态、性质）构成
etymology.tip: likely（可能的）+ hood（状态）= 可能性

meanings.exampleEn: The mathematician proposed a linear model to describe the relationship between the two variables.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位数学家提出了一个线性模型来描述两个变量之间的关系。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 linearis，源自 linea（线）
etymology.suffix: -ar = 形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”
etymology.tip: line（线）+ -ar（形容词后缀）→ 与线有关的 → 线性的

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy imposes a strict limitation on the amount of carbon emissions.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策对碳排放量施加了严格的限制。

meanings.exampleEn: One major limitation of this approach is its inability to handle large datasets efficiently.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种方法的一个主要缺陷是无法高效处理大型数据集。

meanings.exampleEn: The bank sets a daily withdrawal limitation of five thousand dollars.
meanings.exampleZh: 银行设定了每日五千美元的取款限额。

variants.zh: 限制性的；起限制作用的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 limes（边界），经由古法语 limite 进入英语；-ation 为名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果。
etymology.suffix: -ation = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: limit（界限）+ -ation（名词后缀）→ 被限定在界限内 → 限制、缺陷、限额。

layout.zh: 布局；陈列；规划图；页面布局

meanings.exampleEn: The layout of the new office was designed to encourage collaboration among employees.
meanings.exampleZh: 新办公室的布局旨在鼓励员工之间的协作。

meanings.exampleEn: She spent hours adjusting the page layout to make the magazine look more professional.
meanings.exampleZh: 她花了几个小时调整页面布局，使杂志看起来更专业。

meanings.exampleEn: The architect presented a detailed layout of the proposed shopping mall to the investors.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑师向投资者展示了拟建购物中心的详细规划图。

etymology.origin: 由动词短语 lay out（布置、安排）复合而成，后演变为名词
etymology.tip: lay（放）+ out（出）= 把东西摆放出来，即为布局

meanings.exampleEn: The legend of King Arthur has inspired countless works of art.
meanings.exampleZh: 亚瑟王的传说启发了无数艺术作品。

meanings.exampleEn: Celtic legend is rich in heroic tales and supernatural events.
meanings.exampleZh: 凯尔特传奇文学充满了英雄故事和超自然事件。

meanings.exampleEn: Consult the map legend to understand the symbols used on the chart.
meanings.exampleZh: 查阅地图图例以理解图表上使用的符号。

variants.zh: 传说；传奇文学；图例（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 legenda（应被阅读的东西），源自 legere（读，收集）
etymology.suffix: -end（表示“应被...的”，来自拉丁语动形词后缀 -endus/-enda）
etymology.tip: leg（读）+ end（后缀）→ 值得读的故事就是传说

meanings.zh: 最少的；最小的（little 的最高级）
meanings.exampleEn: This is the least expensive solution among all the proposals we have considered.
meanings.exampleZh: 这是我们所考虑过的所有方案中最不昂贵的一个。

meanings.exampleEn: Of all the candidates, she was the least likely to compromise on her principles.
meanings.exampleZh: 在所有候选人中，她是最不可能在原则上妥协的。

meanings.exampleEn: The least we can do is to acknowledge the efforts of those who worked behind the scenes.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们至少应该感谢那些在幕后工作的人所付出的努力。

etymology.origin: 古英语 læsest，为 little 的最高级形式；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: least 与 less 同源，less 是比较级，least 是最高级，意为“最少”。

imperative.zh: 命令；必要的事；规则；祈使语气

meanings.exampleEn: It is imperative that all students submit their assignments before the deadline.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有学生必须在截止日期前提交作业，这是必要的。

meanings.exampleEn: The imperative nature of the crisis left no time for deliberation.
meanings.exampleZh: 危机的紧迫性使得没有时间进行商议。

meanings.exampleEn: His imperative tone made it clear that he expected obedience.
meanings.exampleZh: 他命令的语气表明他期望服从。

meanings.exampleEn: In the sentence 'Open the window', 'open' is an imperative verb.
meanings.exampleZh: 在句子“Open the window”中，“open”是祈使动词。

meanings.exampleEn: Reducing carbon emissions is a moral imperative for modern society.
meanings.exampleZh: 减少碳排放是现代社会的道德必要之事。

meanings.exampleEn: The king's imperative was that all rebels be executed.
meanings.exampleZh: 国王的命令是所有叛乱者都要被处决。

meanings.exampleEn: The imperative of fair play governs all competitive sports.
meanings.exampleZh: 公平竞争的规则支配着所有竞技体育。

meanings.exampleEn: In English, the imperative is formed by using the base form of the verb.
meanings.exampleZh: 在英语中，祈使语气通过使用动词原形来构成。

phrases.zh: 道德义务；道德上的必要之事

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 imperare '命令'，由 in- '在...上' + parare '准备' 构成
etymology.tip: im- 加强 + imper 命令 + -ative 的 → 加强命令的 → 命令的；必要的

meanings.exampleEn: The bride carried a bouquet of white lilies, symbolizing purity and elegance.
meanings.exampleZh: 新娘手持一束白色百合花，象征着纯洁与优雅。

etymology.origin: 源自古英语 lilie，进一步来自拉丁语 lilium，意为“百合花”。
etymology.tip: lily 发音像“丽丽”，美丽的百合花就叫“丽丽”。

related.zh: 饰有百合花的；多百合的

meanings.exampleEn: The linguistic diversity of the region has attracted many researchers from around the world.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区的语言多样性吸引了来自世界各地的许多研究者。

variants.zh: 语言学家；通晓数种语言的人

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 lingua（舌头，语言）
etymology.suffix: -istic = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: lingu（语言）+ istic（形容词后缀）→ 与语言相关的 → 语言的；语言学的

meanings.exampleEn: The company signed a five-year lease on the office building.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司签署了办公楼的五年租约。

meanings.exampleEn: The lease expires at the end of this month, so we must decide whether to renew it.
meanings.exampleZh: 租期本月底届满，我们必须决定是否续租。

meanings.exampleEn: They leased the vacant land to a local farmer for agricultural use.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们把空地出租给当地农民用于农业。

meanings.exampleEn: The university leased several apartments to accommodate visiting scholars.
meanings.exampleZh: 大学租用了几套公寓来安置访问学者。

variants.zh: 出租；租用（第三人称单数）
出租；租用（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 laissier（让走，放开），最终源自拉丁语 laxare（放松）
etymology.tip: lease 与 relax 同源，把东西“放松”出去就是“出租”

meanings.exampleEn: She applied a subtle shade of lipstick before the interview to present a professional image.
meanings.exampleZh: 面试前她涂了一抹淡色口红，以展现专业的形象。

phrases.zh: 口红效应（经济不景气时口红销量上升的现象）

etymology.origin: 由 lip（嘴唇）和 stick（棒状物）组合而成的复合词，指涂在嘴唇上的棒状化妆品。
etymology.tip: 嘴唇（lip）上的一根小棒（stick）就是口红（lipstick）。

meanings.exampleEn: She devoted her lifetime to the study of ancient Chinese literature.
meanings.exampleZh: 她毕生致力于中国古代文学的研究。

phrases.zh: 一生中难得的；千载难逢的

etymology.origin: 古英语复合词，由 līf（生命）和 tīma（时间）组合而成
etymology.tip: life（生命）+ time（时间）= 一生的时间

meanings.exampleEn: He is a remarkably perceptive individual who can easily discern others' emotions.
meanings.exampleZh: 他是一个非常敏锐的人，能轻易察觉他人的情绪。

meanings.exampleEn: The rights of the individual are often weighed against the interests of the community.
meanings.exampleZh: 个人权利常常要与社区利益进行权衡。

meanings.exampleEn: In a complex ecosystem, each individual contributes to the overall stability of the habitat.
meanings.exampleZh: 在复杂的生态系统中，每个个体都对栖息地的整体稳定性有所贡献。

meanings.exampleEn: Individual responsibility is a cornerstone of professional ethics in any organization.
meanings.exampleZh: 个人责任是任何组织中职业道德的基石。

meanings.exampleEn: The ecologist tracked individual organisms to study their migration patterns.
meanings.exampleZh: 生态学家追踪个体生物体以研究它们的迁徙模式。

meanings.exampleEn: The tutor offered individual instruction to each student to address their specific weaknesses.
meanings.exampleZh: 导师为每个学生提供单独的指导，以解决他们的具体弱点。

meanings.exampleEn: Her individual style of painting has earned her international acclaim.
meanings.exampleZh: 她独特的绘画风格为她赢得了国际赞誉。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 individuus（不可分的），由 in-（不）+ dividuus（可分的）构成，后经法语进入英语
etymology.tip: in（不）+ divid（分开）+ ual（的）→ 不可分的 → 个人的、个体的

meanings.exampleEn: The professor was invited to deliver a keynote speech at the international conference.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位教授受邀在国际会议上发表主旨演讲。

meanings.exampleEn: The government invited comments from the public on the new environmental policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府就新环境政策征求公众意见。

meanings.exampleEn: His reckless remarks invited severe criticism from the media.
meanings.exampleZh: 他轻率的言论招致了媒体的严厉批评。

meanings.exampleEn: I received an invite to her wedding ceremony via email.
meanings.exampleZh: 我通过电子邮件收到了她婚礼的邀请。

etymology.root: vit = 走（拉丁语 *vitare，意为“前往”）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 invitare，由 in-（向内）和 *vitare（走）构成，原意为“请人走进来”
etymology.tip: in（向内）+ vit（走）+ e → 请人走进来 → 邀请

jug.zh: 水壶；监牢；模仿夜莺的叫声

meanings.exampleZh: 她把壶里的开水倒进茶壶。

meanings.exampleEn: He spent a night in the jug for disorderly conduct.
meanings.exampleZh: 他因扰乱治安在监牢里待了一夜。

meanings.exampleEn: He can jug like a nightingale, a skill he learned in the countryside.
meanings.exampleZh: 他能模仿夜莺的叫声，这是他在乡下学会的本领。

variants.zh: 模仿夜莺的叫声（第三人称单数）
模仿夜莺的叫声（过去式/过去分词）
模仿夜莺的叫声（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；'模仿夜莺叫声'为拟声用法。

limited.zh: 有限制的；有限的；有限责任的

meanings.exampleEn: The available resources are limited, so we must allocate them carefully.
meanings.exampleZh: 可用资源是有限的，所以我们必须仔细分配。

meanings.exampleEn: The company is registered as a limited liability corporation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家公司注册为有限责任公司。

variants.zh: 限制性的；起限制作用的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 limes（边界），经由古法语 limite 进入英语，-ed 构成形容词表示“有界限的”。
etymology.tip: limit（界限）+ ed（的）= 有界限的 → 有限的

meanings.exampleEn: The disgruntled employee kicked the vending machine in a fit of rage, causing it to malfunction.
meanings.exampleZh: 心怀不满的员工一怒之下踢了自动售货机，导致它出现故障。

meanings.exampleEn: His powerful kick sent the ball hurtling toward the goal, leaving the defender helpless.
meanings.exampleZh: 他有力的一脚将球猛踢向球门，令防守队员无可奈何。

meanings.exampleEn: The shotgun's violent kick bruised the hunter's shoulder, reminding him to brace properly.
meanings.exampleZh: 猎枪剧烈的后座力弄伤了猎人的肩膀，提醒他要正确抵肩。

meanings.exampleEn: The glass bottle's concave kick prevents it from toppling over easily on uneven surfaces.
meanings.exampleZh: 玻璃瓶的凹底使其在凹凸不平的表面上不易倾倒。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

inflate.zh: 使膨胀；使得意；使通货膨胀；使充气

meanings.exampleEn: The influx of capital inflated asset prices across the region.
meanings.exampleZh: 资本涌入使该地区的资产价格膨胀。

meanings.exampleEn: His undeserved praise inflated her ego to an insufferable degree.
meanings.exampleZh: 他不恰当的赞美使她得意忘形到令人难以忍受的程度。

meanings.exampleEn: The economy was inflated by the central bank's aggressive monetary expansion.
meanings.exampleZh: 经济因中央银行激进的货币扩张而通货膨胀。

meanings.exampleEn: The mechanic inflated the flat tire with compressed air.
meanings.exampleZh: 修理工用压缩空气给瘪胎充气。

meanings.exampleEn: The emergency slide inflates automatically when the aircraft door is opened.
meanings.exampleZh: 飞机舱门打开时，紧急滑梯会自动充气膨胀。

variants.zh: 使膨胀；使充气；使得意；使通货膨胀（第三人称单数）
使膨胀；使充气；使得意；使通货膨胀（过去式/过去分词）
使膨胀；使充气；使得意；使通货膨胀（现在分词）

etymology.root: flat = 吹（来自拉丁语 flare）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 inflare，由 in- '进入' + flare '吹' 构成，原义为'吹入'，引申为'使膨胀'。
etymology.tip: in（进入）+ flat（吹）+ ate（动词后缀）→ 往里吹气 → 使膨胀；引申为使得意、使通货膨胀。

meanings.exampleEn: The speed limit on this highway is 120 kilometers per hour.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条高速公路的速度限制是每小时120公里。

meanings.exampleEn: We must limit our expenses to stay within the budget.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们必须限制开支以保持在预算范围内。

variants.zh: 限制性的；起限制作用的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 limes（边界），其属格为 limitis；后经古法语 limite 进入英语。
etymology.tip: limit 就是“边界”，走到边界即被“限制”。

meanings.exampleEn: The accident left him unable to move his lower limbs.
meanings.exampleZh: 那场事故使他无法移动下肢。

meanings.exampleEn: The storm tore a huge limb from the ancient oak tree.
meanings.exampleZh: 暴风雨从古橡树上扯下了一根巨大的枝干。

meanings.exampleEn: The bird's powerful limbs carried it swiftly across the sky.
meanings.exampleZh: 那只鸟有力的翅膀载着它迅速飞过天空。

meanings.exampleEn: They built their house on the eastern limb of the valley.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们把房子建在山谷东边的边缘地带。

phrases.zh: 处于孤立无援的境地；冒险
法律的爪牙（常指警察或律师）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 lim，意为肢体、树枝；与古诺斯语 limr 同源。
etymology.tip: limb 像一根“枝”分叉出“四肢”，记住“有枝有肢就是 limb”。

meanings.exampleEn: He studied hard lest he should fail the exam.
meanings.exampleZh: 他努力学习，以免考试不及格。

meanings.exampleEn: She spoke in a low voice lest she should wake the baby.
meanings.exampleZh: 她低声说话，唯恐吵醒婴儿。

meanings.exampleEn: Please double-check the data lest mistakes be made.
meanings.exampleZh: 请仔细核对数据，免得出错。

phrases.zh: 勿忘历史；以免我们忘记

etymology.origin: 源自古英语短语 'þy læs þe'（意为 'the less that'），后缩合为 lest。
etymology.tip: 由 'the less that' 缩合而来，意为 '以免'。

meanings.exampleEn: The court ruled that the contract was legitimate and enforceable.
meanings.exampleZh: 法院裁定该合同合法且可强制执行。

meanings.exampleEn: Citizens have a legitimate right to protest against unfair policies.
meanings.exampleZh: 公民有正当权利抗议不公平的政策。

meanings.exampleEn: In some legal systems, legitimate children have different inheritance rights from illegitimate ones.
meanings.exampleZh: 在某些法律体系中，婚生子女与非婚生子女的继承权不同。

meanings.exampleEn: The government passed a law to legitimate the previously informal trade practices.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府通过一项法律，使先前非正式的交易做法合法化。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 legitimus（合法的），源自 lex（法律）的属格 legis
etymology.suffix: -ate 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
etymology.tip: leg（法律）+ it + imate → 法律认可的，即“合法的”

meanings.exampleEn: The government has taken effective measures to lessen the impact of the economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已采取有效措施来减轻经济危机的影响。

meanings.exampleEn: The pain gradually lessened as the medicine took effect.
meanings.exampleZh: 随着药物起效，疼痛逐渐减轻了。

variants.zh: 减少；减轻（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 由古英语 læssa（更少）加动词后缀 -en 构成
etymology.tip: less（少）+ en（使）→ 使变少，即减少

literacy.zh: 读写能力；识字；精通文学

meanings.exampleEn: The government has launched a new campaign to improve adult literacy in rural areas.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府发起了一项新运动，以提高农村地区成年人的读写能力。

meanings.exampleEn: Her deep literacy in classical literature made her a respected critic.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对古典文学的精通使她成为一位受人尊敬的评论家。

variants.zh: 有读写能力的；有文化的

phrases.zh: 计算机素养；电脑操作能力
媒介素养；媒体识读能力

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 littera（字母），经由中古英语进入现代英语。
etymology.tip: liter（文字）+ acy（状态）→ 掌握文字的状态 → 读写能力。

related.zh: 有读写能力的；有文化的

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient temple was built with massive blocks of limestone, which have withstood centuries of erosion.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古庙用巨大的石灰石块建造，历经数百年侵蚀依然屹立。

variants.zh: 石灰石（复数形式，指多种石灰石）

etymology.tip: 石灰（lime）+ 石头（stone）就是石灰石

related.zh: 聚光灯；公众注意的中心

meanings.exampleEn: The upper lip of the pitcher plant forms a slippery rim that traps insects.
meanings.exampleZh: 猪笼草的唇状构造形成了一道光滑的边缘，用以困住昆虫。

phrases.zh: 空头人情；口惠而实不至

etymology.origin: 古英语 lippa（唇）；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for driving without a license.
meanings.exampleZh: 他因无照驾驶而被逮捕。

meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant applied for a license to sell alcohol.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家餐厅申请了出售酒类的许可证。

meanings.exampleEn: The company holds a license to operate in the region.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司持有在该地区经营的特许权。

meanings.exampleEn: The government licensed the new drug for clinical use.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府批准了这种新药用于临床。

meanings.exampleEn: The state licenses nurses after they pass the exam.
meanings.exampleZh: 该州在护士通过考试后给他们颁发执照。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 licentia（自由、许可），源自 licere（被允许）
etymology.suffix: -ense（表示性质或状态，源自拉丁语 -entia）
etymology.tip: lic=允许，获得license就是被允许做某事

meanings.exampleEn: The exact locality of the ancient ruins remains unknown to archaeologists.
meanings.exampleZh: 古代遗址的确切位置对考古学家来说仍然未知。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 localis，经由中古法语 localité 进入英语，意为“地方、位置”
etymology.suffix: -ality = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: loc（地方）+ -ality（性质）→ 某个地方的性质 → 所在地、位置

meanings.exampleEn: She is an expert in modern Chinese literature and has published several influential papers.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是中国现代文学专家，发表过多篇有影响力的论文。

meanings.exampleEn: The scientist reviewed the existing literature before designing her experiment.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位科学家在设计实验前查阅了现有的文献。

variants.zh: 有读写能力的；有文化的

etymology.tip: liter（文字）+ -ature（名词后缀）→ 用文字写成的作品 → 文学、文献。

related.zh: 有读写能力的；有文化的

meanings.exampleEn: After the meeting, several colleagues lingered in the conference room to discuss the proposal.
meanings.exampleZh: 会议结束后，几位同事在会议室逗留，讨论这项提案。

meanings.exampleZh: 火被扑灭很久之后，烟味仍弥漫在空气中久久不散。

meanings.exampleZh: 吃早饭别磨蹭，我们得赶早班火车。

meanings.exampleEn: They lingered away the whole afternoon in the café, chatting about their college days.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们在咖啡馆里消磨了整个下午，聊着大学时代的往事。

variants.zh: 逗留；徘徊；继续存留；磨蹭（第三人称单数）

meanings.exampleZh: 在猛烈的暴风雨中，那棵古树被一道闪电劈成了两半。

meanings.exampleZh: 猎豹以闪电般的速度冲过稀树草原去捕捉猎物。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 līhting，与 light（光）相关，原指“照亮”的动作，后专指闪电。
etymology.tip: light（光）+ -ing → 天空中的闪光，即闪电。

meanings.exampleEn: The dramatic landscape of the Scottish Highlands attracts thousands of hikers every year.
meanings.exampleZh: 苏格兰高地壮丽的风景每年吸引成千上万的徒步旅行者。

meanings.exampleEn: The landscape of Guilin, with its limestone peaks and winding rivers, is often regarded as the finest under heaven.
meanings.exampleZh: 桂林的山水，以其石灰岩峰林和蜿蜒的河流，常被誉为天下第一。

meanings.exampleEn: The exhibition features a remarkable landscape painted by a 17th-century Dutch master.
meanings.exampleZh: 展览展出了一幅由17世纪荷兰大师创作的杰出风景画。

meanings.zh: 美化（环境）；对（土地）做景观美化

variants.zh: 美化环境（第三人称单数）
景观美化师；园林设计师
景观美化的；有园林景致的

phrases.zh: 景观建筑学；园林建筑学

meanings.exampleZh: 这座老宅是她曾祖父留下的遗产，他于19世纪建造了它。

variants.zh: 祖先传下来之物；遗赠物（复数）

phrases.zh: 遗留系统（指旧有的计算机系统或软件）

meanings.exampleEn: The nutritionist recommended lean meat as a healthier source of protein.
meanings.exampleZh: 营养学家推荐瘦肉作为更健康的蛋白质来源。

meanings.exampleZh: 她倚靠在栏杆上，凝视着远山，陷入沉思。

meanings.exampleZh: 尽管身材瘦削，这位运动员却拥有非凡的耐力和力量。

最瘦的，脂肪最少的（最高级）

meanings.exampleZh: 水手升起筝帆以利用强劲的离岸风。

meanings.exampleZh: 小心那个自称理财顾问的骗子。

（使）像风筝一样飘动；用空头支票骗钱

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleZh: 对学习的追求是一生的努力，它丰富心灵和品格。

meanings.exampleEn: Her vast learning in classical literature impressed the entire academic committee.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在古典文学方面的渊博学识给整个学术委员会留下了深刻印象。

meanings.exampleZh: 译者逐字地翻译了这部古代文本，保留了每一个古词。
