meanings.exampleEn: The scientist studied the metabolic changes that occur in cells under extreme environmental stress.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位科学家研究了极端环境压力下细胞中发生的变化。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 metabole（变化），由 meta（变化）和 ballein（抛掷）组合而成，后经拉丁语进入英语。
etymology.tip: meta（变化）+ bol（抛掷）+ ic（的）→ 体内物质被抛来抛去不断转化 → 新陈代谢的

meanings.exampleEn: One of her merits as a manager is the ability to remain calm under pressure.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名经理，她的优点之一是能在压力下保持冷静。

meanings.exampleEn: The soldier was honored for his merits in the battle.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名士兵因在战斗中的功绩而受到表彰。

meanings.exampleEn: The proposal has considerable merit and deserves further discussion.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项提议具有相当大的价值，值得进一步讨论。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel merits close attention for its subtle portrayal of human emotions.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说因其对人类情感的细腻描绘而值得密切关注。

variants.zh: 值得；应得（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 meritum（应得之物），源于动词 merere（挣得；值得）
etymology.tip: mer（值得）+ it（结果）→ 值得得到的结果 → 功绩、价值

meanings.exampleEn: Her memory of the accident remains vivid even after all these years.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管多年过去，她对那次事故的记忆依然清晰。

meanings.exampleEn: A good memory is essential for mastering a foreign language.
meanings.exampleZh: 良好的记忆力对于掌握一门外语至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: The old photographs brought back sweet memories of her childhood.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些老照片唤起了她对童年的甜蜜回忆。

meanings.exampleEn: The monument was erected in memory of the fallen soldiers.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座纪念碑是为了纪念阵亡将士而建立的。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 memoria，源于 memor（有记忆的，记住的）
etymology.suffix: -y = 名词后缀，表示状态、性质
etymology.tip: memor（记忆）+ -y（名词后缀）→ 记忆、记忆力。联想：memorize（记住）和 memory 同根，记住这个词就能记住“记忆”。

meanings.exampleEn: The development of metallurgy was a turning point in ancient human civilization.
meanings.exampleZh: 冶金学的发展是古代人类文明的一个转折点。

etymology.root: metall- = 金属；-urgy = 加工技艺
etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 metallourgos（金属加工者），由 metallon（金属）和 ergon（工作、加工）组合而成。
etymology.tip: metall（金属）+ urgy（工艺）→ 加工金属的工艺 → 冶金学。

meanings.exampleEn: The merchant's reputation for fair dealing attracted customers from distant provinces.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位商人公平交易的名声吸引了来自遥远省份的顾客。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mercari（贸易），经古法语 marchant 进入英语
etymology.tip: merchant 是进行贸易（merc）的人（-ant），即商人。

meanings.exampleEn: In the meantime, the research team continued to collect valuable data.
meanings.exampleZh: 在此期间，研究团队继续收集宝贵的数据。

meanings.exampleEn: Meantime, the global economy was undergoing profound changes.
meanings.exampleZh: 与此同时，全球经济正在经历深刻的变化。

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 meane time，意为“中间的时间”；其中 mean 源自拉丁语 medianus（中间的）
etymology.tip: mean（中间）+ time（时间）→ 在中间的时间 → 其间

meanings.exampleEn: The medieval castle stood on the hill, attracting thousands of tourists every year.
meanings.exampleZh: 那座中世纪的城堡矗立在山丘上，每年吸引成千上万的游客。

variants.zh: 中世纪精神；中世纪风格
中世纪史专家；中世纪文化研究者
以中世纪方式；在中世纪

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 medium aevum（中间的时代），后经法语进入英语
etymology.tip: medi（中间）+ ev（时代）+ al（…的）→ 中间时代的 → 中世纪的

margin.zh: 页边的空白；边缘；界限；余裕

meanings.exampleEn: Please leave a margin of about two centimeters on the left side of the paper.
meanings.exampleZh: 请在纸张左侧留出约两厘米的页边空白。

meanings.exampleEn: The company is now operating on the margin of bankruptcy.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家公司目前正濒临破产边缘。

meanings.exampleEn: The margin between success and failure is often extremely narrow.
meanings.exampleZh: 成功与失败之间的界限往往极其狭窄。

meanings.exampleEn: In this critical experiment, we have no margin for error.
meanings.exampleZh: 在这个关键实验中，我们没有犯错的余地。

variants.zh: 页边的空白；边缘；界限；余裕（复数）
边缘的；微小的；不重要的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 margo（边缘），经由古法语进入英语
etymology.tip: marg（边缘）+ in（在...里）→ 在边缘里留白，就是页边空白

meanings.exampleEn: The rising unemployment rate is a serious menace to social stability.
meanings.exampleZh: 不断上升的失业率是对社会稳定的严重威胁。

meanings.exampleEn: Floods menace the low-lying villages along the river every summer.
meanings.exampleZh: 每年夏天洪水都会威胁河边的低洼村庄。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 minacia（威胁），源自 minax（威胁的），与 minere（突出）有关。
etymology.tip: min（突出）如利剑悬顶，威胁（menace）迫在眼前。

meanings.exampleEn: The microprocessor is the central unit that executes instructions in a computer system.
meanings.exampleZh: 微处理器是计算机系统中执行指令的核心单元。

etymology.origin: 由前缀 micro-（微小）加上 processor（处理器）构成，processor 源自拉丁语 processus，意为“前进、处理”。
etymology.tip: micro（微小）+ process（处理）+ or（物）→ 能处理微小数据的器件，即微处理器。

mechanical.zh: 机械的；机械性的；力学的

meanings.exampleEn: The mechanical parts of the machine need regular lubrication to prevent wear.
meanings.exampleZh: 机器的机械部件需要定期润滑以防止磨损。

meanings.exampleEn: His mechanical response to the question revealed that he had not really listened.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对这个问题机械性的回答表明他并没有真正在听。

meanings.exampleEn: The students conducted an experiment to verify the mechanical principles of motion.
meanings.exampleZh: 学生们做了一个实验来验证运动的力学原理。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 mechanikos，经拉丁语 mechanicus 进入英语，意为“机器的”
etymology.tip: mechan（机器）+ ical（形容词后缀）= 与机器相关的，即“机械的”

meanings.exampleEn: The engineer selected a lightweight composite material for the aircraft fuselage.
meanings.exampleZh: 工程师为飞机机身选用了一种轻质复合材料。

meanings.exampleEn: The government dispatched emergency materials to the flood-stricken region.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府向洪灾地区紧急调拨物资。

meanings.exampleEn: The novelist gathered abundant material from her travels for the new book.
meanings.exampleZh: 小说家从旅行中收集了大量素材用于新书。

meanings.exampleEn: This silk material drapes beautifully and is ideal for evening gowns.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种丝绸布料垂坠感极佳，非常适合制作晚礼服。

variants.zh: 唯物主义者；物质主义者

etymology.root: mater = 母亲，引申为物质/材料
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 materia（物质、材料），源自 mater（母亲），因母亲被视为生命之源
etymology.suffix: -al 形容词后缀，表示'...的'；也作名词后缀
etymology.tip: 母亲（mater）是万物之源，由她衍生出物质（material）

meanings.exampleEn: The government's response was merely a temporary measure to appease public discontent.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府的回应仅仅是安抚公众不满的临时措施。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 merus（纯粹的，未混合的）
etymology.tip: mere（纯粹的）加上副词后缀 -ly，就是“纯粹地、仅仅地”。

meanings.exampleEn: Advanced maths is a prerequisite for many scientific research fields.
meanings.exampleZh: 高等数学是许多科学研究领域的先修课程。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 mathema（学习、知识），是 mathematics 的缩写形式
etymology.suffix: -s（来自 mathematics 的复数后缀，此处作为学科名词的一部分）
etymology.tip: math=学习，-s=学科；学习数字的学科就是数学。

meanings.exampleEn: The maturation of the abscess was accompanied by severe pain and swelling.
meanings.exampleZh: 脓肿的化脓伴随着剧烈的疼痛和肿胀。

meanings.exampleEn: The maturation of the immune system continues throughout childhood and adolescence.
meanings.exampleZh: 免疫系统的成熟贯穿整个童年和青春期。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 maturatio，由 maturus（成熟的）+ -ation 构成
etymology.tip: matur（成熟）+ ation（过程）→ 成熟的过程

meanings.exampleEn: The general's clever manoeuvre of his troops surprised the enemy.
meanings.exampleZh: 将军对部队的巧妙调遣使敌人措手不及。

meanings.exampleEn: The navy is conducting a large-scale manoeuvre in the Pacific Ocean.
meanings.exampleZh: 海军正在太平洋进行大规模演习。

meanings.exampleEn: This political manoeuvre was designed to win more support from the voters.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一政治策略旨在赢得选民更多支持。

meanings.exampleEn: The commander manoeuvred his forces to the left flank.
meanings.exampleZh: 指挥官将部队调遣到左翼。

meanings.exampleEn: The troops are manoeuvring in the desert for the upcoming inspection.
meanings.exampleZh: 部队正在沙漠中演习，为即将到来的检阅做准备。

meanings.exampleEn: She manoeuvred to become the chairman of the committee.
meanings.exampleZh: 她施巧计成为了委员会主席。

variants.zh: 调遣；演习；用策略（过去式/过去分词）
调遣；演习；用策略（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自法语 manœuvre，源自拉丁语 manuoperari，由 manus（手）和 operari（工作）构成，原指‘手工操作’，后引申为军事调遣和策略。
etymology.tip: manu(手)+oper(工作)=用手操作，引申为调遣、策略。

meanings.exampleEn: The judge showed no mercy to the hardened criminal.
meanings.exampleZh: 法官对那个惯犯毫不仁慈。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 merces（报酬，恩惠），经古法语 merci 进入英语
etymology.tip: mer（恩惠）+ cy（名词后缀）→ 给予恩惠 → 仁慈、怜悯

meanings.exampleEn: The mighty river carved its way through the ancient canyon over millennia.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条强大的河流历经数千年在古老的峡谷中冲刷出了自己的河道。

meanings.exampleEn: In times of crisis, the mighty must protect the weak rather than exploit them.
meanings.exampleZh: 在危机时期，有势力的人应当保护弱者，而不是剥削他们。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 mihtig，由 might（力量）+ -ig（形容词后缀）演变而来
etymology.tip: mighty = might（力量）+ y（充满……的）→ 充满力量的 → 强大的

meanings.exampleEn: The meteorite left a massive crater in the desert, attracting scientists from around the world.
meanings.exampleZh: 这颗陨星在沙漠中留下了一个巨大的陨石坑，吸引了来自世界各地的科学家。

etymology.root: meteor = 高空中的事物，悬浮
etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 meteōron（高空中的事物）+ 后缀 -ite（表示岩石或矿物）
etymology.tip: meteor（流星）+ ite（石头）→ 从天上掉下来的石头，即陨星。

metallic.zh: 金属的；含金属的；产生金属的

meanings.exampleEn: The metallic frame of the bridge was designed to withstand extreme weather conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座桥的金属框架被设计成能够承受极端天气条件。

meanings.exampleEn: The water in this region has a metallic taste due to the high concentration of minerals.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于矿物质浓度高，这个地区的水带有一种含金属的味道。

meanings.exampleEn: The metallic sound of the hammer striking the anvil echoed through the workshop.
meanings.exampleZh: 锤子敲击铁砧产生的金属声响彻整个车间。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 metallum，源自古希腊语 métallon，意为“金属、矿”。
etymology.tip: 金属（metal）加上形容词后缀 -ic，就是“金属的”。

meanings.exampleEn: The athlete sprinted the final metre to clinch the gold medal.
meanings.exampleZh: 运动员冲刺最后一米，夺得了金牌。

meanings.exampleEn: The poet meticulously arranged the metre of each line to create a haunting rhythm.
meanings.exampleZh: 诗人精心安排每一行的格律，以营造一种萦绕心头的韵律。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 metron，意为“测量”
etymology.tip: metre 既用于测量长度（米），也用于测量诗歌的节奏（格律），都与“测量”相关。

meanings.exampleEn: The militant protesters clashed with the police during the demonstration.
meanings.exampleZh: 在示威游行中，好战的抗议者与警察发生了冲突。

meanings.exampleEn: The government arrested several militants suspected of planning the attack.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府逮捕了几名涉嫌策划袭击的激进分子。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 militare（当兵，作战），由 miles（士兵）派生而来
etymology.suffix: -ant = 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
etymology.tip: milit-（士兵）+ -ant（…的）→ 像士兵一样好斗的 → 好战的

meanings.exampleEn: The mysterious figure was last seen at midnight, when the streets were completely deserted.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个神秘的身影最后一次被人看到是在午夜，当时街上空无一人。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 midniht，由 mid（中间）和 niht（夜）复合而成
etymology.tip: mid（中间）+ night（夜）→ 夜的中间 → 午夜

meanings.exampleEn: The advent of the microcomputer has fundamentally transformed the way we process and store information.
meanings.exampleZh: 微电脑的出现从根本上改变了我们处理和存储信息的方式。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 computare（计算），经由 computer（计算机）组合而成
etymology.tip: micro（小）+ comput（计算）+ er（机器）→ 微型计算机

meanings.exampleEn: The migrant traveled thousands of miles to find a better life.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名移居者跋涉数千英里以寻找更好的生活。

meanings.exampleEn: Migrant birds return to the same wetland every spring.
meanings.exampleZh: 候鸟每年春天都会回到同一片湿地。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 migrare，意为‘迁移、移居’
etymology.suffix: -ant = 表示人或物，或形容词后缀
etymology.tip: migr（迁移）+ ant（人/物）→ 迁移的人或鸟，即移居者、候鸟

meanings.exampleEn: The microwave has become an indispensable appliance in modern kitchens.
meanings.exampleZh: 微波炉已成为现代厨房中不可或缺的电器。

meanings.exampleEn: She microwaved the leftover soup for two minutes before dinner.
meanings.exampleZh: 晚餐前，她用微波炉把剩汤加热了两分钟。

variants.zh: 用微波炉加热（第三人称单数）
用微波炉加热（过去式/过去分词）
用微波炉加热（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 由希腊语词根 micro-（小）与英语单词 wave（波）组合而成，20世纪中期随微波技术发展而广泛使用。
etymology.tip: micro（微小）+ wave（波）→ 波长极短的波，即微波。

lumber.zh: 木材；破旧家俱；废物；隆隆声

meanings.exampleEn: The carpenter selected high-quality lumber for the custom-made bookshelf.
meanings.exampleZh: 木匠为定制的书架挑选了高质量的木材。

meanings.exampleEn: The basement was filled with discarded lumber, including broken chairs and tables.
meanings.exampleZh: 地下室里堆满了废弃的破旧家具，包括破椅子和桌子。

meanings.exampleEn: The warehouse was cleared of all the lumber that had accumulated over the years.
meanings.exampleZh: 仓库里积攒多年的废物被清理一空。

meanings.exampleEn: The lumber of the old engine was audible from the next room.
meanings.exampleZh: 隔壁房间能听到旧发动机的隆隆声。

meanings.exampleEn: The bear lumbered out of the forest and crossed the stream.
meanings.exampleZh: 熊笨重地从森林里走出来，蹚过小溪。

meanings.exampleEn: The company plans to lumber the northern forest despite environmental protests.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司不顾环保抗议，计划砍伐北部森林的树木。

meanings.exampleEn: The study was lumbered with piles of old documents and obsolete equipment.
meanings.exampleZh: 书房里乱堆着成堆的旧文件和过时的设备。

variants.zh: 笨重地移动；伐木；乱堆（过去式/过去分词）
笨重地移动；伐木；乱堆（现在分词）
笨重地移动；伐木；乱堆（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；可能源自拟声或与伦巴第人（Lombard）有关，但词源不明。

measurable.zh: 可测量的；不久的；重要的

meanings.exampleEn: The impact of the new policy is hardly measurable in the short term.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策的影响在短期内几乎无法衡量。

meanings.exampleEn: There has been a measurable improvement in the company's financial performance.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司的财务业绩有了显著的改善。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mensura，经由古法语 mesurable 进入英语
etymology.tip: measure（测量）+ able（可……的）→ 可测量的；能测量出来说明是“显著的”

meanings.exampleEn: The company decided to merge its two departments to improve efficiency.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司决定合并两个部门以提高效率。

meanings.exampleEn: The rising tide gradually merged the footprints on the beach.
meanings.exampleZh: 上涨的潮水逐渐吞没了沙滩上的脚印。

meanings.exampleEn: The two streams merge into a river in the valley.
meanings.exampleZh: 两条小溪在山谷中汇合成一条河。

variants.zh: 合并；消失；吞没（过去式/过去分词）
合并；消失；吞没（现在分词）
合并；消失；吞没（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mergere（浸入、沉没）
etymology.tip: merge 音似“没之”，使东西“没”入其中，即合并、吞没。

meanings.exampleEn: Water is the most common liquid on Earth, essential for all known forms of life.
meanings.exampleZh: 水是地球上最常见的液体，对已知的所有生命形式都至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: In phonetics, the sounds /l/ and /r/ are classified as liquids because they allow air to flow around the tongue.
meanings.exampleZh: 在语音学中，/l/ 和 /r/ 被归类为流音，因为气流可以绕过舌头流动。

meanings.exampleEn: At room temperature, mercury remains in a liquid state, making it unique among metals.
meanings.exampleZh: 在室温下，汞保持液态，这使得它在金属中独一无二。

meanings.exampleEn: The company's liquid assets enable it to respond quickly to unexpected financial crises.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司的流动资产使其能够迅速应对意外的财务危机。

meanings.exampleEn: Her liquid eyes reflected the moonlight, captivating everyone present.
meanings.exampleZh: 她清澈的眼睛映着月光，令在场的每个人都为之着迷。

meanings.exampleEn: The singer's liquid voice captivated the audience throughout the performance.
meanings.exampleZh: 歌手流畅的嗓音贯穿整个演出，令观众着迷。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 liquidus，源于 liquere（流动）
etymology.suffix: -id = 具有...性质的（形容词后缀）
etymology.tip: liqu- 表示流动，-id 表示性质，能流动的物质就是液体。

microscopic.zh: 显微镜的；用显微镜可见的；微观的；(非正式)极微小的

meanings.exampleEn: The microscopic examination revealed the structure of the cell.
meanings.exampleZh: 显微镜检查揭示了细胞的结构。

meanings.exampleEn: These microscopic organisms are invisible to the naked eye.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些用显微镜可见的微生物肉眼无法看见。

meanings.exampleEn: The study focuses on the microscopic behavior of particles.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项研究聚焦于粒子的微观行为。

meanings.exampleEn: The chances of success are microscopic, but we still try.

meanings.exampleEn: The architect recorded the exact measurements of the ancient temple before drafting the restoration plan.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑师在起草修复计划之前记录了古庙的精确尺寸。

meanings.exampleEn: The streets were covered with litter after the parade.

meanings.exampleZh: 皇帝乘坐轿子穿过城市。

meanings.exampleZh: 书房的地板上散落着文件，一片杂乱。

meanings.exampleEn: The mechanism of the clock is so delicate that it requires professional maintenance.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座钟的机械装置非常精密，需要专业人员维护。

meanings.exampleEn: The United Nations established a mechanism to coordinate international disaster relief.

meanings.exampleEn: Scientists are studying the molecular mechanism of this rare disease.

meanings.exampleZh: 这种药物起作用的机理对研究人员来说仍不清楚。

variants.zh: 机械；机构；结构；机理（复数）

metal.zh: 金属；金属制品；合金；本质

meanings.exampleEn: The structural integrity of the bridge relies on the high-grade metal used in its construction.
meanings.exampleZh: 桥梁的结构完整性依赖于其建造中使用的高等级金属。

meanings.exampleEn: The antique shop displayed a collection of ornate metals, including brass candlesticks and iron tools.
meanings.exampleZh: 古董店陈列了一批精美的金属制品，包括黄铜烛台和铁制工具。

meanings.exampleEn: Bronze is a metal that consists primarily of copper and tin.
meanings.exampleZh: 青铜是一种主要由铜和锡组成的合金。

meanings.exampleEn: Adversity often reveals the true metal of a leader.
meanings.exampleZh: 逆境往往能显现出领导者的真正本质。

milky.zh: 乳状的；乳白色的；柔和的

meanings.exampleEn: The solution turned milky when a few drops of acid were added, indicating a chemical reaction had occurred.
meanings.exampleZh: 加入几滴酸后，溶液变得乳状，表明发生了化学反应。

meanings.exampleEn: The milky glow of the moon cast a soft, ethereal light over the silent valley.
meanings.exampleZh: 月亮乳白色的光辉在寂静的山谷上投下柔和而空灵的光。

meanings.exampleEn: She spoke in a milky tone that instantly calmed the anxious child in the crowded waiting room.
meanings.exampleZh: 她用柔和的声音说话，立刻安抚了拥挤候诊室里那个焦虑的孩子。

meanings.exampleEn: To minimize the environmental impact, the factory installed new filtration systems.

meanings.exampleEn: The precision instrument can measure variations as small as one millimetre.
meanings.exampleZh: 这台精密仪器能够测量小至一毫米的偏差。

etymology.tip: milli（千分之一）+ metre（米）= 千分之一米，即毫米

merry.zh: 快乐的；愉快的；嬉戏作乐的

meanings.zh: 快乐的；愉快的；嬉戏作乐的
meanings.exampleEn: The merry crowd at the carnival indulged in games and feasting, oblivious to the passing hours.
meanings.exampleZh: 狂欢节上嬉戏作乐的人群沉迷于游戏和宴饮，全然不觉时光流逝。

phrases.zh: 人越多越热闹；多多益善

etymology.origin: 古英语 myrige（令人愉快的，悦人的）；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The minimum age for this competition is eighteen.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项比赛的最低年龄要求是十八岁。

meanings.exampleZh: 在经济低迷时期，我们需要将成本控制在最低限度。

minimal.zh: 最小的；极微的；最小限度的

meanings.zh: 最小的；极微的；最小限度的

meanings.exampleZh: 风暴对沿海村庄只造成了极微小的破坏。

variants.zh: 极简主义； minimalist 风格

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 minimus，意为“最小的”，是 parvus（小）的最高级形式。
etymology.tip: mini（小）+ al（形容词后缀）→ 小到极致的 → 最小的；极微的。

meanings.exampleEn: The wire mesh was used to filter out large particles from the water.

meanings.exampleEn: The gears mesh smoothly, allowing the machine to run without vibration.

meanings.exampleEn: The marine biodiversity in the coral reef is astonishingly rich.

meanings.exampleZh: 海军陆战队士兵必须同时具备体力和心理韧性。

meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家最新的海景画描绘了暴风雨天空下的汹涌大海。

meanings.exampleEn: It was a miracle that the passengers survived the plane crash without a single scratch.
meanings.exampleZh: 乘客们在飞机失事中毫发无损地幸存下来，这真是个奇迹。

meanings.exampleEn: She likes to meditate in the garden every morning to clear her mind.

meanings.exampleEn: The mere thought of the exam makes her feel anxious.
meanings.exampleZh: 仅仅想到考试就让她感到焦虑。

meanings.exampleEn: The village lies beside a tranquil mere surrounded by reeds.
meanings.exampleZh: 村庄坐落在一个被芦苇环绕的宁静小湖旁。

phrases.zh: 区区小事；微不足道的事

etymology.root: mer/mar = 海，湖（源自原始印欧语 *mori-）
etymology.origin: 名词义来自古英语 mere（海、湖），与拉丁语 mare（海）同源；形容词义来自拉丁语 merus（纯粹的、未混合的）
etymology.tip: 形容词 mere 联想“纯粹的只是”；名词 mere 联想 marine（海的），记住“mere 小湖，marine 大海”

meanings.exampleEn: He found himself in the midst of a heated debate.
meanings.exampleZh: 他发现自己处于一场激烈争论之中。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 mid（中间）的最高级形式 middest，后演变为 midst
etymology.suffix: -est（最高级后缀，表示“最中间”，拼写演变后为 -st）
etymology.tip: mid（中间）+ -est（最）→ 最中间 → 中间

meanings.exampleEn: The Mediterranean diet, rich in olive oil and fresh vegetables, is widely acclaimed for its health benefits.
meanings.exampleZh: 地中海饮食富含橄榄油和新鲜蔬菜，因其健康益处而广受赞誉。

meanings.exampleEn: The Mediterranean has served as a vital trade route connecting three continents since antiquity.
meanings.exampleZh: 自古以来，地中海一直是连接三大洲的重要贸易通道。

meanings.exampleEn: The Mediterraneans have long been known for their seafaring culture.
meanings.exampleZh: 地中海沿岸居民长期以来以航海文化闻名。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mediterraneus，由 medius（中间）和 terra（土地）组成，意为“陆地中间的”，后指地中海。
etymology.tip: medi（中间）+ terr（土地）+ -an → 在陆地中间的海 → 地中海

mechanically.zh: 机械；用机械；机械学；物理

meanings.exampleEn: He mechanically repeated the same phrases without any genuine emotion.
meanings.exampleZh: 他机械地重复着同样的话，没有任何真实情感。

meanings.exampleEn: The factory now produces the components mechanically, greatly increasing efficiency.
meanings.exampleZh: 工厂现在用机械生产这些部件，大大提高了效率。

meanings.exampleEn: The system is mechanically stable under normal operating conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 该系统在正常操作条件下力学上是稳定的。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 mēkhanē（机器），经拉丁语 mechanicus 进入英语
etymology.tip: mechan（机械）+ ically（副词后缀）→ 像机器一样地 → 机械地

meanings.exampleEn: The wounded soldier moaned in pain as the medics carried him off the battlefield.
meanings.exampleZh: 受伤的士兵在医护兵把他抬离战场时痛苦地呻吟着。

meanings.exampleEn: A low moan escaped her lips when she heard the devastating news.
meanings.exampleZh: 听到那个毁灭性的消息时，她嘴里发出了一声低沉的悲叹。

variants.zh: 呻吟；悲叹（第三人称单数）
呻吟；悲叹（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语
etymology.tip: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀，可联想“闷哼”来记忆呻吟之意。

meanings.exampleEn: The software is composed of several independent modules that can be developed separately.
meanings.exampleZh: 该软件由几个可独立开发的模块组成。

meanings.exampleEn: The gear's module determines the size of its teeth and affects the transmission ratio.
meanings.exampleZh: 齿轮的模数决定了齿的大小，并影响传动比。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 modulus（小尺度、小量度），是 modus（尺度、方式）的指小形式
etymology.tip: mod（尺度）+ -ule（小）→ 小尺度、小单元 → 模块；模数

meanings.exampleEn: The barometer uses mercury to measure atmospheric pressure accurately.
meanings.exampleZh: 气压计利用水银来精确测量大气压力。

meanings.exampleEn: Mercury is a toxic heavy metal that can accumulate in the food chain.
meanings.exampleZh: 汞是一种有毒重金属，会在食物链中累积。

meanings.exampleEn: In Roman mythology, Mercury is the swift messenger of the gods.
meanings.exampleZh: 在罗马神话中，墨丘利是众神的敏捷使者。

etymology.root: mercur- = 水银；墨丘利（罗马神使）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Mercurius（墨丘利，罗马神话中的神使），因水银流动性强，炼金术士以神名命名。
etymology.tip: 墨丘利是神的使者，行动敏捷；水银流动迅速，故得名。

meanings.exampleEn: She stared at her reflection in the mirror, searching for signs of fatigue.
meanings.exampleZh: 她凝视着镜子中的自己，寻找疲惫的痕迹。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel is a mirror of the social upheaval in the early twentieth century.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说是二十世纪初社会动荡的真实写照。

meanings.exampleEn: His life is a mirror of virtue and integrity.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的一生是美德与正直的典范。

meanings.exampleEn: The calm lake mirrored the snow-capped mountains perfectly.
meanings.exampleZh: 平静的湖面完美地倒映出雪山。

variants.zh: 反映；反射（第三人称单数）
反映；反射（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mirari（惊奇，看），经古法语 mirour 进入英语
etymology.tip: mir（看）+ -or（物），能照出影像供人观看的物体就是镜子

meanings.exampleEn: The metric system is used for most scientific measurements.
meanings.exampleZh: 大多数科学测量使用公制。

meanings.exampleEn: Profit margin is an important metric for business performance.
meanings.exampleZh: 利润率是衡量企业业绩的重要指标。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 metron（测量），经由拉丁语 metricus 进入英语
etymology.tip: metr（测量）+ -ic（形容词）→ 与测量有关的 → 公制的；计量的

meanings.exampleEn: Her modesty prevented her from boasting about her remarkable achievements.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的谦逊使她不愿夸耀自己的卓越成就。

meanings.exampleEn: The modesty of the cottage reflected their preference for a simple life.
meanings.exampleZh: 小屋的质朴反映出他们偏爱简朴的生活。

meanings.exampleEn: She spoke with modesty, avoiding direct eye contact with the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 她说话时带着羞怯，避免与听众直接目光接触。

phrases.zh: 毫不自夸地；说句不自夸的话

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 modestia，源于 modus（尺度、方式），本义为“保持适度、不过分”。
etymology.suffix: -y = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: mod（尺度）+ -y（状态）→ 凡事有尺度、不越界 → 谦逊、质朴。

meanings.exampleEn: The weary traveler collapsed onto the coarse mat, grateful for a moment of respite.
meanings.exampleZh: 疲惫的旅行者倒在粗糙的垫子上，感激这片刻的喘息。

meanings.exampleEn: A dense mat of algae covered the surface of the stagnant pond, choking the aquatic life beneath.
meanings.exampleZh: 一层浓密的藻类丛覆盖在死水池塘表面，窒息了下面的水生生物。

meanings.exampleEn: The antique picture frame was adorned with an ornate mat that complemented the delicate watercolor.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个古董画框装饰着精美的衬边，与精致的水彩画相得益彰。

meanings.exampleEn: The gymnast matted the floor with thick foam pads to ensure safety during practice.
meanings.exampleZh: 体操运动员用厚泡沫垫铺满地板，以确保训练安全。

meanings.exampleEn: The strong wind matted her long hair into an inextricable tangle.
meanings.exampleZh: 强风使她的长发缠结成一团无法解开的乱麻。

meanings.exampleEn: Wet wool tends to mat easily if it is not properly dried and brushed.
meanings.exampleZh: 湿羊毛如果不妥善干燥和梳理，很容易缠结。

variants.zh: 给...铺垫子（第三人称单数）
给...铺垫子；使缠结（过去式/过去分词）
给...铺垫子；使缠结（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 门口的蹭鞋垫；热烈欢迎

etymology.origin: 古英语 matte，源自拉丁语 matta；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

mixer.zh: 混合者；混合器；搅拌机；搅拌器

meanings.exampleEn: The mixer of the two chemicals must wear protective gloves to avoid burns.
meanings.exampleZh: 混合这两种化学药品的人必须戴防护手套以免灼伤。

meanings.exampleEn: She used an electric mixer to beat the eggs and sugar into a smooth batter.
meanings.exampleZh: 她用电动搅拌机把鸡蛋和糖打成顺滑的面糊。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mixtus（混合），经由古法语 mixte 进入英语
etymology.tip: mix（混合）+ er（者/器）= 混合者或搅拌器

meanings.exampleEn: Only a minority of the students voted against the new policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 只有少数学生投票反对这项新政策。

meanings.exampleEn: He was still in his minority when he inherited the estate.
meanings.exampleZh: 他继承遗产时还未成年。

meanings.exampleEn: The government has taken measures to protect the rights of ethnic minorities.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已采取措施保护少数民族的权利。

variants.zh: 少数；未成年；少数民族（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 minor（较小），经由法语 minorité 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ity = 表示性质、状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: minor（小）+ ity（状态）= 少数的状态

meanings.exampleEn: The mistress of the house welcomed the guests with great courtesy.
meanings.exampleZh: 女主人非常礼貌地迎接了客人。

meanings.exampleEn: The scandal revealed that the politician had kept a mistress for years.
meanings.exampleZh: 这起丑闻揭露了那位政客多年来一直养着一位情妇。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 maistresse，是 maistre（master）的阴性形式
etymology.tip: master（主人）+ -ess（女性）→ 女主人；情妇

meanings.exampleEn: The metal will melt at a temperature of over 1,000 degrees Celsius.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种金属在超过1000摄氏度的温度下会熔化。

meanings.exampleEn: The crystalline powder melts instantly in the solvent, producing a transparent solution.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种结晶粉末在溶剂中立即溶解，产生透明溶液。

meanings.exampleEn: The melt was carefully poured into the mold to form the component.
meanings.exampleZh: 熔化物被小心地倒入模具以形成部件。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

measure.zh: 尺寸；量度器；量度标准；测量

meanings.exampleEn: The measure of the table's surface is exactly one square meter.
meanings.exampleZh: 这张桌子表面的尺寸正好是一平方米。

meanings.exampleEn: The government has taken drastic measures to curb inflation.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已采取严厉措施遏制通货膨胀。

meanings.exampleEn: A barometer is a measure of atmospheric pressure.
meanings.exampleZh: 气压计是测量大气压力的仪器。

meanings.exampleEn: In many societies, wealth is regarded as a measure of success.
meanings.exampleZh: 在许多社会，财富被视为成功的标准。

meanings.exampleEn: The measure of the distance was carried out with great precision.
meanings.exampleZh: 距离的测量以极高的精度进行。

meanings.exampleEn: Researchers measured the levels of pollution in the river.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究人员测量了河流的污染程度。

meanings.exampleEn: It is hard to measure the long-term effects of the reform.
meanings.exampleZh: 很难估量改革的长期影响。

meanings.exampleEn: The new stadium measures 300 meters in circumference.
meanings.exampleZh: 新体育场的周长为300米。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mensura，经古法语 mesure 进入英语
etymology.tip: mens（测量）+ -ure（名词后缀）→ 测量；引申为尺寸、措施

meanings.exampleEn: The young entrepreneur became a millionaire before the age of thirty through his innovative tech startup.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位年轻企业家通过他的创新科技初创公司在三十岁之前就成了百万富翁。

etymology.origin: 来自法语 millionnaire，由 million（百万）加表人的后缀 -aire 构成
etymology.tip: million（百万）+ aire（人）= 拥有百万财富的人，即百万富翁。

related.zh: 第百万的；百万分之一的

meanings.exampleEn: The mob set fire to several buildings during the riot.
meanings.exampleZh: 暴民在骚乱中放火烧毁了几栋建筑。

meanings.exampleEn: The celebrity was quickly surrounded by an adoring mob of fans.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位名人很快被一群狂热的粉丝团团围住。

meanings.exampleEn: The mob controlled the illegal gambling business in the city.
meanings.exampleZh: 该犯罪团伙控制了这座城市的非法赌博生意。

meanings.exampleEn: Fans mobbed the singer as she tried to leave the airport.
meanings.exampleZh: 当这位歌手试图离开机场时，粉丝们蜂拥围住了她。

variants.zh: 聚众围攻；成群围住（过去式/过去分词）
聚众围攻；成群围住（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 人群混乱的场面；群情激昂的场景

etymology.origin: 源自拉丁语 mobile vulgus（可移动的民众），mob 是 mobile 的缩写形式，后独立成词。
etymology.tip: mob 来自 mobile（移动的），可联想为“一哄而散、到处移动的人群”即“暴民”。

meanings.exampleEn: The military successfully intercepted the incoming missile before it reached its target.
meanings.exampleZh: 军方在来袭导弹到达目标之前成功将其拦截。

meanings.exampleEn: Ancient catapults were designed to hurl heavy missiles over city walls.
meanings.exampleZh: 古代投石机被设计用来将沉重的投射物抛过城墙。

meanings.zh: 火箭（尤指作为武器或推进装置）
meanings.exampleEn: The research team launched a missile into the upper atmosphere to collect scientific data.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究团队向高层大气发射了一枚火箭以收集科学数据。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 missilis（可投掷的），源于 mittere 的过去分词 missus（发送，投掷）
etymology.tip: miss（发送）+ ile（可…的）→ 可发送出去的东西 → 发射物、导弹

meanings.exampleEn: The messenger arrived at dawn with the long-awaited news.
meanings.exampleZh: 报信者在黎明时分带着期盼已久的消息赶到了。

meanings.exampleEn: She was regarded as a messenger of goodwill between the two rival factions.
meanings.exampleZh: 她被视为两个敌对派系之间传递善意的使者。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 messager，源自拉丁语 mittere（派遣，发送），后插入 -n- 形成 messenger。
etymology.tip: mess（发送）+ enger（人）= 被派去发送信息的人，即信使。

meanings.exampleEn: The moisture in the air condensed on the cold glass surface.
meanings.exampleZh: 空气中的湿气在冰冷的玻璃表面凝结成了水珠。

meanings.exampleEn: The region relies on seasonal moisture for its agricultural production.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区的农业生产依赖季节性降雨。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 moiste，可能源自拉丁语 mucidus（发霉的、潮湿的）
etymology.tip: moist（潮湿）+ ure（状态）= 潮湿的状态，即湿气、水分。

meanings.exampleEn: The mode of communication has changed dramatically in the digital age.
meanings.exampleZh: 在数字时代，沟通方式发生了巨大变化。

meanings.exampleEn: The camera automatically switches to night mode in low-light conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 相机在光线不足时会自动切换到夜间模式。

meanings.exampleEn: The composer employed the Dorian mode to create a haunting melody.
meanings.exampleZh: 作曲家运用多利亚调式创作出令人难忘的旋律。

meanings.exampleEn: The author's narrative mode blends realism with surrealism.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位作者的叙事文体融合了现实主义与超现实主义。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 modus，意为“方式、尺度、模式”
etymology.tip: mod 表示“方式、模式”，记住“mode = 模式”即可。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel was a minor work in the author's literary career, yet it attracted a cult following.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说在作者文学生涯中是一部次要作品，却吸引了一批狂热追随者。

meanings.exampleEn: The law prohibits the sale of alcoholic beverages to minors without parental consent.
meanings.exampleZh: 法律禁止未经父母同意向未成年人出售酒精饮料。

meanings.exampleEn: She chose psychology as her minor to complement her major in sociology.
meanings.exampleZh: 她选择心理学作为副修科目，以补充她的社会学主修专业。

meanings.exampleEn: He decided to minor in business administration to enhance his career prospects.
meanings.exampleZh: 他决定副修工商管理以提升自己的职业前景。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 minor（更小的），与 minuere（减少）同源
etymology.tip: min-（小）+ -or（更）= 更小的 → 次要的、未成年人

meanings.exampleEn: The monarch wielded absolute power over the realm, commanding both the military and the judiciary.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位帝王对王国拥有绝对权力，统辖军队和司法机构。

variants.zh: 君主主义者；拥护君主制的人

phrases.zh: 专制君主；拥有绝对权力的君主
立宪君主；君主立宪制下的君主
黑脉金斑蝶（一种大型蝴蝶）

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 monarchos，由 monos（单独）和 arkhein（统治）组合而成，意为“独自统治的人”
etymology.tip: mono（单一）+ arch（统治）→ 一个人统治 → 帝王、君主

related.zh: 寡头政治；寡头统治集团

moderate.zh: 适度的；稳健的；中等的；节制的

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor advised him to take moderate exercise to improve his health.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生建议他进行适度的锻炼以改善健康状况。

meanings.exampleEn: Her moderate views on the issue won support from both sides.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在这个问题上的稳健观点赢得了双方的支持。

meanings.exampleEn: He is a moderate drinker and never exceeds two glasses of wine.
meanings.exampleZh: 他饮酒有节制，从不超过两杯葡萄酒。

meanings.exampleEn: The government took measures to moderate the impact of the economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府采取措施以减轻经济危机的冲击。

meanings.exampleEn: A senior professor was invited to moderate the academic debate.
meanings.exampleZh: 一位资深教授受邀主持这场学术辩论。

meanings.exampleEn: The moderates in the party called for a more balanced policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 党内的稳健派呼吁采取更为平衡的政策。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 moderatus，是 moderari（控制、调节）的过去分词，与 modus（尺度）相关
etymology.tip: mod（尺度）+ ate → 使符合尺度 → 适度的、有节制的

modest.zh: 谦逊的；羞怯的；端庄的；适度的

meanings.exampleEn: Despite his remarkable achievements, the scientist remained modest about his contributions.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管取得了卓越的成就，这位科学家对自己的贡献仍然很谦逊。

meanings.exampleEn: She gave a modest smile when the audience applauded her performance.
meanings.exampleZh: 当观众为她的表演鼓掌时，她羞怯地笑了笑。

meanings.exampleEn: The young lady wore a modest dress that suited the formal occasion.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位年轻女士穿着一件端庄的连衣裙，很适合这个正式场合。

meanings.exampleEn: The company expects a modest increase in profits this year despite the economic downturn.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管经济不景气，公司预计今年利润仍会有适度增长。

phrases.zh: 不高的收入；微薄的收入

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 modestus，源自 modus（尺度、方式），表示“有分寸的、守规矩的”。
etymology.suffix: -est（拉丁语形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”）
etymology.tip: mod（尺度）+ est（性质）→ 做事有尺度、有分寸 → 谦逊的、适度的。

migrate.zh: 移动；移往；随季节而移居

meanings.exampleEn: Many young people migrate to big cities in search of better job opportunities.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多年轻人迁往大城市以寻找更好的工作机会。

meanings.exampleEn: These birds migrate south every autumn to escape the harsh winter.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些鸟每年秋天向南迁徙以躲避严酷的冬天。

meanings.exampleEn: The IT team decided to migrate the entire database to a cloud-based platform.
meanings.exampleZh: IT团队决定将整个数据库转移到云平台上。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 migrare，意为‘迁移、离开’
etymology.tip: migr（移动）+ -ate（动词后缀）→ 移动位置 → 迁移

mate.zh: 配偶；对手；助手；(象棋)将死

meanings.exampleEn: In many bird species, the male performs an elaborate courtship dance to attract a mate.
meanings.exampleZh: 在许多鸟类中，雄性会表演精心设计的求偶舞蹈来吸引配偶。

meanings.exampleEn: He was a tough mate in the debate, always challenging her arguments.
meanings.exampleZh: 在辩论中他是一个强劲的对手，总是挑战她的论点。

meanings.exampleEn: The cook's mate was responsible for preparing the ingredients.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨师的助手负责准备食材。

meanings.exampleEn: With a brilliant queen sacrifice, he mated his opponent in just twenty moves.
meanings.exampleZh: 凭借一记精彩的弃后，他仅用二十步就将死了对手。

etymology.root: mete = 食物（古英语，现代 meat 的前身）
etymology.origin: 来自古英语 gemetta（共餐者），由 ge-（共同）+ mete（食物）构成，原指同桌吃饭的人，后引申为伙伴、配偶。
etymology.prefix: ge-（古英语前缀，表示共同，现代拼写中已脱落）
etymology.tip: 一起吃 meat（食物）的人就是你的 mate（伙伴）。

meanings.exampleEn: The visiting professor delivered a thought-provoking lecture on artificial intelligence ethics to a packed auditorium.
meanings.exampleZh: 客座教授向座无虚席的礼堂发表了一场关于人工智能伦理的引人深思的演讲。

meanings.exampleEn: He spent the whole weekend revising his lecture for the international symposium.
meanings.exampleZh: 他花了整个周末修改他为国际研讨会准备的讲稿。

meanings.exampleEn: The manager gave his team a severe lecture for their negligence.
meanings.exampleZh: 经理因团队疏忽而严厉训斥了他们。

meanings.exampleEn: She lectures in modern history at a prestigious university, captivating students with her insightful analysis.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在一所著名大学讲授现代史，以富有洞察力的分析吸引着学生。

meanings.exampleEn: His father lectured him about his irresponsible behavior.
meanings.exampleZh: 他父亲训斥他不负责任的行为。

variants.zh: 演讲；讲课；训斥（第三人称单数）
演讲；讲课；训斥（过去式/过去分词）
演讲；讲课；训斥（现在分词）

etymology.root: lect = 读；选择（源自拉丁语 legere）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 lectura（阅读），经古法语进入英语，与 legere（读；选择）有关
etymology.tip: lect（读）+ ure（名词后缀）→ 朗读出来的内容 → 演讲；讲课

mess.zh: 食堂；伙食；用膳；一份食品

meanings.exampleEn: The room was in a complete mess after the party.
meanings.exampleZh: 聚会后房间里一片狼藉。

meanings.zh: 食堂（尤指军队、学校等的）
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers gathered in the mess for their evening meal.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵们聚集在食堂吃晚饭。

meanings.zh: 一份食物（尤指流质食物）
meanings.exampleEn: The cook served a mess of porridge to the hungry recruits.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨师给饥饿的新兵们端了一份粥。

meanings.exampleEn: Don't mess the kitchen while I'm on the phone.
meanings.exampleZh: 我打电话时别把厨房弄乱。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 missus（被送出的东西，一道菜），经古法语 mes 进入英语，原指一份食物，后引申为混乱。
etymology.tip: miss（发送）→ 被端上来的菜（mess）→ 菜洒了变成一团乱。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy was moderately received by the public, with both praise and criticism.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策被公众适度地接受，既有赞扬也有批评。

meanings.exampleEn: He tends to speak moderately, avoiding extreme opinions in any debate.
meanings.exampleZh: 他倾向于中庸地发言，在任何辩论中都避免极端观点。

phrases.zh: 相当成功的；还算成功的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 moderatus，是 moderari（控制、调节）的过去分词，意为“保持适度、有节制的”。
etymology.tip: moder（控制、度量）+ -ly（副词后缀）→ 以有节制的方式 → 适度地。

meanings.exampleEn: The government adopted various means to tackle the economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府采取各种方法来应对经济危机。

meanings.exampleEn: He achieved his goal by fair means or foul.
meanings.exampleZh: 他不择手段地达到了自己的目的。

meanings.exampleEn: Language is a powerful means of communication.
meanings.exampleZh: 语言是一种强大的交流工具。

meanings.exampleEn: She is a woman of considerable means, owning several estates.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是个相当富有的女人，拥有多处房产。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 medium（中间），经古法语 moyen 进入英语，原义为‘中间途径’
etymology.suffix: -s（复数后缀，此处已固化为名词形式）
etymology.tip: 通过中间媒介（medium）达到目的，就是means（方法、手段）

meanings.exampleEn: The old olive mill still operates, crushing the fruit between massive granite wheels.
meanings.exampleZh: 那座古老的橄榄压榨机仍在运转，用巨大的花岗岩轮碾碎果实。

meanings.exampleEn: The water mill on the river has been grinding wheat for over two centuries.
meanings.exampleZh: 河边的水磨坊两个多世纪以来一直在磨小麦。

meanings.exampleEn: The steel mill employs thousands of workers in the region.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家钢铁厂雇用了该地区数千名工人。

variants.zh: 压榨机；磨坊；制造厂（复数）
碾碎；铣（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 molere '磨'，经古英语 mylen 演变而来
etymology.tip: mill 就是磨东西的地方，记住 mol/mill = 磨

meanings.exampleEn: Excuse me, Mister, but you have dropped your wallet on the pavement.
meanings.exampleZh: 打扰一下，先生，您的钱包掉在人行道上了。

phrases.zh: 万事通；能解决一切问题的人

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 magister（主人、首领），由 magis（更）+ -ter（比较级后缀）构成，经古法语 maistre 演变为 Mister。
etymology.tip: mag（大）+ ter（人）→ 大人物 → 先生

meanings.exampleEn: The security leak in the database exposed millions of users' personal information to cybercriminals.
meanings.exampleZh: 数据库中的安全漏洞将数百万用户的个人信息暴露给了网络罪犯。

meanings.exampleEn: After the heavy storm, the homeowner discovered a leak in the ceiling that had stained the plaster.
meanings.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，房主发现天花板有一处漏处，弄脏了灰泥。

meanings.exampleEn: The leak of radioactive water from the nuclear plant raised serious concerns about environmental safety.
meanings.exampleZh: 核电站放射性水的泄漏引发了人们对环境安全的严重担忧。

meanings.exampleEn: The toxic gas leaked from the corroded valve, posing an immediate threat to the workers.
meanings.exampleZh: 有毒气体从腐蚀的阀门漏出，对工人构成直接威胁。

meanings.exampleEn: The confidential information leaked to the public before the board could make an official announcement.
meanings.exampleZh: 机密信息在董事会正式宣布之前就泄漏给了公众。

meanings.exampleEn: A disgruntled employee leaked the company's strategic plan to its fiercest rival.
meanings.exampleZh: 一名心怀不满的员工将公司的战略计划泄露给了其最强劲的竞争对手。

variants.zh: 漏出；泄露（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 leccan（使滴落、渗漏）
etymology.tip: 联想：leak 音似'裂开'，有裂缝就会漏（leak）

meanings.exampleEn: The singer adjusted the microphone before starting her performance.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位歌手在开始表演前调整了麦克风。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 mikros（小）+ phone（声音）
etymology.tip: micro（小）+ phone（声音），麦克风把微小声音放大传出去。

meanings.exampleEn: The government decided to take military action against the rebels.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府决定对叛乱分子采取军事行动。

meanings.exampleEn: The military was called in to assist with the flood relief efforts.
meanings.exampleZh: 军队被调来协助洪水救援工作。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 militaris，源于 miles（士兵）
etymology.tip: milit（士兵）+ ary（形容词后缀）→ 与士兵有关的 → 军事的

meanings.exampleEn: The meeting was scheduled at midday, when the sun was at its highest point.
meanings.exampleZh: 会议安排在正午，此时太阳处于最高点。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 middæg，由 mid（中间）+ dæg（日）组成
etymology.tip: mid（中间）+ day（日）→ 日居正中，即正午

meanings.exampleEn: The travelers decided to stay at a motel on the outskirts of the city for the night.
meanings.exampleZh: 旅行者们决定在城郊的一家汽车旅馆过夜。

etymology.origin: 由 motor 和 hotel 两个词混合而成，指为驾车旅客提供住宿的旅馆。
etymology.tip: motor（汽车）+ hotel（旅馆）→ motel（汽车旅馆）

meanings.exampleEn: The monument was erected in memory of the soldiers who died in the war.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座纪念碑是为了纪念在战争中牺牲的士兵而建立的。

variants.zh: 纪念碑的；纪念性的；巨大的；不朽的

phrases.zh: 国家纪念碑；国家名胜古迹
为纪念某人/某事物而建的纪念碑；…的见证

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 monumentum，源自 monere（提醒），原指“提醒之物”，后引申为纪念碑、纪念物。
etymology.suffix: -ment = 名词后缀，表示行为的结果或事物
etymology.tip: monu（提醒）+ ment（名词）→ 提醒人们记住的东西 → 纪念碑。

meanings.exampleEn: All human beings are mortal, so we should cherish every moment of life.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有人类都终有一死，因此我们应该珍惜生命的每一刻。

meanings.exampleEn: The soldier received a mortal wound on the battlefield and died soon after.
meanings.exampleZh: 那名士兵在战场上受了致命伤，不久便去世了。

meanings.exampleEn: She lived in mortal fear of losing her job during the economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 经济危机期间，她极度害怕失去工作。

meanings.exampleEn: Even the greatest mortal cannot escape the passage of time.
meanings.exampleZh: 即使是伟大的凡人也无法逃脱时间的流逝。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mortalis，由 mors（死亡）派生而来
etymology.tip: mort（死）+ al（...的）→ 终有一死的；致命的

meanings.exampleEn: The government had to mobilize the army to deal with the natural disaster.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府不得不动员军队应对自然灾害。

meanings.exampleEn: It is essential to mobilize all available resources to achieve the project goals.
meanings.exampleZh: 调动一切可用资源对于实现项目目标至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy aims to mobilize capital in the domestic market.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策旨在使国内市场的资本流通起来。

variants.zh: 动员；调动（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mobilis（可移动的），源于 movere（移动）
etymology.tip: mob（移动）+ -ize（使）→ 使移动起来 → 动员、调动

meanings.exampleEn: The missing data in the report made it impossible to draw any conclusion.
meanings.exampleZh: 报告中缺失的数据使得无法得出任何结论。

variants.zh: 错过（miss的过去式和过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 missan，意为“未击中、错过”
etymology.suffix: -ing，构成形容词或现在分词，表示“...的”
etymology.tip: miss（错过）+ -ing（的）→ 错过的、不见的

meanings.exampleEn: In severe winter, she wore a pair of woolen mittens to keep her hands warm.
meanings.exampleZh: 在严冬，她戴了一副羊毛连指手套来保暖。

meanings.exampleEn: The boxer raised his mittens to defend against the opponent's punch.
meanings.exampleZh: 拳击手举起拳击手套抵挡对手的拳头。

variants.zh: 连指手套；拳击手套（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 mitaine，原指一种手套；词源不详，无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: 联想记忆：mitten 与 mitt（手套）形近，mitten 是连指手套，mitt 是棒球手套。

meanings.exampleEn: The memorial ceremony was held to honor the fallen heroes.
meanings.exampleZh: 纪念仪式是为了向阵亡英雄致敬。

meanings.exampleEn: The war memorial in the town square attracts many visitors every year.
meanings.exampleZh: 城镇广场上的战争纪念碑每年吸引许多游客。

meanings.exampleEn: The citizens submitted a memorial to the city council, demanding better public transportation.
meanings.exampleZh: 市民向市议会提交了一份请愿书，要求改善公共交通。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 memorialis，源自 memoria（记忆）
etymology.tip: memor（记忆）+ -al（…的）→ 与记忆有关的 → 纪念的

meanings.exampleEn: The committee proposed to modify the existing regulations to accommodate new technological developments.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会提议修正现有法规以适应新的技术发展。

meanings.exampleEn: You may need to modify your travel itinerary if the weather conditions worsen.
meanings.exampleZh: 如果天气恶化，你可能需要变更旅行行程。

meanings.exampleEn: In English grammar, adjectives are used to modify nouns and pronouns.
meanings.exampleZh: 在英语语法中，形容词用来修饰名词和代词。

meanings.exampleEn: The government took measures to modify the impact of the economic crisis on low-income families.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府采取措施缓和经济危机对低收入家庭的影响。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 modificare（限制，调节），由 modus（尺度，方式）+ facere（做，制作）构成
etymology.tip: mod（方式）+ ify（使）→ 使符合某种方式 → 修改、修饰

meanings.exampleEn: His silence was misunderstood as disapproval by the committee.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的沉默被委员会误解为不赞成。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 misunderstandan，由 mis-（错误地）+ understandan（理解）构成；understandan 由 under- + standan 组成，本义为“站在…之中/之间”，后引申为理解。
etymology.tip: mis（错）+ under（下面）+ stand（站）→ 站在错误的位置，自然就误解了。

meanings.exampleEn: The audience was mostly composed of college students.
meanings.exampleZh: 观众大部分由大学生组成。

meanings.exampleEn: She mostly spends her weekends reading in the library.
meanings.exampleZh: 她周末通常是在图书馆看书度过的。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 mǣst，加上副词后缀 -ly 构成
etymology.tip: most（大部分）+ ly = 以大部分的方式 → 大部分地；主要地

meanings.exampleEn: The morning mist gradually dispersed under the rising sun, revealing the silhouette of the distant mountains.
meanings.exampleZh: 晨雾在升起的太阳下逐渐消散，显露出远山的轮廓。

meanings.exampleEn: The cold air misted the windshield, making it difficult for the driver to see the road clearly.
meanings.exampleZh: 冷空气使挡风玻璃蒙上了一层薄雾，让司机难以看清道路。

variants.zh: 使蒙上薄雾（第三人称单数）
使蒙上薄雾（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 起雾；蒙上水汽（尤指玻璃、眼镜等）

etymology.origin: 古英语 mist，意为“雾”；属基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。

meanings.exampleEn: He took a mouthful of cold coffee and grimaced at the bitter taste.
meanings.exampleZh: 他喝了一大口冷咖啡，因苦味而做了个鬼脸。

phrases.zh: 对某人大骂一通；斥责某人

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 mūþ（嘴）加上名词后缀 -ful（表示“充满……的量”）
etymology.tip: mouth（嘴）+ ful（满）→ 满嘴的量 → 一口；满口

related.zh: 喉舌；代言人；乐器的吹口

moist.zh: 潮湿的；多雨的；感伤的；含泪的

meanings.exampleEn: The damp climate kept the walls moist, causing the paint to peel within months.
meanings.exampleZh: 潮湿的气候使墙壁保持湿润，几个月内油漆就开始剥落。

meanings.exampleEn: The moist season in the tropics often brings about a surge of insect populations.
meanings.exampleZh: 热带的多雨季节常常导致昆虫数量激增。

meanings.exampleEn: Her eyes grew moist as she recalled the bittersweet memories of her childhood.
meanings.exampleZh: 回忆起童年苦乐参半的往事时，她的眼睛湿润了。

meanings.exampleEn: His voice trembled and his gaze was moist with unshed tears.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的声音颤抖，目光中含着未落下的泪水。

phrases.zh: 湿润的眼睛；含泪的眼睛

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 moiste，源自拉丁语 mucidus（发霉的）或 musteus（新鲜的），与 mucus（黏液）同源。
etymology.tip: moist 谐音“摸衣湿”——摸到衣服湿了，就是潮湿的。

meanings.exampleEn: The maximum of the container is two liters, so you cannot pour more water into it.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个容器的最大量是两升，所以你不能再往里面倒更多的水。

meanings.exampleEn: The temperature reached its maximum at noon, after which it began to decline.
meanings.exampleZh: 中午气温达到了极点，之后开始下降。

meanings.exampleEn: In calculus, the maximum of a function is a point where the function's value is greater than or equal to the values at all nearby points.
meanings.exampleZh: 在微积分中，函数的极大值是一个点，在该点函数值大于或等于所有邻近点的值。

meanings.exampleEn: The maximum speed of this vehicle is 200 kilometers per hour, which is quite impressive for a production car.
meanings.exampleZh: 这辆车的最高速度是200公里每小时，对于量产车来说相当令人印象深刻。

variants.zh: 最大的；最高的；最充分的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 maximus，是 magnus（大）的最高级形式
etymology.suffix: -um 名词后缀（拉丁语中性词尾）
etymology.tip: maxim（最大）+ um（名词后缀）→ 最大量；极点

meanings.exampleEn: The sculptor chiseled the mass of marble into a magnificent statue.
meanings.exampleZh: 雕塑家把这块大理石雕成了一座宏伟的雕像。

meanings.exampleEn: The mass of the population supports the new policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 大多数民众支持这项新政策。

meanings.exampleEn: The mass of an object remains constant regardless of its location.
meanings.exampleZh: 物体的质量与其位置无关，始终保持不变。

meanings.exampleEn: A mass of evidence has been collected to prove his innocence.
meanings.exampleZh: 已经收集了大量证据来证明他的清白。

meanings.exampleEn: Protesters massed in the central square to demand reform.
meanings.exampleZh: 抗议者聚集在中央广场要求改革。

meanings.exampleEn: The advent of mass production revolutionized the manufacturing industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 大规模生产的出现彻底改变了制造业。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 massa（团，块），源自古希腊语 maza（大麦饼，面团）
etymology.tip: mass 本身即词根，表示'团、块'，联想'一堆东西聚成团'

meanings.exampleEn: The momentary silence was broken by a sudden thunderclap.
meanings.exampleZh: 刹那间的寂静被突如其来的雷声打破。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 momentum（运动，瞬间），经古法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: moment（瞬间）+ -ary（的）= 瞬间的，刹那间的。

meanings.exampleEn: The solution is a heterogeneous mixture, requiring constant agitation to maintain uniformity.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种溶液是一种非均相混合物，需要持续搅拌以保持均匀。

meanings.exampleEn: His latest novel is an intriguing mixture of realism and surrealism, challenging conventional narrative structures.
meanings.exampleZh: 他最新的小说融合了现实主义与超现实主义，令人着迷，挑战了传统叙事结构。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee's decision was a mixture of political compromise and economic pragmatism.

meanings.exampleEn: The new method of data analysis significantly improved the accuracy of the experiment.

meanings.exampleEn: The monstrous waves swallowed the entire coastal village in minutes.
meanings.exampleZh: 巨大的海浪在几分钟内吞没了整个沿海村庄。

marshal.zh: 元帅；陆空军高级将官；典礼官；执法官

meanings.exampleZh: 陆军元帅在决战中指挥盟军。

meanings.exampleZh: 典礼官在国宴上宣布贵宾到场。

mental.zh: 心智的；精神病的；心理的；颏的

meanings.exampleZh: 这位哲学家论证说，心智过程不能简化为纯粹的神经活动。

meanings.exampleZh: 事件发生后，嫌疑人被送往精神病院接受精神评估。

meanings.exampleZh: 长期隔离会对人的心理健康产生不利影响。

meanings.exampleEn: The mental foramen is a small opening in the mandible that transmits the mental nerve and vessels.
meanings.exampleZh: 颏孔是下颌骨上的一个小孔，内有颏神经和血管通过。

meanings.exampleEn: The exhibition displayed a miniature of the ancient city, capturing every detail of its architecture.
meanings.exampleZh: 展览展示了一幅古城的缩图，捕捉了其建筑的每一个细节。

meanings.zh: 肌肉发达的；强壮的；有力的
meanings.exampleEn: The athlete's muscular physique was the result of years of rigorous training.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位运动员肌肉发达的体格是多年严格训练的结果。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 musculus，意为“小老鼠”，因肌肉收缩时形似小鼠活动而得名。
etymology.suffix: -ar = 形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”
etymology.tip: muscul（肌肉）+ ar（形容词后缀）→ 与肌肉有关的 → 肌肉发达的

meanings.exampleEn: A multitude of factors contributed to the economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 众多因素导致了这场经济危机。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 multitudo，由 multus（多的）加后缀 -tudo 构成
etymology.suffix: -tude = 表示状态、程度的名词后缀
etymology.tip: multi（多）+ tude（状态）→ 数量多的状态 → 多数；群众

meanings.exampleEn: The two countries signed a mutual defense treaty to ensure their common security.
meanings.exampleZh: 两国签署了相互防御条约，以确保共同安全。

meanings.exampleEn: Their mutual interest in classical music laid the foundation of a lasting friendship.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们对古典音乐共同的兴趣为持久的友谊奠定了基础。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mutuus（相互的，互换的），与 mutare（改变、交换）相关
etymology.tip: mut（交换）+ -al（的）→ 彼此交换的 → 相互的；共有的

mysterious.zh: 神秘的；难解的；不可思议的

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient temple is shrouded in a mysterious atmosphere that fascinates every visitor.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古老的寺庙笼罩在神秘的气氛中，令每位游客着迷。

meanings.exampleEn: The detective tried to explain the mysterious code found in the victim's diary.
meanings.exampleZh: 侦探试图解释在受害者日记中发现的难解密码。

meanings.exampleEn: It is mysterious how the ship vanished without leaving any trace in the calm sea.
meanings.exampleZh: 那艘船在平静的海面上消失得无影无踪，真是不可思议。

phrases.zh: 神秘的情况；不可思议的境况

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 mysterium，最终源自希腊语 mysterion（秘密仪式、奥秘）
etymology.tip: myst（秘密）+ -ous（充满……的）→ 充满秘密的 → 神秘的

meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant is famous for its tender mutton stew served with fresh herbs.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家餐厅以鲜嫩的羊肉炖菜配新鲜香草而闻名。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 moton，意为公羊，后引申指羊肉。
etymology.tip: mutton 与羊相关，看到 mutton 就想到“羊肉”。

leather.zh: 皮革；皮制品；马镫的皮带

meanings.exampleEn: The artisan's hands were calloused from years of working with tough leather.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位工匠的双手因多年处理坚韧皮革而长满老茧。

meanings.exampleEn: The jockey adjusted the leathers to ensure a secure foothold in the stirrups.
meanings.exampleZh: 骑师调整了马镫皮带，以确保在马镫中的稳固支撑。

meanings.exampleEn: In the past, a disobedient apprentice might be leathered by his master.
meanings.exampleZh: 过去，不听话的学徒可能会被师傅用皮鞭抽打。

meanings.exampleEn: The craftsman decided to leather the antique chest to restore its original elegance.
meanings.exampleZh: 工匠决定用皮革覆盖这个古董箱子，以恢复其原有的优雅。

variants.zh: 用皮鞭抽打；用皮革覆盖（第三人称单数）
用皮鞭抽打；用皮革覆盖（过去式/过去分词）
用皮鞭抽打；用皮革覆盖（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 lether，与德语 Leder 同源，无明显词根词缀。

meanings.exampleEn: The athlete was awarded a gold medal for her outstanding performance in the Olympic Games.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位运动员因在奥运会上的出色表现而被授予金牌。

meanings.exampleEn: He medaled in the 100-meter sprint at the national championships, setting a new record.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在全国锦标赛100米短跑中夺得奖牌，并创造了新纪录。

meanings.exampleEn: The government medaled the brave soldier for his extraordinary courage in the rescue mission.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府授予这位勇敢的士兵奖章，以表彰他在救援任务中的非凡勇气。

variants.zh: 获得奖牌；授予……奖牌（美式过去式）
获得奖牌；授予……奖牌（英式过去式）
获得奖牌；授予……奖牌（美式现在分词）
获得奖牌；授予……奖牌（英式现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 medius（中间的），经意大利语 medaglia（半第纳尔硬币）和法语 médaille 演变为奖牌
etymology.tip: medi（中间）的硬币，中间价值的硬币演变为奖牌

meanings.exampleEn: The sailor climbed the mast to get a better view of the approaching storm.
meanings.exampleZh: 水手爬上桅杆，以便更好地观察即将来临的风暴。

meanings.exampleEn: The radio mast on the hill transmits signals to the entire valley.
meanings.exampleZh: 山上的无线电杆向整个山谷传输信号。

etymology.origin: 古英语 mæst，源自原始日耳曼语 *mastaz
etymology.tip: mast 与 must 相近：桅杆(mast)必须(must)牢固

meanings.exampleEn: The committee proposed several modifications to the original plan before it was approved.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会在批准原计划之前提出了几处修改。

meanings.exampleEn: The software update includes a modification that corrects the data processing error.
meanings.exampleZh: 软件更新包含一项修正，用于纠正数据处理错误。

meanings.exampleEn: In the sentence "a very beautiful garden," the word "very" is a modification of the adjective.
meanings.exampleZh: 在句子“一个非常美丽的花园”中，“非常”是对形容词的修饰。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 modificare（modus 尺度 + facere 做），经法语 modification 进入英语
etymology.tip: mod（尺度）+ ification（使成为），使符合尺度即为“修改、修正”

meanings.exampleEn: The government has taken measures to modulate the pace of economic growth to avoid overheating.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已采取措施调整经济增长速度，以避免过热。

meanings.exampleEn: In the final movement, the composer modulates the melody from C major to A minor, creating a dramatic shift in mood.
meanings.exampleZh: 在最后一个乐章中，作曲家将旋律从C大调转调到A小调，营造出戏剧性的情绪转变。

meanings.exampleEn: She learned to modulate her voice so that even the back row of the auditorium could hear her clearly.
meanings.exampleZh: 她学会了控制自己的嗓音，以便礼堂后排的人也能听清。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 modulari（测量，调节），源自 modulus（小尺度）
etymology.tip: mod（尺度）+ -ulate（动词后缀）→ 使符合尺度 → 调整

meanings.exampleEn: The experienced miner detected a faint vein of gold deep within the rock.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位经验丰富的矿工在岩石深处发现了一条微弱的金矿脉。

meanings.exampleEn: The continuous miner operates efficiently in narrow underground seams, significantly boosting extraction rates.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种连续开矿机在狭窄的地下矿层中高效运转，显著提高了开采率。

meanings.exampleEn: The miner was ordered to undermine the enemy's bunker by digging a tunnel beneath it.
meanings.exampleZh: 那名坑道工兵奉命在敌人碉堡下方挖掘坑道以将其炸毁。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 mine（矿），可能源自凯尔特语；后缀 -er 表示“人”或“器械”
etymology.tip: mine（矿）+ er（人/物）= 矿工或开矿机

meanings.exampleEn: The Moslem community in this city celebrates Eid with great enthusiasm.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座城市的穆斯林社区以极大的热情庆祝开斋节。

meanings.exampleEn: She has a deep interest in Moslem culture and history.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对伊斯兰文化和历史有浓厚的兴趣。

phrases.zh: 穆斯林世界；伊斯兰世界

etymology.root: 无明确词根；源自阿拉伯语 muslim（顺从者）
etymology.origin: 来自阿拉伯语 muslim，意为“顺从真主的人”，是伊斯兰教信徒的自称。
etymology.tip: Moslem 与 Muslim 同义，联想“穆斯林=顺从真主的人”。

mortgage.zh: 抵押；约束性义务；抵押借款

meanings.exampleEn: They took out a mortgage to buy their first home.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们申请抵押贷款购买了第一套住房。

meanings.exampleEn: He mortgaged his house to finance the new business venture.
meanings.exampleZh: 他抵押了自己的房子来为新企业融资。

variants.zh: 抵押借款；抵押贷款（复数）

etymology.root: mort = 死；gage = 抵押品、担保
etymology.origin: 来自古法语 mort gage，字面意为“死抵押”，指贷款还清前抵押品始终处于“死”的状态（不能解除）。
etymology.tip: mort（死）+ gage（抵押品）→ 抵押品在还清前“死”绑在债务上，即“抵押”。

meanings.exampleEn: The composer's musical genius was evident in every intricate movement of the symphony.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位作曲家的音乐天赋在交响乐的每一个复杂乐章中都显露无遗。

meanings.exampleEn: The Broadway musical captivated audiences with its dazzling choreography and poignant storyline.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部百老汇音乐舞台剧以其 dazzling 的编舞和引人深思的故事情节征服了观众。

etymology.root: mus- = 缪斯（希腊神话中的艺术女神），引申为音乐
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 musicus，最终源自希腊语 mousike（缪斯的艺术），后经古法语 musique 进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -al = 形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”
etymology.tip: 缪斯（Muse）掌管音乐与艺术，mus- 加形容词后缀 -al，即“与缪斯艺术有关的”，联想为“音乐的”。

meanings.exampleEn: The new motorway will reduce travel time between the two cities by half.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条新建的高速公路将使两座城市之间的出行时间缩短一半。

etymology.root: motor = 运动，发动机；way = 道路
etymology.origin: 由 motor（汽车） + way（道路）构成的复合词，20世纪初出现于英国，指专供汽车高速行驶的道路。
etymology.tip: motor（汽车）+ way（路）= 汽车行驶的路，即高速公路。

meanings.exampleEn: The musician spent years perfecting his craft before performing at the prestigious concert hall.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位音乐家花了多年时间完善技艺，才在 prestigious 的音乐厅演出。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 musica，源自希腊语 mousike（艺术，音乐），后接表人的后缀 -ian
etymology.tip: music（音乐）+ -ian（人）= 从事音乐的人，即音乐家。

meanings.exampleEn: It was naive of him to believe that the rumor would disappear without any evidence.
meanings.exampleZh: 他天真地认为没有证据谣言就会消失。

etymology.origin: 来自法语 naïve，源自拉丁语 nativus（天然的，与生俱来的），与 native 同源。
etymology.tip: na-（像“拿”）+ -ive（形容词后缀），拿着出生时的纯真状态，就是“天真的”。

national.zh: 国家的；国立的；全国性的；民族的

meanings.exampleEn: The government has implemented a series of national policies to boost economic growth.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已实施一系列国家政策以促进经济增长。

meanings.exampleEn: She was admitted to a prestigious national university after years of hard work.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过多年努力，她被一所著名的国立大学录取。

meanings.exampleEn: The issue of climate change has become a national concern that requires immediate action.
meanings.exampleZh: 气候变化问题已成为需要立即采取行动的全国性关切。

meanings.exampleEn: The festival is a celebration of the country's rich national heritage and cultural diversity.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个节日是对该国丰富的民族遗产和文化多样性的庆祝。

variants.zh: 全国性地；在全国范围内

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 natio（出生、种族、民族），经由古法语进入英语，后加形容词后缀 -al 形成 national。
etymology.tip: nat（出生）+ -al（...的）→ 与出生地相关的 → 国家的、民族的。

meanings.exampleEn: The police finally arrested the murderer after a ten-year investigation.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过十年调查，警方终于逮捕了那名凶手。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 murdre，进一步源于日耳曼语，原意为“谋杀、暗杀”
etymology.tip: murder（谋杀）+ er（人）= 实施谋杀的人，即凶手。

meanings.exampleEn: The heavy rain turned the dirt road into deep mud, making it impassable for vehicles.
meanings.exampleZh: 大雨把土路变成了深深的泥浆，车辆无法通行。

meanings.exampleEn: The politician accused his opponents of throwing mud at him during the campaign.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位政客指责对手在竞选期间对他进行诽谤。

phrases.zh: 守旧的人；顽固不化的人

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The murmur of the crowd grew louder as the results were announced.
meanings.exampleZh: 结果公布时，人群的低语声变得更大了。

meanings.zh: 低语；发出轻柔持续的声音；私下抱怨
meanings.exampleEn: She murmured a soft apology before leaving the room.
meanings.exampleZh: 她低声说了一句抱歉，然后离开了房间。

variants.zh: 低语；发出轻柔持续的声音；私下抱怨（过去式/过去分词）
低语；发出轻柔持续的声音；私下抱怨（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 毫无怨言地；一声不吭地

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 murmurare，为拟声词，模仿低语或咕哝的声音。
etymology.tip: murmur 听起来像“默默”，默默发声就是低语、咕哝。

related.zh: 低语的；发出轻柔声音的
低语声；椋鸟群飞的景象（源自低语般的振翅声）

meanings.exampleEn: The entire nation was shocked by the sudden policy shift.
meanings.exampleZh: 整个国家都被这一突然的政策转变震惊了。

meanings.exampleEn: The Chinese nation has a long history of cultural diversity.
meanings.exampleZh: 中华民族有着悠久的文化多样性历史。

phrases.zh: 民族国家；单一民族国家

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 natio（出生、种族），经由古法语 nation 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: nat（出生）+ ion（名词后缀）→ 同出生的一群人 → 民族、国家

meanings.exampleEn: The narration of the novel is both vivid and compelling, drawing readers into the protagonist's inner world.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说的叙述既生动又引人入胜，将读者带入主人公的内心世界。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 narratio(n-)，源于 narrare（讲述）
etymology.tip: narr（讲述）+ -ation（行为）→ 讲述的行为 → 叙述

meanings.exampleEn: The mosque's minaret towers over the old city, visible from every corner.
meanings.exampleZh: 清真寺的宣礼塔高耸于老城之上，从每个角落都能看到。

etymology.root: s-j-d = 叩拜（阿拉伯语词根）
etymology.origin: 来自阿拉伯语 masjid（礼拜场所），经法语 mosquée 进入英语
etymology.tip: 清真寺（mosque）是穆斯林叩拜（s-j-d）之处，记住“叩拜之地”即可

meanings.exampleEn: We should not judge the morality of an action solely by its consequences.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们不应仅凭后果来判断行为的道德性。

meanings.exampleEn: The fable teaches a profound morality about the dangers of greed.
meanings.exampleZh: 这则寓言讲述了关于贪婪危害的深刻教训。

meanings.exampleEn: Her morality is beyond reproach; she always acts with integrity.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的品行无可指责，总是正直行事。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 moralitas，源于 mos（风俗）的派生词 moralis
etymology.tip: mor（风俗）+ ality（性质）→ 符合社会风俗的品行，即道德

meanings.exampleEn: He tucked the napkin into his collar before starting the elaborate meal.
meanings.exampleZh: 开始享用这顿丰盛的饭菜前，他把餐巾塞进衣领里。

meanings.exampleEn: She grabbed a napkin to wipe the spilled coffee off the table.
meanings.exampleZh: 她抓起一张餐巾纸擦掉洒在桌上的咖啡。

meanings.exampleEn: In British English, a diaper is often referred to as a napkin.
meanings.exampleZh: 在英式英语中，尿布常被称为 napkin。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 nappe（桌布），加上中古英语指小后缀 -kin，原义为“小桌布”。
etymology.tip: nappe（桌布）+ kin（小）→ 小桌布 → 餐巾。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel's intricate narrative weaves together the lives of three generations.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说错综复杂的叙述将三代人的生活交织在一起。

meanings.exampleEn: She employed a narrative technique that blurred the line between fact and fiction.
meanings.exampleZh: 她运用了一种模糊事实与虚构界限的叙事技巧。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 narrare（讲述、叙述），其词源可能与 gnarus（知道的）有关，表示“使知道”。
etymology.tip: narr（讲述）+ -ative（有……性质的）→ 用来讲述的 → 叙述的；名词化为“叙述；故事”。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient stones were covered with a thick layer of moss, making the path slippery.
meanings.exampleZh: 古老的石头上覆盖着厚厚一层苔藓，使小路变得湿滑。

meanings.exampleEn: The hiker got stuck in the moss and had to be pulled out by his companions.
meanings.exampleZh: 徒步旅行者陷在泥沼中，不得不被同伴拉出来。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 mos，原指沼泽、泥沼，后引申指生长于潮湿处的苔藓。
etymology.tip: moss 就是苔藓，常长在潮湿的沼泽边，看到 moss 联想“湿漉漉的绿毯”。

municipal.zh: 市政的；自治区的；内政的

meanings.exampleEn: The municipal government has launched a new campaign to improve public transportation.
meanings.exampleZh: 市政府已发起一项改善公共交通的新运动。

meanings.exampleEn: Each municipal district is responsible for its own waste management system.
meanings.exampleZh: 每个自治区负责自己的废物管理系统。

meanings.exampleEn: The municipal affairs of the city are managed by the local council.
meanings.exampleZh: 该市的内政事务由地方议会管理。

etymology.root: muni = 服务，职责；cip = 拿取，承担
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 municipalis，源自 municipium（自治市镇），由 munus（职责）+ capere（承担）构成
etymology.tip: muni（服务）+ cip（承担）+ al → 承担公共服务职责的 → 市政的

meanings.exampleEn: The bacteria multiply rapidly in warm conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 细菌在温暖条件下迅速繁殖。

meanings.exampleEn: To calculate the area, multiply the length by the width.
meanings.exampleZh: 计算面积时，用长乘以宽。

meanings.exampleEn: Our problems have multiplied since the project started.
meanings.exampleZh: 自项目开始以来，我们的问题成倍增加。

variants.zh: 乘；繁殖；增加（过去式/过去分词）
乘；繁殖；增加（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 multiplicare，由 multus（多）和 plicare（折叠）组成
etymology.tip: multi（多）+ ply（折叠）→ 多次折叠 → 成倍增加、繁殖、乘

meanings.exampleEn: The molecular structure of the compound determines its chemical properties.
meanings.exampleZh: 该化合物的分子结构决定了其化学性质。

variants.zh: 分子层面地；以分子形式

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 moles（质量，堆），经由法语 moléculaire；molecule 是 moles 的指小词 molecula（微小质量）的形容词形式
etymology.tip: mole（质量）+ -cule（小）+ -ar（的）→ 微小质量组成的 → 分子的

related.zh: 分子层面地；以分子形式

meanings.exampleZh: 政府决定铸造一系列新的纪念币以庆祝百年纪念。

motivate.zh: 给与动机；刺激；提高...的学习欲望；促动

mouse.zh: 老鼠；胆小羞怯的人；鼠标

phrases.zh: 猫捉老鼠；欲擒故纵的游戏

etymology.origin: 古英语 mus，基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleZh: 咖啡是巴西的土产，现在许多热带国家都有种植。

navy.zh: 海军；海军人员；海军军力；烟蒂

meanings.exampleZh: 海军派遣数艘军舰前往冲突地区执行维和任务。

meanings.exampleZh: 这座沿海城市的许多年轻人都渴望加入海军，为国效力。

meanings.exampleZh: 该国海军军力已大幅现代化，以保护其海洋利益。

meanings.exampleZh: 那个老守财奴把每一分钱都囤积起来，连必需品也不肯花钱买。

meanings.exampleZh: 尽管他很有钱，他却是个出了名的吝啬鬼，从不为同事买一轮酒。
