meanings.exampleZh: 他对她外貌的下流评论在专业场合完全不可接受。

meanings.exampleEn: The detective sensed a nasty plot behind the seemingly accidental death.
meanings.exampleZh: 侦探在看似意外死亡的背后察觉到一桩险恶的阴谋。

variants.zh: 更污秽的；更下流的；更险恶的
最污秽的；最下流的；最险恶的

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 nasty，可能源自古法语 nastre（恶劣的）或荷兰语 nestig（肮脏的）；无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: 联想记忆：na(那) + sty(猪圈) → 猪圈又脏又臭，令人联想到污秽、下流、险恶。

negligible.zh: 可以忽略的；不足取的；无用的

meanings.exampleEn: The damage to the car was negligible.
meanings.exampleZh: 汽车的损坏程度微不足道。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 negligere（忽视），由 neg-（不）+ legere（选择）构成
etymology.tip: neg（不）+ lig（选择）+ ible（可...的）→ 不值得选择的 → 可忽略的

mature.zh: 成熟的；到期的；充分考虑的

meanings.exampleEn: His mature attitude towards criticism impressed the entire team.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对批评的成熟态度给整个团队留下了深刻印象。

meanings.exampleEn: The mature bond will be redeemed at its face value.
meanings.exampleZh: 这笔到期的债券将按其面值赎回。

meanings.exampleEn: After mature deliberation, the committee approved the proposal.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过充分考虑，委员会批准了该提案。

meanings.exampleEn: The challenging internship matured her ability to solve complex problems.
meanings.exampleZh: 具有挑战性的实习锻炼了她解决复杂问题的能力。

meanings.exampleEn: The investment certificates will mature at the end of the fiscal year.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些投资凭证将在财政年度末到期。

variants.zh: （使）成熟；到期（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 成年学生（尤指大学中年龄较大的学生）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 maturus（成熟的，及时的）
etymology.tip: matur- 成熟，联想“马图尔”成熟了；pre-前 + mature 早熟，im-不 + mature 不成熟

meanings.exampleEn: The janitor leaned the mop against the wall after scrubbing the grimy corridor.
meanings.exampleZh: 清洁工擦洗了肮脏的走廊后，把拖把靠在墙上。

meanings.exampleEn: The mischievous boy made a mop at his classmates, which provoked a ripple of laughter.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个调皮的男孩朝同学们做了个鬼脸，引起一阵笑声。

meanings.exampleEn: She mopped the kitchen floor meticulously to remove every trace of the spilled coffee.
meanings.exampleZh: 她仔细地拖了厨房地板，以清除洒落咖啡的所有痕迹。

meanings.exampleEn: He mopped the sweat from his brow with a handkerchief before continuing his speech.
meanings.exampleZh: 他用手帕擦去额头上的汗水，然后继续演讲。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: A rise in temperature does not necessarily mean that the climate is changing permanently.
meanings.exampleZh: 温度升高并不必然意味着气候正在永久变化。

meanings.exampleEn: You are not necessarily required to attend every meeting, but your presence is encouraged.
meanings.exampleZh: 你不必须参加每一次会议，但鼓励你出席。

meanings.exampleEn: The government must necessarily allocate more funds to public health in times of crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 在危机时期，政府有必要将更多资金分配给公共卫生。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 necessarius，由 ne-（不）+ cedere（走开，让步）构成，原意为“不可回避的”
etymology.tip: ne（不）+ cess（走）+ ary + ly → 不能走开的 → 必然的、必须的

naughty.zh: 顽皮的；没规矩的；不适当的；下流的

meanings.exampleEn: The naughty puppy chewed the sofa cushions while its owner was away.
meanings.exampleZh: 那只顽皮的小狗趁主人不在时咬坏了沙发垫。

meanings.exampleEn: It was naughty of the students to talk back to the substitute teacher.
meanings.exampleZh: 学生们顶撞代课老师，真是太没规矩了。

meanings.exampleEn: The editor deleted the naughty remarks from the article to keep it professional.
meanings.exampleZh: 编辑删除了文章中不适当的言论，以保持其专业性。

meanings.exampleEn: The comedian's naughty jokes made some audience members uncomfortable.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位喜剧演员的下流笑话让一些观众感到不适。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 nāwiht，由 nā（no，没有）和 wiht（thing，事物）组合而成，原义为“一无是处、邪恶”，后弱化为“顽皮的”。
etymology.suffix: -y = 形容词后缀，表示“有…性质的”
etymology.tip: naughty = naught（无）+ y，原指“一无是处/坏”，现在多指“顽皮、没规矩”。

naturally.zh: 自然地；以自然力；天生地

meanings.exampleEn: She spoke naturally despite the large audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管观众很多，她仍然很自然地讲话。

meanings.exampleEn: The cave was formed naturally over thousands of years.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个洞穴是经过数千年以自然力形成的。

meanings.exampleEn: He is naturally gifted in mathematics.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在数学方面天生有天赋。

phrases.zh: 对……来说很自然；天生就会
自然发生的；天然存在的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 naturalis，源自 natura（自然）
etymology.tip: nat（出生）+ -ural + -ly，天生如此，自然发生。

meanings.exampleEn: The multiple causes of climate change require a comprehensive global response.
meanings.exampleZh: 气候变化的多种原因需要全面的全球应对。

meanings.exampleEn: The least common multiple of 6 and 8 is 24.
meanings.exampleZh: 6和8的最小公倍数是24。

etymology.root: ple = 倍、折叠（来自拉丁语 -plex）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 multiplex，由 multus（许多）和 -plex（折叠、倍数）合成
etymology.tip: multi（多）+ ple（倍）→ 多倍的 → 多样的、倍数

meanings.exampleEn: The navigation of the ship through the stormy waters required exceptional skill and experience.
meanings.exampleZh: 船在暴风雨水域中的航行需要非凡的技巧和经验。

meanings.exampleEn: Ancient navigation depended heavily on the observation of stars and celestial bodies.
meanings.exampleZh: 古代航海在很大程度上依赖于对星星和天体的观测。

meanings.exampleEn: The car's navigation system guided us through the unfamiliar city without any trouble.
meanings.exampleZh: 汽车的导航系统毫不费力地引导我们穿过了这座陌生的城市。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 navigare（驾驶船只），由 navis（船）+ agere（驾驶）构成
etymology.tip: nav（船）+ ig（驾驶）+ ation = 驾驶船，即航行、导航

meanings.exampleEn: The collision of a neutron with an atomic nucleus can trigger a chain reaction.
meanings.exampleZh: 中子与原子核的碰撞能引发链式反应。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 neuter（两者都不），后用于物理学表示电中性粒子；-on 为粒子名称后缀。
etymology.tip: neutr（中性）+ on（粒子）→ 电中性的粒子 → 中子

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient ritual remains a mystery that scientists have yet to unravel.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一古老仪式仍是一个科学家尚未解开的奥秘。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 mysterion，源自 mystes（入会者），与 myein（闭上嘴/眼睛）有关，引申为“不可言说之事”
etymology.tip: myst-（神秘）+ -ery（名词后缀）→ 神秘之事；联想“谜（mystery）让人 mystify（迷惑）”。

myth.zh: 神话；虚构的事；虚构的人

meanings.exampleEn: The myth of Prometheus has inspired countless works of art.
meanings.exampleZh: 普罗米修斯的神话启发了无数艺术作品。

meanings.exampleEn: It is a common myth that cracking your knuckles causes arthritis.
meanings.exampleZh: 一个常见的错误观念是，掰手指关节会导致关节炎。

meanings.exampleEn: The hero of the novel is a myth created by the author's imagination.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说的主人公是作者想象出来的虚构人物。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 mythos，意为故事、传说；经由拉丁语 mythus 进入英语。
etymology.tip: myth 本身就是词根，看到 myth 就想到神话故事。

meanings.exampleEn: The archaeologist unearthed an exquisite necklace adorned with ancient amulets.
meanings.exampleZh: 考古学家发掘出一条饰有古代护身符的精美项链。

etymology.root: neck = 脖子；lace = 带子/系带
etymology.origin: 来自古法语 laz（绳圈），后与 neck 组合成 necklace
etymology.tip: 脖子上的带子就是项链

meanings.exampleEn: The congregation gathered in the nave for the Easter service, beneath the soaring vaulted ceiling.
meanings.exampleZh: 会众聚集在教堂中殿参加复活节礼拜，头顶是高耸的拱形天花板。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient city's nave served as a bustling marketplace where merchants from distant regions exchanged goods.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古城的中央广场曾是一个熙熙攘攘的市场，来自遥远地区的商人在这里交换货物。

meanings.exampleEn: The mechanic inspected the nave of the wheel for signs of wear after the long-distance journey.
meanings.exampleZh: 长途行驶后，机械师检查了车轮轮毂是否有磨损迹象。

variants.zh: 中殿；中央广场；轮毂（复数）

etymology.origin: 中殿义来自拉丁语 navis（船），因教堂中殿形似倒扣的船；轮毂义源自古英语 nafu（轮毂），与船无关。
etymology.tip: nave 像一艘倒扣的船，记住“船形中殿”即可。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee nominated her as the candidate for the presidential election.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会提名她为总统选举的候选人。

meanings.exampleEn: The board nominated him to serve as the chief financial officer.
meanings.exampleZh: 董事会任命他担任首席财务官。

meanings.exampleEn: Scientists nominated the newly discovered species after the famous biologist.
meanings.exampleZh: 科学家以那位著名生物学家的名字为新发现的物种命名。

phrases.zh: 任命某人为……；提名某人为……

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nominare（命名），由 nomen（名字）派生而来
etymology.tip: nomin（名字）+ ate（动词后缀）→ 把名字提出来 → 提名、任命、命名

meanings.exampleEn: The migratory birds flew northwards as the cold season approached.
meanings.exampleZh: 随着寒冷季节的临近，候鸟向北方飞去。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 norþ，加上表示方向的副词后缀 -wards
etymology.tip: north（北）+ wards（朝向）= 向北方

meanings.exampleEn: The noisy construction site made it impossible for residents to concentrate on their work.
meanings.exampleZh: 嘈杂的建筑工地使居民无法集中精力工作。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 noise，意为吵闹、争吵；后加形容词后缀 -y 构成 noisy
etymology.tip: noise（噪音）+ y（充满...的）→ 充满噪音的 → 嘈杂的

meanings.exampleEn: His nickname, 'The Professor', reflects his scholarly demeanor.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的绰号“教授”反映了他学者般的气质。

meanings.exampleEn: They nicknamed the tall building 'The Pencil' because of its shape.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们因为那座高楼的外形而给它起了个绰号叫“铅笔”。

variants.zh: 给…起绰号（第三人称单数）
给…起绰号（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.root: nick/eke = 额外，增加；name = 名字
etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 ekename，原义为“额外的名字”，后因误断音（an ekename 被听成 a nekename）演变为 nickname。
etymology.tip: 额外的名字（eke + name）就是绰号。

meanings.exampleEn: Under normal circumstances, the experiment should yield consistent results within a few hours.
meanings.exampleZh: 在正常情况下，实验应在几小时内产生一致的结果。

meanings.exampleEn: After the crisis, the country gradually returned to a state of normal in its economic activities.
meanings.exampleZh: 危机过后，该国的经济活动逐渐恢复到常态。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 normalis，由 norma（规则、标准）+ -alis（形容词后缀）构成
etymology.tip: norm（规则标准）+ al（形容词后缀）= 符合规则的，即正常的、标准的

meanings.exampleEn: The wind is blowing from the northeast, bringing cold air to the coastal cities.
meanings.exampleZh: 风从东北方向吹来，给沿海城市带来了冷空气。

meanings.exampleEn: They live in the northeast part of the country, where the climate is much drier.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们住在这个国家的东北部，那里气候干燥得多。

meanings.exampleEn: The migratory birds flew northeast to escape the approaching winter.
meanings.exampleZh: 候鸟向东北飞去，以躲避即将到来的冬天。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 norþ（北）与 ēast（东）的组合
etymology.tip: north（北）+ east（东）= 东北

meanings.exampleEn: The report contained a lot of needless details that distracted from the main argument.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份报告包含许多不必要的细节，分散了对主要论点的注意力。

etymology.origin: 古英语 nēd（需要） + 后缀 -less（无，没有）
etymology.tip: need（需要）+ less（无）= 没有需要的，即“不必要的”。

related.zh: 贫穷的；缺乏生活必需品的

meanings.exampleEn: We mourn the loss of our dear friend.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们哀悼挚友的离去。

meanings.exampleEn: She mourned over her lost youth.
meanings.exampleZh: 她为逝去的青春而忧伤。

meanings.exampleEn: He is still mourning for his grandmother.
meanings.exampleZh: 他仍在为祖母服丧。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 murnan，意为悲伤、哀悼，源自原始日耳曼语 *murnan。
etymology.tip: 谐音“默哀”：mourn（默哀）就是哀悼。

meanings.exampleEn: The final price, minus the applicable discounts, still exceeds our monthly budget.
meanings.exampleZh: 最终价格减去适用折扣后，仍然超出我们的月度预算。

meanings.exampleEn: The temperature plummeted to minus twenty degrees, causing severe frostbite risks for outdoor workers.
meanings.exampleZh: 气温骤降至零下二十度，给户外工作者带来严重的冻伤风险。

meanings.exampleEn: In algebraic expressions, a minus before a bracket reverses the sign of every term inside.
meanings.exampleZh: 在代数表达式中，括号前的减号会改变括号内每一项的符号。

meanings.exampleEn: Although he is talented, his inability to meet deadlines is a major minus in this competitive industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管他很有才华，但在这个竞争激烈的行业里，不能按时完成任务是一个重大不足。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 minus，意为“更少”，是 parvus（小）的比较级
etymology.tip: minus 本义“更少”，少一点就是“减号”，引申为“负的、不足”。

meanings.exampleEn: She jotted down the professor's key points in her notebook during the lecture.
meanings.exampleZh: 讲座期间，她在笔记本上记下了教授讲的重点。

meanings.exampleEn: The technician consulted the maintenance notebook before repairing the machine.
meanings.exampleZh: 技术员在修理机器前查阅了维修手册。

meanings.exampleEn: The accountant recorded every promissory note in the company's notebook for future audit.
meanings.exampleZh: 会计将每张期票记录在公司的期票簿中，以备日后审计。

variants.zh: 笔记本；手册；期票簿（复数）

etymology.root: note = 记录，标记；book = 书，本子
etymology.origin: 由古英语中的 note 和 book 组合而成的复合词，原指用于记录的本子。
etymology.tip: note（记录）+ book（本子）= 用来记录的本子，即笔记本。

meanings.exampleEn: The wind is blowing from the northwest, bringing cold air to the region.
meanings.exampleZh: 风从西北方向吹来，给该地区带来了冷空气。

meanings.exampleEn: They set up camp on the northwest slope of the mountain.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们在山的西北坡扎营。

meanings.exampleEn: The river flows northwest through the dense forest before turning east.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条河向西北流过茂密的森林，然后转向东流。

phrases.zh: 西北地区（尤指美国西北部）

etymology.origin: 由古英语 north（北）和 west（西）复合而成
etymology.tip: north（北）+ west（西）= 西北，记住两个方向词组合即可。

meanings.exampleEn: In mathematical notation, the symbol '∞' represents infinity.
meanings.exampleZh: 在数学符号表示法中，符号“∞”代表无穷大。

meanings.exampleEn: The editor added a brief notation to clarify the obscure passage in the manuscript.
meanings.exampleZh: 编辑添加了一条简短的注释，以澄清手稿中晦涩的段落。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 notatio（标记、记录），源于 notare（标记），后经法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -tion = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: nota（标记）+ -tion（名词后缀）→ 标记出来的东西 → 记号、符号表示法。

meanings.exampleEn: Nitrogen is an essential element for all living organisms, as it is a key component of amino acids and nucleic acids.
meanings.exampleZh: 氮是所有生物体必需的元素，因为它是氨基酸和核酸的关键组成部分。

etymology.origin: 来自法语 nitrogène，由 nitr-（硝石）和 -gène（产生）构成，指从硝石中产生的气体。
etymology.tip: nitro（硝石）+ gen（产生）→ 从硝石中产生的气体 → 氮气

meanings.exampleEn: The neighbouring countries have signed a new trade agreement to boost regional cooperation.
meanings.exampleZh: 邻近国家签署了一项新的贸易协定，以促进区域合作。

etymology.root: neigh = 近，邻近；bour = 居住者
etymology.origin: 来自古英语 neahgebūr，由 neah（近）和 gebūr（居民）组合而成
etymology.suffix: -ing 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
etymology.tip: neighbour（邻居）+ ing = 像邻居一样的，即邻近的、接壤的

meanings.exampleEn: The normalization of diplomatic relations between the two countries took decades of negotiation.
meanings.exampleZh: 两国关系的正常化经过了数十年的谈判。

meanings.exampleEn: The company underwent a process of normalization to comply with international standards.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司经历了正规化过程以符合国际标准。

variants.zh: 使正常化的；正在标准化的

phrases.zh: 数据规范化；数据标准化
正常化过程；规范化流程

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 norma（规则、标准）→ normalis（符合标准的）→ 法语 normaliser → 英语 normalize + -ation
etymology.tip: norm（标准）+ -al（形容词后缀）+ -ization（名词后缀）→ 使符合标准 → 正常化、规范化

nominal.zh: 名义上的；名字的；有名无实的；稍许的

meanings.exampleEn: The nominal leader of the party has little real power in decision-making.
meanings.exampleZh: 该党的名义领袖在决策中几乎没有实权。

meanings.exampleEn: The nominal definition of the term is provided in the first chapter of the book.
meanings.exampleZh: 该术语的名称性定义在本书第一章中给出。

meanings.exampleEn: He holds a nominal title but performs none of the duties associated with it.
meanings.exampleZh: 他空有一个头衔，却不履行与之相关的任何职责。

meanings.exampleEn: The service was provided at a nominal charge, barely covering the cost.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项服务只收取象征性的少许费用，几乎不够成本。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nominalis，源自 nomen（名字）
etymology.tip: nomin（名字）+ -al（…的）→ 与名字有关的 → 名义上的

meanings.exampleEn: The bird meticulously wove twigs and leaves into a secure nest high in the branches.
meanings.exampleZh: 那只鸟精心地将树枝和树叶编织成高悬于枝头的安全巢穴。

meanings.exampleEn: Many seabirds nest on the sheer cliffs, safe from terrestrial predators.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多海鸟在陡峭的悬崖上筑巢，以躲避陆地上的捕食者。

phrases.zh: 空巢；子女长大离家后的家庭

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；来自古英语

meanings.exampleEn: The university notified all students of the new examination schedule via email.
meanings.exampleZh: 大学通过电子邮件通知了所有学生新的考试安排。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 notificare，由 notus（已知的）+ facere（做）构成，经古法语 notifier 进入英语。
etymology.tip: not（知道）+ -fy（使）→ 使某人知道 → 通知。

monitor.zh: 监督器；级长；监听员；班长

meanings.exampleEn: The technician adjusted the monitor to display the patient's vital signs clearly.
meanings.exampleZh: 技术员调整了监视器，以便清晰地显示病人的生命体征。

meanings.exampleEn: As the monitor of Class 3, she is responsible for collecting homework and maintaining discipline.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为三班的班长，她负责收作业和维护纪律。

meanings.exampleEn: The senior monitor addressed the assembly on behalf of the student council.
meanings.exampleZh: 高年级级长代表学生会向全体大会致辞。

meanings.exampleEn: The radio monitor intercepted the encrypted signals from the enemy base.
meanings.exampleZh: 无线电监听员截获了来自敌方基地的加密信号。

meanings.exampleEn: The system monitors air quality in real time to ensure environmental safety.
meanings.exampleZh: 该系统实时监测空气质量，以确保环境安全。

variants.zh: 监控；监测（过去式/过去分词）
监控；监测（第三人称单数）
监视器；班长；级长；监听员（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 monitor（提醒者），由 monere（警告）派生
etymology.tip: mon（警告）+ or（人/物）→ 提醒你的人或物 → 监视器、班长

meanings.exampleEn: The northern regions of the country experience extreme cold during winter.
meanings.exampleZh: 该国北部地区在冬季经历极度的严寒。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 norþern，由 north（北）加形容词后缀 -ern 构成
etymology.suffix: -ern = 表示方向、方位的形容词后缀
etymology.tip: north（北）+ -ern（...的）→ 北方的

naked.zh: 裸体的；无装饰的；无保护的；赤贫的

meanings.exampleEn: The artist insisted that the model pose naked for the life drawing class.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家坚持要求模特在写生课上摆出裸体姿势。

meanings.exampleEn: The room was stark and naked, with bare walls and no furniture.
meanings.exampleZh: 房间空荡荡的，毫无装饰，只有光秃秃的墙壁和没有家具。

meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers were left naked to the enemy's attack after their defenses collapsed.
meanings.exampleZh: 防御崩溃后，士兵们毫无防护地暴露在敌人的攻击之下。

meanings.exampleEn: The economic crisis left the family naked, without any savings or assets.
meanings.exampleZh: 经济危机使这个家庭赤贫，没有任何积蓄或资产。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 nacod，源自原始日耳曼语 *nakwadaz，最终源自印欧语 *nogw-（裸）。
etymology.tip: 核心词根 nogw- 意为“裸”，naked 即“裸体的”；同根词 nude 也是裸体。

motor.zh: 马达；发动机；原动力；汽车

meanings.exampleEn: The electric motor in the industrial robot operates with remarkable precision and efficiency.
meanings.exampleZh: 工业机器人中的电动马达以惊人的精度和效率运转。

meanings.exampleEn: The ship's motor failed during the storm, leaving the crew at the mercy of the waves.
meanings.exampleZh: 暴风雨中船的发动机失灵，船员们只能听凭海浪摆布。

meanings.exampleEn: Curiosity is the motor that drives scientific innovation and discovery.
meanings.exampleZh: 好奇心是推动科学创新与发现的原动力。

meanings.exampleEn: The exhibition showcased a vintage motor from the early twentieth century.
meanings.exampleZh: 展览展示了一辆二十世纪初的老式汽车。

variants.zh: 马达；发动机；原动力；汽车（复数）
乘汽车旅行（第三人称单数）
乘汽车旅行（过去式/过去分词）
乘汽车旅行（现在分词/动名词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 motor（移动者），源自 movere（移动）
etymology.tip: mot（移动）+ or（物）= 使物体移动的东西，即马达

meanings.exampleEn: In the sentence 'The beauty of nature is endless,' both 'beauty' and 'nature' are nouns.
meanings.exampleZh: 在句子“自然之美是无尽的”中，“美”和“自然”都是名词。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nomen（名字），经由古法语 noun 进入英语
etymology.tip: noun 是“名词”，名词就是事物的“名字”（nomen），记住“名字”即“名词”。

meanings.exampleEn: The narrow alley between the skyscrapers was barely wide enough for a single person to pass through.
meanings.exampleZh: 摩天大楼之间的狭窄小巷几乎只够一个人通过。

meanings.exampleEn: The government's new policies aim to narrow the widening gap between the urban and rural areas.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府的新政策旨在缩小城乡之间不断扩大的差距。

meanings.exampleEn: The sailors had to steer the vessel carefully through the narrows of the river delta.
meanings.exampleZh: 水手们不得不小心地驾驶船只穿过三角洲河口的狭窄水道。

etymology.origin: 古英语 nearu，意为狭窄；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

mask.zh: 面具；假面具；掩饰；石膏面模

meanings.exampleEn: The thief wore a black mask, making it impossible for the security cameras to identify him.
meanings.exampleZh: 窃贼戴着黑色面具，使得监控摄像头无法识别他。

meanings.exampleEn: His affable manner is merely a mask that conceals his ruthless ambition.
meanings.exampleZh: 他和蔼可亲的态度不过是掩盖其冷酷野心的假面具。

meanings.exampleEn: The museum displayed a plaster mask taken from the poet's face after his death.
meanings.exampleZh: 博物馆展出了一副诗人死后从脸上翻制的石膏面模。

meanings.exampleEn: She tried to mask her anxiety with a confident smile before the interview.
meanings.exampleZh: 面试前，她试图用自信的微笑掩饰内心的焦虑。

meanings.exampleEn: All the guests masked themselves before entering the grand masquerade ball.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有宾客在进入盛大的化装舞会前都戴上了面具。

variants.zh: 掩饰/戴面具的第三人称单数
掩饰/戴面具的过去式和过去分词
掩饰/戴面具的现在分词

etymology.origin: 源自阿拉伯语 maskharah（小丑），经意大利语 maschera、法语 masque 进入英语；无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: mask 即“面具”，戴上面具就是“掩饰”；由“面具”联想到“伪装”即可。

meanings.exampleEn: The awe-inspiring power of nature reminds us of the fragility of human civilization.
meanings.exampleZh: 大自然令人敬畏的力量提醒我们人类文明的脆弱。

meanings.exampleEn: It is human nature to seek meaning and purpose in the face of adversity.
meanings.exampleZh: 面对逆境时寻求意义和目的是人的本性。

meanings.exampleEn: Her cautious nature prevented her from making hasty decisions during the negotiation.
meanings.exampleZh: 她谨慎的性格使她在谈判中避免做出草率的决定。

meanings.exampleEn: The philosopher argued that humans in a state of nature are driven by self-preservation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位哲学家认为，处于自然状态下的人类受自我保存的驱使。

phrases.zh: 第二天性；习以为常的事

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 natura，源于 nasci（出生），本义为“天生的性质”，后引申为“自然、本性”。
etymology.suffix: -ure = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果或状态
etymology.tip: nat（出生）+ ure（名词后缀）→ 与生俱来的东西 → 本性、自然

meanings.exampleEn: His motive for resigning was never fully explained.
meanings.exampleZh: 他辞职的动机从未得到充分解释。

meanings.exampleEn: The primary motive of the campaign is to raise public awareness of climate change.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项运动的主要目的是提高公众对气候变化的意识。

meanings.exampleEn: The motive of betrayal recurs throughout the novel.
meanings.exampleZh: 背叛的主题在小说中反复出现。

meanings.exampleEn: The composer used a somber motive to convey the tragedy.
meanings.exampleZh: 作曲家使用了一种阴郁的基调来传达悲剧。

phrases.zh: 不可告人的动机；别有用心

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 movere 的过去分词 motus，意为“移动”；经由古法语 motif 进入英语。
etymology.tip: mot（移动）+ -ive（有…性质的）→ 让人行动的东西 → 动机

meanings.exampleEn: The patient was too weak to take any nourishment by mouth.
meanings.exampleZh: 病人虚弱得无法经口摄入任何营养品。

variants.zh: 营养良好的；得到滋养的

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 norriss-/nourrir，最终源自拉丁语 nutrire（喂养、滋养）
etymology.suffix: -ment 表示行为的结果或相关事物
etymology.tip: nour（滋养）+ -ish（动词后缀）+ -ment（名词后缀）→ 滋养品、营养

meanings.exampleEn: The rusty nail protruding from the plank posed a potential hazard to anyone passing by.
meanings.exampleZh: 从木板中突出的生锈钉子对任何经过的人都构成潜在危险。

meanings.exampleEn: Constant exposure to harsh chemicals had rendered her nail brittle and discolored.
meanings.exampleZh: 长期接触刺激性化学物质使她的指甲变得脆弱且变色。

meanings.exampleEn: The carpenter nailed the heavy oak frame securely to the wall.
meanings.exampleZh: 木匠把沉重的橡木框架牢牢地钉在墙上。

phrases.en: hit the nail on the head

etymology.origin: 古英语 nagel（钉子；指甲），与德语 Nagel 同源；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: 无词根词缀，可联想钉子与指甲的坚硬质感。

meanings.exampleEn: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the outdoor concert proceeded as scheduled.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，户外音乐会仍按计划进行。

meanings.exampleEn: The task was difficult; notwithstanding, they completed it ahead of time.
meanings.exampleZh: 任务很艰巨；尽管如此，他们还是提前完成了。

phrases.zh: 尽管有任何条款（法律用语）

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 notwithstonding，由 not + withstanding（withstand 的现在分词）构成
etymology.tip: not + with + standing = 不站在（某事物）旁边，即“尽管”

meanings.exampleEn: She was newly appointed as the director of the research institute.
meanings.exampleZh: 她最近被任命为这个研究所的所长。

meanings.exampleEn: The newly decorated room looks quite different from before.
meanings.exampleZh: 重新装修过的房间与以前大不相同。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 neowe，意为“新的”
etymology.suffix: -ly = 副词后缀，表示方式或状态
etymology.tip: new（新的）+ ly（副词后缀）→ 以新的方式 → 最近；重新

meanings.exampleEn: She is my favorite niece, and I always bring her souvenirs from my business trips.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是我最喜欢的侄女，我出差时总给她带纪念品。

phrases.zh: 姻亲侄女/甥女（配偶的侄女/甥女）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 neptis（孙女；外甥女），经古法语 niece 进入英语
etymology.tip: niece 与 nephew 对应，记住 nephew 是侄子，niece 是侄女；词根 nepot- 还藏在 nepotism（裙带关系）里。

meanings.exampleEn: He neglected his health and rarely exercised, which eventually led to serious illness.
meanings.exampleZh: 他忽视了自己的健康，很少锻炼，最终导致重病。

meanings.zh: 疏忽；忽视；被忽略的状态
meanings.exampleEn: The old building suffered years of neglect before it was finally restored.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座老建筑在被最终修复之前，遭受了多年的忽视。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 neglegere，由 neg-（不）+ legere（选择）构成，意为“不去选择、不关心”。
etymology.tip: neg（不）+ lect（选择）→ 不去选择、不去理会 → 疏忽、忽略

meanings.exampleEn: The giraffe's long neck allows it to reach leaves high in the trees.
meanings.exampleZh: 长颈鹿的长脖子使它能够够到树高处的叶子。

meanings.exampleEn: The neck of her blouse was trimmed with delicate lace.
meanings.exampleZh: 她衬衫的领口镶着精致的花边。

etymology.origin: 古英语 hnecca；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀
etymology.tip: 脖子（neck）是头和身体的连接处，联想“项链”（necklace）戴在脖子上。

meanings.exampleEn: Nonetheless, the experiment yielded significant results despite the initial setbacks.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管如此，实验尽管最初遭遇挫折，仍然产生了显著的结果。

etymology.origin: 由 none（无）+ the + less（少）组合而成，意为“尽管如此”
etymology.tip: none（无）+ the + less（少）→ 即使没有减少，仍然如此

nuisance.zh: 讨厌的东西；讨厌的人；损害

meanings.exampleEn: The constant noise from the construction site has become a real nuisance to the residents.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑工地持续不断的噪音已成为居民们真正讨厌的东西。

meanings.exampleEn: The court ruled that the factory's toxic emissions constituted a public nuisance.
meanings.exampleZh: 法院裁定该工厂的有毒排放构成了对公众的妨害。

variants.zh: 讨厌的人；讨厌的东西；损害（复数）

phrases.zh: 惹人讨厌；使自己成为令人讨厌的人
干扰价值；令人讨厌的价值（指虽无实际危害但足以造成麻烦）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 nuisance，源自拉丁语 nocere（伤害）
etymology.suffix: -ance = 名词后缀，表示状态、性质
etymology.tip: noc（伤害）+ -ance（名词）→ 带来伤害或麻烦的东西 → 讨厌的人/东西

meanings.exampleEn: The notion of time as a linear progression is deeply ingrained in modern culture.
meanings.exampleZh: 时间是一种线性进程的概念在现代文化中根深蒂固。

meanings.exampleEn: She had a vague notion of traveling abroad after graduation, but she hadn't made any concrete plans.
meanings.exampleZh: 她有一个模糊的想法，毕业后出国旅行，但尚未制定任何具体计划。

variants.zh: 概念；观念；想法（复数形式）
概念上的；理论上的；名义上的

phrases.zh: 对……毫无概念；完全不理解
模糊的想法；隐约的概念

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 notio（概念、想法），源于 noscere（知道、认识）的过去分词 notus。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: not（知道）+ ion（名词后缀）→ 知道后形成的“概念、观念”。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient oak in the village square has stood for over three centuries.
meanings.exampleZh: 村庄广场上那棵古老的橡树已经矗立了三个多世纪。

meanings.exampleEn: This cabinet is crafted from solid oak, ensuring both durability and elegance.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个橱柜由实心橡木制成，既耐用又优雅。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；来自古英语 āc，与德语 Eiche 同源。
etymology.tip: oak 像一棵高大的橡树，树干笔直，记住“OK”的橡树很健康。

meanings.exampleEn: Building muscle requires consistent training and adequate protein intake.
meanings.exampleZh: 增肌需要持续训练和充足的蛋白质摄入。

meanings.exampleEn: He used his muscle to force the heavy door open.
meanings.exampleZh: 他用臂力强行推开了那扇沉重的门。

meanings.exampleEn: Several large companies are trying to muscle into the emerging market.
meanings.exampleZh: 几家大公司正试图强行打入这个新兴市场。

variants.zh: 强行挤入（第三人称单数）
强行挤入（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 musculus（小老鼠），因肌肉在皮下活动时形似小老鼠而得名；后经法语 muscle 进入英语。
etymology.tip: 肌肉（muscle）像小老鼠（mus）在皮下爬动，记住 mus + cle = 小老鼠。

related.zh: 肌骨骼的；肌肉与骨骼的

meanings.exampleEn: The motion of the planets around the sun was not fully understood until the 17th century.
meanings.exampleZh: 行星围绕太阳的移动直到17世纪才被完全理解。

meanings.exampleEn: The dancer's graceful motions captivated the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 舞者优雅的动作令观众着迷。

meanings.exampleEn: He made a motion with his hand to signal that we should stop.
meanings.exampleZh: 他做了一个手势示意我们应该停下来。

meanings.exampleEn: The board will vote on the motion to increase the budget.
meanings.exampleZh: 董事会将对增加预算的动议进行投票。

meanings.exampleEn: She motioned to the waiter to bring the menu.
meanings.exampleZh: 她示意服务员拿菜单来。

variants.zh: 移动；动作；手势；提议（复数）
示意，打手势（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 motio(n-)，意为“移动”，源自 movere “移动”
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: mot 是“移动”，-ion 是名词后缀，motion 就是“移动、动作”

notorious.zh: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；众人皆知的

meanings.zh: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的
meanings.exampleEn: The notorious gangster was finally arrested after decades of crime.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个臭名昭著的黑帮头目在犯罪数十年后终于被捕。

meanings.exampleEn: The region is notorious for its extreme weather conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个地区因极端天气而众所周知。

variants.zh: 臭名昭著地；众所周知地

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 notorius，源于 notus（已知的），是 noscere（了解）的过去分词
etymology.tip: not（知道）+ -ious（…的）→ 大家都知道 → 臭名昭著

meanings.exampleEn: Good nutrition is essential for maintaining a healthy immune system and preventing chronic diseases.
meanings.exampleZh: 良好的营养对于维持健康的免疫系统和预防慢性疾病至关重要。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nutritio（喂养），源自 nutrire（滋养、哺乳）
etymology.suffix: -tion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: nutri（滋养）+ tion（名词后缀）→ 滋养的过程 → 营养

meanings.exampleEn: It is noble to sacrifice one's own interests for the welfare of others.
meanings.exampleZh: 为了他人的福祉而牺牲个人利益是高尚的。

meanings.exampleEn: She comes from a noble family with a long and distinguished history.
meanings.exampleZh: 她出身于一个历史悠久、声名显赫的贵族家庭。

meanings.exampleEn: In medieval Europe, nobles held vast lands and wielded considerable political power.
meanings.exampleZh: 在中世纪的欧洲，贵族拥有广袤的土地并掌握着相当大的政治权力。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nobilis，意为“众所周知的、出身名门的”，源自 noscere（知道）。
etymology.tip: 贵族（noble）因“知名”（nobil）而显得高贵。

notable.zh: 著名人士；值得注意之事物

meanings.zh: 值得注意的，显著的；著名的
meanings.exampleEn: The conference attracted a notable number of international scholars.
meanings.exampleZh: 这次会议吸引了相当数量的国际学者，十分引人注目。

meanings.exampleEn: Several local notables attended the charity gala to show their support.
meanings.exampleZh: 几位当地名人出席了慈善晚会以示支持。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 notabilis，由 nota（标记）+ -bilis（可……的）构成
etymology.tip: not（标记）+ able（可……的）= 可被标记的，即值得注意的

neighbourhood.zh: 邻接；周围；附近一带；邻近

meanings.exampleEn: The neighbourhood has changed dramatically over the past decade.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个街区在过去十年里发生了巨大变化。

meanings.exampleEn: We value the neighbourhood that has developed among the residents.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们珍视居民之间形成的邻里情谊。

meanings.exampleEn: The explosion could be heard throughout the entire neighbourhood.
meanings.exampleZh: 爆炸声在整个邻近地区都能听到。

phrases.zh: 邻里守望（社区治安联防）
居民委员会；社区委员会

etymology.root: neighbour = 邻居（由古英语 neah '近' + gebur '居民' 构成）
etymology.origin: 来自古英语 neahgebur（近邻），后加后缀 -hood 表示状态或区域
etymology.suffix: -hood = 状态、身份、时期；在此表示区域或关系
etymology.tip: neighbour（邻居）+ hood（状态/区域）→ 邻居们所在的区域，即附近一带

meanings.exampleEn: The reform movement has gained significant momentum in recent months.
meanings.exampleZh: 近几个月来，这场改革运动获得了巨大的动力。

meanings.exampleEn: The total momentum of a closed system remains constant if no external forces act on it.
meanings.exampleZh: 若无外力作用，封闭系统的总动量保持不变。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 momentum（运动，动力），源于 movere（移动）
etymology.suffix: -mentum 名词后缀，表示行为的结果或工具
etymology.tip: mot（移动）+ -mentum（名词后缀）→ 移动的力量 → 动力；动量

nonsense.zh: 无意义的事；荒谬言行；荒唐

meanings.exampleEn: The report was full of statistical nonsense that obscured the real issues.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份报告充斥着统计上的无意义内容，掩盖了真正的问题。

meanings.exampleEn: His explanation for the delay was sheer nonsense; no one believed a word of it.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对延误的解释纯属荒谬言行，没人相信一个字。

meanings.exampleEn: It would be nonsense to claim that money brings happiness without exception.
meanings.exampleZh: 声称金钱无一例外地带来幸福是荒唐的。

phrases.zh: 严肃的；不容胡闹的；务实的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 sentire（感觉），经古法语 sens 进入英语；non- 表示否定
etymology.tip: non（不）+ sense（意义）→ 没有意义 → 胡说八道

numerous.zh: 很多的；数目众多的；多数的

meanings.zh: 很多的；数目众多的；多数的
meanings.exampleEn: The professor has published numerous papers on environmental economics over the past decade.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位教授在过去十年中发表了大量关于环境经济学的论文。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 numerosus（数目众多的），由 numerus（数目）+ -osus（充满...的）构成
etymology.tip: numer（数）+ ous（多）→ 数不完的 → 众多的

neat.zh: 整洁的；巧妙的；匀称的；简洁的

meanings.exampleEn: His desk is always neat, with every document carefully arranged.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的书桌总是整洁的，每份文件都摆放得井井有条。

meanings.exampleEn: She came up with a neat solution to the complex problem.
meanings.exampleZh: 她想出了一个巧妙的方法来解决这个复杂的问题。

meanings.exampleEn: The neat proportions of the building reflect the architect's meticulous design.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座建筑匀称的比例反映了建筑师一丝不苟的设计。

meanings.exampleEn: The neat summary at the end of the report helped the readers grasp the key points quickly.
meanings.exampleZh: 报告末尾简洁的总结帮助读者快速抓住要点。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nitidus（明亮的，整洁的），经古法语 neit 进入英语
etymology.tip: 词根 nit 意为“闪耀”，闪耀发光的东西看起来整洁而巧妙

meanings.exampleEn: A balanced diet is essential to nourish both body and mind.
meanings.exampleZh: 均衡的饮食对于滋养身心至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: She still nourishes the hope of becoming a professional writer.
meanings.exampleZh: 她仍然怀有成为一名职业作家的希望。

variants.zh: 营养良好的；得到滋养的

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 norrir，源自拉丁语 nutrire（喂养、滋养）
etymology.tip: nour（滋养）+ ish（使动）→ 使得到滋养，引申为“怀有”

numerical.zh: 数字的；数值的；以数字表示的；擅长于计数的

meanings.exampleEn: The numerical data obtained from the experiment were analyzed with sophisticated statistical software.
meanings.exampleZh: 从实验中获得的数值数据用复杂的统计软件进行了分析。

meanings.exampleEn: Please arrange the items in numerical order before submitting the report.
meanings.exampleZh: 提交报告前，请将项目按数字顺序排列。

meanings.exampleEn: She has a numerical mind and can solve complex calculations almost instantly.
meanings.exampleZh: 她擅长计数，几乎能瞬间解决复杂的计算。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 numerus（数）
etymology.tip: numer（数）+ ical（形容词后缀）= 与数有关的，即“数字的”

related.zh: 会计算的；有计算能力的

meanings.exampleEn: The new test serves as a norm for measuring students' academic progress.
meanings.exampleZh: 新测试作为衡量学生学业进步的基准。

meanings.exampleEn: She set the norm for professional conduct in the company.
meanings.exampleZh: 她为公司职业行为树立了模范。

meanings.exampleEn: The government established a national norm for air quality.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府制定了国家空气质量标准。

meanings.exampleEn: In many cultures, reciprocity is a fundamental social norm.
meanings.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，互惠是一项基本的社会准则。

variants.zh: 基准；模范；标准；准则（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 norma（木匠的直角尺，引申为规则、标准）
etymology.tip: norm 本身就是词根，意为“标准”，记住“norm=标准”即可。

meanings.exampleEn: The migratory birds flew northward to escape the approaching winter.
meanings.exampleZh: 候鸟向北飞去，以躲避即将来临的冬天。

meanings.exampleEn: The northward route was blocked by a sudden snowstorm.
meanings.exampleZh: 向北的路线被突如其来的暴风雪阻断了。

meanings.exampleEn: The explorers continued their journey toward the northward despite the harsh conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管条件艰苦，探险者们仍继续向北方行进。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 norþ，加上表示方向的后缀 -ward
etymology.tip: north（北方）+ ward（朝向）= 向北

obvious.zh: 明显的；明白的；显然的；平淡无奇的

meanings.zh: 明显的；明白的；显然的；平淡无奇的
meanings.exampleEn: It was obvious to everyone that the plan would fail without further funding.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有人都明白，没有更多资金，这个计划将会失败。

phrases.zh: 说显而易见的话；陈述明摆着的事实

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 ob viam（在路上），后演变为 obvious，意为“摆在路上的、迎面可见的”，引申为“明显的”。
etymology.suffix: -ous = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: ob（迎面）+ via（路）+ ous（的）→ 迎面就在路上的 → 一眼就能看到的 → 明显的

meanings.exampleEn: The observer noted a subtle change in the experiment's outcome.
meanings.exampleZh: 观察者注意到了实验结果的细微变化。

meanings.exampleEn: As a strict observer of the rules, she never violated the protocol.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为规则的严格遵守者，她从不违反规程。

meanings.exampleEn: The United Nations sent an observer to monitor the ceasefire.
meanings.exampleZh: 联合国派遣了一名观察员监督停火。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 observare，由 ob-（朝向）+ servare（保持，看守）构成
etymology.tip: ob（朝向）+ serv（看守）+ er（人）→ 朝着目标看守的人 → 观察者

meanings.exampleEn: Every citizen has an obligation to obey the law.
meanings.exampleZh: 每个公民都有遵守法律的义务。

meanings.exampleEn: She felt a moral obligation to help the homeless.
meanings.exampleZh: 她觉得帮助无家可归者是一种道德责任。

meanings.exampleEn: The contract places a legal obligation on both parties.
meanings.exampleZh: 合同对双方都施加了法律约束。

meanings.exampleEn: He signed an obligation to repay the loan within five years.
meanings.exampleZh: 他签署了一份五年内偿还贷款的契约。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obligatio，由 ob（朝向）+ ligare（捆绑）构成，原意为“被绑住、受约束”。
etymology.suffix: -ation = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: ob（朝向）+ lig（绑）+ ation（名词）→ 被绑在某事上 → 义务、责任。

meanings.exampleEn: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil through their root systems.
meanings.exampleZh: 植物通过根系从土壤中吸收养分。

meanings.exampleEn: A nutrient-rich diet is essential for maintaining a healthy immune system.
meanings.exampleZh: 富含营养的饮食对于维持健康的免疫系统至关重要。

variants.zh: 在营养上；从营养角度看

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nutrire（滋养，喂养）
etymology.suffix: -ent = 形容词后缀，表示“...的”；也可作名词后缀，表示“...剂/物”
etymology.tip: nutri（滋养）+ ent（...的）→ 滋养的；作名词即“滋养物→营养素”。

nightmare.zh: 梦魇；恶梦；可怕的事物(或情景、人物)

meanings.exampleEn: He woke up screaming, drenched in sweat after a vivid nightmare.
meanings.exampleZh: 他从一场逼真的梦魇中尖叫着醒来，浑身是汗。

meanings.exampleEn: The child was afraid to sleep because of the recurring nightmares.
meanings.exampleZh: 因为反复做恶梦，这个孩子害怕睡觉。

meanings.zh: 可怕的事物(或情景、人物)
meanings.exampleEn: The war-torn city became a logistical nightmare for aid workers.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座饱受战争摧残的城市成了救援人员后勤上的噩梦。

phrases.zh: 最糟糕的情况；噩梦般的局面
令人恐惧的事物；心理阴影

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 niht（夜）+ mare（梦魇，传说中压在睡眠者身上的恶魔）
etymology.tip: 夜晚（night）的梦魇（mare）让你做噩梦

meanings.exampleEn: The experiment failed; nevertheless, the data collected provided valuable insights.
meanings.exampleZh: 实验失败了；然而，收集到的数据提供了宝贵的见解。

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 never the less，意为“并不因此更少”，后连写为 nevertheless
etymology.tip: never + the + less = 从不因此更少 → 然而，尽管如此

obstinate.zh: 倔强的；顽固的；不让步的

meanings.zh: 倔强的；顽固的；不让步的
meanings.exampleEn: Despite all the evidence, he remained obstinate in his refusal to admit the mistake.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管证据确凿，他仍然顽固地拒绝承认错误。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obstinatus，是 obstinare 的过去分词，意为“坚持、固执”，由 ob- 和 stare 构成。
etymology.tip: ob（对着）+ stin（站立）+ ate（的）→ 对着干站着不动 → 倔强的、顽固的

meanings.exampleEn: It is difficult to obtain accurate data on the long-term effects of this drug.
meanings.exampleZh: 很难获得关于这种药物长期影响的准确数据。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obtinere，由 ob-（加强）+ tenere（持有）构成
etymology.tip: ob（加强）+ tain（拿住）→ 努力拿住 → 获得

meanings.exampleEn: They exchanged oaths of loyalty that bound them for life.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们交换了终生约束彼此的忠诚誓约。

meanings.exampleEn: He took an oath to uphold the constitution before assuming office.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在就职前宣誓维护宪法。

meanings.exampleEn: The driver muttered an oath when the traffic light turned red again.
meanings.exampleZh: 红灯再次亮起时，司机低声咒骂了一句。

variants.zh: 誓约；誓言；咒骂（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；源自古英语 āþ，与德语 Eid 同源。
etymology.tip: 基础词汇，直接记忆即可。

neutral.zh: 中立者；中立国；非彩色；空档

meanings.exampleEn: The journalist must remain neutral when reporting on political conflicts.
meanings.exampleZh: 记者在报道政治冲突时必须保持中立。

meanings.exampleEn: A neutral solution has a pH of 7, neither acidic nor alkaline.
meanings.exampleZh: 中性溶液的pH值为7，既非酸性也非碱性。

meanings.exampleEn: The living room was decorated in neutral tones to create a calm atmosphere.
meanings.exampleZh: 客厅用非彩色色调装饰，以营造宁静的氛围。

meanings.exampleEn: Make sure the gear lever is in the neutral position before starting the engine.
meanings.exampleZh: 启动发动机前，确保变速杆处于空挡位置。

meanings.exampleEn: In the debate, the moderator acted as a neutral, ensuring both sides had equal time.
meanings.exampleZh: 在辩论中，主持人作为中立者，确保双方有平等的时间。

meanings.exampleEn: Switzerland has long been recognized as a neutral in international conflicts.
meanings.exampleZh: 瑞士长期以来在国际冲突中被公认为中立国。

meanings.exampleEn: In color theory, black, white, and gray are considered neutrals.
meanings.exampleZh: 在色彩理论中，黑、白、灰被视为非彩色。

meanings.exampleEn: He shifted the car into neutral and waited at the traffic light.
meanings.exampleZh: 他把汽车挂到空挡，在红绿灯前等待。

etymology.root: utr = 两者之一（来自拉丁语uter）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语neutralis，由neuter（两者都不）派生，neuter由ne-（不）+ uter（两者之一）构成
etymology.tip: ne-（不）+ utr（两者之一）+ -al → 不偏向两者中的任何一个，即中立

meanings.exampleEn: His obsession with cleanliness makes it difficult for him to enjoy casual gatherings.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对清洁的困扰使他难以享受随意的聚会。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obsessio，由 ob- + sedere（坐）构成，原义为“坐在对面、围困”，引申为“占据心头、困扰”。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: ob（反）+ sess（坐）+ ion → 坐在心里不走 → 困扰

meanings.exampleEn: The nursery is equipped with modern educational toys to stimulate infants' cognitive development.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家托儿所配备了现代教育玩具，以促进婴儿的认知发展。

meanings.exampleEn: The farmer ordered a batch of saplings from the local nursery to expand his orchard.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位农民从当地苗圃订购了一批树苗，以扩大他的果园。

meanings.exampleEn: The corrupt regime was a nursery of crime and social injustice.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个腐败的政权是犯罪和社会不公的温床。

variants.zh: 托儿所；苗圃；温床（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 norricerie，源自拉丁语 nutrix（乳母），与 nurse 同源
etymology.tip: nurse（护理）+ -ery（场所）→ 护理孩子或植物的地方

meanings.exampleEn: Nylon is widely used in the manufacture of durable and lightweight fabrics.
meanings.exampleZh: 尼龙广泛用于制造耐用且轻便的织物。

etymology.origin: 20世纪30年代杜邦公司创造的商品名，无传统词根词缀。
etymology.tip: 无词根词缀，可联想“尼龙”为音译词直接记忆。

meanings.exampleEn: The system sends an automatic notification to users when their account is accessed from an unfamiliar device.
meanings.exampleZh: 当用户的账户从陌生设备登录时，系统会自动发送通知。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 notificare（使知道），由 notus（已知的）+ facere（做）构成
etymology.tip: not（知道）+ ification（使成为）→ 使知道 → 通知

meanings.exampleEn: Occasionally, she would pause and glance at the distant mountains, lost in thought.
meanings.exampleZh: 她偶尔会停下来，眺望远山，陷入沉思。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 occasio（机会，时机），由 ob-（朝向）+ cadere（落下）演变而来，经法语进入英语，再加 -al 和 -ly 构成副词。
etymology.prefix: oc-（ob- 的变体）= 朝向，面对
etymology.tip: oc（朝向）+ cas（落下）+ ionally → 事情“落到”你面前的情况不常有，所以是“偶尔”。

meanings.exampleEn: The law obliges parents to send their children to school.
meanings.exampleZh: 法律迫使父母送子女上学。

meanings.exampleEn: Could you oblige me by closing the window?
meanings.exampleZh: 你能帮我把窗户关上吗？

meanings.exampleEn: I am much obliged to you for your timely help.
meanings.exampleZh: 我非常感激你的及时帮助。

phrases.zh: 被迫做某事；有义务做某事
为某人提供某物；帮某人的忙

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obligare，由 ob-（朝向，加强）+ ligare（绑）构成，原意为“绑住、束缚”，引申为“迫使、施惠”。
etymology.tip: ob（加强）+ lig（绑）→ 把人“绑”住 → 迫使；帮人“绑”好 → 施惠。

meanings.exampleEn: The missing documents were nowhere to be found, despite an exhaustive search of the entire office.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管对整个办公室进行了彻底搜查，那些丢失的文件仍无处可寻。

meanings.exampleEn: The company rose from nowhere to become a global leader in technology.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家公司从无名之地崛起，成为全球科技领导者。

phrases.zh: 在偏远地方；前不着村后不着店

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 nāhwǣr，由 nā（no）+ hwǣr（where）组成
etymology.tip: no（没有）+ where（哪里）→ 没有哪里 → 无处

meanings.exampleEn: Obviously, the data from the experiment were manipulated to support the hypothesis.
meanings.exampleZh: 显而易见，实验数据被篡改以支持该假设。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 ob viam，意为“在路上、挡在路上”，后引申为“显而易见的”；obviously 由 obvious + -ly 构成。
etymology.tip: ob（迎面）+ vi（路）+ ous + ly → 东西就摆在路上，迎面可见 → 显而易见地。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel explores the complexities of human relationships in a rapidly changing society.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说探讨了快速变化社会中人际关系的复杂性。

meanings.exampleEn: The scientist proposed a novel approach to solving the energy crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位科学家提出了一种解决能源危机的新颖方法。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 novus（新的），经古法语/意大利语 novella（小故事）进入英语
etymology.tip: nov（新）+ el（小）→ 新出现的小东西，引申为“新颖的；小说”

meanings.exampleEn: The novelty of the new job soon wore off, leaving only routine tasks.
meanings.exampleZh: 新工作的新奇感很快消退，只剩下日常事务。

meanings.exampleEn: In the 19th century, the telephone was regarded as a fascinating novelty.
meanings.exampleZh: 在19世纪，电话被视为一种迷人的新奇事物。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 novus（新的），经古法语 novelté 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ty = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: nov（新）+ -ty（名词后缀）→ 新奇、新鲜的事物

meanings.exampleEn: The scientist's careful observation of the chemical reaction revealed an unexpected byproduct.
meanings.exampleZh: 科学家对化学反应的仔细观察揭示了一种意想不到的副产物。

meanings.exampleEn: Weather stations around the world make continuous observation of atmospheric pressure and temperature.
meanings.exampleZh: 世界各地的气象站对气压和气温进行持续观测。

meanings.exampleEn: A good detective relies on sharp observation to notice details that others overlook.
meanings.exampleZh: 优秀的侦探依靠敏锐的观察力来注意到他人忽略的细节。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 observare（观察，注视），由 ob-（朝向）和 servare（看，守护）组合而成。
etymology.tip: ob（加强）+ serv（看）+ ation（名词）→ 认真看 → 观察

meanings.exampleEn: My nephew, a brilliant young scientist, has just been awarded a prestigious research grant.
meanings.exampleZh: 我的侄子是一位杰出的年轻科学家，刚刚获得了一项著名的研究资助。

phrases.zh: 侄子和侄女；外甥和外甥女

etymology.root: nepot- = 孙子/侄子（拉丁语 nepos）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nepos，经古法语 neveu 进入英语
etymology.tip: nephew 与 nepotism（裙带关系）同源，记住“对侄子外甥的偏爱”即可。

related.zh: 裙带关系者；重用亲属的人

nuclear.zh: 核子的；原子能的；核的；中心的

meanings.exampleEn: The nuclear structure of the atom was first proposed in the early twentieth century.
meanings.exampleZh: 原子的核结构在二十世纪初首次被提出。

meanings.exampleEn: Nuclear power plants generate electricity without emitting greenhouse gases.
meanings.exampleZh: 核电站发电时不会排放温室气体。

meanings.exampleEn: The treaty prohibits all nuclear testing in the region.
meanings.exampleZh: 该条约禁止在该地区进行一切核试验。

meanings.exampleEn: The nuclear family typically consists of parents and their children.
meanings.exampleZh: 核心家庭通常由父母和子女组成。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nucleus（果核，核心），是 nux（坚果）的指小词
etymology.tip: nucle（核）+ -ar（的）= 核的；核心的

meanings.exampleEn: The temperature dropped to nought overnight, causing the pipes to freeze.
meanings.exampleZh: 夜间气温降至零度，导致水管冻结。

meanings.exampleEn: All his efforts came to nought in the face of relentless opposition.
meanings.exampleZh: 面对无情的反对，他的一切努力都化为乌有。

phrases.zh: 化为泡影；失败；毫无结果
井字游戏（画圈打叉游戏）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 nōwiht，由 nā（无）+ wiht（事物）合成，原义为“没有任何事物”；与 naught 同源，not 亦由此缩略而来。
etymology.tip: nā（无）+ wiht（事物）→ 没有事物 → 零/无

meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers were trained to show absolute obedience to their commanding officers.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵们被训练要对指挥官绝对服从。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 oboedire，由 ob-（朝向）+ audire（听）构成，本义为“倾听”，引申为“服从”。
etymology.suffix: -ience = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: ob（朝向）+ edi（听）+ ence（名词）→ 朝着（上级）倾听 → 服从

meanings.exampleEn: The lack of funding remains a major obstacle to the completion of the research project.
meanings.exampleZh: 资金短缺仍然是完成该研究项目的主要障碍。

phrases.zh: 障碍赛跑道；障碍训练场

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obstaculum，由 ob（对着）+ stare（站立）+ -culum（工具/手段）构成，意为“挡在路上的东西”。
etymology.tip: ob（对着）+ st（站）+ acle（物）→ 站在对面挡路的东西 → 障碍

meanings.exampleEn: The nun devoted her entire life to caring for the sick in the remote mountain village.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位修女毕生致力于在偏远的山村照料病人。

meanings.exampleEn: The Buddhist nun meditated in silence for hours every day before the morning service.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位尼姑每天清晨法事之前都会静默禅修数小时。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nonna（修女、保姆），经古英语 nunne 进入英语。
etymology.tip: nun 与拉丁语 nonna 同源，记住 nonna 是“奶奶/修女”，nun 就是修女。

meanings.exampleEn: The nuclear explosion produced a towering mushroom cloud that could be seen for miles.
meanings.exampleZh: 核爆炸产生了高耸的蘑菇云，数英里外都能看到。

meanings.exampleEn: Foraging for wild mushrooms requires expert knowledge to distinguish edible species from poisonous ones.
meanings.exampleZh: 采摘野生蘑菇需要专业知识，以区分可食用品种和有毒品种。

meanings.exampleEn: The mining tycoon was dismissed by old aristocrats as a mere mushroom, despite his immense wealth.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位矿业大亨尽管拥有巨额财富，却被老贵族视为纯粹的暴发户。

variants.zh: 迅速增长；采蘑菇（过去式/过去分词）
迅速增长；采蘑菇（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 mousseron，可能源于 mousse（苔藓），因蘑菇常生于苔藓间。
etymology.tip: mushroom 与 mousse（苔藓）同源，想象蘑菇从苔藓中冒出。

obscene.zh: 淫秽的；猥亵的；讨人厌的；可憎的

meanings.exampleEn: The court ruled that the film contained obscene scenes and banned its public screening.
meanings.exampleZh: 法院裁定该影片含有淫秽镜头，禁止其公开放映。

meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for making obscene gestures to the passers-by.
meanings.exampleZh: 他因向路人做猥亵手势而被逮捕。

meanings.exampleEn: The amount of money spent on the election campaign is absolutely obscene.
meanings.exampleZh: 这次竞选活动花费的钱多得简直令人讨厌。

meanings.exampleEn: It is obscene that people are starving while food is wasted every day.
meanings.exampleZh: 人们挨饿而食物每天被浪费，这是可憎的。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obscenus（不吉利的，令人厌恶的），可能由 ob-（朝向）+ caenum（污物）演变而来。
etymology.tip: ob-朝向 + scen-污秽，朝向污秽的东西就是淫秽的。

meanings.exampleEn: His objection to the proposal was based on environmental concerns.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对该提议的异议是基于环境方面的担忧。

meanings.exampleEn: Despite their strong objection, the committee approved the plan.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管他们强烈反对，委员会还是批准了该计划。

meanings.exampleEn: She has a personal objection to eating meat.
meanings.exampleZh: 她个人不喜欢吃肉。

meanings.exampleEn: The main objection to the product is its high price.
meanings.exampleZh: 该产品的主要缺点是价格太高。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obiectio(n-)，由 ob- 'towards/against' + iacere 'to throw' 构成
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为或状态
etymology.tip: ob（反对）+ ject（投掷）+ ion，把反对意见“扔”向对方

meanings.exampleEn: The couple's offspring have all inherited their artistic talent.
meanings.exampleZh: 这对夫妇的后代都继承了他们的艺术天赋。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 off + spring，意为“从……跳出来/产生出来的”，引申为后代
etymology.tip: off（离开）+ spring（跳出）→ 从你身上“跳出来”的，就是你的后代。

mould.zh: 模子；模制品；松软沃土；霉

meanings.exampleEn: The metal parts are cast in a mould.
meanings.exampleZh: 金属零件在模子里浇铸。

meanings.exampleEn: The ceiling was decorated with plaster moulds.
meanings.exampleZh: 天花板上装饰着石膏模制品。

meanings.exampleEn: The seeds need rich mould to grow.
meanings.exampleZh: 种子需要肥沃的松软土壤才能生长。

meanings.exampleEn: The damp climate caused mould to form on the walls.
meanings.exampleZh: 潮湿的气候导致墙壁上长了霉。

meanings.zh: 塑造；使成形；对…产生影响
meanings.exampleEn: Parents help mould their children's character.
meanings.exampleZh: 父母帮助塑造孩子的性格。

variants.zh: 模子；模制品；松软沃土；霉（复数）

phrases.zh: 用模子浇铸；一个模子刻出的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 modulus（小尺度、模型），经古法语 moule 进入英语；与 mode、model 同源。
etymology.tip: mould 与 model 同源，都是“模子”，用模子塑造模型。

meanings.exampleEn: The prolonged negotiation between the two countries finally resulted in a mutually beneficial trade agreement.
meanings.exampleZh: 两国之间漫长的谈判最终达成了互利的贸易协定。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 negotium（事务、生意），由 nec（不）+ otium（闲暇）构成，本义为“没有闲暇”，引申为“谈判、磋商”。
etymology.prefix: neg- = 不，没有（来自 nec- 的同化形式）
etymology.tip: neg（不）+ oti（闲暇）+ ation（名词）→ 没有闲暇去闲谈，而是坐下来谈判。

meanings.exampleEn: The accident occurred at the intersection of two busy streets during rush hour.
meanings.exampleZh: 事故发生在两条繁忙街道的交叉路口，正值交通高峰期。

meanings.exampleEn: It suddenly occurred to her that she had left the key in the office.
meanings.exampleZh: 她突然想到自己把钥匙落在了办公室。

meanings.exampleEn: Such a phenomenon rarely occurs in nature without human intervention.
meanings.exampleZh: 没有人类干预的情况下，这种现象在自然界中很少存在。

variants.zh: 发生；被想到；存在（第三人称单数）
发生；被想到；存在（过去式/过去分词）
发生；被想到；存在（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 某人想到；浮现在某人脑海中

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 occurrere，由 ob-（朝向，相对）+ currere（跑）构成，原意为“跑向、迎面而来”，后引申为“发生、出现”。
etymology.prefix: oc-（ob- 在 c 前的同化形式，意为“朝向、相对”）
etymology.tip: oc（朝向）+ cur（跑）→ 事情“跑”到眼前或脑中 → 发生；被想到

meanings.exampleEn: His occasional visits to the library were always a surprise to his colleagues.
meanings.exampleZh: 他偶尔来图书馆总是让同事感到意外。

meanings.exampleEn: The company hired an occasional assistant to handle the extra workload during peak season.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司雇了一名临时助理来处理旺季的额外工作量。

phrases.zh: 偶尔开车的人；非职业司机

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 occasio（机会，时机），由 ob-（朝向）+ cadere（落下）构成
etymology.prefix: oc-（ob- 的变体）= 朝向，临近
etymology.tip: 偶然（occasional）之事就是落到你头上的机会（occasio）

meanings.exampleEn: The onward march of technology shows no signs of slowing down.
meanings.exampleZh: 技术的向前发展丝毫没有减缓的迹象。

meanings.exampleEn: The explorers pushed onward through the dense jungle despite the harsh weather.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管天气恶劣，探险者们仍穿过茂密的丛林向前推进。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 onweard，由 on（在……上/向前）与 -ward（朝向）组合而成
etymology.tip: on（向前）+ ward（方向）→ 一直向前，记住“onward = 向前进”。

meanings.exampleEn: Oceania is a geographic region comprising Australasia, Melanesia, Micronesia and Polynesia.
meanings.exampleZh: 大洋洲是一个包括澳大拉西亚、美拉尼西亚、密克罗尼西亚和波利尼西亚的地理区域。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Oceanus，源自希腊语 Okeanos（大洋之神/大洋），加上地名后缀 -ia 表示地区
etymology.tip: ocean（海洋）+ ia（地区）= 被大洋环绕的地区，即大洋洲

meanings.exampleEn: The mosquito net protected the sleeping child from insects.
meanings.exampleZh: 蚊帐保护了熟睡的孩子免受昆虫叮咬。

meanings.exampleEn: The police spread a net over the city to capture the fugitive.
meanings.exampleZh: 警方在全城布下罗网以抓捕逃犯。

meanings.exampleEn: The company reported a net of $2 million for the fiscal year.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司报告本财年净利为200万美元。

meanings.exampleEn: They netted a large haul of fish in the deep sea.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们在深海用网捕到了大量鱼。

meanings.exampleEn: The sale netted the firm a substantial profit.
meanings.exampleZh: 这笔销售使公司净赚了可观的利润。

meanings.exampleEn: The net weight of the product is 500 grams.
meanings.exampleZh: 该产品的净重为500克。

variants.zh: 用网捕；净赚（第三人称单数）
用网捕；净赚（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: Nickel is a hard, silvery-white metal that is widely used in alloys and batteries.
meanings.exampleZh: 镍是一种坚硬的银白色金属，广泛用于合金和电池。

meanings.exampleEn: He inserted a nickel into the vending machine to buy a soda.
meanings.exampleZh: 他往自动售货机里投了一枚镍币买汽水。

meanings.exampleEn: The price of a cup of coffee was only a nickel in the 1950s.
meanings.exampleZh: 在20世纪50年代，一杯咖啡只要五分镍币。

phrases.zh: 小钱；零钱；微不足道的金额

etymology.origin: 来自德语 Kupfernickel（假铜），由 Kupfer（铜）+ Nickel（小妖精/淘气鬼）构成；矿工发现这种矿石看似含铜却提炼不出铜，便以传说中的淘气鬼命名。
etymology.tip: nickel 可拆成 nick + el，联想：Nick（尼克）捡到一枚镍币，高兴得像个淘气鬼。

meanings.exampleEn: The prevalence of obese children has increased dramatically over the past few decades.
meanings.exampleZh: 过去几十年里，肥胖儿童的患病率急剧上升。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obesus，是 obedere（吞食，吃光）的过去分词，由 ob-（过度）+ edere（吃）构成
etymology.tip: ob（过度）+ es（吃）→ 吃得过度，导致肥胖

noticeable.zh: 显而易见的；显著的；值得注意的

meanings.zh: 显而易见的；显著的；值得注意的
meanings.exampleEn: The improvement in his performance was noticeable after months of practice.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过几个月的练习，他的表现有了明显的提高。

etymology.origin: 由 notice（注意）+ -able（可...的）构成；notice 来自拉丁语 notitia（知晓）
etymology.tip: notice（注意）+ able（可...的）→ 可被注意到的，即显而易见的。

meanings.exampleEn: The squirrel stored a large quantity of nuts in the hollow tree before the winter arrived.
meanings.exampleZh: 松鼠在冬天来临之前在树洞里储存了大量坚果。

meanings.exampleEn: The nut of the problem lies in the discrepancy between policy and practice.
meanings.exampleZh: 问题的核心在于政策与实践之间的差异。

meanings.exampleEn: He tightened the nut with a wrench to secure the loose wheel.
meanings.exampleZh: 他用扳手拧紧螺帽以固定松动的轮子。

phrases.zh: 难对付的人（或事）；棘手的问题
基本组成部分；具体细节

etymology.origin: 古英语 hnutu；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀
etymology.tip: 联想：坚果外壳坚硬，引申为“核心”和“螺帽”。

meanings.exampleEn: The occurrence of such errors is rare in this system.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种错误在该系统中很少发生。

meanings.exampleEn: The meeting was an unexpected occurrence that changed everyone's plans.
meanings.exampleZh: 这次会议是一件意外事件，改变了所有人的计划。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 occurrere（跑向、迎面而来），由 ob-（朝向）+ currere（跑）构成
etymology.prefix: oc-（ob- 的变体，表示朝向、相对）
etymology.tip: oc（朝向）+ cur（跑）+ rence → 跑过来到你面前 → 发生、出现

meanings.exampleEn: The electrical resistance of this component is measured in ohms.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个元件的电阻以欧姆为单位测量。

etymology.origin: 以德国物理学家乔治·西蒙·欧姆（Georg Simon Ohm）命名
etymology.tip: 欧姆是电阻单位，记住Ohm=Ω，联想到欧姆定律。

meanings.exampleEn: She was lost in a muse about the meaning of life.
meanings.exampleZh: 她陷入对生命意义的沉思之中。

meanings.exampleEn: He mused on the possibility of changing his career.
meanings.exampleZh: 他沉思着改变职业的可能性。

variants.zh: 沉思；冥想（过去式/过去分词）
沉思；冥想（第三人称单数）

etymology.root: muse = 思考；缪斯（源自希腊语 Mousa，印欧词根 *men- 思考）
etymology.origin: 来自希腊神话中的缪斯女神 Mousa，引申为“沉思”；与 mind 等同源于印欧词根 *men-
etymology.tip: 缪斯女神(Muse)在沉思(muse)中赐予灵感，记住“muse=思考”

meanings.exampleEn: The operation of this advanced machinery requires specialized training.
meanings.exampleZh: 操作这台先进机器需要专业培训。

meanings.exampleEn: The surgeon's precise operation of the scalpel impressed the entire medical team.
meanings.exampleZh: 外科医生使用手术刀的精准动作给整个医疗团队留下了深刻印象。

meanings.exampleEn: The patient underwent a risky heart operation and recovered remarkably well.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位病人接受了一次高风险的心脏手术，并且恢复得非常好。

meanings.exampleEn: In computer science, a binary operation combines two elements to produce a third.
meanings.exampleZh: 在计算机科学中，二元运算将两个元素结合以产生第三个元素。

variants.zh: 有效的；运转着的；手术的
操作的；运营的；可使用的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 operari（工作），由 opus（作品、工作）派生而来
etymology.suffix: -ation = 表示行为、过程或结果的名词后缀
etymology.tip: oper（工作）+ ation（行为）→ 工作的过程 → 操作、手术、运算

meanings.exampleEn: The government has implemented strict laws to combat the illegal trade of opium.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已实施严格的法律来打击非法的鸦片贸易。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 opion，源自 opos（植物汁液），经拉丁语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ium = 名词后缀，表示物质或元素
etymology.tip: opium 的汁液来自罂粟，联想“鸦片”即罂粟汁制成。

meanings.exampleEn: The glass in the bathroom window is opaque to ensure privacy.
meanings.exampleZh: 浴室窗户的玻璃是不透明的，以保护隐私。

meanings.exampleEn: His writing style is so opaque that even scholars struggle to interpret it.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的写作风格十分晦涩，连学者都难以解读。

meanings.exampleEn: In photography, an opaque is used to block light from reaching certain areas of the film.
meanings.exampleZh: 在摄影中，不透明体用于阻挡光线到达胶片的特定区域。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 opacus，意为“阴暗的、遮蔽的”
etymology.tip: opaque 中的 opac- 像“遮蔽”，被遮住就“不透明”

occupy.zh: 占领；占(时间、空间等)；住进；担任

meanings.exampleEn: The rebel forces occupied the capital city within a week.
meanings.exampleZh: 叛军在不到一周内占领了首都。

meanings.exampleEn: The new project occupies most of my time and energy.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个新项目占据了我大部分时间和精力。

meanings.exampleEn: They occupied the apartment on the fifth floor last month.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们上个月住进了五楼的公寓。

meanings.exampleEn: She occupies the position of chief financial officer.
meanings.exampleZh: 她担任首席财务官一职。

variants.zh: 占领；占据（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 occupare，由 ob-（朝向）+ capere（拿取）构成，字面意为‘抓住、占有’；经古法语 occuper 进入英语。
etymology.tip: oc(朝向)+cup(拿)+y → 朝自己拿过来 → 占领、占据

meanings.exampleEn: The odour of freshly baked bread filled the kitchen.
meanings.exampleZh: 新鲜烤面包的气味充满了厨房。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 odor（气味），经古法语 odour 进入英语。
etymology.tip: odour 就是“气味”，联想“哦，都儿”一闻就有味儿。

meanings.exampleEn: She is a teacher by occupation, but her real passion is painting.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的职业是教师，但她真正的爱好是绘画。

meanings.exampleEn: The occupation of the disputed territory by foreign troops caused international concern.
meanings.exampleZh: 外国军队对该争议领土的占有引起了国际社会的关注。

meanings.exampleEn: During his occupation of the office, he implemented several important reforms.
meanings.exampleZh: 在他任职期间，他实施了几项重要的改革。

meanings.exampleEn: The military occupation lasted for more than a decade before the troops withdrew.
meanings.exampleZh: 军事占领持续了十多年，之后军队才撤出。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 occupatio，由 ob- + capere 构成
etymology.tip: ob（加强）+ cap（抓）+ ation → 紧紧抓住不放 → 占有；引申为职业

meanings.exampleEn: The new system will become fully operational by next month.
meanings.exampleZh: 新系统将在下个月全面投入运作。

operator.zh: 操作员；行家；经纪人；算子

optimistic.zh: 乐观的；乐观主义的；乐天的

meanings.exampleEn: The tyrannical regime oppressed its citizens for decades, denying them basic human rights.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个暴虐政权压迫其公民数十年，剥夺他们的基本人权。

meanings.exampleZh: 小号手将弱音器插入号口，以产生更柔和、更遥远的声音。

meanings.exampleEn: The company has established a global network of suppliers to ensure efficient distribution.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司已建立起全球供应商网络，以确保高效分销。

meanings.exampleEn: The news was broadcast simultaneously across the national television network.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条新闻通过全国电视广播网同时播出。

meanings.exampleEn: A network of tiny cracks appeared on the surface of the ancient vase.
meanings.exampleZh: 古代花瓶表面出现了细小的网状裂纹。

meanings.exampleEn: To succeed in business, you need to network with influential people in your industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 要在商界取得成功，你需要与业内具有影响力的人士建立人际关系网。

meanings.exampleEn: All the computers in the laboratory are networked to a central server.
meanings.exampleZh: 实验室里的所有计算机都联网到一台中央服务器。

variants.zh: 将…联网（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 由古英语 net（网）和 weorc（工作、结构）组合而成，原指网状结构或系统
etymology.tip: net（网）+ work（工作/结构）= 像网一样工作的系统，即网络

meanings.exampleEn: Despite fierce opposition, the candidate managed to defeat his opponent in the final debate.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管遭到强烈反对，这位候选人还是在最后一场辩论中击败了他的对手。

meanings.exampleEn: The opponent forces were well entrenched along the riverbank, making any advance extremely difficult.
meanings.exampleZh: 敌对部队在河岸沿线构筑了坚固的工事，使得任何推进都极为困难。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 opponere（op- 相对 + ponere 放置），经由法语进入英语
etymology.tip: op（相反）+ pon（放置）+ ent（人）→ 站在对立面的人 → 对手

meanings.exampleEn: The orchard yielded a bountiful harvest of apples this autumn.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个果园今年秋天出产了丰硕的苹果。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 ortgeard，由 ort（植物，wort 的变体）+ geard（园子）组成
etymology.tip: ort（植物）+ gard（园子）= 种植果树（植物）的园子，即果园

meanings.exampleEn: The nurture of a child requires patience and love.
meanings.exampleZh: 养育孩子需要耐心和爱。

meanings.exampleEn: The soil provides essential nurture for the young plants.
meanings.exampleZh: 土壤为幼苗提供必需的营养物。

meanings.exampleEn: She nurtured her ambition until it became a successful career.
meanings.exampleZh: 她培育自己的抱负，直到它成为一份成功的事业。

variants.zh: 养育；培育（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 先天与后天；遗传与环境

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nutrire（喂养，养育），经古法语 norriture 进入英语
etymology.tip: nutr- 喂养，-ure 行为，喂养的行为就是养育

meanings.exampleEn: The outbreak of the epidemic prompted the government to implement strict quarantine measures.
meanings.exampleZh: 疫情的爆发促使政府实施了严格的隔离措施。

phrases.zh: 控制疫情（或事态）的爆发

etymology.origin: 由短语 break out（爆发）逆构而来，out 表示“向外”，break 表示“破裂”，合意为“向外破裂”，引申为“爆发”。
etymology.tip: out（向外）+ break（破裂）→ 向外破裂 → 爆发

meanings.exampleEn: In the interest of brevity, the speaker omitted several minor details from his presentation.
meanings.exampleZh: 为了简洁起见，演讲者省略了演讲中的几个次要细节。

meanings.exampleEn: The editor decided to omit the controversial paragraph from the article to avoid public backlash.
meanings.exampleZh: 编辑决定从文章中删除那段有争议的内容，以避免公众强烈反对。

meanings.exampleEn: He omitted to mention that he had already received the payment.
meanings.exampleZh: 他疏忽了提及他已经收到付款。

meanings.exampleEn: She inadvertently omitted her signature from the contract, rendering it invalid.
meanings.exampleZh: 她无意中在合同上遗漏了签名，导致合同无效。

variants.zh: 省略；删除；疏忽；遗漏（过去式/过去分词）
省略；删除；疏忽；遗漏（现在分词）
省略；删除；疏忽；遗漏（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语omittere，由ob-（离开）+ mittere（送）构成，意为“送走、放开”，引申为“省略、遗漏”。
etymology.prefix: ob-（在m前同化为om-），意为“离开、去除”
etymology.tip: om（离开）+ mit（送）= 把……送走，即省略、遗漏。

meanings.exampleEn: The conference provides an excellent opportunity for professionals to exchange ideas and establish international cooperation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这次会议为专业人士提供了交流思想、建立国际合作的绝佳机会。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 opportunitas，由 ob-（朝向）+ portus（港口）构成，原指顺风朝向港口，引申为有利的时机
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: 机会就像船驶向港口（ob+port），顺风进港正是好时机。

meanings.exampleEn: She is noted for her innovative approach to environmental conservation.
meanings.exampleZh: 她以创新的环境保护方法而闻名。

meanings.zh: 注意；记录（note的过去式和过去分词）
meanings.exampleEn: The researcher noted the subtle changes in the experiment results.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究者注意到了实验结果的细微变化。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 notare（标记）的过去分词 notatus，后进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ed = 形容词后缀，表示“有……特征的”
etymology.tip: not（标记）+ ed（被……的）→ 被标记出来的 → 著名的

meanings.exampleEn: The outdoor concert was canceled due to the sudden thunderstorm.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于突如其来的雷雨，那场户外音乐会被取消了。

etymology.origin: 由 out（外）+ door（门）构成的复合词，原意“门外”，引申为“户外的”。
etymology.tip: out（外）+ door（门）= 门外的，即户外的。

meanings.exampleEn: The optical nerve transmits visual information from the eye to the brain.
meanings.exampleZh: 视神经将视觉信息从眼睛传递到大脑。

meanings.exampleEn: The magician's trick relied on an optical illusion that deceived the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 魔术师的把戏依靠一种欺骗观众的视觉错觉。

meanings.exampleEn: Optical instruments such as telescopes and microscopes are essential in scientific research.
meanings.exampleZh: 望远镜和显微镜等光学仪器在科学研究中必不可少。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 optikos（视觉的），经由拉丁语 opticus 进入英语。
etymology.tip: opt（看）+ ical（的）→ 用眼睛看的 → 视觉的；光学的。

meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for a minor drug offence.
meanings.exampleZh: 他因轻微的毒品违法行为而被逮捕。

meanings.exampleEn: His careless remarks gave great offence to the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 他轻率的言论极大地冒犯了听众。

meanings.exampleEn: Speeding is a common traffic offence in urban areas.
meanings.exampleZh: 超速是城市地区常见的交通违规行为。

meanings.exampleEn: In her eyes, betraying a friend was a moral offence.
meanings.exampleZh: 在她看来，背叛朋友是一种道德上的罪过。

variants.zh: 冒犯的；令人不快的；攻击性的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 offendere（撞击、冒犯），由 ob-（对着）+ fendere（打击）构成，经古法语 offense 进入英语。
etymology.prefix: ob-（变为 of-）= 相对，反对
etymology.tip: ob（相反）+ fend（打）+ ce → 对着你打 → 冒犯、犯罪

meanings.exampleEn: The nucleus of the debate lies in the ethical implications of genetic engineering.
meanings.exampleZh: 辩论的核心在于基因工程的伦理影响。

meanings.exampleEn: The nucleus, though minuscule, accounts for nearly all of an atom's mass.
meanings.exampleZh: 原子核虽然微小，却几乎占据了原子全部的质量。

meanings.exampleEn: The cell nucleus houses the genetic material that directs cellular activities.
meanings.exampleZh: 细胞核容纳着指导细胞活动的遗传物质。

meanings.exampleEn: The small workshop served as the nucleus of what would become a multinational corporation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个小作坊成为了后来跨国公司的起点。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 nucleus（果仁，核心），是 nux（坚果）的指小词
etymology.suffix: -us 名词后缀（拉丁语阳性名词结尾）
etymology.tip: nucle-（核）+ -us（名词后缀）→ 核心；原子核就是原子的核心。

outermost.zh: 最外面的；最远离中心的

meanings.zh: 最外面的；最远离中心的
meanings.exampleEn: The outermost layer of the Earth is called the crust.
meanings.exampleZh: 地球最外面的层被称为地壳。

etymology.origin: 由古英语 ūt（外）的比较级 ūtera 再加最高级后缀 -most 构成，表示“最外面的”
etymology.tip: outer（更外面的）+ most（最）= 最外面的

outcry.zh: 尖叫；倒彩；强烈抗议；喊价

meanings.exampleEn: An outcry of terror echoed through the dark corridor.
meanings.exampleZh: 一声恐惧的尖叫在黑暗的走廊里回荡。

meanings.exampleEn: The referee's decision was met with a loud outcry from the fans.
meanings.exampleZh: 裁判的判罚引起了球迷们的大声倒彩。

meanings.exampleEn: The new tax policy provoked a public outcry across the nation.
meanings.exampleZh: 新税收政策在全国范围内引发了公众的强烈抗议。

meanings.exampleEn: The auctioneer heard an outcry of five hundred dollars from the back row.
meanings.exampleZh: 拍卖师听到后排有人喊价五百美元。

variants.zh: 尖叫；倒彩；强烈抗议；喊价（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 由 out（向外）与 cry（喊叫）复合而成，源自古英语
etymology.tip: out（向外）+ cry（喊叫）→ 把喊声发出来 → 尖叫、抗议

meanings.exampleEn: The orthodox interpretation of the doctrine has been challenged by modern theologians.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一教义的正统解释已受到现代神学家的挑战。

meanings.exampleEn: His orthodox approach to marketing seems outdated in the digital age.
meanings.exampleZh: 他传统的营销方式在数字时代显得过时。

meanings.exampleEn: She followed the orthodox procedure for filing the complaint.
meanings.exampleZh: 她按照惯常程序提交投诉。

etymology.root: ortho = 正确的，直的；dox = 意见，看法
etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 orthodoxos，由 orthos（正确）+ doxa（意见）构成
etymology.tip: ortho（正确）+ dox（观点）→ 观点正确的 → 正统的

meanings.exampleEn: The door opens outwards, so you need to pull it toward you to close it.
meanings.exampleZh: 这扇门是向外开的，所以关门时需要把它朝你这边拉。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 ūt + -weardes，表示“向外的方向”
etymology.tip: out（向外）+ wards（朝向）→ 朝着外面的方向 → 向外地

meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers are trained to be obedient to their commanding officers.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵们被训练成服从指挥官的人。

meanings.exampleEn: She gave an obedient nod and left the room without protest.
meanings.exampleZh: 她顺从地点了点头，毫无异议地离开了房间。

meanings.exampleEn: He is an obedient son who always takes care of his elderly parents.
meanings.exampleZh: 他是个孝顺的儿子，总是照顾年迈的父母。

phrases.zh: 恭顺的仆人；忠实的仆人

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 oboedire（服从），由 ob-（朝向）+ audire（听）构成，字面意为“倾听（命令）”。
etymology.suffix: -ient = 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
etymology.tip: ob（朝向）+ ed（听，来自 aud 的变体）+ ient（形容词后缀）→ 朝着命令的方向听 → 服从的

meanings.exampleEn: Before writing the essay, she made a detailed outline of the main arguments.
meanings.exampleZh: 写文章之前，她列出了主要论点的详细大纲。

meanings.exampleEn: The outline of the mountain was clearly visible against the morning sky.
meanings.exampleZh: 清晨的天空下，山的轮廓清晰可见。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor outlined the key points of the lecture in the first five minutes.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授在头五分钟内概述了讲座的要点。

meanings.exampleEn: The artist outlined the figure with a few bold strokes.
meanings.exampleZh: 艺术家用几笔粗线条勾勒出人物的轮廓。

variants.zh: 概述；描画轮廓（第三人称单数）
概述；描画轮廓（过去式/过去分词）
概述；描画轮廓（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 由 out（在外）+ line（线）组合而成，原指“外部的线条”，后引申为轮廓、概要。
etymology.tip: out（外面）+ line（线）→ 外面的线条就是轮廓，把轮廓写出来就是大纲。

meanings.exampleEn: The young officer was promoted to captain after demonstrating exceptional leadership in the mission.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名年轻军官在任务中表现出非凡的领导力，被晋升为上尉。

meanings.exampleEn: The chief operating officer decided to restructure the company's global supply chain.
meanings.exampleZh: 首席运营主管决定重组公司的全球供应链。

meanings.exampleEn: The government officer addressed the press about the new environmental regulations.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府官员就新的环保法规向媒体发表了讲话。

meanings.exampleEn: As a public officer, she is committed to serving the community with integrity and transparency.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名公务员，她致力于以诚信和透明的方式服务社区。

variants.zh: 军官；主管；官员；公务员（复数）

etymology.root: fic = 做（来自拉丁语 facere）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 officium（职务，服务），由 ob-（朝向）+ facere（做）构成，后加 -er 表人
etymology.prefix: ob-（朝向，在 f 前同化为 of-）
etymology.tip: ob（朝向）+ fic（做）+ er（人）→ 朝向职责做事的人 → 官员/军官

meanings.exampleEn: Citizens ought to comply with the laws of their country.
meanings.exampleZh: 公民应该遵守国家的法律。

meanings.exampleEn: The results ought to be available by next week.
meanings.exampleZh: 结果大概下周就能出来。

phrases.zh: 本应该做某事（而实际未做）

etymology.origin: 古英语 ahte，为 agan（拥有，欠）的过去式；后演变为情态动词，表示义务或推测。
etymology.tip: 无词根词缀，整体记忆：ought to 表示“应该”。

meanings.exampleEn: He draped his overcoat over the back of the chair before taking his seat at the conference table.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在会议桌旁落座前，把大衣搭在椅背上。

etymology.origin: 由古英语 ofer（在...之上/额外）与古法语 cote（外衣）组合而成，后形成 overcoat
etymology.tip: over（在...之上）+ coat（外套）→ 穿在外套之上的衣服 → 大衣

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient Roman amphitheater has an oval arena that could accommodate tens of thousands of spectators.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古罗马圆形剧场拥有一个可容纳数万名观众的椭圆形竞技场。

meanings.exampleEn: The artist drew a perfect oval and then transformed it into a portrait of a human face.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家画了一个完美的椭圆形，然后将其改造成一幅人像画。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 ovum（卵），经由法语 oval 进入英语；-al 为形容词后缀。
etymology.tip: ov（卵）+ -al（形容词后缀）→ 像卵一样的 → 椭圆形的。

organic.zh: 器官的；有机的；组织的；根本的

meanings.exampleEn: The organic diseases of the liver are often difficult to diagnose in their early stages.
meanings.exampleZh: 肝脏的器质性疾病在早期阶段往往难以诊断。

meanings.exampleEn: Organic chemistry focuses on the structure, properties, and reactions of carbon-containing compounds.
meanings.exampleZh: 有机化学研究含碳化合物的结构、性质和反应。

meanings.exampleEn: The company's organic structure allows for flexible decision-making across departments.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司的组织结构允许各部门灵活决策。

meanings.exampleEn: The organic law of the nation guarantees fundamental rights to all citizens.
meanings.exampleZh: 国家的根本法保障所有公民的基本权利。

variants.zh: 有机地；器官地；有组织地

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 organicus，源自希腊语 organikos，由 organon（工具、器官）派生
etymology.tip: organ（器官/工具）+ ic（形容词后缀）→ 与器官、工具相关的 → 有机的、组织的

outer.zh: 外部的；外面的；在外的；远离中心的

meanings.zh: 外部的；外面的；在外的；远离中心的
meanings.exampleEn: The outer layer of the planet is composed mainly of solid rock.
meanings.exampleZh: 这颗行星的外部主要由坚硬的岩石构成。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 ūtera，是 ūt（out）的比较级形式
etymology.tip: out（外面）+ -er（比较级）= 更靠外的，即外部的

meanings.exampleEn: Many college students prefer to study outdoors on a sunny day rather than in the library.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多大学生在晴天更喜欢在户外学习，而不是在图书馆里。

meanings.exampleEn: The expedition team spent a whole month exploring the great outdoors of the Arctic region.
meanings.exampleZh: 探险队花了整整一个月探索北极地区的广阔野外。

variants.zh: 爱好户外活动的；适合户外的

etymology.origin: 由 out（在外）和 door（门）加副词性后缀 -s 构成，原指“在门外”，后引申为“户外”。
etymology.suffix: -s = 副词后缀，表示方式或地点
etymology.tip: 走出门外（out + doors）就是户外。

outstanding.zh: 杰出的；突出的；未偿付的；未决定的

meanings.exampleEn: She is an outstanding scientist whose research has transformed modern genetics.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是一位杰出的科学家，其研究改变了现代遗传学。

meanings.exampleEn: The outstanding feature of this architectural design is its innovative use of natural light.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一建筑设计的突出特点在于其对自然光的创新运用。

meanings.exampleEn: The company still has an outstanding debt of five million dollars to the bank.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司仍有一笔五百万美元的债务未偿付给银行。

meanings.exampleEn: The question of who will take over the project remains outstanding after the meeting.
meanings.exampleZh: 会议之后，由谁接管该项目的问题仍未决定。

etymology.origin: 由 out + stand + -ing 构成，原义为“站出来的”，引申为“突出的、杰出的”；用于财务和法律语境中表示“未了结的、未偿付的”。
etymology.suffix: -ing = 形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”
etymology.tip: “站出来（out+stand）的人自然杰出；账单还悬在外面（outstanding）就是未偿付的。”

meanings.exampleEn: The chef insisted that the cake be baked in a preheated oven for exactly forty minutes.
meanings.exampleZh: 主厨坚持认为蛋糕必须在预热好的烤箱中烘烤整整四十分钟。

meanings.exampleEn: In the traditional kitchen, a brick oven served both for baking bread and simmering stews.
meanings.exampleZh: 在传统厨房里，砖砌的灶既用来烤面包，也用来炖菜。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient medical text metaphorically described the oven as the womb of life, where warmth nurtures growth.
meanings.exampleZh: 古代医学文献隐喻性地将子宫描述为生命的炉灶，温暖孕育生长。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀；来自古英语 ofen，与德语 Ofen 同源。

neighbour.zh: 邻居；邻接的东西；邻国；邻座

meanings.exampleEn: Despite years of living next door, the two neighbours barely exchanged a word.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管做了多年隔壁邻居，这两人几乎没说过一句话。

meanings.exampleEn: The new building is a close neighbour to the historic cathedral, creating an interesting architectural contrast.
meanings.exampleZh: 新建筑紧邻历史大教堂，形成了有趣的建筑对比。

meanings.exampleEn: The two countries have been hostile neighbours for decades, yet their trade relations continue to flourish.
meanings.exampleZh: 这两个国家几十年来一直是不友好的邻国，但贸易关系却持续繁荣。

meanings.exampleEn: During the long flight, my neighbour kindly offered me a copy of his magazine.
meanings.exampleZh: 长途飞行中，我的邻座友善地递给我一本他的杂志。

meanings.exampleEn: The small village neighbours a vast forest that remains unexplored by humans.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个小村庄毗邻一片人类尚未探索的广阔森林。

variants.zh: 邻近，毗邻（第三人称单数）
邻近，毗邻（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 neahgebur，由 neah（近）和 gebur（居住者）组成
etymology.suffix: -bour = 居住者（来自古英语 gebur）
etymology.tip: neigh（近）+ bour（居住者）：住在附近的人就是邻居。

outlaw.zh: 被剥夺法律保护的人；罪犯

meanings.zh: 被剥夺法律保护的人；罪犯；亡命之徒
meanings.exampleEn: The notorious outlaw was finally captured after years of evading the authorities.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个臭名昭著的亡命之徒在躲避当局多年后终于被抓获。

meanings.zh: 宣布…为不合法；使…失去法律保护
meanings.exampleEn: The government moved to outlaw the use of certain plastic bags in an effort to reduce pollution.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府采取措施宣布使用某些塑料袋为不合法，以减少污染。

variants.zh: 被剥夺法律保护的人；罪犯（复数）
宣布…为不合法（第三人称单数）
宣布…为不合法（过去式/过去分词）
宣布…为不合法（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 亡命之徒乡村音乐（一种反传统的乡村音乐风格）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 utlaga，由 ut（out，在外）+ lagu（law，法律）组成，原指被剥夺法律保护的人。
etymology.tip: out（在外）+ law（法律）= 在法律之外的人，即“亡命之徒”。

meanings.exampleEn: The ornamental garden was meticulously designed to enhance the beauty of the mansion.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座观赏花园经过精心设计，以增添豪宅的美感。

meanings.exampleEn: She placed a delicate porcelain ornamental on the mantelpiece to add elegance to the room.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在壁炉架上放了一件精致的瓷器装饰物，为房间增添优雅。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 ornare（装饰），经由古法语 ornement 进入英语。
etymology.tip: orn-（装饰）+ -ment（名词）+ -al（形容词）→ 装饰的、观赏的。

meanings.exampleEn: The chef added a pinch of mustard to the sauce to enhance its flavor.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨师在酱汁里加了一撮芥末以提升风味。

meanings.exampleEn: The mustard plants in the field blossomed into vibrant yellow flowers.
meanings.exampleZh: 田野里的芥菜开出了鲜艳的黄色花朵。

meanings.exampleEn: The young intern is full of mustard and eager to prove herself.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位年轻实习生充满热情，渴望证明自己。

phrases.zh: 非常热心的；极感兴趣的

etymology.root: must- = 葡萄汁（源自拉丁语 mustum）
etymology.origin: 来自古法语 moustarde，源自拉丁语 mustum（葡萄汁），因早期芥末酱用葡萄汁调制而得名
etymology.suffix: -ard（名词后缀，表示具有某种性质的人或物）
etymology.tip: must（葡萄汁）+ ard（人）→ 用葡萄汁调制的芥末酱，记住“must”是葡萄汁而非“必须”

meanings.exampleEn: She managed to overcome her fear of public speaking through constant practice.
meanings.exampleZh: 她通过不断练习设法克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。

variants.zh: 战胜；克服（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 古英语 ofercuman，由 ofer（over）+ cuman（come）组成
etymology.tip: over（越过）+ come（来）= 从困难上跨过来，即“克服”

observe.zh: 觉察到；遵守；注意到；庆祝

meanings.exampleEn: I observed a distinct change in his attitude toward the project.
meanings.exampleZh: 我觉察到他对项目的态度发生了明显变化。

meanings.exampleEn: All citizens are expected to observe the laws and regulations of the country.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有公民都应遵守国家的法律法规。

meanings.exampleEn: She observed that the experiment yielded inconsistent results under varying temperatures.
meanings.exampleZh: 她注意到实验在不同温度下产生了不一致的结果。

meanings.exampleEn: The community gathers annually to observe the festival with traditional rituals.
meanings.exampleZh: 社区每年聚集在一起，以传统仪式庆祝这个节日。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 observare，由 ob-（朝向）+ servare（看护，注视）构成
etymology.tip: ob（朝向）+ serv（看护）→ 朝着某物看护、注视 → 观察、遵守

meanings.exampleEn: The overhang of the cliff provided shelter from the rain.
meanings.exampleZh: 悬崖的突出部份提供了避雨的遮蔽处。

meanings.exampleEn: The balcony overhangs the garden below.
meanings.exampleZh: 阳台悬于下方的花园之上。

meanings.exampleEn: The upper floor overhangs slightly to create a shaded entrance.
meanings.exampleZh: 上层略微突出，形成了一个阴凉的入口。

variants.zh: 悬于…之上；突出（第三人称单数）
悬于…之上；突出（过去式/过去分词）
突出部份；悬垂部份（复数）

etymology.origin: 由古英语前缀 ofer（在上，超过）与 hangian（悬挂）组合而成
etymology.tip: over（在上方）+ hang（悬挂）= 在上方悬挂，即“悬垂、突出”

meanings.exampleEn: I overheard their conversation while waiting in the corridor.
meanings.exampleZh: 我在走廊等候时无意中听到了他们的谈话。

variants.zh: 无意中听到（过去式/过去分词）
无意中听到（第三人称单数）

phrases.zh: 无意中听到某人正在做某事
无意中听到某人说某事

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 oferhieran，由 ofer（over）+ hieran（hear）组成
etymology.tip: over（越过）+ hear（听）→ 在无意间越过正常听觉范围而听到

meanings.exampleEn: The oar, worn smooth by countless voyages, was the sailor's most trusted companion in the raging sea.
meanings.exampleZh: 那把被无数次航行磨得光滑的桨，是水手在汹涌大海中最信赖的伙伴。

meanings.exampleEn: Despite his slender build, he proved to be an indomitable oar, driving the boat forward with relentless strokes.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管他身材瘦削，他证明了自己是一位不屈不挠的桨手，以不懈的划桨驱动船只前进。

meanings.exampleEn: The rescue team oared the lifeboat through the treacherous currents to reach the stranded climbers.
meanings.exampleZh: 救援队用桨划着救生艇穿过险恶的水流，以到达被困的登山者。

meanings.exampleEn: They oared silently along the moonlit channel, careful not to disturb the nocturnal wildlife.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们沿着月光下的水道默默划桨，小心不惊扰夜间的野生动物。

variants.zh: 用桨划的过去式/过去分词

etymology.origin: 古英语

original.zh: 最初的；原始的；有创意的

meanings.exampleEn: The original plan was abandoned due to unexpected costs.
meanings.exampleZh: 最初的计划因意外成本而被放弃。

meanings.exampleEn: Her original approach to the problem impressed all the judges.
meanings.exampleZh: 她解决这个问题的独创方法给所有评委留下了深刻印象。

meanings.exampleEn: The museum displays the original of the famous painting, not a copy.
meanings.exampleZh: 博物馆展出的是这幅名画的原作，而非复制品。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 origo（起源），源自 oriri（升起）
etymology.tip: origin（起源）+ -al（...的）= 与起源有关的，即“原始的；最初的”

meanings.zh: 使超载；使过载；超过负荷
meanings.exampleEn: The sudden surge of requests overloaded the server, causing it to crash.
meanings.exampleZh: 突然涌入的大量请求使服务器超载，导致其崩溃。

meanings.exampleEn: Information overload has become a common problem in the digital age.
meanings.exampleZh: 信息过载已成为数字时代的普遍问题。

variants.zh: 使超载（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 由前缀 over- 加名词/动词 load 构成；load 源自古英语 lād（路，运载），后引申为装载、负荷。
etymology.tip: over（超过）+ load（负荷）→ 超过负荷，即超载。

meanings.exampleEn: The pungent odor of ammonia permeated the laboratory, making it almost impossible to breathe.
meanings.exampleZh: 刺鼻的氨水气味弥漫着实验室，让人几乎无法呼吸。

meanings.exampleEn: The subtle odor of jasmine wafted through the open window, evoking memories of her grandmother's garden.
meanings.exampleZh: 茉莉花的淡淡香味透过敞开的窗户飘来，唤起她对祖母花园的回忆。

meanings.exampleEn: The politician remained in good odor with his constituents despite the scandal.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管有丑闻，这位政治家在选民中仍保持着良好的名声。

meanings.exampleEn: His remarks carried an odor of hypocrisy that did not escape the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的言论带有一种虚伪的意味，这没有逃过听众的注意。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 odor（气味），经古法语 odour 进入英语
etymology.tip: odor 本身就是词根，看到 odor 就联想到“气味”；同根词 odorous、odorless 等都与气味相关。

meanings.exampleEn: You must finish the assignment on time; otherwise, you will fail the course.
meanings.exampleZh: 你必须按时完成作业，否则你会挂科。

meanings.exampleEn: Many people believe the policy will succeed, but the data suggests otherwise.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多人认为这项政策会成功，但数据表明并非如此。

meanings.exampleEn: We could have handled the dispute otherwise, but we chose to compromise.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们本可以以别的方式处理这场争端，但我们选择了妥协。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 ōþer + wīse，意为“在其他方式中”
etymology.tip: other（其他）+ wise（方式）→ 在其他方式下 → 否则；不同地

meanings.exampleEn: The oral agreement is legally binding in some contexts.
meanings.exampleZh: 在某些情况下，口头协议具有法律约束力。

meanings.exampleEn: Oral hygiene is essential for preventing tooth decay.
meanings.exampleZh: 口腔卫生对预防蛀牙至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: The final assessment consists of a written exam and an oral.
meanings.exampleZh: 期末考核包括笔试和口试。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 oralis，源自 os（属格 oris）'嘴'；经法语 oral 进入英语。
etymology.tip: or（嘴）+ -al（的）→ 用嘴说的 → 口头的；口试

meanings.zh: 东方的；东方国家的；东方人的
meanings.exampleEn: The oriental art exhibition attracted many Western collectors.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场东方艺术展吸引了许多西方收藏家。

meanings.zh: 东方人；亚洲人（尤指东亚人）
meanings.exampleEn: In the past, some Western scholars held stereotyped views of Orientals.
meanings.exampleZh: 过去，一些西方学者对东方人抱有刻板印象。

variants.zh: 使东方化；采用东方风格

phrases.zh: 东方明珠（如上海东方明珠塔）

etymology.root: orient- = 升起，东方（太阳升起的地方）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 oriens（升起，东方），由 oriri（升起）的现在分词而来
etymology.tip: 太阳从东方升起（orient），加上形容词后缀-al，就是“东方的”

meanings.exampleEn: Many residents oppose the construction of a new airport near their homes.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多居民反对在自家附近建造新机场。

meanings.exampleEn: They opposed reason to the enemy's blind violence.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们以理性对抗敌人的盲目暴力。

meanings.exampleEn: The workers opposed the exploitation by going on strike.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们通过罢工来抗争剥削。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 opponere（ob- '对着，相反' + ponere '放置'），经古法语 opposer 进入英语
