meanings.exampleEn: The scientist's persistence finally led to a breakthrough in cancer research.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位科学家的坚持不懈最终带来了癌症研究的突破。

meanings.exampleEn: The persistence of high inflation has forced the central bank to raise interest rates.
meanings.exampleZh: 高通胀的持续迫使中央银行提高利率。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 persistere，由 per-（始终）+ sistere（站立）构成
etymology.suffix: -ence = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: per（始终）+ sist（站立）+ ence（状态）→ 始终站立不动 → 坚持不懈、持续

meanings.exampleEn: She subscribed to several academic periodicals to keep up with the latest research.
meanings.exampleZh: 她订阅了几种学术期刊以了解最新研究。

meanings.exampleEn: The periodical review of the company's financial status is essential for investors.
meanings.exampleZh: 定期审查公司的财务状况对投资者至关重要。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 periodus，源自希腊语 periodos（peri- 周围 + hodos 路）
etymology.tip: period（周期）+ -ical（形容词后缀）→ 周期的，定期的；名词引申为期刊。

persevere.zh: 坚持；孜孜不倦；不屈不挠；(辩论中)固执己见

meanings.exampleEn: Despite numerous setbacks, she persevered in her research until she finally achieved a breakthrough.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管屡遭挫折，她仍孜孜不倦地坚持研究，直到最终取得突破。

meanings.exampleEn: The athlete persevered through pain and exhaustion to cross the finish line.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位运动员不屈不挠，忍受疼痛和疲惫冲过终点线。

meanings.exampleEn: He would persevere in his argument even when confronted with overwhelming evidence to the contrary.
meanings.exampleZh: 即使面对大量相反的证据，他仍会在辩论中固执己见。

variants.zh: 坚持；不屈不挠（过去式/过去分词）
坚持的；不屈不挠的（现在分词/形容词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 perseverare，由 per-（贯穿）和 severus（严肃的）组合而成，意为“始终严肃认真地坚持”。
etymology.tip: per（始终）+ sever（严肃）→ 始终严肃认真地做一件事 → 坚持、不屈不挠。

personnel.zh: 人员；人事部门；人事科(处)

meanings.exampleEn: The company is recruiting skilled personnel for its new branch.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司正在为新分公司招聘熟练人员。

meanings.exampleEn: She submitted her resignation to the personnel office yesterday.
meanings.exampleZh: 她昨天向人事部门提交了辞呈。

etymology.origin: 来自法语 personnel，源自拉丁语 personalis，与 persona（人）相关
etymology.suffix: -nel（后缀，构成名词/形容词，表示与...有关）
etymology.tip: person（人）+ -nel → 与“人”相关的集合 → 人员、人事部门

perspective.zh: 远景；透视感；(观察问题的)视角；透视法

meanings.exampleEn: From the top of the hill, you can get a perspective of the entire valley.
meanings.exampleZh: 从山顶上，你可以看到整个山谷的远景。

meanings.exampleEn: The artist used linear perspective to create a sense of depth in the painting.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家运用线性透视法在画作中营造出纵深感。

meanings.exampleEn: The report examines the issue from the perspective of developing countries.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份报告从发展中国家的视角审视这一问题。

phrases.zh: 正确地看待；合乎比例地
客观地看待某事；摆正某事的位置

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 perspicere（看透、看清）的过去分词 perspectus，经法语 perspective 进入英语。
etymology.tip: per（透过）+ spect（看）+ ive → 透过现象看本质，即“视角、透视”。

meanings.exampleEn: The peculiarity of her writing style lies in its vivid imagery.
meanings.exampleZh: 她写作风格的特质在于其生动的意象。

meanings.exampleEn: One peculiarity of the substance is its ability to conduct electricity at low temperatures.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种物质的一个特性是它在低温下能够导电。

meanings.exampleEn: He has a peculiarity of always checking the door lock three times before leaving.
meanings.exampleZh: 他有个怪癖，离开前总要检查门锁三次。

variants.zh: 特质；特性；怪癖（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 peculiaris（属于自己的），源自 peculium（私有财产），进一步源自 pecu（牛，古时牛是财富的象征）
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: pecu（牛）+ liar + ity → 牛是私有财产，代表个人特有的性质 → 特质、怪癖

meanings.exampleEn: The pace of technological change has accelerated dramatically in recent decades.
meanings.exampleZh: 近几十年来，技术变革的速度显著加快。

meanings.exampleEn: The team struggled to maintain the pace set by their captain.
meanings.exampleZh: 队伍努力保持队长设定的步调。

meanings.exampleEn: The dancer's graceful pace captivated the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 舞者优雅的步法迷住了观众。

meanings.exampleEn: He paced himself carefully to conserve energy for the final sprint.
meanings.exampleZh: 他小心调整节奏，以保存体力做最后冲刺。

meanings.exampleEn: He paced back and forth in his office, deep in thought.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在办公室里来回踱步，陷入沉思。

variants.zh: 踱步；为…定速度（过去式/过去分词）
踱步；为…定速度（现在分词）
踱步；为…定速度（第三人称单数）

phrases.zh: 以蜗牛般的速度，极慢地

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 passus（步伐），经古法语 pas 进入英语
etymology.tip: pace 与 pass 同源，'走过的一步'就是速度与步调

meanings.exampleEn: The professor asked the student to focus only on pertinent evidence in the research paper.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授要求学生在研究论文中只关注相关的证据。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pertinere（延伸至，涉及），由 per-（完全）和 tenere（持有）构成
etymology.suffix: -ent = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: per（完全）+ tin（握住）+ ent（的）→ 完全握住主题不放 → 切题的，相关的

related.zh: 大陆；洲（原义“保持在一起的陆地”）

passive.zh: 消极的；被动的；冷漠的；顺从的

meanings.exampleEn: His passive attitude toward the project frustrated the entire team.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对项目的消极态度让整个团队感到沮丧。

meanings.exampleEn: In the negotiation, she remained passive, letting the other side make all the decisions.
meanings.exampleZh: 谈判中她保持被动，让对方做所有决定。

meanings.exampleEn: The government's passive response to the crisis drew widespread criticism.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府对危机的冷漠回应招致了广泛批评。

meanings.exampleEn: He was passive in the face of unfair treatment, never daring to protest.
meanings.exampleZh: 面对不公待遇他顺从忍受，从不敢抗议。

meanings.exampleEn: The sentence "The window was broken" is in the passive.
meanings.exampleZh: 句子“窗户被打破了”用的是被动语态。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 passivus，由 pati（忍受，遭受）的过去分词 passus 加 -ivus 构成
etymology.tip: pass（忍受）+ -ive（...的）→ 默默忍受而不反抗的 → 被动的、消极的

overtake.zh: 赶上；突然降临于；压倒；代替

meanings.exampleEn: She had to sprint to overtake the leading runner before the finish line.
meanings.exampleZh: 她必须在终点线前冲刺才能赶上领先的跑者。

meanings.exampleEn: A profound sense of loneliness suddenly overtook him in the crowded city.
meanings.exampleZh: 在拥挤的城市里，一种深深的孤独感突然降临到他身上。

meanings.exampleEn: Fear overtook his reason when he saw the shadow in the dark alley.
meanings.exampleZh: 在黑暗的小巷里看到影子时，恐惧压倒了他的理智。

meanings.exampleEn: Digital communication has overtaken traditional mail in many countries.
meanings.exampleZh: 在许多国家，数字通信已经取代了传统邮件。

variants.zh: 赶上；压倒；代替（overtake 的过去式）
赶上；压倒；代替（overtake 的过去分词）
赶上；压倒；代替（overtake 的现在分词）
赶上；压倒；代替（overtake 的第三人称单数）

phrases.zh: 被事态发展所压倒；跟不上形势

etymology.origin: 古英语 ofertacan，由 ofer（over）+ tacan（take）组成
etymology.tip: over（超过）+ take（拿）→ 拿得更多，超过并赶上

meanings.exampleEn: The workers are paving the road with asphalt to ensure a smooth surface.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们正在用沥青铺设道路，以确保路面平整。

meanings.exampleEn: The agreement paved the way for a peaceful resolution of the conflict.
meanings.exampleZh: 该协议为冲突的和平解决做了安排。

meanings.exampleEn: The garden path was paved with colorful pebbles collected from the beach.
meanings.exampleZh: 花园小径铺满了从海滩捡来的彩色鹅卵石。

meanings.exampleEn: His groundbreaking research paved the way for modern medical treatments.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的开创性研究为现代医学治疗铺平了道路。

phrases.zh: 为...铺平道路；为...创造条件

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pavire，意为“敲打、踩实”，引申为铺路。
etymology.tip: pave 中 pav 意为“踩实”，把地面踩实就是“铺设”。

meanings.exampleEn: The athlete wiped the perspiration from his forehead after the marathon.
meanings.exampleZh: 马拉松结束后，运动员擦去额头上的汗。

meanings.exampleEn: Perspiration is the body's natural way of regulating temperature.
meanings.exampleZh: 流汗是身体调节体温的自然方式。

meanings.exampleEn: Success is often the result of hard work and perspiration rather than sheer luck.
meanings.exampleZh: 成功往往是努力和汗水的结果，而非纯粹的运气。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 perspirare（通过皮肤排出），由 per-（穿过）+ spirare（呼吸）构成，后引申为“出汗”。
etymology.suffix: -ation = 名词后缀，表示行为或结果
etymology.tip: per（穿透）+ spir（呼吸）+ ation，汗水就像皮肤在“呼吸”时透出来的水珠。

personality.zh: 个性；人格；(团体、地方、国家)特有特性；名人

meanings.exampleEn: Her vibrant personality made her the center of attention at every social gathering.
meanings.exampleZh: 她活泼的个性使她成为每次社交聚会的焦点。

meanings.exampleEn: The historic city has preserved its unique architectural personality despite modern development.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管经历了现代发展，这座历史名城仍保留了其独特的建筑特色。

meanings.exampleEn: The talk show host interviewed several prominent personalities from the entertainment industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位脱口秀主持人采访了娱乐界的几位知名人物。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 persona，原指演员戴的面具，后引申为“人、角色”
etymology.tip: person（人）+ ality（性质）→ 人的性质 → 个性

philanthropy.zh: 慈善；仁慈；博爱；慈善事业

meanings.zh: 慈善；仁慈；博爱；慈善事业
meanings.exampleEn: His philanthropy has transformed the lives of thousands of underprivileged children in rural areas.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的慈善事业改变了农村地区数千名贫困儿童的生活。

phrases.zh: 企业慈善；公司慈善事业
付诸行动的慈善；实际的慈善行为

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 philanthropia，由 philein（爱）和 anthropos（人类）组合而成
etymology.suffix: -y 名词后缀，表示性质、状态或行为
etymology.tip: phil（爱）+ anthrop（人类）+ y（名词后缀）→ 爱人类 → 慈善、博爱

related.zh: 厌恶人类者；愤世嫉俗者

meanings.exampleEn: The price of the loaf has risen by a penny since last year.
meanings.exampleZh: 这块面包的价格自去年以来上涨了一便士。

meanings.exampleEn: He counted every penny before deciding whether to buy the ticket.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在决定是否买这张票之前，把每一分钱都数了一遍。

meanings.exampleEn: She refused to work for a mere penny when her skills were worth far more.
meanings.exampleZh: 当她的技能价值远不止于此的时候，她拒绝为区区小钱工作。

meanings.exampleEn: There is not a penny of truth in the rumor spread online.
meanings.exampleZh: 网上流传的谣言中没有一点是真的。

phrases.zh: 你在想什么呢（用于询问沉默者的想法）

phrases.en: in for a penny, in for a pound
phrases.zh: 一不做二不休；既然开始就干到底
小处精明，大处浪费；贪小失大

etymology.origin: 古英语 penig，与德语 Pfennig 同源，原指一种小额货币。
etymology.tip: penny 音似“陪你”，一枚小硬币陪你买小东西。

meanings.exampleEn: You must obtain written permission from the authorities before conducting the survey.
meanings.exampleZh: 在进行这项调查之前，你必须获得当局的书面许可。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 permittere（per- 通过 + mittere 发送），经由古法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为或状态
etymology.tip: per（通过）+ miss（发送）+ ion → 发送过去让你通过 → 许可

meanings.exampleEn: The phenomenon of global warming has attracted worldwide attention.
meanings.exampleZh: 全球变暖这一现象已引起全世界的关注。

meanings.exampleEn: There is a growing phenomenon that young people prefer online shopping to going to malls.
meanings.exampleZh: 年轻人宁愿网购也不愿去商场，这种迹象日益明显。

meanings.exampleEn: The phenomenon of social media addiction is particularly evident among teenagers.
meanings.exampleZh: 社交媒体成瘾的表现尤其在青少年中显而易见。

meanings.exampleEn: The aurora borealis is one of nature's most spectacular phenomena.
meanings.exampleZh: 北极光是自然界最壮观的奇迹之一。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 phainomenon（显现出来的东西），由 phainein（显示）的中性分词形式演变而来
etymology.suffix: -omenon（希腊语分词后缀，表示“显现的”）
etymology.tip: phan=显现，phenomenon就是“显现出来的东西”，即现象。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient pale, constructed of sturdy oak timbers, still encircles the manor grounds.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座由坚固橡木建造的古老栅栏，至今仍环绕着庄园的庭院。

meanings.exampleEn: His provocative remarks during the lecture went far beyond the pale of academic decency.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在讲座中的挑衅性言论远远超出了学术礼仪的界线。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee's jurisdiction falls within the pale of international maritime law.
meanings.exampleZh: 该委员会的管辖权属于国际海洋法的范围。

meanings.exampleEn: The harrowing news left her face visibly pale, betraying her inner turmoil.
meanings.exampleZh: 那令人悲痛的消息使她脸色明显苍白，暴露出内心的不安。

meanings.exampleEn: Under the pale glow of the streetlamp, the deserted alley seemed even more sinister.
meanings.exampleZh: 在路灯暗淡的光线下，空无一人的小巷显得更加阴森。

meanings.exampleEn: He opted for a pale blue shirt to soften the formality of his dark suit.
meanings.exampleZh: 他选择了一件浅蓝色衬衫，以缓和深色西装的正式感。

etymology.origin: 名词义源自拉丁语 palus（木桩），经古法语 pal 进入英语；形容词义源自拉丁语 pallere（变苍白），经古法语 pale 进入英语。
etymology.tip: 木桩(palus)围成栅栏(pale)，界线范围在其中；脸色苍白(pale)如纸，暗淡无光。

meanings.exampleEn: The first phase of the project focuses on data collection and analysis.
meanings.exampleZh: 该项目的第一阶段侧重于数据收集与分析。

meanings.exampleEn: The country entered a new phase of political stability after the reform.
meanings.exampleZh: 改革之后，这个国家进入了政治稳定的新局面。

meanings.exampleEn: We need to examine every phase of the problem before making a decision.
meanings.exampleZh: 在做出决定之前，我们需要审视这个问题的每一个方面。

meanings.exampleEn: The phase difference between the two waves determines the interference pattern.
meanings.exampleZh: 两列波之间的相位差决定了干涉图样。

meanings.exampleEn: The government decided to phase the new policy over three years.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府决定在三年内分阶段逐步实行这项新政策。

variants.zh: 分阶段进行（第三人称单数）
分阶段进行（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 逐步淘汰；逐步停止使用

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 phasis（出现，显现），源于 phainein（显示，使显现）
etymology.suffix: -sis 变体 -se，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: phase 本义是“显现出来的样子”，引申为事物发展过程中显现出的“阶段、局面”。

patent.zh: 专利权；许可证；执照；专利品

meanings.exampleEn: The company filed a lawsuit to protect its patent on the new drug.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司提起诉讼以保护其新药的专利权。

meanings.exampleEn: This device is a patent that has revolutionized the way we communicate.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种设备是一项彻底改变我们沟通方式的专利品。

meanings.exampleEn: The researcher decided to patent her innovative method before publishing the results.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位研究员决定在发表结果之前为她的创新方法申请专利。

meanings.exampleEn: It was patent to everyone that the negotiations had failed.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有人都清楚，谈判已经失败。

meanings.exampleEn: The patent protection period for this invention lasts twenty years.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项发明的专利保护期为二十年。

variants.zh: 获得专利权（第三人称单数）
获得专利权（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 patens（打开的），由动词 patere（展开、可进入）的现在分词演变而来
etymology.tip: 专利（patent）是公开（open）的发明，专利文件将技术方案公之于众，换取独占权。

meanings.exampleEn: The peacock fanned out its iridescent tail feathers to attract a mate.
meanings.exampleZh: 孔雀展开它彩虹色的尾羽以吸引配偶。

meanings.exampleEn: He is a peacock who always boasts about his achievements in front of colleagues.
meanings.exampleZh: 他是个好炫耀的人，总在同事面前吹嘘自己的成就。

etymology.root: pea- = 孔雀（源自拉丁语 pavo）
etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 pecok，由 pea（孔雀，源自拉丁语 pavo）与 cock（公鸡）复合而成
etymology.tip: pea（孔雀）+ cock（公鸡）= 孔雀；雄孔雀开屏炫耀，故引申为“爱炫耀的人”

persistent.zh: 固执的；坚持的；持续的；作用持久的

meanings.exampleEn: Despite overwhelming evidence, he remained persistent in his refusal to accept the truth.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管证据确凿，他仍然固执地拒绝接受事实。

meanings.exampleEn: Her persistent efforts in learning English finally paid off when she passed the CET-6 exam.
meanings.exampleZh: 她坚持学习英语的努力终于得到了回报，通过了六级考试。

meanings.exampleEn: The persistent rain caused severe flooding in several coastal cities.
meanings.exampleZh: 持续的降雨导致多个沿海城市遭受严重洪灾。

meanings.exampleEn: This medication has a persistent effect, so patients only need to take it once a day.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种药物作用持久，因此患者每天只需服用一次。

phrases.zh: 持续性植物状态（植物人状态）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 persistere，由 per-（贯穿）+ sistere（站立）构成，意为“始终坚持站立”。
etymology.suffix: -ent = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: per（始终）+ sist（站立）+ ent（的）→ 始终站立不动 → 坚持的；固执的

peck.zh: 配克(英美干量单位)；啄痕；啄食；许多

meanings.exampleEn: The farmer sold a peck of wheat at the local market.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个农民在当地市场卖了一配克小麦。

meanings.exampleEn: The woodpecker left a distinct peck on the tree trunk.
meanings.exampleZh: 啄木鸟在树干上留下了一个清晰的啄痕。

meanings.exampleEn: She has a peck of troubles to deal with before the deadline.
meanings.exampleZh: 截止日期前她有一大堆麻烦要处理。

meanings.exampleEn: The hen pecked at the grain scattered on the ground.
meanings.exampleZh: 母鸡啄食着撒在地上的谷粒。

variants.zh: 啄；啄食（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 啄食；小口地吃；不断敲打

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: Despite numerous setbacks, she persisted in her quest for scientific truth.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管遭遇无数挫折，她仍坚持追求科学真理。

meanings.exampleEn: He persisted in his unreasonable demands, refusing to compromise.
meanings.exampleZh: 他固执地坚持不合理要求，拒绝妥协。

meanings.exampleEn: The heavy rain persisted for three days, causing severe flooding.
meanings.exampleZh: 大雨持续三天，造成严重洪灾。

meanings.exampleEn: The witness persisted that she had seen the suspect at the scene.
meanings.exampleZh: 证人坚称她在现场看到了嫌疑人。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 persistere，由 per-（贯穿）+ sistere（站立）构成
etymology.tip: per（始终）+ sist（站立）= 始终站立不动 → 坚持

meanings.exampleEn: The climbers finally reached the peak after a grueling ascent.
meanings.exampleZh: 登山者经过艰苦攀登终于到达了山峰。

meanings.exampleEn: At the peak of his career, he won the Nobel Prize.
meanings.exampleZh: 在他事业的巅峰时期，他获得了诺贝尔奖。

meanings.exampleEn: The economy peaked in the late 1990s before the recession.
meanings.exampleZh: 经济在20世纪90年代末达到高峰，之后便陷入衰退。

meanings.exampleEn: Traffic is heaviest during peak hours in the city center.
meanings.exampleZh: 市中心在高峰时段交通最为拥堵。

variants.zh: 达到高峰（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The advent of digital photography has revolutionized the way we capture and preserve memories.
meanings.exampleZh: 数码摄影的出现彻底改变了我们捕捉和保存记忆的方式。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 photos（光）+ graphein（写、画），意为用光作画。
etymology.tip: photo（光）+ graph（画）+ y（名词）→ 用光作画 → 摄影。

peripheral.zh: 周边的；周围的；圆周的；无关紧要的

meanings.zh: 周边的；周围的；圆周的；无关紧要的
meanings.exampleEn: The peripheral areas of the city are less crowded than the downtown core.
meanings.exampleZh: 城市的周边地区比市中心不那么拥挤。

meanings.zh: 外围设备（如计算机的外部设备）
meanings.exampleEn: This printer is a peripheral that connects to the computer via a USB port.
meanings.exampleZh: 这台打印机是一种通过USB端口连接到计算机的外围设备。

variants.zh: 周边地；外围地；无关紧要地

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 peripheria，由 peri-（周围）+ pherein（携带）构成，原指“圆周、外围”。
etymology.tip: peri（周围）+ pher（携带）+ al（的）→ 携带到周围的 → 周边的

meanings.exampleEn: The residents launched a petition to protest against the construction of the chemical plant.
meanings.exampleZh: 居民们发起请愿，抗议化工厂的建造。

meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer filed a petition for a writ of habeas corpus on behalf of the detainee.
meanings.exampleZh: 律师代表被拘留者提交了一份人身保护令诉状。

meanings.exampleEn: Her petition for a divorce was finally granted by the court after months of deliberation.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过数月的审议，法院最终批准了她的离婚申请。

meanings.exampleEn: The villagers petitioned the local government to provide better medical facilities.
meanings.exampleZh: 村民们向当地政府请愿，要求提供更好的医疗设施。

variants.zh: 请愿；祈求（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 petitio（请求，追求），源于动词 petere（寻求，请求）
etymology.suffix: -ition = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: pet（追求）+ ition（名词后缀）→ 为追求某个目标而正式提出的请求 → 请愿

meanings.exampleEn: His powers of persuasion finally convinced the committee to approve the proposal.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的说服力最终使委员会批准了这项提案。

meanings.exampleEn: People of different political persuasions gathered to debate the new policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 持不同政治信念的人们聚集在一起辩论这项新政策。

meanings.exampleEn: The party was split into several rival persuasions over the issue of reform.
meanings.exampleZh: 该党在改革问题上分裂成了几个对立的派别。

meanings.exampleEn: Her argument lacked persuasion because it was based on outdated statistics.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的论点缺乏说服力，因为它基于过时的统计数据。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 persuasio，由 per- + suadere（劝告）构成
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: per（完全）+ suas（劝告）+ ion → 彻底劝告 → 说服

pest.zh: 令人讨厌之物；有害之物；害虫；瘟疫

meanings.exampleEn: Farmers have to apply pesticides regularly to protect their crops from various pests.
meanings.exampleZh: 农民必须定期施用杀虫剂，以保护庄稼免受各种害虫的侵害。

meanings.exampleEn: That persistent salesman at the door is becoming a real pest to the whole neighborhood.
meanings.exampleZh: 门口那个纠缠不休的推销员正成为整个街坊邻里十分讨厌的人。

meanings.exampleEn: In the Middle Ages, the pest swept through Europe, leaving countless casualties in its wake.
meanings.exampleZh: 中世纪时，瘟疫席卷欧洲，留下了无数伤亡。

variants.zh: 害虫；讨厌的人（或物）；瘟疫（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pestis（瘟疫，毁灭）
etymology.tip: pest 音似“拍死它”，害虫就该拍死它。

physiological.zh: 生理学的；生理学上的；生理机能的

meanings.zh: 生理学的；生理学上的；生理机能的
meanings.exampleEn: The physiological effects of sleep deprivation include impaired memory and weakened immune function.
meanings.exampleZh: 睡眠不足的生理影响包括记忆力受损和免疫功能减弱。

variants.zh: 生理学上；生理机能方面

etymology.root: physio- = 自然；生理；log = 学科
etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 physis（自然、生长）与 logos（学科、理性），经拉丁语 physiologia 进入英语，后缀 -ical 表示形容词。
etymology.tip: physio（生理）+ log（学科）+ ical（形容词）→ 与生理学科相关的 → 生理学的

meanings.exampleEn: The company's market share has grown by 15 percent over the past two quarters.
meanings.exampleZh: 在过去两个季度中，该公司的市场份额增长了15%。

meanings.exampleEn: There was a five percent reduction in carbon emissions due to the new policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于新政策，碳排放量减少了百分之五。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 per centum，意为“每一百”
etymology.tip: per（每）+ cent（百）= 每一百，即百分比

related.zh: 分（货币单位，百分之一美元）

photoelectric.zh: 光电的；灯光摄影装置的

meanings.exampleEn: The photoelectric effect provided crucial evidence for the quantum nature of light.
meanings.exampleZh: 光电效应为光的量子本性提供了关键证据。

meanings.exampleEn: The studio relies on sophisticated photoelectric equipment to control lighting precisely.
meanings.exampleZh: 该工作室依靠精密的灯光摄影装置来精确控制照明。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 phos/phot-（光）和 elektron（琥珀，引申为电）
etymology.tip: photo（光）+ electric（电的）→ 光电的

philosopher.zh: 哲学家；哲人；思想开创人；达观的人

meanings.exampleEn: The philosopher devoted his life to exploring the nature of existence and reality.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位哲学家毕生致力于探索存在与现实的本质。

meanings.exampleEn: As a philosopher, she approached everyday dilemmas with remarkable calm and rationality.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一位哲人，她以非凡的冷静和理性应对日常困境。

meanings.exampleEn: Marx is regarded as a philosopher whose ideas fundamentally reshaped modern social theory.
meanings.exampleZh: 马克思被视为一位思想开创人，其观点从根本上重塑了现代社会理论。

meanings.exampleEn: After years of hardship, he became a philosopher who accepted both fortune and misfortune with equanimity.
meanings.exampleZh: 历经多年磨难后，他成了一个达观的人，对得失荣辱都能泰然处之。

variants.zh: 进行哲学思考；以哲理阐释

phrases.zh: 自然哲学家（旧指科学家）

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 philosophos，意为“爱智慧的人”，由 philo-（爱）+ sophia（智慧）构成
etymology.tip: 爱智慧（philo+soph）的人（-er）就是哲学家。

meanings.exampleEn: The human perception of color varies under different lighting conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 人类对颜色的知觉在不同光照条件下会发生变化。

meanings.exampleEn: His perception of the situation was distorted by his anxiety.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对形势的感觉因焦虑而扭曲。

meanings.exampleEn: She has a remarkable perception of complex mathematical concepts.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对复杂数学概念有非凡的领悟力。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 perceptio，由 per-（完全）+ capere（拿取）构成，原义为“彻底抓住、领会”。
etymology.suffix: -tion = 名词后缀，表示行为或结果
etymology.tip: per（完全）+ cept（拿取）+ ion → 完全拿住 → 知觉、领悟

perpendicular.zh: 垂直线；垂直的位置；直立(姿势)；刚正

meanings.exampleEn: The tower is perfectly perpendicular to the ground, which is a remarkable feat of ancient engineering.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座塔与地面完全垂直，这是古代工程的一项非凡壮举。

meanings.exampleEn: Draw a perpendicular from the vertex to the base of the triangle.
meanings.exampleZh: 从顶点向三角形的底边画一条垂线。

meanings.exampleEn: The soldier maintained a rigid perpendicular even under the scorching sun.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名士兵在烈日下依然保持笔直的直立姿势。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 perpendiculum（铅垂线），由 per-（完全）+ pendere（悬挂）+ -culum（工具）构成
etymology.suffix: -icular = 具有...性质的（形容词后缀）
etymology.tip: per-完全 + pend悬挂 + -icular... 铅垂线完全悬挂，即垂直于地面

performance.zh: 施行；工作情况；成绩；行为

meanings.exampleEn: The performance of his duties requires great patience.
meanings.exampleZh: 履行他的职责需要极大的耐心。

meanings.exampleEn: Her performance in the play won critical acclaim.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在剧中的表演赢得了评论界的赞誉。

meanings.exampleEn: The employee's performance has improved significantly this quarter.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名员工本季度的工作表现显著改善。

meanings.exampleEn: The company's financial performance exceeded analysts' expectations.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司的财务业绩超出了分析师的预期。

meanings.exampleEn: The new engine delivers outstanding performance at high speeds.
meanings.exampleZh: 这款新发动机在高速下表现出卓越的性能。

meanings.exampleEn: His performance in the meeting was unprofessional.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在会议上的行为不够专业。

variants.zh: 表演；履行（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 parformer，由拉丁语 per-（完全）+ formare（形成）构成
etymology.tip: per（完全）+ form（形成）+ ance（名词后缀）→ 完全形成的过程 → 履行、表现、表演

petty.zh: 琐碎的；小规模的；小气的；委琐的

meanings.exampleEn: The committee spent hours debating petty details instead of addressing the core issue.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会花了数小时争论琐碎的细节，而不是解决核心问题。

meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for a petty theft at the local supermarket.
meanings.exampleZh: 他因在当地超市犯下的小规模盗窃而被逮捕。

meanings.exampleEn: It was petty of him to criticize her for such a minor mistake.
meanings.exampleZh: 他为这么一个小错误批评她，显得很小心眼。

meanings.exampleEn: His petty behavior in the meeting revealed a lack of professional dignity.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在会议上的委琐举止暴露出缺乏职业尊严。

variants.zh: 更琐碎的；更小气的（比较级）
最琐碎的；最小气的（最高级）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 petit（小的），中古英语时期借入英语，后拼写演变为 petty。
etymology.tip: petit（小）+ y → 小的、琐碎的；联想法语词“petit”表示“小”，如“petit four”（小点心）。

meanings.exampleEn: Teenagers often find it easier to confide in their peers than in their parents.
meanings.exampleZh: 青少年往往觉得向同龄人倾诉比向父母倾诉更容易。

meanings.exampleEn: The new law was fiercely opposed by the peers in the House of Lords.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项新法律遭到上议院贵族们的强烈反对。

meanings.exampleEn: She peered through the fog, trying to discern the outline of the distant lighthouse.
meanings.exampleZh: 她透过浓雾凝视，试图辨认远处灯塔的轮廓。

variants.zh: 凝视的过去式/过去分词
无与伦比的；出类拔萃的

phrases.zh: 同辈压力；来自同龄人的压力

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 per，源自拉丁语 par（相等）
etymology.tip: peer 源自 par（相等），同辈之间地位相等，贵族之间等级相当。

philosophy.zh: 哲学；人生观；哲学思想；哲理

meanings.exampleEn: The professor's lecture on existential philosophy challenged the students' conventional beliefs.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授关于存在主义哲学的讲座挑战了学生们的传统观念。

meanings.exampleEn: Her philosophy of life emphasizes resilience and gratitude in the face of adversity.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的人生观强调在逆境中保持韧性与感恩。

meanings.exampleEn: The Enlightenment philosophy profoundly influenced the political revolutions of the 18th century.
meanings.exampleZh: 启蒙运动的哲学思想深刻影响了18世纪的政治革命。

meanings.exampleEn: The fable conveys a simple philosophy about the dangers of unchecked ambition.
meanings.exampleZh: 这则寓言传达了一个关于野心失控之危险的简单哲理。

variants.zh: 进行哲学思考；哲理化地论述

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 philosophia，由 philo-（爱）+ sophia（智慧）构成，意为“热爱智慧”。
etymology.tip: 爱智慧（philo+soph+y）就是哲学，记住“哲学=爱智慧”。

physical.zh: 身体的；物质的；自然的；物理学的

meanings.exampleEn: Regular physical exercise can significantly reduce the risk of chronic diseases.
meanings.exampleZh: 定期的身体锻炼能显著降低患慢性疾病的风险。

meanings.exampleEn: The physical world is governed by laws that scientists strive to understand.
meanings.exampleZh: 物质世界受科学家努力去理解的规律所支配。

meanings.exampleEn: Physical geography focuses on natural features such as mountains, rivers, and climate.
meanings.exampleZh: 自然地理学关注山脉、河流和气候等自然特征。

meanings.exampleEn: The experiment was designed to test a fundamental principle of physical chemistry.
meanings.exampleZh: 该实验旨在检验物理化学的一个基本原理。

meanings.exampleEn: The company requires all new employees to undergo a thorough physical before starting work.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司要求所有新员工在开始工作前接受全面的体格检查。

variants.zh: 身体上；物质上；按自然规律

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 physica，最终源自希腊语 physis（自然）
etymology.tip: phys（自然）+ -al（的）→ 与自然相关的 → 自然的；物理学的；身体的

meanings.exampleEn: The discovery of vast petroleum reserves transformed the region's economy.
meanings.exampleZh: 巨大石油储量的发现改变了该地区的经济。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 petroleum，由 petra（岩石）和 oleum（油）组合而成，意为“岩石中的油”。
etymology.tip: petr（石）+ ole（油）= 石油，石头里流出的油。

philanthropic.zh: 慈善(事业)的；博爱的；乐善好施的

meanings.zh: 慈善(事业)的；博爱的；乐善好施的
meanings.exampleEn: His philanthropic efforts have transformed the lives of thousands of underprivileged children.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的慈善事业改变了数千名贫困儿童的生活。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 philanthropos（爱人类的），由 philein（爱）+ anthropos（人）构成
etymology.tip: 爱(phil)人类(anthrop)的(ic) → 慈善的

meanings.exampleEn: The parrot settled on its perch and began to preen its feathers.
meanings.exampleZh: 鹦鹉落在栖木上，开始整理羽毛。

meanings.exampleEn: From his perch atop the hill, he could survey the entire valley.
meanings.exampleZh: 他从山顶的高处可以俯瞰整个山谷。

meanings.exampleEn: The acrobat balanced gracefully on a slender perch high above the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 杂技演员在观众上方高高的细杆上优雅地保持平衡。

meanings.exampleEn: The angler was delighted to catch a large perch in the lake.
meanings.exampleZh: 垂钓者在湖里钓到一条大河鲈，非常高兴。

meanings.exampleEn: A sparrow perched on the windowsill, chirping softly.
meanings.exampleZh: 一只麻雀栖息在窗台上，轻声鸣叫。

meanings.zh: 使坐落于；把…置于高处（或边缘）
meanings.exampleEn: The village is perched on the edge of a steep cliff.
meanings.exampleZh: 村庄坐落在陡峭悬崖的边缘。

variants.zh: 栖木；高位；杆；河鲈的复数
栖息；停留；使坐落于（第三人称单数）
栖息；停留；使坐落于（过去式/过去分词）
栖息；停留；使坐落于（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 使某人失去地位；挫某人的威风

etymology.root: pertica = 长杆（栖木义）；perca = 鲈鱼（河鲈义）
etymology.origin: 栖木义来自古法语 perche，源自拉丁语 pertica（长杆）；河鲈义来自拉丁语 perca，源自古希腊语 perke。
etymology.tip: perch 音似“爬起”，鸟从低处爬起站上高杆栖息。

pebble.zh: 小圆石；小鹅卵石；水晶透镜；碎石花纹

meanings.exampleEn: The path was covered with smooth pebbles, making it difficult to walk in bare feet.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条小路铺满光滑的小圆石，赤脚行走很困难。

meanings.exampleEn: In the 18th century, a pebble was often used as a lens for eyeglasses.
meanings.exampleZh: 在18世纪，水晶透镜常被用作眼镜镜片。

meanings.exampleEn: The leather's natural pebble made it ideal for bookbinding.
meanings.exampleZh: 皮革天然的碎石花纹使其非常适合书籍装订。

variants.zh: 多卵石的；布满小圆石的
铺满卵石的；有碎石花纹的

phrases.zh: 鞋里的石子；令人烦恼的小事

etymology.origin: 古英语 papolstan（小石子）演变而来
etymology.tip: pebble 像一颗圆滚滚的小石子，联想“胖宝”的谐音。

meanings.exampleEn: The ferry slowly approached the pier, where dozens of passengers were waiting to board.
meanings.exampleZh: 渡轮缓缓靠近码头，那里有几十名乘客正在等候登船。

meanings.exampleEn: Engineers inspected the concrete pier that supports the massive bridge span.
meanings.exampleZh: 工程师检查了支撑巨大桥跨的混凝土桥墩。

meanings.exampleEn: The window pier between the two large panes adds structural stability to the wall.
meanings.exampleZh: 两块大玻璃窗之间的支框增强了墙壁的结构稳定性。

meanings.exampleEn: The stone pier protects the small harbor from the violent waves of the open sea.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座石砌防波堤保护小港湾免受外海巨浪的侵袭。

variants.zh: 码头；桥墩；支框；防波堤（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 petra（岩石），经古法语 pierre 进入英语，原义为“石砌的突堤”。
etymology.tip: pier 像用石头（petra）砌成的码头或桥墩，记住“石”就记住了 pier。

meanings.exampleEn: To calculate the perimeter of a rectangle, add twice the length and twice the width.
meanings.exampleZh: 要计算矩形的周长，将长和宽分别乘以二再相加。

meanings.exampleEn: The security guards patrol the perimeter of the military base every two hours.
meanings.exampleZh: 警卫每两小时在军事基地的周界巡逻一次。

meanings.exampleEn: Trees were planted along the perimeter of the campus to reduce noise from the street.
meanings.exampleZh: 校园周边种了树木，以减少街道噪音。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 perimetros，由 peri-（周围）+ metron（测量）构成
etymology.tip: peri（周围）+ meter（测量）→ 测量周围一圈 → 周长

meanings.exampleEn: The chef seasoned the steak with freshly ground black pepper.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨师用现磨的黑胡椒粉给牛排调味。

meanings.exampleEn: Pepper was once so valuable that it was used as currency.
meanings.exampleZh: 胡椒曾经非常珍贵，甚至被用作货币。

meanings.exampleEn: Some peppers are extremely hot and can irritate the skin.
meanings.exampleZh: 有些辣椒极其辛辣，会刺激皮肤。

meanings.exampleEn: She peppered the soup with a little black pepper.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在汤里撒了一点黑胡椒粉。

meanings.exampleEn: The wall was peppered with bullet holes.
meanings.exampleZh: 墙上布满了弹孔。

variants.zh: 第三人称单数：撒胡椒粉于；使布满
过去式/过去分词：撒胡椒粉于；使布满
现在分词：撒胡椒粉于；使布满

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 piper，经古英语 pipor 演变而来；最终源自梵语 pippali（胡椒粒）。
etymology.tip: pepper 本身即词根，源自拉丁语 piper，记住“胡椒”即可。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient civilization perished in the wake of the volcanic eruption.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个古代文明在火山爆发后毁灭了。

meanings.exampleEn: Many passengers perished when the ferry sank in the storm.
meanings.exampleZh: 渡轮在暴风雨中沉没时，许多乘客丧生。

meanings.exampleEn: The delicate flowers perished quickly under the scorching sun.
meanings.exampleZh: 娇嫩的花朵在烈日下迅速凋谢。

meanings.exampleEn: His spirit perished after years of relentless failure.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过多年不断的失败，他的精神颓丧了。

phrases.zh: 但愿不会如此；别这么想

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 perire（消失，毁灭），由 per-（完全）+ ire（走）构成；经古法语 perir 进入英语。
etymology.tip: per（完全）+ ire（走）= 完全走掉，即毁灭、丧生。

photographic.zh: 照相的；摄影用的；详细记录的；逼真的

meanings.exampleEn: The photographic evidence clearly showed the suspect at the scene of the crime.
meanings.exampleZh: 照片证据清楚地显示嫌疑人在犯罪现场。

meanings.exampleEn: She bought a new photographic lens for her trip to the safari park.
meanings.exampleZh: 她为去野生动物园旅行买了一个新的摄影镜头。

meanings.exampleEn: His photographic account of the expedition left nothing to the imagination.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对探险活动的详细记录让人无需再发挥想象。

meanings.exampleEn: The artist's photographic style made the portrait look almost like a real person.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家逼真的风格使肖像看起来几乎像真人一样。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 phōs（光）和 graphein（写、记录），合意为“用光记录”，后引申为“摄影的”。
etymology.tip: photo（光）+ graph（写/记录）+ ic（的）→ 用光记录下来的 → 照相的；逼真的。

physicist.zh: 物理学家；机械唯物论者；自然科学家

meanings.exampleEn: The physicist presented a groundbreaking theory about quantum entanglement at the international conference.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位物理学家在国际会议上提出了关于量子纠缠的开创性理论。

meanings.exampleEn: As a strict physicist, he believed that all phenomena could be reduced to mechanical laws.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一个严格的机械唯物论者，他认为所有现象都可以还原为机械规律。

meanings.exampleEn: In the 19th century, a physicist often conducted research across astronomy, chemistry, and biology.
meanings.exampleZh: 在19世纪，自然科学家常常跨天文学、化学和生物学开展研究。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 physica，源自古希腊语 physis（自然）
etymology.suffix: -ist = 表示从事某职业或信仰的人
etymology.tip: physic（自然）+ ist（人）= 研究自然的人，即物理学家

meanings.exampleEn: The piston moves up and down inside the cylinder to convert pressure into mechanical motion.
meanings.exampleZh: 活塞在气缸内上下运动，将压力转化为机械运动。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pistare（捣碎），经由意大利语 pistone 和法语 piston 进入英语，原指捣碎工具，后引申为机械中的活塞。
etymology.suffix: -on = 名词后缀，表示工具或物件
etymology.tip: pist-（捣碎）+ -on（工具）= 捣碎的工具，想象活塞在气缸中反复“捣”动，从而记住词义。

physically.zh: 按自然规律；完全地；实际上；真正地

meanings.exampleEn: It is physically impossible for a human to fly by flapping arms.
meanings.exampleZh: 人类靠挥动手臂飞行按自然规律是不可能的。

meanings.exampleEn: The report was physically devoid of any factual evidence.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份报告完全缺乏事实依据。

meanings.exampleEn: Physically, the two samples are identical, but their chemical properties differ.
meanings.exampleZh: 实际上，这两个样本相同，但它们的化学性质不同。

meanings.exampleEn: She was physically exhausted after the marathon.
meanings.exampleZh: 马拉松比赛后，她真正地精疲力竭了。

phrases.zh: 身体活跃的；经常锻炼的
物理上可能的；按自然规律可行的

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 physis（自然），经拉丁语 physica、古法语 physique，形成英语 physical，再加副词后缀 -ly。
etymology.tip: phys- 联想到 physics（物理学），物理学研究自然规律，所以 physically 意为“按自然规律、实际上”。

meanings.exampleEn: The price of petrol has risen sharply due to the global oil crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于全球石油危机，汽油价格急剧上涨。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 petroleum（石油），由 petra（岩石）+ oleum（油）构成，petrol 为其缩写。
etymology.tip: 岩石里流出的油，就是汽油。

plausible.zh: 貌似真实的；貌似合理的；说得煞有其事的

meanings.zh: 貌似真实的；貌似合理的；说得煞有其事的
meanings.exampleEn: His explanation for being late sounded plausible, but I still had my doubts.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对迟到的解释听起来貌似合理，但我仍然心存疑虑。

variants.zh: 貌似可信地；貌似合理地
难以置信的；不像真实的

phrases.zh: 貌似可信的否认；可推诿性

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 plausibilis，源于 plaudere（鼓掌、赞同），原义为“值得鼓掌的”，后引申为“貌似可信的”。
etymology.tip: plaus（鼓掌）+ ible（可……的）→ 可让人鼓掌相信的 → 貌似合理的

related.zh: 难以置信的；不像真实的

meanings.exampleEn: The patient was diagnosed with a rare genetic disorder that required immediate surgical intervention.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名病人被诊断出患有罕见的遗传性疾病，需要立即进行手术干预。

meanings.exampleEn: In the sentence "The window was broken by Tom," the window is the patient of the action.
meanings.exampleZh: 在句子“The window was broken by Tom”中，window 是动作的承受者。

meanings.exampleEn: A good teacher must be patient enough to explain complex concepts to students with varying levels of ability.
meanings.exampleZh: 一位好老师必须有足够的耐心，向能力水平各异的学生解释复杂的概念。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 patiens（忍受的），是动词 pati（忍受，遭受）的现在分词
etymology.suffix: -ent = 形容词后缀，表示“...的”；也可作名词后缀，表示“...的人”
etymology.tip: pat（忍受）+ ent（...的/人）：能忍受病痛的是“病人”，能忍受等待的是“有耐心的”。

pious.zh: 虔诚的；敬神的；尽责的；可嘉的

meanings.exampleEn: The pious pilgrims traveled miles to pay homage at the ancient shrine.
meanings.exampleZh: 那些虔诚的朝圣者跋涉数英里，前往古圣祠表达敬意。

meanings.exampleEn: As a pious citizen, she always fulfilled her civic duties with unwavering diligence.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名尽责的公民，她总是以坚定不移的勤勉履行自己的公民义务。

meanings.zh: 可嘉的；值得称赞的（常含讽刺意味，指表面虔诚或伪善）
meanings.exampleEn: His pious remarks about environmental protection were contradicted by his polluting factory.
meanings.exampleZh: 他关于环境保护的可嘉言论，却被自己污染环境的工厂所驳倒。

phrases.zh: （难以实现的）虔诚愿望；一厢情愿
（为达所谓善意的）虔诚骗局；伪善行为

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pius（虔诚的，尽责的），经由古法语 pius 进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ous = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: pi（虔诚）+ ous（形容词后缀）→ 充满虔诚的 → 虔诚的；尽责的。

meanings.exampleEn: The detective drew his pistol and aimed at the fleeing suspect.
meanings.exampleZh: 侦探拔出手枪，瞄准了逃跑的嫌疑人。

meanings.exampleEn: The athlete fired a pistol to signal the start of the race.
meanings.exampleZh: 运动员鸣响信号枪，示意比赛开始。

etymology.root: pistol- = 手枪（源自捷克语 píšťala，意为“管子、哨管”）
etymology.origin: 来自捷克语 píšťala（管子、哨管），因早期手枪枪管形似管子而得名，经法语 pistole 进入英语。
etymology.tip: pistol 音似“皮斯托”，想象皮带上别着一把“手枪”，皮斯托（pistol）随时拔枪。

related.zh: 旧时欧洲金币（同源词，与手枪无关）

plateau.zh: 高地；高原；(上升后的)稳定水平

meanings.exampleEn: The Tibetan Plateau is often called the 'Roof of the World' due to its immense altitude.
meanings.exampleZh: 青藏高原因其极高的海拔常被称为“世界屋脊”。

meanings.exampleEn: After months of rapid growth, the company's sales finally reached a plateau, prompting managers to seek new strategies.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过数月的快速增长，公司的销售额终于进入稳定期，促使管理层寻求新策略。

meanings.zh: 达到稳定水平；进入停滞期
meanings.exampleEn: Her language proficiency seemed to plateau after she stopped practicing daily, despite years of prior effort.
meanings.exampleZh: 在停止日常练习后，她的语言水平似乎停滞不前，尽管此前已努力多年。

variants.zh: 高原；稳定水平（复数，法语式复数）
达到稳定水平（第三人称单数）
达到稳定水平（过去式/过去分词）
达到稳定水平（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 进入稳定期；达到停滞水平

etymology.origin: 来自法语 plateau，意为“平的东西”，源自通俗拉丁语 *plattum，最终源于希腊语 platys（平的）
etymology.suffix: -eau（法语名词后缀，常表示“小”或具体事物）
etymology.tip: plat（平）+ eau（水）→ 平坦如水面般的高原，记住“平”就能联想“高原/稳定水平”。

meanings.exampleEn: The pungent aroma of spices permeated the entire kitchen.
meanings.exampleZh: 香料刺鼻的气味弥漫了整个厨房。

meanings.exampleEn: Water can permeate through the porous rock layers.
meanings.exampleZh: 水能够渗透过多孔的岩层。

meanings.exampleEn: A sense of optimism permeated the conference hall.
meanings.exampleZh: 一种乐观的情绪充满了会议厅。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy will permeate every aspect of our daily life.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策将影响我们日常生活的方方面面。

variants.zh: 动词第三人称单数：弥漫；渗透；充满；影响
动词过去式/过去分词：弥漫；渗透；充满；影响
动词现在分词：弥漫；渗透；充满；影响

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 permeare，由 per-（穿过）+ meare（通过）构成
etymology.tip: per（穿过）+ mea（通过）+ ate → 穿过并通行 → 渗透、弥漫

meanings.exampleEn: The plutocrat used his immense wealth to influence national politics.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位财阀利用其巨额财富影响国家政治。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 ploutos（财富）+ kratos（权力、统治），指凭借财富掌握权力的人。
etymology.tip: pluto（财富）+ crat（统治者）→ 靠财富统治的人 → 富豪、财阀。

meanings.exampleEn: She persuaded her colleagues to adopt the new strategy despite initial resistance.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管起初有阻力，她还是说服了同事们采纳新策略。

meanings.exampleEn: The evidence presented in the report persuaded the jury of the defendant's innocence.
meanings.exampleZh: 报告中的证据使陪审团相信被告是无辜的。

variants.zh: 说服，劝说（第三人称单数）
说服，劝说（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 persuadere，由前缀 per-（彻底）和动词 suadere（劝告）构成
etymology.tip: per（彻底）+ suade（劝告）→彻底劝告→说服

meanings.exampleEn: The hikers were unaware of the peril lurking beneath the seemingly tranquil surface of the glacier.
meanings.exampleZh: 徒步者们没有意识到冰川平静表面下潜藏的危险。

meanings.exampleEn: The country's economy is in grave peril due to the prolonged political crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于长期政治危机，该国经济处于严重险境。

meanings.exampleEn: The captain warned the crew about the perils of navigating through the pirate-infested waters.
meanings.exampleZh: 船长警告船员们关于在海盗出没水域航行的险因。

meanings.exampleEn: Any delay in the rescue operation could peril the lives of the trapped miners.
meanings.exampleZh: 救援行动的任何延误都可能危及被困矿工的生命。

etymology.root: peril = 危险（来自拉丁语 periculum）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 periculum（危险、试验），经古法语 peril 进入英语
etymology.tip: peril 谐音“怕惹”，危险的事别惹。

planet.zh: 行星；命运星辰；杰出的人；重大影响的事

meanings.exampleEn: The discovery of a new planet in a distant solar system has excited astronomers worldwide.
meanings.exampleZh: 在遥远太阳系中发现一颗新行星，令全世界的天文学家兴奋不已。

meanings.exampleEn: In ancient astrology, each person's life was believed to be governed by the influence of a specific planet.
meanings.exampleZh: 在古代占星术中，人们相信每个人的命运都受到特定命运星辰的影响。

meanings.exampleEn: In the field of theoretical physics, she is regarded as a planet among her peers.
meanings.exampleZh: 在理论物理学领域，她被同行视为一位杰出的人物。

meanings.exampleEn: The signing of the climate accord was a planet in the global political landscape.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项气候协议的签署是全球政治格局中一件具有重大影响的事。

phrases.zh: 地球（指人类居住的星球）

etymology.root: planet- = 漫游者（来自希腊语 planētēs）
etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 planētēs，意为“漫游者”，因行星在天空中移动而得名

meanings.exampleEn: The traditional pickle, made of salt and water, is essential for preserving herring.
meanings.exampleZh: 传统的盐卤由盐和水制成，对腌制鲱鱼至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: She marinated the cucumbers in a spicy pickle overnight.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把黄瓜在辛辣的腌汁中浸泡了一夜。

meanings.exampleEn: A jar of pickle is a staple in many Eastern European cuisines.
meanings.exampleZh: 一罐泡菜是许多东欧菜肴中的主食。

meanings.exampleEn: After losing his job and his wallet, he found himself in a real pickle.
meanings.exampleZh: 丢了工作又丢了钱包，他发现自己陷入了真正的困境。

meanings.exampleEn: They pickle the onions in vinegar to enhance their flavor.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们用醋腌制洋葱以增强风味。

etymology.origin: 词源不明，可能来自中古荷兰语 pekel（盐水），后进入英语。
etymology.tip: pickle 音似“皮抠”：皮被抠破，泡在盐卤里很痛，陷入困境。

playground.zh: 运动场；操场；度假胜地；活动场所

meanings.exampleEn: The school playground was renovated with new basketball courts and a running track.
meanings.exampleZh: 学校操场经过翻新，配备了新的篮球场和跑道。

meanings.exampleEn: This coastal town is a popular playground for wealthy tourists seeking luxury and relaxation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个海滨小镇是富裕游客寻求奢华与放松的热门度假胜地。

meanings.exampleEn: The city's tech parks have become a vibrant playground for innovative startups and entrepreneurs.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座城市的科技园区已成为创新初创企业和企业家们充满活力的活动场所。

variants.zh: 运动场；操场；度假胜地；活动场所（复数）

etymology.origin: 复合词，由 play（古英语 plega，意为游戏、运动）和 ground（古英语 grund，意为地面、场地）组合而成

related.zh: 基础； groundwork 基础工作

meanings.exampleEn: The tailor used a pin to secure the hem before sewing the delicate fabric.
meanings.exampleZh: 裁缝在缝制精致面料前用大头针固定下摆。

meanings.exampleEn: She pinned the notice to the bulletin board so that everyone could see the updated schedule.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把通知钉在公告板上，以便每个人都能看到更新的时间表。

variants.zh: 动词pin的过去式和过去分词

phrases.zh: 迫使（某人）明确表态；确定；查明

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

pleasant.zh: 愉快的；可爱的；活泼的；亲切的

meanings.exampleEn: The pleasant atmosphere of the seaside town made the tourists reluctant to leave.
meanings.exampleZh: 海滨小镇愉快的气氛使游客们不愿离去。

meanings.exampleEn: She has a pleasant smile that instantly puts everyone at ease.
meanings.exampleZh: 她有着可爱的微笑，能立刻让每个人感到放松。

meanings.exampleEn: The children were in a pleasant mood, chatting and laughing all the way.
meanings.exampleZh: 孩子们心情活泼欢快，一路上有说有笑。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor gave a pleasant nod to each student as they entered the lecture hall.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授在学生们进入讲堂时向每个人亲切地点了点头。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 plaisant，源自拉丁语 placere（取悦，使高兴）
etymology.tip: pleas（取悦）+ -ant（……的）→ 能取悦人的 → 令人愉快的

meanings.exampleEn: Students are encouraged to participate in extracurricular activities to broaden their horizons.
meanings.exampleZh: 鼓励学生参加课外活动以开阔视野。

meanings.exampleEn: A true friend is willing to participate your joys and sorrows.
meanings.exampleZh: 真正的朋友愿意分享你的欢乐与悲伤。

meanings.exampleEn: His remarks participated of a subtle irony that was not lost on the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的话语带有一种微妙的讽刺，听众都心领神会。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 participare，由 pars（部分）和 capere（拿取）构成，意为“取一份”
etymology.tip: 参加就是“取得自己的一份”

meanings.exampleEn: The sudden noise caused a momentary pause in the conversation, as everyone turned to see what had happened.
meanings.exampleZh: 突如其来的噪音使谈话暂时中断，所有人都转过身去看发生了什么。

meanings.exampleEn: She paused briefly before making her final decision, weighing the pros and cons of each option.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在做出最终决定前短暂停顿，权衡每个选项的利弊。

meanings.exampleEn: The lecturer paused the slide presentation to address an unexpected question from the audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 讲师暂停了幻灯片演示，以回答观众提出的一个意外问题。

variants.zh: 暂停；停顿（过去式/过去分词）
暂停；停顿（第三人称单数）

phrases.zh: 使某人犹豫；使某人认真考虑

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pausa，源自古希腊语 pausis（停止）
etymology.tip: 看到 pause 就想到播放器上的“暂停键”，词根 paus 意为“停止”。

meanings.exampleEn: His remarks offended many members of the audience at the conference.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在会议上的言论冒犯了许多听众。

meanings.exampleEn: The harsh lighting in the room offended her eyes.
meanings.exampleZh: 房间里刺眼的灯光使她感到不舒服。

meanings.exampleEn: Such behavior offends against the basic principles of justice.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种行为违反了正义的基本原则。

meanings.exampleEn: The young man offended again and was sent to prison.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个年轻人再次犯罪，被送进了监狱。

phrases.zh: 对…感到生气；因…而被冒犯

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 offendere，由 ob-（对着，朝向）+ fendere（击打）构成，原义为“击打、碰撞”，后引申为“冒犯、违反”。
etymology.prefix: ob-（= against，相对，相反；在 f 前同化为 of-）
etymology.tip: ob（对着）+ fend（击打）= 迎面击打 → 冒犯

meanings.exampleEn: The teacher asked us to underline the key phrases in the passage.
meanings.exampleZh: 老师让我们在文章中划出关键短语。

meanings.exampleEn: His phrase was so ambiguous that nobody could tell his real intention.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的措辞十分含糊，没人能看出他的真实意图。

meanings.exampleEn: She phrased her criticism carefully so as not to offend anyone.
meanings.exampleZh: 她小心翼翼地措辞批评，以免冒犯任何人。

variants.zh: 措辞；表达（第三人称单数）
措辞；表达（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 套用一句老话；创造新短语

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 phrasis，意为“说话、措辞”，经拉丁语进入英语。
etymology.tip: phrase 就是“说话的方式”——把话组织成短语。

meanings.exampleEn: She made a heartfelt plea for mercy to the judge.
meanings.exampleZh: 她向法官发自内心地恳求宽恕。

meanings.exampleEn: His plea of ignorance did not convince the jury.
meanings.exampleZh: 他无知的辩解没有说服陪审团。

meanings.exampleEn: The defendant entered a plea of not guilty at the trial.
meanings.exampleZh: 被告在庭审中作了不认罪的抗辩。

meanings.exampleEn: The court finally heard the plea after months of delay.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过数月拖延，法院终于审理了该诉讼。

variants.zh: 恳求；辩解；抗辩；诉讼（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 placitum（判决，意见），源于 placere（使满意）
etymology.tip: plea 与 please 同源，恳求是为了取悦对方，使其答应请求。

meanings.exampleEn: The tropical climate of Hainan Island is ideal for cultivating pineapple, which has become a major export commodity.
meanings.exampleZh: 海南岛的热带气候非常适合种植菠萝，菠萝已成为主要的出口商品。

meanings.exampleEn: After being laid off, he had to rely on pineapple to make ends meet until he found a new job.
meanings.exampleZh: 被解雇后，他不得不依靠失业救济金维持生计，直到找到新工作。

etymology.root: pine = 松树；apple = 苹果（复合词）
etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 pinapple，原指松果，后因菠萝外形似松果而命名
etymology.tip: pine（松树）+ apple（苹果），松树上的苹果？其实是菠萝

meanings.exampleEn: The senior partner in the law firm decided to retire after decades of service.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家律师事务所的高级合伙人服务数十年后决定退休。

meanings.exampleEn: As a silent partner, he invested heavily in the startup but rarely attended board meetings.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一位隐名股东，他向这家初创公司投入巨资，却很少出席董事会会议。

meanings.exampleEn: Countries that are reliable trading partners often enjoy mutual economic prosperity.
meanings.exampleZh: 互为可靠贸易伙伴的国家往往能共享经济繁荣。

meanings.exampleEn: She chose her life partner based on shared values rather than superficial charm.
meanings.exampleZh: 她基于共同的价值观而非表面的魅力来选择人生伴侣。

meanings.exampleEn: The two companies partnered to develop an innovative renewable energy solution.
meanings.exampleZh: 两家公司合伙开发一种创新的可再生能源解决方案。

meanings.exampleEn: The teacher partnered each student with a native speaker to enhance their conversational skills.
meanings.exampleZh: 老师把每个学生与一位母语者配对，以提高他们的会话能力。

variants.zh: 合伙人；股东；伙伴；伴侣（复数）
合伙；配对（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 parçonier，源于拉丁语 partitionem（分享、分配）

meanings.exampleEn: The new pipeline will transport natural gas from the remote fields to the coastal refinery.
meanings.exampleZh: 新的管道将把天然气从偏远的油田输送到沿海炼油厂。

meanings.exampleEn: The company has established a reliable pipeline for recruiting top talent from universities.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司已经建立了一条从大学招聘顶尖人才的可靠渠道。

variants.zh: 管道；管线；传递途径（复数）

etymology.origin: 由 pipe（管子）+ line（线路）组成的复合词
etymology.tip: pipe（管子）+ line（线路）= 管线；联想：管道就是由管子连成的线路

meanings.exampleEn: The arrow pierced the knight's armor with incredible force.
meanings.exampleZh: 箭以惊人的力量刺穿了骑士的盔甲。

meanings.exampleEn: The cold wind pierced through his thin coat, making him shiver.
meanings.exampleZh: 寒风穿透他的薄外套，使他发抖。

meanings.exampleEn: She pierced her ears to wear the delicate gold earrings.
meanings.exampleZh: 她给耳朵打了眼，以便戴精致的金耳环。

meanings.exampleEn: The detective pierced the suspect's lies and uncovered the truth.
meanings.exampleZh: 侦探洞悉了嫌疑人的谎言，揭露了真相。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 percier，源自拉丁语 pertundere（刺穿），由 per-（通过）+ tundere（击打）构成
etymology.tip: per-（穿透）+ 击打 → 刺穿；联想：用针“穿透”物体就是 pierce

peep.zh: 一瞥；偷看；不完全的景象；初现

meanings.exampleEn: She caught a peep of the celebrity through the crowd.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在人群中瞥见了那位名人。

meanings.exampleEn: He took a quick peep through the keyhole before opening the door.
meanings.exampleZh: 开门前他从锁孔里快速偷看了一眼。

meanings.exampleEn: The thick fog allowed only a peep of the distant mountains.
meanings.exampleZh: 浓雾只让人看到远山的一角。

meanings.exampleEn: The first peep of dawn appeared over the horizon.
meanings.exampleZh: 黎明初现于地平线。

meanings.exampleEn: Stop peeping at your neighbor's paper during the exam.
meanings.exampleZh: 考试时不要偷看邻座的试卷。

meanings.exampleEn: The moon peeped out from behind the clouds.
meanings.exampleZh: 月亮从云后微现。

meanings.exampleEn: The chicks peeped softly in the nest, waiting for their mother.
meanings.exampleZh: 小鸡在巢里轻轻地吱吱叫，等待着妈妈。

variants.zh: 偷看；窥视；微现；发出吱吱声（第三人称单数）

meanings.exampleEn: The region has plentiful rainfall, which makes it ideal for agriculture.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区降雨充沛，非常适合农业。

etymology.tip: plenty（大量）+ -ful（充满）→ 充满大量的，即“丰富的”

pillar.zh: 柱子；栋梁；台柱；重要的支持者

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient temple's massive pillars have withstood centuries of earthquakes and storms.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古老寺庙的巨大柱子经受住了几个世纪的地震和风暴。

meanings.zh: 栋梁；台柱；重要的支持者
meanings.exampleEn: She has long been regarded as a pillar of the local community, organizing charity events and mentoring young people.
meanings.exampleZh: 她长期以来被视为当地社区的栋梁，组织慈善活动并指导年轻人。

etymology.root: pil = 柱（来自拉丁语 pila）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pila（柱子），经古法语 piler 进入中古英语，后拼写演变为 pillar
etymology.tip: pil（柱）+ -ar（名词后缀）→ 柱子；引申为栋梁、支持者

physics.zh: 物理学；物理过程；物理现象

meanings.exampleEn: The principles of physics govern the behavior of matter and energy in the universe.
meanings.exampleZh: 物理学的原理支配着宇宙中物质和能量的行为。

meanings.exampleEn: The researchers studied the physics of fluid turbulence in the laboratory.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究人员在实验室研究了流体湍流的物理过程。

meanings.exampleEn: The physics of the aurora borealis has fascinated scientists for centuries.
meanings.exampleZh: 北极光的物理现象几个世纪以来一直令科学家着迷。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 physika，意为“自然事物”，源自 physis（自然）

meanings.exampleEn: The word 'children' is a plural noun, while 'child' is singular.

meanings.exampleEn: In English, most nouns form their plural by adding -s or -es.
meanings.exampleZh: 在英语中，大多数名词通过加 -s 或 -es 构成复数形式。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pluralis，源自 plus（更多）
etymology.tip: plur（更多）+ -al（的）→ 多于一个的 → 复数的

politician.zh: 政客；政治家；从事党派政治的人

meanings.zh: 政客；政治家；从事党派政治的人
meanings.exampleEn: The politician promised to reform the healthcare system if elected.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位政客承诺如果当选将改革医疗体系。

variants.zh: 使政治化；使具有政治性

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 polites（公民），经由拉丁语 politicus、法语 politicien 演变而来
etymology.tip: polit（城市）+ ician（人）→ 管理城市事务的人 → 政客

particular.zh: 一项(或条、点)；个别项目；详细说明

meanings.exampleZh: 研究人员专注于这一现象的特定方面，忽略了其余部分。

meanings.exampleEn: She showed particular concern for the welfare of the refugees.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对难民的福祉表现出特别的关心。

meanings.exampleEn: He is very particular about the quality of the ingredients he uses in cooking.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对自己烹饪所用食材的质量非常讲究。

meanings.exampleEn: The report is accurate in every particular.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份报告的每一个细节都很准确。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 particularis，由 particula（小部分）派生，particula 是 pars（部分）的指小词
etymology.tip: part（部分）+ -icular（小……的）→ 整体中的小部分 → 个别的、特别的

meanings.exampleEn: She padded the box with cotton to protect the fragile vase during transit.

填补；步行（过去式/过去分词）

meanings.exampleEn: She pleaded with the kidnappers to release her child.

variants.zh: 恳求；辩护（过去式/过去分词）
恳求；辩护（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 plaidier，源自拉丁语 placitum（判决），与 placere（取悦）同源

pint.zh: 品脱(干量或液量的单位)

meanings.zh: 品脱（干量或液量的单位）

meanings.exampleZh: 这个食谱需要一品脱奶油，在英国约合568毫升。

meanings.exampleEn: The train was already pulling into the platform when we arrived at the station.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们到达车站时，火车已经驶入站台。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor stepped onto the platform and began her lecture on modern linguistics.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授走上讲台，开始她关于现代语言学的讲座。

meanings.exampleEn: This online platform provides a space for young scholars to exchange innovative ideas.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个在线论坛为年轻学者提供了交流创新想法的空间。

variants.zh: 站台；月台；讲台；论坛（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自法语 plateforme，由 plat（平的）+ forme（形状）组合而成，原义为“扁平的结构”，后引申为“平台、站台”等义。

physician.zh: 医师；内科医师；解除痛苦者

meanings.exampleEn: The physician prescribed a new medication to alleviate the patient's chronic pain.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位医师开了一种新药来缓解病人的慢性疼痛。

meanings.exampleEn: The physician advised the patient to undergo a comprehensive metabolic panel to identify the cause of fatigue.

meanings.exampleEn: In ancient times, a physician was often regarded as a healer who could relieve both physical and spiritual suffering.
meanings.exampleZh: 在古代，医师常被视为能解除身体和精神痛苦的医治者。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 physis（自然），经拉丁语 physica 和古法语 fisicien 演变而来
etymology.tip: phys（身体）+ ician（人）→ 研究身体的人 → 医师

pigeon.zh: 鸽子；易上当受骗的人；年轻女子

meanings.exampleEn: The pigeon on the windowsill cooed softly at dawn.
meanings.exampleZh: 窗台上的鸽子在黎明时轻柔地咕咕叫。

meanings.exampleEn: He was a pigeon in the card game, easily cheated by the gamblers.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在牌局中是个容易上当受骗的人，轻易就被赌徒们骗了。

meanings.exampleEn: The poet's muse was a young pigeon from the village.
meanings.exampleZh: 诗人的缪斯是村里的一位年轻女子。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pipio（幼鸟，吱吱叫的鸟），经古法语 pijon 进入英语；属基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: 无词根词缀，可联想鸽子咕咕叫的声音来记忆。

meanings.exampleEn: The region has plenty of natural resources, yet its economy remains underdeveloped.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区拥有丰富的自然资源，然而其经济仍不发达。

meanings.exampleEn: We have plenty time to discuss the details before making a decision.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们有足够的时间在做出决定前讨论细节。

meanings.exampleEn: The lecture hall is plenty large enough to accommodate all the students.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个演讲厅足够大，能容纳所有学生。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 plenus（满的），经古法语 plenté 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ty 构成抽象名词，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: plen（满）+ ty（名词后缀）→ 满的状态 → 充足、丰富

meanings.exampleEn: The poet's latest collection explores the boundary between prose and poetry.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位诗人最新的作品集探讨了散文与诗歌之间的界限。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 poesis，源自希腊语 poiesis，意为“创作、制作”，后指诗歌创作
etymology.suffix: -ry = 集合名词后缀，表示…的艺术/作品
etymology.tip: 诗人是创造者，poetry 就是“创造出来的艺术”——诗歌。

plastic.zh: 塑料；可塑体；可塑性物质

meanings.exampleEn: The accumulation of plastic waste in the ocean has become a severe ecological crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 海洋中塑料垃圾的堆积已成为严重的生态危机。

meanings.exampleEn: In sculpture class, the clay served as a highly adaptable plastic for the students' creative designs.
meanings.exampleZh: 在雕塑课上，黏土作为一种高度可塑的材料，供学生们进行创意设计。

meanings.exampleEn: Certain synthetic resins are considered excellent plastics due to their ability to be molded under heat.
meanings.exampleZh: 某些合成树脂因在受热条件下易于成型，被认为是极好的可塑性物质。

meanings.exampleEn: The government has imposed a ban on single-use plastic cutlery to reduce environmental pollution.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已禁止使用一次性塑料餐具以减少环境污染。

meanings.exampleEn: Human memory is not a plastic entity that can be endlessly reshaped without consequence.
meanings.exampleZh: 人类记忆并非一种可以无限制重塑而不产生后果的可塑实体。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 plastikos（可塑造的），源于 plassein（塑造）
etymology.tip: plast（塑造）+ ic（...的）→ 可塑造的 → 塑料

meanings.exampleEn: The mountain slopes were covered with dense pine forests, providing habitat for diverse wildlife.
meanings.exampleZh: 山坡上覆盖着茂密的松林，为多种野生动物提供了栖息地。

meanings.exampleEn: The cabin was built of sturdy pine, which resisted decay for decades.
meanings.exampleZh: 这间小屋用坚固的松木建造，数十年来不易腐朽。

meanings.zh: 渴望，思念（常与 for 连用）
meanings.exampleEn: He pined for his homeland while studying abroad.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在国外学习时思念家乡。

meanings.exampleEn: After her husband died, she pined away for years.
meanings.exampleZh: 丈夫去世后，她多年来日渐憔悴。

variants.zh: 渴望，思念（第三人称单数）
渴望，思念；憔悴（过去式/过去分词）
渴望，思念；憔悴（现在分词）

etymology.root: pin（来自拉丁语 pinus）= 松树
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pinus（松树），经古法语 pin 进入中古英语
etymology.tip: pine 与 pin（针）形近，松树针叶如针，联想记忆

meanings.exampleEn: The government has implemented new policies to control the rapid population growth in urban areas.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已实施新政策以控制城市地区快速的人口增长。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 populus（人民），经由法语 population 进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ation = 表示行为、状态、结果的名词后缀
etymology.tip: popul（人民）+ -ation（名词后缀）→ 人民的总数 → 人口

meanings.exampleEn: The exasperated manager pinched the bridge of his nose before responding to the unreasonable demand.
meanings.exampleZh: 恼怒的经理在回应不合理要求前捏了捏鼻梁。

meanings.exampleEn: These newly purchased leather shoes pinch, particularly after prolonged walking.
meanings.exampleZh: 这双新买的皮鞋夹脚，尤其是长时间行走后。

meanings.exampleEn: The pickpocket was caught pinching a wallet from an unsuspecting tourist.
meanings.exampleZh: 扒手从毫无戒备的游客身上偷钱包时被抓住了。

meanings.exampleEn: She gave his cheek a playful pinch as a gesture of affectionate teasing.
meanings.exampleZh: 她开玩笑地捏了一下他的脸颊，以示亲昵的逗弄。

meanings.exampleEn: A pinch of cinnamon can dramatically enhance the aroma of the dessert.
meanings.exampleZh: 一小撮肉桂能显著提升甜点的香气。

variants.zh: 捏；掐；拧（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 pinchier，词源不明，无明显词根词缀

plain.zh: 平原；草原；朴实无华的东西；无格式

meanings.exampleEn: The vast plain stretched to the horizon, dotted with herds of wild antelope.
meanings.exampleZh: 广阔的平原一直延伸到地平线，点缀着成群的野生羚羊。

meanings.exampleEn: Her explanation made the complex theory plain to every student in the class.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的解释使这个复杂的理论对班上每个学生都一目了然。

meanings.exampleEn: The instructions are written in plain language so that even beginners can follow them.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些说明用简单的语言写成，以便初学者也能理解。

meanings.exampleEn: She wore a plain black dress to the interview, avoiding any unnecessary decoration.
meanings.exampleZh: 她穿了一件朴素的黑裙子去面试，避免任何多余的装饰。

meanings.exampleEn: The plain terrain of the region makes it ideal for constructing new roads.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区平坦的地形非常适合修建新道路。

meanings.exampleEn: His accusation was plain wrong, and he later apologized for the misunderstanding.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的指控完全错误，后来他为这一误解道了歉。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 planus（平的），经古法语 plain 进入英语。
etymology.tip: plain 与 plane 同源，都是“平”；平原平坦，说话平实易懂。

meanings.exampleEn: The security forces conducted a routine patrol along the border at dawn.
meanings.exampleZh: 安全部队在黎明时分沿边境进行了例行巡逻。

meanings.exampleEn: A patrol of armed guards was dispatched to the remote outpost.
meanings.exampleZh: 一支武装警卫巡逻队被派往偏远的哨所。

meanings.exampleEn: Armed guards patrol the perimeter of the facility every night.
meanings.exampleZh: 武装警卫每晚在设施周边巡逻。

etymology.origin: 来自法语 patrouiller，原意'用脚掌踩踏/在泥泞中跋涉'，后引申为'巡逻'
etymology.tip: patrol = pat（脚掌）+ rol（转），脚掌来回走动，即巡逻

popular.zh: 通俗的；流行的；受欢迎的；大众的

meanings.zh: 流行的；受欢迎的；通俗的；大众的
meanings.exampleEn: The online course has become increasingly popular among college students seeking flexible learning schedules.
meanings.exampleZh: 这门在线课程在寻求灵活学习时间安排的大学生中变得越来越受欢迎。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 popularis，源自 populus（人民）
etymology.tip: popul（人民）+ -ar（……的）→ 属于人民的 → 大众的、流行的

meanings.exampleEn: The old couple sat on the porch, watching the rain fall on the garden.
meanings.exampleZh: 那对老夫妇坐在门廊上，看着雨落在花园里。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 porticus（柱廊），经古法语 porche 进入英语
etymology.tip: 门（port）前有廊（porch），记住“门廊”就是 porch。

meanings.exampleEn: The museum has a remarkable collection of ancient Chinese porcelain.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家博物馆收藏了一批令人惊叹的中国古代瓷器。

etymology.origin: 来自法语 porcelaine，源自意大利语 porcellana，原指一种光滑的贝壳，后因其质地与瓷器相似而转指瓷器。
etymology.tip: 联想“贝壳光滑如瓷”，porcelain 就是那光洁的瓷器。

political.zh: 政治的；政治上的；政党的；从事政治的

meanings.exampleEn: The political landscape of the region has shifted dramatically over the past decade.
meanings.exampleZh: 过去十年间，该地区的政治格局发生了巨大变化。

meanings.exampleEn: His political allegiance to the ruling party remained unwavering throughout the crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 在整个危机期间，他对执政党的政治忠诚始终坚定不移。

meanings.exampleEn: She decided to pursue a political career after years of grassroots activism.
meanings.exampleZh: 在多年基层活动之后，她决定从事政治事业。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 polis（城市），经由拉丁语 politicus 和法语 politique 进入英语
etymology.tip: polit（城市/公民）+ ical（形容词后缀）→ 关于城市公民事务的 → 政治的

meanings.exampleEn: Industrial waste has severely polluted the river, making the water undrinkable.
meanings.exampleZh: 工业废料严重污染了这条河，使水无法饮用。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 polluere，由 pol-（完全）与 lutum（泥）组合，本义为“用泥弄脏”。
etymology.tip: pol（彻底）+ lut（泥）+ e → 彻底弄上泥 → 污染

meanings.exampleEn: He poked the embers with a long iron rod, sending a shower of sparks into the night air.
meanings.exampleZh: 他用一根长铁杆拨弄余烬，激起一阵火花飞入夜空。

meanings.exampleEn: A curious squirrel poked out from behind the tree trunk, watching the hikers intently.
meanings.exampleZh: 一只好奇的松鼠从树干后探出头来，专注地看着徒步者。

meanings.exampleEn: She gave him a playful poke in the arm to wake him from his daydream.
meanings.exampleZh: 她开玩笑地戳了一下他的胳膊，把他从白日梦中唤醒。

meanings.exampleEn: The old woman carried her groceries in a brown paper poke, a relic of a bygone era.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位老妇人用一只棕色纸袋装着杂货，那是过去时代的遗物。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The polarity of the magnet determines the direction of the magnetic field.
meanings.exampleZh: 磁体的极性决定了磁场的方向。

meanings.exampleEn: There is a growing polarity between the rich and the poor in modern society.
meanings.exampleZh: 在现代社会中，富人与穷人之间存在着日益加剧的截然对立。

variants.zh: 极地的；极性的；截然对立的

etymology.root: polar = 极的，来自拉丁语 polus（轴、极）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 polus，经由法语 polarité 进入英语，原指天极或地极，后引申为极性及对立性。
etymology.suffix: -ity = 表示性质、状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: polar（极的）+ -ity（性质）→ 极性；两极之间的对立就是“截然相反”。

meanings.exampleEn: The government's new economic policy aims to curb inflation while promoting sustainable growth.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府的新经济政策旨在抑制通货膨胀，同时促进可持续增长。

meanings.exampleEn: It is the company's policy to maintain absolute transparency in all financial dealings.
meanings.exampleZh: 在所有财务交易中保持绝对透明是公司的方针。

meanings.exampleEn: Adopting a wait-and-see policy, the investors refrained from making any hasty decisions.
meanings.exampleZh: 采取观望策略，投资者们避免做出任何草率的决定。

meanings.exampleEn: Before signing the policy, please read the clauses regarding coverage and exclusions carefully.
meanings.exampleZh: 在签署保险单之前，请仔细阅读有关承保范围和免责条款的条文。

variants.zh: 政策；方针；策略；保险单（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 politia，源自古希腊语 politeia（城邦治理、公民权）
etymology.tip: polit（城市/国家）+ cy（制度）→ 治理国家的制度 → 政策

pneumatic.zh: 充气的；空气的；有气胎的；气动的

meanings.exampleEn: The pneumatic mattress can be inflated in minutes for camping.
meanings.exampleZh: 充气床垫几分钟内就能充好，适合露营。

meanings.exampleEn: Pneumatic pressure is often used to describe the force exerted by compressed air.
meanings.exampleZh: 气压常用来描述压缩空气所产生的力。

meanings.exampleEn: Pneumatic tires absorb shocks better than solid rubber ones.
meanings.exampleZh: 有气胎的轮胎比实心橡胶轮胎更能吸收震动。

meanings.exampleEn: The factory uses pneumatic tools to assemble the components quickly.
meanings.exampleZh: 工厂使用气动工具快速组装零件。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 pneuma（风，空气，呼吸），经拉丁语 pneumaticus 进入英语
etymology.tip: pneumat（空气）+ ic（的）→ 与空气有关的，即充气的、气动的

polar.zh: 两极的；极地的；正好相反的；极性的

meanings.exampleEn: The polar regions are experiencing unprecedented ice melt due to global warming.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于全球变暖，极地地区正经历前所未有的冰层融化。

meanings.exampleEn: The two politicians hold polar views on almost every major issue.
meanings.exampleZh: 这两位政治家在几乎所有重大问题上都持截然相反的观点。

meanings.exampleEn: Water molecules are polar, which allows them to dissolve many ionic compounds.
meanings.exampleZh: 水分子是极性的，这使得它们能够溶解许多离子化合物。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 polaris，源于希腊语 polos（轴、天极）
etymology.tip: pol（极）+ -ar（形容词后缀）→ 与极有关的 → 极地的；两极的

meanings.exampleEn: The pond was teeming with aquatic life, reflecting the surrounding willows in its placid surface.
meanings.exampleZh: 池塘里充满水生生物，平静的水面倒映着周围的柳树。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

plantation.zh: 种植园；大农场；植树造林；新开垦地

meanings.exampleEn: The slaves on the cotton plantation worked from dawn to dusk.
meanings.exampleZh: 棉花种植园里的奴隶从黎明工作到黄昏。

meanings.exampleEn: He inherited a vast plantation in the countryside from his grandfather.
meanings.exampleZh: 他从祖父那里继承了一座位于乡间的大农场。

meanings.exampleEn: The government encouraged plantation of native trees to restore the damaged ecosystem.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府鼓励植树造林，种植本土树种以恢复受损的生态系统。

meanings.exampleEn: The settlers established a new plantation on the fertile land near the river.
meanings.exampleZh: 定居者在河边肥沃的土地上建立了一片新开垦地。

variants.zh: 种植园；大农场；植树造林；新开垦地（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 plantatio，经由法语 plantation 进入英语，原意为“栽种、种植”。
etymology.suffix: -ation = 表示行为、状态或结果的名词后缀
etymology.tip: plant（种植）+ -ation（名词后缀）→ 种植出来的地方 → 种植园。

meanings.exampleEn: The politician's popularity was severely tarnished by the corruption scandal.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位政客的名声因腐败丑闻而严重受损。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel has gained immense popularity among young readers worldwide.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说在全球年轻读者中获得了极高的人气。

meanings.exampleEn: The popularity of streaming services has fundamentally transformed the entertainment industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 流媒体服务的普及从根本上改变了娱乐产业。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 populus（人民），经由法语 popularité 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: 人民（popul）喜欢的程度（-ity）就是流行度

meanings.exampleEn: The satellite was maneuvered into its correct position above the Earth.
meanings.exampleZh: 卫星被调整到地球上方正确的位置。

meanings.exampleEn: She has risen to a position of great influence in the academic world.
meanings.exampleZh: 她已在学术界上升到极具影响力的地位。

meanings.exampleEn: His official position as ambassador grants him diplomatic immunity.
meanings.exampleZh: 他作为大使的官方身分赋予他外交豁免权。

meanings.exampleEn: Given the current financial position, the company must cut costs immediately.
meanings.exampleZh: 鉴于当前的财务形势，公司必须立即削减成本。

meanings.exampleEn: The photographer positioned the model to capture the best light.
meanings.exampleZh: 摄影师安置好模特的位置，以捕捉最佳光线。

variants.zh: 位置；地位；身分；形势（复数）
安置；定位（第三人称单数）
安置；定位（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 ponere 的过去分词 positus，意为“被放置的”
etymology.suffix: -ition = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: pos（放置）+ -ition（名词后缀）→ 被放置的地方 → 位置

porter.zh: 大楼管理员；门房；搬运工人；侍者

meanings.exampleEn: The porter at the apartment building knows every resident by name.
meanings.exampleZh: 公寓大楼的管理员知道每一位住户的名字。

meanings.exampleEn: A porter helped us carry our luggage to the hotel room.
meanings.exampleZh: 一位搬运工人帮我们把行李搬到了酒店房间。

meanings.exampleEn: The hotel porter recommended a quiet restaurant near the square.
meanings.exampleZh: 酒店侍者推荐了广场附近一家安静的餐厅。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 porteur，源自拉丁语 portator，由 portare（携带）+ -er（施动者）构成
etymology.tip: port（携带）+ er（人）→ 搬运东西的人 → 搬运工/门房

meanings.exampleEn: The new material is a polymer that can be molded into various shapes.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种新材料是一种可以模塑成各种形状的聚合物。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 polymers，由 poly-（多）和 meros（部分）组合而成，意为“由许多部分组成的”。
etymology.tip: poly（多）+ mer（部分）→ 由许多重复单元组成的物质，即“聚合物”。

pink.zh: 粉红色；石竹花；化身；典范

meanings.exampleEn: She dyed her curtains a delicate shade of pink to match the new sofa.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把窗帘染成淡粉红色，以搭配新沙发。

meanings.exampleEn: The garden was bordered with fragrant pinks that attracted butterflies in summer.
meanings.exampleZh: 花园边缘种满了芬芳的石竹花，夏天吸引蝴蝶。

meanings.exampleEn: He was the very pink of courtesy, always offering his seat to the elderly.
meanings.exampleZh: 他是礼貌的化身，总是给老人让座。

meanings.exampleEn: Her performance was the pink of perfection, leaving the judges no room for criticism.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的表演是完美的典范，让评委毫无批评余地。

meanings.exampleEn: The setting sun cast a pink glow over the snow-capped mountains.
meanings.exampleZh: 夕阳在雪山上投下粉红色的光辉。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The explorers discovered a deep pit hidden beneath the dense forest canopy.
meanings.exampleZh: 探险家在茂密林冠下发现了一个深坑。

meanings.exampleEn: Working in a coal pit requires strict adherence to safety regulations.
meanings.exampleZh: 在煤矿矿井工作必须严格遵守安全规定。

meanings.exampleEn: She carefully removed the pit from the avocado before slicing it.
meanings.exampleZh: 切片前她小心地去掉牛油果的果核。

meanings.exampleEn: The old farmhouse had a dark pit used for storing root vegetables.
meanings.exampleZh: 那座老农舍有一个用来储存根茎蔬菜的黑暗地窖。

meanings.exampleEn: The acid rain has pitted the ancient stone statues.
meanings.exampleZh: 酸雨使古代石像表面出现了凹痕。

variants.zh: 深坑；矿井；果核；地窖（复数）
挖坑于；使凹陷（第三人称单数）
挖坑于；使凹陷（过去式/过去分词）
挖坑于；使凹陷（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 pytt，源自拉丁语 puteus（井）

meanings.exampleEn: The workers protested against the delay in their weekly payoff.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们抗议每周发薪被拖延。

meanings.exampleEn: The gang members gathered to divide the payoff from the bank robbery.
meanings.exampleZh: 团伙成员聚在一起瓜分银行抢劫的分赃。

meanings.exampleEn: The inspector was dismissed for accepting a payoff from the construction company.
meanings.exampleZh: 该检查员因收受建筑公司的贿赂而被解职。

meanings.exampleEn: The long-term investment finally produced a substantial payoff.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项长期投资最终产生了可观的盈利。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 paier，源自拉丁语 pacare（安抚，偿还），后与副词 off 构成短语动词 pay off，再名词化为 payoff
etymology.tip: pay（支付）+ off（清偿）→ 付清后得到回报；引申为贿赂、分赃

meanings.exampleEn: The postal service has been modernized to handle the increasing volume of online shopping deliveries.
meanings.exampleZh: 邮政服务已经现代化，以处理日益增长的网购包裹量。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 posita（放置），经由古法语 poste 和意大利语 posta，指驿站或邮递系统
etymology.tip: post（邮政）+ al（形容词后缀）→ 邮政的

meanings.exampleEn: The Polish economy has experienced remarkable growth since joining the European Union.
meanings.exampleZh: 波兰经济自加入欧盟以来经历了显著增长。

meanings.exampleEn: She is proud of her Polish heritage and often celebrates traditional festivals.
meanings.exampleZh: 她为自己的波兰血统感到自豪，经常庆祝传统节日。

meanings.exampleEn: Polish literature boasts a rich tradition of poetry and prose.
meanings.exampleZh: 波兰文学拥有悠久的诗歌和散文传统。

meanings.exampleEn: Learning Polish can be challenging due to its complex grammar and pronunciation.
meanings.exampleZh: 学习波兰语可能具有挑战性，因为其语法和发音复杂。

meanings.exampleEn: The Polish have made significant contributions to science and art.
meanings.exampleZh: 波兰人为科学和艺术做出了重大贡献。

etymology.origin: 来自波兰语 Polanie（平原居民），经由拉丁语 Polonia 进入英语
etymology.tip: Pol-（田野）+ -ish（...的）→ 田野上的民族 → 波兰的

meanings.exampleEn: The poultry industry has been severely affected by the outbreak of avian influenza.
meanings.exampleZh: 家禽业因禽流感的爆发而受到严重影响。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 pouletrie，源于 poulet（小鸡），后指家禽总称
etymology.suffix: -ry = 集合名词后缀，表示一类事物或场所
etymology.tip: poult（幼禽）+ -ry（集合）→ 幼禽集合 → 家禽

portable.zh: 可携带的；可搬运的；可移动的

meanings.zh: 可携带的；可搬运的；可移动的
meanings.exampleEn: The portable generator provided electricity for the entire campsite during the storm.
meanings.exampleZh: 这台便携式发电机在暴风雨期间为整个营地提供了电力。

phrases.zh: 便携式电脑，笔记本电脑

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 portare（搬运，携带），经古法语 portable 进入英语。
etymology.tip: port（搬运）+ able（可……的）→ 可以搬运的 → 便携的。

obscure.zh: 模糊的；昏暗的；难解的；晦涩的

meanings.exampleEn: The details of the contract remain obscure to most employees.
meanings.exampleZh: 合同细节对大多数员工来说仍然模糊不清。

meanings.exampleEn: The obscure lighting in the corridor made it difficult to find the exit.
meanings.exampleZh: 走廊里昏暗的灯光使人很难找到出口。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor's explanation was so obscure that even the top students were confused.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授的解释如此难解，连最优秀的学生都感到困惑。

meanings.exampleEn: His poetry is full of obscure references that only a few scholars can understand.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的诗歌充满了晦涩的典故，只有少数学者能理解。

meanings.exampleEn: The new evidence only obscures the truth rather than clarifying it.
meanings.exampleZh: 新证据反而使真相更加模糊，而非使其清晰。

phrases.zh: 混淆问题；使问题变得模糊
起源不明的；来历不明的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 obscurus，由 ob- + -scurus 构成，原义为‘被覆盖的、黑暗的’
etymology.tip: ob-（在...之上）+ scur（覆盖）→ 被覆盖住，所以模糊、昏暗

meanings.exampleEn: The theory postulates that the universe is expanding at an accelerating rate.
meanings.exampleZh: 该理论假定宇宙正在加速膨胀。

meanings.exampleEn: The basic postulate of democracy is that all citizens are equal before the law.
meanings.exampleZh: 民主的基本条件是所有公民在法律面前一律平等。

variants.zh: 假定；假设（过去式/过去分词）
假定；假设（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 postulare（要求，请求），经由法语 postuler 进入英语。
etymology.tip: postul（要求）+ -ate（动词）→ 提出要求 → 引申为“假定、假设”

meanings.exampleEn: The poet recited a beautiful poem at the ceremony.
meanings.exampleZh: 诗人在仪式上朗诵了一首优美的诗。

meanings.exampleEn: The sunset over the ocean was a poem in itself.
meanings.exampleZh: 海上的日落本身就是一首诗般美的事物。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 poiēma（作品，诗），源于 poiein（制作，创造），经拉丁语 poema 进入英语
etymology.tip: 诗是“制作”出来的文字作品——poem

meanings.exampleEn: For breakfast, he ate a bowl of steaming porridge with honey.
meanings.exampleZh: 早餐时，他吃了一碗热气腾腾的加蜂蜜的粥。

meanings.exampleEn: The mixture was stirred until it became a thick porridge.
meanings.exampleZh: 混合物被搅拌至变成浓稠的糊状物。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 potage（汤），由 pot（锅）+ -age 构成，后演变为 porridge。
etymology.tip: porridge 与 pot（锅）同源，锅里煮出来的粥。

meanings.exampleEn: The environmental activists put up a poster on the campus bulletin board to call for immediate action on climate change.
meanings.exampleZh: 环保活动人士在校园公告栏上张贴了一张海报，呼吁立即采取行动应对气候变化。

meanings.exampleEn: In ancient times, the poster galloped across the plains to deliver urgent imperial decrees without delay.
meanings.exampleZh: 在古代，驿马疾驰过平原，以毫不耽搁地传递紧急的皇帝诏令。

phrases.zh: （常用于宣传的）代表人物；封面人物

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 positus（放置），经由古法语 poste 和英语 post（张贴；邮件），后加名词后缀 -er 表示“张贴之物”
etymology.tip: post（张贴）+ er（物）→ 张贴出来的东西 → 海报

meanings.exampleEn: It requires considerable pluck to challenge the established norms in academia.
meanings.exampleZh: 在学术界挑战既定规范需要相当大的勇气。

meanings.exampleEn: The chef prepared a traditional dish using the pluck of a freshly slaughtered lamb.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨师用刚宰杀的羊的内脏制作了一道传统菜肴。

meanings.exampleEn: She plucked the child's sleeve to prevent him from stepping into the road.
meanings.exampleZh: 她猛拉孩子的袖子，防止他走到马路上。

meanings.exampleEn: The old woman carefully plucked the grey hairs from her scalp.
meanings.exampleZh: 老妇人小心地拔掉头皮上的白发。

variants.zh: 拔；猛拉（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 pluccian（采摘、拔）
etymology.tip: pluck 与 pull 相近，猛拉（pull）需要勇气（pluck）

meanings.exampleEn: The committee decided to postpone the meeting until next Friday due to the unexpected conflict.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于意外的冲突，委员会决定将会议推迟到下周五。

variants.zh: 推迟（postpone的过去式和过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 postponere，由 post（后）+ ponere（放）构成，意为“放到后面”，引申为“推迟”。
etymology.tip: post（后）+ pone（放）→ 放到后面 → 推迟

meanings.exampleEn: The pilgrim carried only a small pack as he journeyed through unfamiliar lands.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位旅行者只背了一个小包，穿行于陌生的土地。

meanings.exampleEn: Every year, thousands of pilgrims visit the holy city of Jerusalem.
meanings.exampleZh: 每年成千上万的朝圣者访问圣城耶路撒冷。

meanings.exampleEn: The pilgrims offered incense and prayers at the ancient temple.
meanings.exampleZh: 香客们在古庙中上香祈祷。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 peregrinus（异乡人、旅行者），由 per-（穿过）+ ager（土地）构成，经古法语 pelerin 进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -im（名词后缀，由拉丁语 -inus 演变而来）
etymology.tip: per（穿过）+ agr（土地）+ -im → 穿行于土地之上的人 → 朝圣者

plaster.zh: 石膏；灰泥；安慰(缓解)用品；膏药

meanings.exampleEn: The sculptor mixed plaster to create a life-sized bust.
meanings.exampleZh: 雕塑家混合石膏制作了一个真人大小的半身像。

meanings.exampleEn: The old walls were covered with a layer of plaster that had begun to crack.
meanings.exampleZh: 旧墙上覆盖的一层灰泥已经开始开裂。

meanings.exampleEn: He applied a plaster to the wound to relieve the pain and promote healing.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在伤口上贴了一块膏药以缓解疼痛并促进愈合。

meanings.exampleEn: They plastered the interior walls before painting the room.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们在粉刷房间之前给内墙涂上了灰泥。

meanings.exampleEn: Rain plastered his hair to his forehead as he ran across the campus.
meanings.exampleZh: 雨水打湿了他的头发，使其紧贴在前额上，他跑过校园。

variants.zh: 涂灰泥；粘贴（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 emplastron（膏药），由 en-（在上）和 plastos（塑造的）构成，经拉丁语 emplastrum、古法语 plastre 进入英语
etymology.tip: plast-（塑造）→ 用来塑造、涂抹的材料就是 plaster（石膏/灰泥）

meanings.exampleEn: There is a strong possibility that the conference will be postponed due to the severe weather.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于恶劣天气，会议被推迟的可能性很大。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 possibilitas，源自 posse（能够）
etymology.tip: poss（能够）+ -ibility（性质）→ 能够的性质 → 可能性

meanings.exampleEn: The project is practically finished; we only need to polish a few details.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个项目几乎完成了，我们只需要再润色几个细节。

meanings.exampleEn: Practically speaking, his proposal is impossible to implement within the budget.
meanings.exampleZh: 事实上，他的提议在预算内是不可能实施的。

phrases.zh: 实际上来说；从实际角度讲
几乎一切；几乎所有东西

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 practicus，源自希腊语 praktikos，意为“适合行动的、实践的”
etymology.tip: practically = pract（实践）+ -ical（形容词后缀）+ -ly（副词后缀），实践上做出来的结果就是“事实上、几乎”。

pet.zh: 宠物；受宠爱的人；宠坏的孩子；不悦

meanings.exampleEn: Keeping a pet entails a long-term commitment to its well-being.
meanings.exampleZh: 养宠物需要对其福祉做出长期承诺。

meanings.exampleEn: As the youngest child, she was the pet of the entire family.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为最小的孩子，她是全家的宠儿。

meanings.exampleEn: The family's pet, a thoroughly spoiled child, threw a tantrum at the dinner table.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个家庭的宠儿，一个被宠坏的孩子，在餐桌上大发脾气。

meanings.exampleEn: He stormed out of the meeting in a pet over the rejected proposal.
meanings.exampleZh: 他因提议被否决而气冲冲地离开了会议室。

meanings.exampleEn: She gently petted the anxious dog to soothe its nerves.
meanings.exampleZh: 她轻轻抚摸那只焦虑的狗，以安抚它的情绪。

meanings.exampleEn: The doting grandparents petted their granddaughter with lavish gifts.
meanings.exampleZh: 溺爱孙女的祖父母用奢华的礼物宠爱她。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor's pet theory was eventually validated by a series of experiments.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位教授钟爱的理论最终通过一系列实验得到了验证。

variants.zh: 抚摸；宠爱（第三人称单数）
抚摸；宠爱（过去式/过去分词）
抚摸；宠爱（现在分词/动名词）

phrases.zh: 老师的宠儿；得宠的学生

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

practicable.zh: 可实行的；可做的；可用的

meanings.zh: 可实行的；可做的；可用的
meanings.exampleEn: The committee finally agreed on a practicable solution to the funding crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会最终就解决资金危机的一个可行方案达成了一致。

phrases.zh: 在尽可能可行的范围内

etymology.origin: 来自中世纪拉丁语 practicabilis，源自 practicare（实践、实行），最终可追溯至希腊语 praktikos（实践的、能做的）。
etymology.tip: practic（实践）+ able（可…的）→ 可以实践的 → 可实行的。

pilot.zh: 飞行员；领航员；航船者；导向器

meanings.exampleEn: The seasoned pilot skillfully navigated the aircraft through the turbulent storm.
meanings.exampleZh: 经验丰富的飞行员熟练地驾驶飞机穿越了湍流风暴。

meanings.exampleEn: The harbor pilot boarded the vessel to guide it safely into the crowded port.
meanings.exampleZh: 港口领航员登上船只，引导它安全进入拥挤的港口。

meanings.exampleEn: The river pilot steered the cargo ship through the treacherous shallows.
meanings.exampleZh: 内河舵手驾驶货船穿过危险的浅滩。

meanings.exampleEn: The pilot in the guidance system corrects the missile's trajectory.
meanings.exampleZh: 制导系统中的导向器修正导弹的弹道。

meanings.exampleEn: He piloted the helicopter through the dense fog with remarkable composure.
meanings.exampleZh: 他以非凡的镇定驾驶直升机穿过浓雾。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor piloted the research team through the complex project.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授引导研究团队完成了这个复杂的项目。

meanings.exampleEn: The company plans to pilot the new software in several selected schools.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司计划在几所选定的学校试点这款新软件。

meanings.exampleEn: The pilot program has yielded encouraging results in reducing energy consumption.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项试点计划在降低能耗方面取得了令人鼓舞的成果。

variants.zh: 驾驶；引导；试验（第三人称单数）
驾驶；引导；试验（过去式/过去分词）
驾驶；引导；试验（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自法语 pilot，源自意大利语 pilota，可能源于希腊语 pedon（桨）
etymology.tip: pilot 可联想为‘掌桨的人’，即舵手、领航员

meanings.exampleEn: The company failed to perform its contractual obligations to deliver the goods on time.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司未能履行其按时交付货物的合同义务。

meanings.exampleEn: The orchestra will perform a symphony composed by a contemporary musician at the annual concert.
meanings.exampleZh: 管弦乐队将在年度音乐会上演奏一首当代音乐家创作的交响曲。

meanings.exampleEn: The new engine performs efficiently even under extreme weather conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种新发动机即使在极端天气条件下也能高效运行。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 per- 'through' + formare 'to form'，经古法语进入英语
etymology.tip: per（完全）+ form（形成）→ 完全形成 → 完成，履行

meanings.exampleEn: The vast prairie stretched endlessly under the blazing sun, dotted with wildflowers and grazing bison.
meanings.exampleZh: 广袤的大草原在烈日下无尽延伸，点缀着野花和吃草的野牛。

phrases.zh: 普列里草原（北美高草草原）

etymology.origin: 来自法语 prairie，源自古法语 praerie，最终源自拉丁语 pratum（草地、牧场）
etymology.tip: prat-（草地）+ -ie（地点）→ 草地连绵的地方 → 大草原

meanings.exampleEn: The possession of a valid passport is essential for international travel.
meanings.exampleZh: 持有有效护照对于国际旅行至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: He lost all his possessions in the devastating fire.
meanings.exampleZh: 在那场毁灭性的大火中，他失去了所有财产。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 possessio，由 potis（有能力的）+ sedere（坐）构成，意为“有能力坐在上面”，引申为“占有”。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: pos（有能力）+ sess（坐）+ ion → 有能力坐在上面，即“占有、拥有”。

pose.zh: 姿势；姿态；装模作样；伪装
