meanings.exampleEn: The artist asked the model to hold a graceful pose for the portrait.
meanings.exampleZh: 画家要求模特为这幅肖像保持一个优雅的姿势。

meanings.exampleEn: The couple posed for photographs in front of the ancient temple.
meanings.exampleZh: 这对夫妇在古庙前摆姿势拍照。

meanings.exampleEn: He posed as a security guard to gain access to the restricted area.
meanings.exampleZh: 他冒充保安以进入受限区域。

meanings.exampleEn: The new data poses a serious challenge to the existing theory.
meanings.exampleZh: 新数据对现有理论提出了严峻的挑战。

variants.zh: 摆姿势（过去式/过去分词）；假装（过去式/过去分词）
摆姿势（现在分词）；假装（现在分词）
装模作样的人；故作姿态者

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 poser，源自晚期拉丁语 pausare（停止、休息），并与拉丁语 ponere（放置）的过去分词 positus 含义混合。
etymology.tip: pos 意为“放置”，把身体“放置”成某个样子就是“姿势”，把问题“放置”出来就是“提出”。

meanings.exampleEn: The pope delivered a historic address to the assembled crowd in St. Peter's Square.
meanings.exampleZh: 教皇在圣彼得广场向聚集的人群发表了历史性的演讲。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 papa，经由古英语 papa，原指‘父亲’，后特指罗马主教。
etymology.tip: pope 源自 papa（父亲），教皇在信徒心中如同‘圣父’。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel vividly portrays the life of ordinary people in the 19th century.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说生动地描绘了19世纪普通人的生活。

variants.zh: 描绘；描写（过去式/过去分词）
描绘；描写（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 portraire，源于拉丁语 protrahere（向前拉出），由 pro-（向前）+ trahere（拉）构成
etymology.tip: por（向前）+ tray（拉/画）→ 向前画出 → 描绘

meanings.exampleEn: The professor praised the student's insightful analysis of the complex literary work.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授称赞了那名学生对这部复杂文学作品的深刻分析。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy received high praise from environmental activists for its ambitious goals.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策因其宏大的目标而受到环保活动人士的高度赞扬。

variants.zh: 赞美；称赞（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 preisier，源自拉丁语 pretiare，意为估价、称赞；与 price（价格）同源。
etymology.tip: praise 与 price 同源，称赞就是“给予价值”。

positive.zh: 肯定的；积极的；有把握的

meanings.zh: 肯定的；积极的；有把握的
meanings.exampleEn: Despite the setbacks, she remained positive about the outcome of the project.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管遭遇挫折，她仍然对项目的结果持肯定态度。

meanings.exampleEn: In the debate, he focused on the positives of the new policy rather than its drawbacks.
meanings.exampleZh: 在辩论中，他着重谈论新政策的积极面而非其缺陷。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 positivus，由 ponere 的过去分词 positus 加形容词后缀 -ivus 构成
etymology.tip: pos（放置）+ -itive（有...性质的）→ 把想法“放在”心里，就是肯定的、积极的

meanings.exampleEn: The photograph of the ancient temple captured the intricate details of its architecture.
meanings.exampleZh: 那张古庙的照片捕捉到了其建筑的精妙细节。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel is a vivid photograph of life in the Victorian era.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说是对维多利亚时代生活的生动逼真的描绘。

meanings.exampleEn: She photographed the protesters from every angle to document the event.
meanings.exampleZh: 她从各个角度拍摄抗议者，以记录这一事件。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 phōs（光）+ graphē（书写，记录）
etymology.tip: 用光（photo）记录（graph）下来的画面就是照片。

powerful.zh: 有力的；有权力的；强大的

meanings.exampleEn: The powerful earthquake destroyed thousands of buildings in a matter of seconds.
meanings.exampleZh: 那次强烈的地震在几秒钟内摧毁了数千座建筑物。

meanings.exampleEn: The country's most powerful political leader announced a series of sweeping reforms.
meanings.exampleZh: 该国最有权力的政治领袖宣布了一系列全面改革。

etymology.root: power = 力量；能力（源自拉丁语 potere/posse，意为“能够”）
etymology.origin: 来自古法语 povoir，最终源自拉丁语 potere（能够）；本词由 power + 后缀 -ful 构成
etymology.tip: power（力量）+ ful（充满）→ 充满力量的 → 强大的；有力的

meanings.exampleEn: The postage for an international letter has increased significantly due to the new postal policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于新的邮政政策，国际信件的邮资大幅上涨。

etymology.origin: 来自法语 postage，由 post（邮政）+ -age（费用）构成
etymology.tip: post（邮政）+ age（费用）= 邮资，即寄信要付的“邮政费用”

meanings.exampleEn: The chemist ground the substance into a fine powder for the experiment.
meanings.exampleZh: 化学家将这种物质研磨成细粉以供实验使用。

meanings.exampleEn: The old castle stored barrels of powder in its armory.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古堡在军械库里储存了成桶的火药。

meanings.exampleEn: She powdered the baby after bathing him to keep his skin dry.
meanings.exampleZh: 她给婴儿洗完澡后为他撒上爽身粉，以保持皮肤干爽。

variants.zh: 撒粉于；使成粉末（第三人称单数）
撒粉于；使成粉末（过去式/过去分词）
撒粉于；使成粉末（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pulvis（属格 pulveris），意为“灰尘、粉末”，经古法语 poudre 进入英语。
etymology.tip: powder 与 pulverize（粉碎）同源，看到“粉末”就想到 pulver- 这个词根。

meanings.exampleEn: The hotel boasts a large outdoor pool surrounded by tropical gardens.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家酒店拥有一个被热带花园环绕的大型室外泳池。

meanings.exampleEn: The geologists discovered a rich oil pool beneath the desert.
meanings.exampleZh: 地质学家在沙漠下发现了一个丰富的石油层。

meanings.zh: 共用资源（或资金、人员），联营
meanings.exampleEn: The company maintains a large data pool for machine learning research.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司维护着一个大型数据池用于机器学习研究。

meanings.exampleEn: Several investors pooled their funds to launch the startup.
meanings.exampleZh: 几位投资者集中资金创办了这家初创公司。

variants.zh: 集中，联营（第三人称单数）
集中，联营（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 pōl（水池）；‘联营’义源自法语 poule（赌注，共同资金）
etymology.tip: 水池(pool)里众人把钱凑在一起(pool)

meanings.exampleEn: Wearing a helmet is a necessary precaution when riding a motorcycle.
meanings.exampleZh: 骑摩托车时戴头盔是必要的预防措施。

meanings.exampleEn: You should take every precaution to avoid losing your passport while traveling abroad.
meanings.exampleZh: 在国外旅行时，你应该处处留心，避免丢失护照。

meanings.exampleEn: The police maintained a high level of precaution during the state visit.
meanings.exampleZh: 国事访问期间，警方保持了高度的警戒。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praecavere，由 prae（在前）+ cavere（小心）构成，经法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ caution（小心）→ 预先小心 → 预防、警戒。

positively.zh: 明确地；肯定地；无疑地；(非正式)确实地

meanings.exampleEn: The instructions were positively stated to avoid any misunderstanding.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些指示被明确地表述出来，以避免任何误解。

meanings.exampleEn: She responded positively to the proposal during the meeting.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在会议期间肯定地回应了这项提议。

meanings.exampleEn: This discovery is positively the most significant breakthrough in the field.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一发现无疑是该领域最重要的突破。

meanings.exampleEn: The weather was positively freezing during the outdoor expedition.
meanings.exampleZh: 在户外探险期间，天气确实冷得要命。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 positus，是 ponere 的过去分词，意为“放置”，引申为“确定的位置或事实”
etymology.tip: 把想法“放置”（posit）在确定的位置上，再加上 -ive 和 -ly，就是“明确地、肯定地”。

meanings.exampleEn: The Portuguese are known for their seafaring history and vibrant culture.
meanings.exampleZh: 葡萄牙人以航海历史和充满活力的文化而闻名。

meanings.exampleEn: She has been learning Portuguese for three years in order to study in Lisbon.
meanings.exampleZh: 为了去里斯本学习，她已经学了三年葡萄牙语。

meanings.zh: 葡萄牙的；葡萄牙人的；葡萄牙语的
meanings.exampleEn: The Portuguese cuisine features fresh seafood and olive oil.
meanings.exampleZh: 葡萄牙美食以新鲜海鲜和橄榄油为特色。

phrases.zh: 僧帽水母（一种有毒的海洋生物）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Portus Cale（意为“温暖的港口”），后指葡萄牙地区
etymology.tip: Portugal（葡萄牙）+ -ese（……的/人/语），即葡萄牙的、葡萄牙人、葡萄牙语

meanings.exampleEn: He pulled the plug out of the bathtub and the water drained away.
meanings.exampleZh: 他从浴缸里拔出塞子，水就流走了。

meanings.exampleEn: Make sure the plug is inserted firmly into the socket before switching on the device.
meanings.exampleZh: 确保插头牢牢插入插座后再打开设备。

meanings.exampleEn: The workers plugged the leak with a special sealant to prevent further damage.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们用特殊密封剂堵住了漏洞，以防止进一步损坏。

meanings.exampleEn: The author appeared on several talk shows to plug his latest novel.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位作者出现在多个脱口秀节目中宣传他的最新小说。

variants.zh: 堵；塞；宣传（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 可能来自中古荷兰语 plugge，原意为“塞子”。
etymology.tip: 无词根词缀，可联想“插头插入插座”来记忆。

meanings.exampleEn: The poet drew inspiration from the bustling streets of the metropolis.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位诗人从大都市熙熙攘攘的街道中汲取灵感。

phrases.zh: 诗人角（威斯敏斯特教堂中安葬著名诗人的地方）

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 poiētēs（制作者，创作者），经由拉丁语 poēta 进入英语
etymology.tip: poet = poi（创造）+ et（人），创造文字的人即诗人。

meanings.exampleEn: He plunged into the river without hesitation.
meanings.exampleZh: 他毫不犹豫地跳进河里。

meanings.exampleEn: The company plunged millions into the new project.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司投入数百万资金到这个新项目中。

meanings.exampleEn: The horse plunged down the steep slope.
meanings.exampleZh: 马沿着陡坡猛冲下去。

meanings.exampleEn: Stock prices plunged after the unexpected announcement.
meanings.exampleZh: 意外公告发布后，股价暴跌。

meanings.exampleEn: Her graceful plunge from the diving board earned her a perfect score.
meanings.exampleZh: 她从跳板上优雅的跳水为她赢得了满分。

meanings.exampleEn: The athletes warmed up beside the plunge pool before the competition.
meanings.exampleZh: 比赛前，运动员们在跳水池旁热身。

meanings.exampleEn: The sudden plunge in temperature caught everyone off guard.
meanings.exampleZh: 气温的骤降让所有人措手不及。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 plongier，最终源自拉丁语 plumbum（铅），原指用铅坠测水深或沉入水中。
etymology.tip: plunge 与 plumb（铅）同源，铅坠入水即“跳进”，引申为猛冲、暴跌。

meanings.exampleEn: The cargo ship finally docked at the port after a week-long voyage across the stormy sea.
meanings.exampleZh: 货船在狂风暴雨的海上航行一周后，终于停靠在港口。

meanings.exampleEn: Shanghai is not only a major industrial center but also one of the busiest ports in the world.
meanings.exampleZh: 上海不仅是重要的工业中心，也是世界上最繁忙的埠之一。

meanings.exampleEn: The technician inspected the aircraft's cargo port to ensure it was securely sealed before takeoff.
meanings.exampleZh: 技术人员检查了飞机的货舱门，确保起飞前已严密关闭。

meanings.exampleEn: After years of wandering, the small coastal village became a peaceful port for his weary soul.
meanings.exampleZh: 漂泊多年后，这个宁静的海边小村成了他疲惫心灵的避风港。

phrases.zh: 危急时的任何避难所；饥不择食

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 portus（港口、避风港）
etymology.tip: 港口（port）是船只的“入口”，记住 port = 港口。

meanings.exampleEn: The predominant factor in the company's success is its innovative technology.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司成功的首要因素是其创新技术。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praedominari，由 prae-（在前）+ dominari（统治）构成
etymology.suffix: -ant = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ domin（统治）+ ant → 在前面统治的 → 占主导地位的

meanings.exampleEn: The minister preached a sermon on forgiveness to the congregation.
meanings.exampleZh: 牧师就宽恕之道向会众讲道。

meanings.exampleEn: My father always preaches about the importance of hard work, but he never listens to my views.
meanings.exampleZh: 我父亲总爱说教勤奋工作的重要性，却从不听我的想法。

meanings.exampleEn: She travels around the world preaching the benefits of sustainable living.
meanings.exampleZh: 她走遍世界宣讲可持续生活方式的益处。

variants.zh: 传道；讲道；说教；宣讲（过去式/过去分词）
传道；讲道；说教；宣讲（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 对已赞同的人说教；白费口舌
对某人喋喋不休地说教

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praedicare（公开宣布、宣讲），经古法语 prechier 进入英语
etymology.tip: prae（在前）+ dic（说）→ 在众人面前说 → 宣讲、说教

meanings.exampleEn: The factory was found to be emitting poisonous waste into the river, endangering the local ecosystem.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家工厂被发现向河中排放有毒废物，危及当地生态系统。

meanings.exampleEn: Her poisonous remarks about his family deeply hurt him and destroyed their friendship.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对他家人的恶毒言论深深伤害了他，也毁掉了他们的友谊。

meanings.exampleEn: He is one of the most poisonous people I have ever met, always spreading negativity and discontent.
meanings.exampleZh: 他是我见过的最讨厌的人之一，总是散布消极情绪和不满。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 poison（饮料，后指毒药），最终源自拉丁语 potio（饮料）
etymology.tip: poison（毒药）+ ous（充满）→ 充满毒药的 → 有毒的

meanings.exampleEn: The portrait hanging in the gallery captures the subtle melancholy of the sitter.
meanings.exampleZh: 挂在画廊里的那幅肖像捕捉到了模特微妙忧郁的神情。

meanings.exampleEn: The photographer specializes in striking portraits of indigenous people.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位摄影师擅长拍摄原住民的引人注目的人像。

meanings.exampleEn: A marble portrait of the philosopher adorns the library entrance.
meanings.exampleZh: 哲学家的半身大理石像装饰着图书馆入口。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel offers a vivid portrait of urban life in the 19th century.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说生动地描写了19世纪的城市生活。

variants.zh: 肖像；人像；半身像；描写（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自法语 portrait，源自古法语 portraire“描绘”，再源自拉丁语 protrahere“拉出，描绘”（pro-向前 + trahere拉）。
etymology.tip: portrait = por（向前）+ trait（拉）→ 把人的形象“拉”到画布上，就是肖像。

meanings.exampleEn: The plague swept through Europe in the 14th century, killing millions.
meanings.exampleZh: 14世纪，瘟疫席卷欧洲，夺去了数百万人的生命。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient Greeks believed that the plague was a divine punishment for human arrogance.
meanings.exampleZh: 古希腊人认为瘟疫是对人类傲慢的天罚。

meanings.exampleEn: The plague of bureaucracy has hindered the progress of many developing countries.
meanings.exampleZh: 官僚主义的麻烦阻碍了许多发展中国家的发展。

meanings.exampleEn: Locusts are a plague that can devastate crops within hours.
meanings.exampleZh: 蝗虫是一种能在数小时内毁掉庄稼的灾祸。

meanings.exampleEn: He has been plagued by persistent back pain for years.
meanings.exampleZh: 多年来，他一直被持续的背痛所折磨。

meanings.exampleEn: Reporters plagued the celebrity with questions as she left the courthouse.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位名人离开法院时，记者们用问题烦扰她。

variants.zh: 折磨；烦扰（第三人称单数）
折磨；烦扰（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 像躲避瘟疫一样避开某人/某物；避之唯恐不及

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 plaga（打击，伤口），后指瘟疫；源自希腊语 plaga（打击），最终源于印欧语词根 *plak-（击打）
etymology.tip: plague 音似“扑来格”，联想：瘟疫像打击一样扑来，带来灾祸。

preferable.zh: 更可取的；更好的；更合意的

meanings.zh: 更可取的；更好的；更合意的
meanings.exampleEn: For a busy professional, working from home is often preferable to commuting during rush hour.
meanings.exampleZh: 对于忙碌的职场人士来说，在家办公通常比高峰时段通勤更可取。

phrases.zh: 非常可取的；极为理想的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praeferre（pre- 在前 + ferre 带来），意为“放在前面、优先选择”，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ fer（拿）+ able（可…的）→ 可拿到前面来的 → 更可取的。

practical.zh: 实际的；现实的；实用性的

meanings.exampleEn: The practical application of this theory requires careful planning and resources.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一理论的实际应用需要周密的规划和资源。

meanings.exampleEn: We need a practical approach to solve the current economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们需要一种现实的方法来解决当前的经济危机。

meanings.exampleEn: The course focuses on practical skills rather than abstract knowledge.
meanings.exampleZh: 这门课程侧重于实用技能而非抽象知识。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 practicus，最终源自希腊语 praktikos（关于行动的、实践的）
etymology.tip: pract（实践）+ ical（的）→ 与实践相关的 → 实际的、实用的

meanings.exampleEn: She pondered the implications of the decision before responding.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在回应之前仔细考虑了该决定的影响。

meanings.exampleEn: He sat by the window, pondering on the mysteries of the universe.
meanings.exampleZh: 他坐在窗边，沉思宇宙的奥秘。

variants.zh: 仔细考虑；沉思（过去式/过去分词）
仔细考虑；沉思（现在分词）
仔细考虑；沉思（第三人称单数）

phrases.zh: 仔细考虑某事；沉思某事

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 ponderare（称量，权衡），源自 pondus（重量）
etymology.tip: pond（重量）+ 动词化 → 掂量重量 → 权衡、沉思

meanings.exampleEn: She found solace in prayer during the difficult times.
meanings.exampleZh: 在困难时期，她从祈祷中找到了安慰。

meanings.exampleEn: His prayer for mercy was finally heard by the judge.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对宽恕的恳求最终被法官听到了。

meanings.exampleEn: The priest recited a solemn prayer at the ceremony.
meanings.exampleZh: 牧师在仪式上念诵了一段庄严的祷辞。

meanings.exampleEn: Each prayer knelt silently before the altar.
meanings.exampleZh: 每位祈祷者都静静地跪在祭坛前。

variants.zh: 祈祷；恳求；祷辞；祈祷者（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 prex/precis（祈求），经古法语 preiere 进入英语
etymology.tip: prec（祈求）+ -er（人或物）= 祈求的人或祈求的话，即 prayer

meanings.exampleEn: Some people believe that fate has predestined every event in our lives.
meanings.exampleZh: 有些人相信命运注定了我们生活中的每一件事。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praedestinare，由 prae（预先）+ destinare（确定，指定）构成
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ destin（命运）+ e → 预先决定命运 → 注定

predominantly.zh: 主要地；显著地；大多数地；突出地

meanings.zh: 主要地；显著地；大多数地；突出地
meanings.exampleEn: The region's economy is predominantly agricultural, with few industrial enterprises.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区的经济主要以农业为主，几乎没有什么工业企业。

variants.zh: 主要的；占主导地位的；显著的
占主导地位；支配；占优势

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 dominari（统治），由前缀 pre-（在前）和词根 domin 及后缀 -ant（形容词后缀）和 -ly（副词后缀）构成。
etymology.suffix: -antly = 具有……性质地（由 -ant + -ly 组成）
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ domin（统治）+ antly → 在前面统治的 → 占主导地位地 → 主要地。

related.zh: 占优势的；统治的；显性的

precious.zh: 宝贵的；珍贵的；过于精致的；珍爱的

meanings.exampleEn: Time is a precious resource that should be allocated wisely in our daily schedule.
meanings.exampleZh: 时间是一种宝贵的资源，应在日常安排中合理分配。

meanings.zh: 过于精致的；矫揉造作的
meanings.exampleEn: His writing style is somewhat precious, with an excessive ornamentation that distracts from the main ideas.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的写作风格有些过于精致，过多的修饰反而分散了对主要观点的注意力。

meanings.exampleEn: She kept the precious memories of her childhood in a worn-out diary.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把童年珍爱的记忆保存在一本破旧的日记里。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pretiosus，源自 pretium（价值、价格）
etymology.tip: preci（价值）+ ous（充满的）= 充满价值的，即“宝贵的”

meanings.exampleEn: It is difficult to predict how the global economy will evolve in the next decade.
meanings.exampleZh: 很难预测全球经济在未来十年将如何演变。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praedicere，由 prae（在前）+ dicere（说）构成，意为“预先说出”
etymology.suffix: -dict 本身为词根，此处无额外后缀
etymology.tip: pre（提前）+ dict（说）→ 提前说出来 → 预言、预测

meanings.exampleEn: The chairman preceded the meeting with a brief introduction.
meanings.exampleZh: 主席在会议开始前先做了一个简短的介绍。

meanings.exampleEn: In this company, quality precedes quantity in production decisions.
meanings.exampleZh: 在这家公司，生产决策中质量优于数量。

meanings.exampleEn: Safety concerns should precede all other considerations in the experiment.
meanings.exampleZh: 在实验中，安全考虑应优先于所有其他因素。

variants.zh: 在...之前（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praecedere，由 prae-（在前）和 cedere（走）合成
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ cede（走）→ 走在前面 → 在...之前

meanings.exampleEn: The government has implemented various policies to alleviate poverty in rural areas.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已实施各种政策以缓解农村地区的贫困。

meanings.exampleEn: His writing shows a remarkable poverty of imagination.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的写作显示出想象力的极度贫乏。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 paupertas，源自 pauper（贫穷的）
etymology.suffix: -ty = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: pover-（poor的变体）+ -ty（名词后缀）→ 贫穷的状态

meanings.exampleEn: The new manager is more approachable than her predecessor was.
meanings.exampleZh: 新经理比她的前任更平易近人。

meanings.exampleEn: We should respect the wisdom of our predecessors and learn from their experiences.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们应当尊重先辈的智慧，并从他们的经历中学习。

meanings.exampleEn: The modern smartphone is the successor of its predecessor, the traditional cellphone.
meanings.exampleZh: 现代智能手机是传统手机这一前身的后继者。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praedecessor，由 prae-（在前）+ decessor（退位者）构成，而 decessor 又来自 de-（离开）+ cedere（走）
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ de（离开）+ cess（走）+ or（人）→ 走在前面离开的人 → 前任、先辈

meanings.exampleEn: The satellite requires a precise calculation of its orbit to avoid collision.
meanings.exampleZh: 卫星需要精确计算其轨道以避免碰撞。

meanings.exampleEn: Her precise analysis of the data left no room for doubt.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对数据的严谨分析不容置疑。

meanings.exampleEn: Please give a precise answer to the question, not a vague one.
meanings.exampleZh: 请对这个问题给出明确的回答，而不是含糊其辞。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praecidere（预先切下）的过去分词 praecisus
etymology.tip: 预先切好（pre- + cis），切得干净利落，就是精确、明确。

meanings.exampleEn: Her preference for classical music over pop is evident in her daily playlist.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对古典音乐而非流行音乐的偏爱在她每日播放列表中显而易见。

meanings.exampleEn: In job promotion, seniority is often given preference over other factors.
meanings.exampleZh: 在职位晋升中，资历往往比其他因素更受优先考虑。

meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant offers a variety of desserts, but chocolate cake is my preference.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家餐厅提供多种甜点，但巧克力蛋糕是我的偏爱。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praeferre（prae- 在前 + ferre 带来），意为“放在前面、更喜欢”，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ence = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态或行为
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ fer（拿）+ ence（名词）→ 把某物拿到前面 → 优先选择、偏爱。

meanings.exampleEn: The postman delivers letters and parcels to every household in the neighborhood regardless of the weather.
meanings.exampleZh: 无论天气如何，邮递员都会把信件和包裹送到附近每家每户。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 posita（放置）与古英语 man（人）的复合词，原指驿站中负责递送邮件的人
etymology.tip: post（邮政）+ man（人）= 邮递员

meanings.exampleEn: She fluffed the pillow and settled into bed, savoring the quiet of the night.
meanings.exampleZh: 她拍了拍枕头，上床安歇，享受着夜晚的宁静。

meanings.exampleEn: He propped his back against a firm pillow while reading a lengthy novel.
meanings.exampleZh: 他读长篇小说的时侯，把背靠在一个结实的靠垫上。

meanings.exampleEn: The formation of pillow rocks indicates that this region was once submerged beneath the sea.
meanings.exampleZh: 枕状岩的形成表明该地区曾经淹没于海底。

variants.zh: 把...搁在枕上；垫（过去式/过去分词）
把...搁在枕上；垫（现在分词）
把...搁在枕上；垫（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pulvinus，经古英语 pyle 演变而来
etymology.tip: pulvin（枕头）+ 谐音“疲劳”：累了就靠枕头

meanings.exampleEn: The research findings could possibly change the way we approach mental health treatment.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些研究结果可能会改变我们处理心理健康治疗的方式。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 possibilis，源自 posse（能够，有能力）
etymology.tip: poss（能够）+ ibly（可……地）→ 可能地

poison.zh: 毒药；毒；毒物；有毒害的事物

meanings.exampleEn: The assassin slipped a lethal poison into the king's goblet, causing his immediate collapse.
meanings.exampleZh: 刺客将致命毒药悄悄放入国王的酒杯，使他当场倒下。

meanings.zh: 有毒害的事物（有害影响）
meanings.exampleEn: Jealousy is a poison that gradually corrodes the bonds of friendship.
meanings.exampleZh: 嫉妒是一种毒害，逐渐侵蚀友谊的纽带。

meanings.exampleEn: The criminal plotted to poison his wealthy uncle in order to inherit the fortune.
meanings.exampleZh: 罪犯密谋毒死他富有的叔叔以继承财产。

meanings.exampleEn: The leaked chemicals poisoned the soil, making it unfit for cultivation.
meanings.exampleZh: 泄漏的化学品污染了土壤，使其无法耕种。

etymology.root: pot = 喝（来自拉丁语 potare）
etymology.origin: 来自古法语 poison（饮料，后指毒药），源自拉丁语 potio（饮料）
etymology.tip: 毒药常被伪装成“饮料”让人喝下，记住词根 pot=喝

meanings.exampleEn: Many young people prefer to communicate through social media rather than face-to-face meetings.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多年轻人较喜欢通过社交媒体交流，而不是面对面会晤。

meanings.exampleEn: The victim decided to prefer charges against the suspect for fraud.
meanings.exampleZh: 受害者决定对嫌疑人提出欺诈指控。

variants.zh: 较喜欢；提出（第三人称单数）
较喜欢；提出（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 宁愿做某事；更喜欢做某事

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praeferre，由 prae（在前）+ ferre（带来）构成，原义为“放在前面”，引申为“优先选择”。
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ fer（拿）→ 把某物拿到前面 → 优先选择，较喜欢。

meanings.exampleEn: He possesses a valid driver's license and an international passport.
meanings.exampleZh: 他持有有效的驾驶执照和国际护照。

meanings.exampleEn: The tech giant possesses a dominant share of the global smartphone market.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家科技巨头占有全球智能手机市场的主导份额。

meanings.exampleEn: She possesses an extraordinary ability to memorize complex data instantly.
meanings.exampleZh: 她拥有瞬间记住复杂数据的非凡能力。

meanings.exampleEn: He struggled to possess himself when faced with the rude accusation.
meanings.exampleZh: 面对粗鲁的指责时，他努力克制自己。

variants.zh: 持有；占有；拥有（第三人称单数）
持有；占有；拥有（过去式/过去分词）
持有；占有；拥有（现在分词）

etymology.root: sess = 坐（源自拉丁语 sedere）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 possidere（占有），由 potis（有能力的）+ sedere（坐）构成，字面意为“坐在上面（作为主人）”。
etymology.prefix: pos- = 能够，有能力的（源自拉丁语 potis）
etymology.tip: pos（有能力）+ sess（坐）→ 有能力坐在上面 → 占有、拥有。

potential.zh: 潜在性；可能性；潜力；潜能

meanings.exampleEn: There is a real potential for conflict between the two communities.
meanings.exampleZh: 两个社区之间确实存在发生冲突的可能性。

meanings.exampleEn: The young athlete has enormous potential that has yet to be fully realized.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员拥有尚未完全发挥的巨大潜力。

meanings.exampleEn: We need to identify potential risks before launching the new product.
meanings.exampleZh: 在新产品上市前，我们需要识别潜在风险。

phrases.en: have the potential to do sth

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 potentia，源自 posse 的现在分词 potens，意为“有能力的、有力的”。
etymology.tip: pot（能力）+ -ial（...的）= 有能力的、尚未显现的，即“潜在的”。

meanings.exampleEn: A significant portion of the budget was allocated to scientific research.
meanings.exampleZh: 预算的很大一部分被分配给了科学研究。

meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant serves generous portions of pasta, which often leave customers feeling satisfied.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家餐厅供应大份意大利面，常常让顾客感到满足。

meanings.exampleEn: It was his portion to endure great hardships before achieving success.
meanings.exampleZh: 在成功之前经历巨大艰辛是他的命运。

meanings.exampleEn: In ancient times, a bride's portion was often used to secure her future in marriage.
meanings.exampleZh: 在古代，新娘的嫁妆常被用来保障她婚后的生活。

meanings.exampleEn: The manager portioned out the work among the team members to ensure efficiency.
meanings.exampleZh: 经理将工作分配给团队成员以确保效率。

variants.zh: 分配；把…分成份额（过去式/过去分词）
分配；把…分成份额（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 portio（部分，份额）
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态、结果
etymology.tip: port（部分）+ ion（名词后缀）→ 部分；一份

politics.zh: 政治；政治学；政见；政治活动

meanings.exampleEn: The intricate interplay of interests and ideologies makes politics a complex arena where compromise is often indispensable.
meanings.exampleZh: 利益与意识形态的复杂交织使政治成为一个复杂的舞台，妥协往往不可或缺。

meanings.exampleEn: In her graduate studies, she focused on comparative politics, analyzing the political systems of emerging democracies.
meanings.exampleZh: 在研究生学习中，她专注于比较政治学，分析新兴民主国家的政治制度。

meanings.exampleEn: His politics are shaped by a deep commitment to social justice and a pragmatic approach to economic reform.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的政见由对社会正义的坚定承诺和对经济改革的务实态度所塑造。

meanings.exampleEn: Many young people are increasingly drawn to grassroots politics as a means of effecting tangible change in their communities.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多年轻人日益被基层政治活动所吸引，以此作为在社区中实现切实变革的手段。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 politikos（公民的），经拉丁语 politicus、法语 politique 进入英语，原指“城邦事务”。
etymology.tip: polit-（城邦）+ -ics（学科）→ 治理城邦的学问 → 政治

meanings.exampleEn: The preparation for the final examination requires a systematic review of all the key points.
meanings.exampleZh: 期末考试的预习需要系统复习所有重点内容。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praeparatio(n-)，由 prae-（在前）+ parare（使准备好）构成
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ par（准备）+ ation（名词后缀）→ 预先准备

meanings.exampleEn: The preceding analysis has laid a solid foundation for our further research.
meanings.exampleZh: 前面的分析为我们进一步的研究奠定了坚实的基础。

meanings.exampleEn: Please refer to the diagram preceding the conclusion.
meanings.exampleZh: 请参阅结论之前的图表。

variants.zh: 在...之前（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praecedere，由 prae-（在前）+ cedere（走）构成
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ ced（走）+ ing（的）→ 走在前面的一一在前的

preclude.zh: 预先排除；预防；阻止；妨碍

meanings.exampleEn: The new evidence precludes any possibility of a fair trial.
meanings.exampleZh: 新证据排除了进行公正审判的任何可能性。

meanings.exampleEn: Regular exercise may preclude the onset of many chronic diseases.
meanings.exampleZh: 经常锻炼也许能预防许多慢性病的发生。

meanings.exampleEn: His poor health precluded him from taking part in the expedition.
meanings.exampleZh: 他糟糕的健康状况妨碍了他参加这次探险。

variants.zh: 排除；预防；阻止（过去式/过去分词）
排除；预防；阻止（第三人称单数）
排除；预防；阻止（现在分词）
排除性的；预防性的；阻止的
排除性地；预防性地；阻止地

phrases.zh: 阻止某人做某事；使某人无法做某事

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praecludere，由 prae（在前）+ claudere（关闭）构成，原义为“在前面关闭”，引申为“排除、阻止”。
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ clude（关闭）→ 预先关上门 → 排除、阻止。

meanings.exampleEn: The prediction of an impending economic crisis alarmed many investors.
meanings.exampleZh: 对即将到来的经济危机的预言使许多投资者感到恐慌。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praedictio，由 prae（在前）+ dicere（说）构成，意为“预先说出”。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ dict（说）+ ion（名词）→ 预先说出的话 → 预言、预报

meanings.exampleEn: The law prescribes that all citizens must pay taxes.
meanings.exampleZh: 法律规定所有公民必须纳税。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee prescribed a strict procedure for the experiment.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会为这项实验指定了严格的程序。

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor prescribed that the patient should rest for at least a week.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生嘱咐病人至少休息一周。

meanings.exampleEn: The physician prescribed a new antibiotic for the infection.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生为这种感染开了一种新的抗生素。

variants.zh: 规定；指定；嘱咐；开处方（第三人称单数）
规定；指定；嘱咐；开处方（过去式/过去分词）
规定；指定；嘱咐；开处方（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praescribere，由 prae（在前）+ scribere（写）构成，原意为“写在前面”，引申为“预先规定、指示”。
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ scribe（写）→ 预先写下来 → 规定、指定、开处方。

meanings.exampleEn: A basic knowledge of computer programming is a prerequisite qualification for this advanced course.
meanings.exampleZh: 基本的计算机编程知识是这门高级课程的一项先决条件。

meanings.exampleEn: Passing the entrance examination is a prerequisite for admission to the university.
meanings.exampleZh: 通过入学考试是进入这所大学的先决条件。

variants.zh: 先决条件；前提（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 prae-（在前）+ requirere（寻求，要求），经由 requisite 演变而来
etymology.suffix: -ite = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ requisite（必需的）→ 在前面必须先满足的 → 先决条件

pregnant.zh: 怀孕的；充满的；思想丰富的；成果丰硕的

meanings.exampleEn: The pregnant woman was advised to take folic acid supplements during her first trimester.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位怀孕的妇女被建议在孕早期服用叶酸补充剂。

meanings.exampleEn: The atmosphere in the meeting room was pregnant with tension as the deadline approached.
meanings.exampleZh: 随着截止日期的临近，会议室里的气氛充满了紧张。

meanings.exampleEn: Her pregnant remarks during the seminar sparked a heated debate among the scholars.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在研讨会上思想丰富的言论在学者们中间引发了激烈的辩论。

meanings.exampleEn: The decade of relentless research finally yielded a pregnant harvest of scientific discoveries.
meanings.exampleZh: 这十年不懈的研究最终带来了成果丰硕的科学发现。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praegnans（怀孕的），由 prae-（前）+ gnasci（出生）构成
etymology.tip: pre（前）+ gn（出生）+ ant（形容词）→ 出生前的状态 → 怀孕的

premium.zh: 额外补贴；奖金；奖赏；保险费

meanings.exampleEn: The annual premium for his health insurance increased significantly this year.
meanings.exampleZh: 今年他的健康保险年度保险费大幅上涨了。

meanings.exampleEn: Employees who work overtime receive a premium for their extra hours.
meanings.exampleZh: 加班的员工会因额外的工作时间获得补贴。

meanings.exampleEn: The company focuses on producing premium goods for the high-end market.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家公司专注于为高端市场生产优质产品。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praemium（奖赏、战利品），由 prae-（在前）+ emere（买、取）构成，原指在战斗前许诺的奖赏。
etymology.tip: premium = prae（在前）+ em（买）+ ium → 在购买之前先谈好的额外奖赏 → 奖金、保险费、优质的。

meanings.exampleEn: Tears poured down her cheeks as she heard the tragic news.
meanings.exampleZh: 听到这个悲惨的消息，泪水顺着她的脸颊流下来。

meanings.exampleEn: He poured the boiling water into the teapot carefully.
meanings.exampleZh: 他小心地将沸水倒入茶壶中。

meanings.exampleEn: It poured all day, so the outdoor concert was cancelled.
meanings.exampleZh: 一整天都下着倾盆大雨，因此户外音乐会取消了。

variants.zh: 第三人称单数：流出；倾泻；下大雨
过去式/过去分词：流出；倾泻；下大雨
现在分词/动名词：流出；倾泻；下大雨

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: In the sentence 'The book is on the table,' the word 'on' is a preposition.
meanings.exampleZh: 在句子“The book is on the table”中，单词“on”是一个介词。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praepositio，由 prae（在前）+ ponere（放置）构成，意为“放在前面的词”
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态或结果
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ posit（放置）+ ion（名词后缀）→ 放在名词前面的词 → 介词

preliminary.zh: 初步做法；初步措施；预试；预选赛

meanings.exampleEn: The preliminary results of the experiment suggest a significant breakthrough in cancer research.
meanings.exampleZh: 实验的初步结果表明，这项研究可能在癌症领域取得重大突破。

meanings.exampleEn: After a few preliminaries, the chairman finally introduced the main topic of the meeting.
meanings.exampleZh: 在几句开场白之后，主席终于引入了会议的主要议题。

meanings.exampleEn: The team was eliminated in the preliminary of the national championship.
meanings.exampleZh: 该队在全国锦标赛的预选赛中被淘汰。

variants.zh: 初步做法；预试；预选赛（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praeliminaris，由 prae（前）+ limen（门槛）构成，意为“门槛之前的”，引申为“初步的”。
etymology.suffix: -ary = 形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”
etymology.tip: pre（前）+ limin（门槛）+ ary（的）→ 站在门槛之前的 → 还没正式进入，所以是“初步的”。

meanings.exampleEn: The renowned physicist was a Pole who won the Nobel Prize for her research on radioactivity.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位著名物理学家是波兰人，她因放射性研究获得诺贝尔奖。

meanings.exampleEn: The expedition team finally reached the North Pole after months of arduous trekking across the ice.
meanings.exampleZh: 探险队经过数月艰苦的冰上跋涉，终于到达了北极点。

meanings.exampleEn: Unlike magnetic poles attract each other, while like poles repel.
meanings.exampleZh: 异名磁极相互吸引，同名磁极相互排斥。

meanings.exampleEn: The battery's positive pole is connected to the circuit via a copper wire.
meanings.exampleZh: 电池的正极通过铜线连接到电路。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 polos（轴，天空），经拉丁语 polus 进入英语；与表示波兰人的 Pole 同形异源。
etymology.tip: 地球绕轴自转，轴的两端就是 pole（极）

meanings.exampleEn: Despite numerous obstacles, she remained steadfast in her pledge to eradicate illiteracy in the region.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管障碍重重，她仍然坚守自己在该地区扫除文盲的诺言。

meanings.exampleEn: The administration's pledge to invest in renewable energy was met with widespread skepticism from environmentalists.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府投资可再生能源的保证遭到了环保人士的广泛质疑。

meanings.exampleEn: The knight's solemn pledge to protect the realm was inscribed on the ancient stone.
meanings.exampleZh: 骑士保卫王国的庄严誓言被刻在古老的石头上。

meanings.exampleEn: The antique vase served as a pledge for the substantial loan he obtained from the bank.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个古董花瓶作为他从银行获得大额贷款的抵押。

meanings.exampleEn: The CEO pledged to overhaul the company's outdated data security protocols by the end of the fiscal year.
meanings.exampleZh: 首席执行官保证在财政年度结束前彻底改革公司过时的数据安全协议。

meanings.exampleEn: They pledged their ancestral estate to secure funding for the ambitious startup venture.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们抵押了祖传的房产，为雄心勃勃的创业项目筹集资金。

phrases.zh: 保证做某事；承诺做某事

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 plege（担保人），源自中世纪拉丁语 plegium，最终源于日耳曼语 *plegan（保证）
etymology.tip: p + ledge（悬崖边），在悬崖边立下誓言，记住 pledge 是“誓言、保证”

premature.zh: 早产的；过早的；不成熟的

meanings.exampleEn: The infant was born three weeks premature and required special care.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名婴儿早产了三周，需要特殊护理。

meanings.exampleEn: His premature retirement from politics surprised all his supporters.
meanings.exampleZh: 他过早退出政坛，令所有支持者感到惊讶。

meanings.exampleEn: It would be premature to declare victory before the final results are announced.
meanings.exampleZh: 在最终结果公布之前就宣布胜利是不成熟的。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praematurus，由 prae-（前）+ maturus（成熟）构成
etymology.tip: pre（提前）+ mature（成熟）= 在成熟之前 → 过早的、不成熟的

meanings.exampleEn: The prevalent use of smartphones has transformed the way people communicate.
meanings.exampleZh: 智能手机的普遍使用改变了人们的交流方式。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praevalere（占优势），由 prae-（在前）+ valere（强壮）构成，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ent = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ val（强）+ ent（的）→ 在前面占强势的 → 普遍的、流行的。

meanings.exampleEn: The presidency carries immense responsibility for the nation's welfare.
meanings.exampleZh: 总统职权对国家福祉负有巨大责任。

meanings.exampleEn: She was appointed to the presidency of the multinational corporation.
meanings.exampleZh: 她被任命为这家跨国公司的总裁。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praesidere，由 prae-（在前）+ sedere（坐）构成，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ency = 名词后缀，表示状态或职权
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ sid（坐）+ ency（状态）→ 坐在前面主持的人所拥有的职权 → 总统职权

meanings.exampleEn: The farmer hitched the plough to his tractor and began to turn over the soil.
meanings.exampleZh: 农夫把犁挂到拖拉机上，开始翻土。

meanings.exampleEn: The plough was ready for sowing after the spring rains.
meanings.exampleZh: 春雨过后，犁过的地已准备好播种。

meanings.exampleEn: The tractor ploughed the field in less than an hour.
meanings.exampleZh: 拖拉机不到一小时就犁完了这块地。

meanings.exampleEn: The farmers plough in early spring.
meanings.exampleZh: 农民们早春犁地。

phrases.zh: 把（利润）再投资；把（作物）犁入土中

etymology.origin: 古英语 plōh，意为“犁”；与德语 Pflug 同源。基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: plough 与 plow 同义，可联想“p-low”：犁地时人要压低身子。

prepare.zh: 准备；筹备；使在思想上有准备；制造

meanings.exampleEn: The committee spent months preparing the annual conference.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会花了数月时间筹备年度会议。

meanings.exampleEn: The lecture prepared the audience for the upcoming policy changes.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场讲座让听众对即将到来的政策变化有了思想准备。

meanings.exampleEn: The pharmacist prepared a special ointment for the patient's skin condition.
meanings.exampleZh: 药剂师为病人的皮肤状况配制了一种特殊药膏。

meanings.exampleEn: She prepared for the interview by researching the company thoroughly.
meanings.exampleZh: 她通过彻底研究该公司来为面试做准备。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praeparare，由 prae-（前）+ parare（准备）构成
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ par（准备）+ e → 预先准备好

meanings.exampleEn: The vice president will preside over the annual conference in the chairman's absence.
meanings.exampleZh: 董事长缺席时，副总裁将主持年度会议。

variants.zh: 主持；主管（第三人称单数）
主持；主管（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praesidere，由 prae（在前）+ sedere（坐）构成，原意为“坐在前面”，引申为“主持、监管”。
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ sid（坐）+ e → 坐在前面的人就是主持者。

president.zh: 总统；总裁；董事长；(学院)院长

meanings.exampleEn: The president addressed the nation on the economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 总统就经济危机向全国发表讲话。

meanings.exampleEn: She was elected president of the multinational corporation.
meanings.exampleZh: 她被选为这家跨国公司的总裁。

meanings.exampleEn: The college president announced a new scholarship program.
meanings.exampleZh: 学院院长宣布了一项新的奖学金计划。

variants.zh: 总统；总裁；董事长；(学院)院长（复数）
总统（或总裁、董事长等）的职位（或任期）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praesidere（坐在前面，主持），由 prae-（在前）+ sedere（坐）构成，后经古法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ sid（坐）+ ent（人）→ 坐在前面的人 → 主持者 → 总统/总裁。

meanings.exampleEn: The ruling in this case set a legal precedent that influenced subsequent decisions.
meanings.exampleZh: 此案的裁决开创了一个法律先例，影响了后续的判决。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praecedere（走在前面），由 prae-（在前）+ cedere（走）构成
etymology.suffix: -ent = 表示...的（形容词后缀）或...者（名词后缀）
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ ced（走）+ ent → 走在前面的事 → 先例

meanings.exampleEn: The pressure of the water at great depths can crush a submarine.
meanings.exampleZh: 深水处的水压可以压碎潜艇。

meanings.exampleEn: He felt immense pressure from his parents to choose a stable career.
meanings.exampleZh: 他感到父母施加的巨大压力，要求他选择一份稳定的职业。

meanings.exampleEn: The union pressured the management to improve working conditions.
meanings.exampleZh: 工会向管理层施压，要求改善工作条件。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pressura，经由古法语 pressure 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ure = 表示行为、结果或状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: press（压）+ ure（名词后缀）→ 压的状态 → 压力

player.zh: 竞赛者；上场队员；游戏者；演员

meanings.exampleEn: The seasoned player demonstrated remarkable resilience during the championship, outmaneuvering all opponents.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位经验丰富的竞赛者在锦标赛中表现出非凡的韧性，智胜了所有对手。

meanings.exampleEn: The coach substituted a fresh player in the final minutes to reinforce the team's defense.
meanings.exampleZh: 教练在最后几分钟换上一名新上场队员以加强球队防守。

meanings.exampleEn: In the virtual reality game, each player must navigate intricate puzzles to advance to the next level.
meanings.exampleZh: 在虚拟现实游戏中，每个游戏者必须解开复杂的谜题才能进入下一关。

meanings.exampleEn: The versatile player captivated the audience with her nuanced portrayal of the tragic heroine.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位多才多艺的演员以她对悲剧女主角细腻的演绎吸引了观众。

variants.zh: 竞赛者；上场队员；游戏者；演员（复数）
玩；参加（比赛）；演奏（过去式/过去分词）
玩；参加（比赛）；演奏（现在分词/动名词）

phrases.zh: 团队合作者；有团队精神的人

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 plega（游戏、运动），后加 -er 表示人或物
etymology.tip: play（玩）+ er（人）= 玩的人，即游戏者、运动员

meanings.exampleEn: The preservation of historical buildings requires both government funding and public awareness.
meanings.exampleZh: 历史建筑的保护既需要政府资金，也需要公众意识。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praeservare（预先看守），经古法语进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ation = 名词后缀，表示行为、过程
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ serv（保持）+ ation（名词）→ 预先保持完好 → 保存

meanings.exampleEn: The villagers would pray for a bountiful harvest every spring.
meanings.exampleZh: 村民们每年春天都会祈祷丰收。

meanings.exampleEn: She prayed the committee to reconsider her application before the deadline.
meanings.exampleZh: 她恳求委员会在截止日期前重新考虑她的申请。

meanings.exampleEn: Pray tell me how you managed to solve such a perplexing puzzle.
meanings.exampleZh: 请告诉我你是如何解开这个令人困惑的谜题的。

variants.zh: 祈祷；恳求（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 请告诉我（正式或幽默用法）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 precari（请求，恳求），经古法语 preier 进入英语
etymology.tip: pray 与 prec 同源，想象祈祷就是向上天发出恳求

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor wrote a prescription for a new antibiotic to treat the infection.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生开了一张新抗生素的处方来治疗感染。

meanings.exampleEn: The king's prescription that all citizens must pay the new tax was met with widespread resistance.
meanings.exampleZh: 国王要求所有公民缴纳新税的命令遭到了广泛的抵制。

meanings.exampleEn: The law includes a clear prescription of the duties and responsibilities of each government official.
meanings.exampleZh: 该法律明确指定了每位政府官员的职责和责任。

variants.zh: 规定的；指定的；约定俗成的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praescriptio，由 prae（预先）+ scribere（写）构成，原意为“预先写下的规定”。
etymology.suffix: -tion = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ script（写）+ tion（名词）→ 预先写好的东西 → 处方、命令、指定。

meanings.exampleEn: The economic crisis precipitated a wave of unemployment.
meanings.exampleZh: 经济危机引发了一波失业潮。

meanings.exampleEn: Cooling the solution will precipitate the salt.
meanings.exampleZh: 冷却溶液会使盐沉淀出来。

meanings.exampleEn: Rain precipitated from the dark clouds.
meanings.exampleZh: 雨水从乌云中骤然落下。

meanings.exampleEn: A white precipitate formed in the test tube.
meanings.exampleZh: 试管中形成了白色沉淀物。

meanings.exampleEn: His precipitate decision led to disastrous consequences.
meanings.exampleZh: 他鲁莽的决定导致了灾难性后果。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praecipitare（头朝下抛下），由 prae（在前）+ caput（头）构成
etymology.tip: pre（前）+ cipit（头）+ ate → 头朝前落下，引申为“突然发生；沉淀”

meanings.exampleEn: Presently, the company is focusing on expanding its overseas markets.
meanings.exampleZh: 目前，该公司正专注于拓展海外市场。

meanings.exampleEn: The manager will be back presently, so please wait a moment.
meanings.exampleZh: 经理很快就会回来，请稍等片刻。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praesentem，由 prae-（在前）+ esse（存在）构成，意为“在前的、在场的”，后加副词后缀 -ly。
etymology.tip: pre-（在前）+ esse（存在）= 呈现在前 → 目前；眼前的事很快发生 → 不久。

meanings.exampleEn: We must preserve the ancient ruins from further erosion.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们必须保护这些古代遗迹免受进一步侵蚀。

meanings.exampleEn: It is crucial to preserve a sense of humor in times of crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 在危机时期保持幽默感至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: The scientists developed a new technique to preserve food without chemical additives.
meanings.exampleZh: 科学家们开发了一种新技术，无需化学添加剂即可保存食物。

meanings.exampleEn: In autumn, many families preserve apples and plums for the winter.
meanings.exampleZh: 秋天，许多家庭会腌制苹果和李子以备过冬。

meanings.exampleEn: This national preserve is home to a wide variety of endangered species.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个国家保护区是多种濒危物种的家园。

meanings.exampleEn: Classical music was once the preserve of the aristocracy.
meanings.exampleZh: 古典音乐曾经是贵族独占的领域。

variants.zh: 保护；保持；保存（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praeservare，由 prae-（在前）+ servare（保持，看守）构成
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ serv（保持）+ e → 提前保持好 → 保护、保存

meanings.exampleEn: The company had previously announced plans to expand its overseas operations.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司先前已宣布了扩大海外业务的计划。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praevius，由 prae（在前）+ via（路）构成，意为“在前面的路”，后引申为“先前的”。
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ vi（路）+ ous + ly → 走在前面路上的 → 先前地

meanings.exampleEn: In many industries, a few large companies predominate over the market.
meanings.exampleZh: 在许多行业，少数大公司主导着市场。

variants.zh: 占主导地位；支配；控制（第三人称单数）
占主导地位；支配；控制（过去式/过去分词）
占主导地位；支配；控制（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praedominari，由 prae-（在前）+ dominari（统治）构成
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ domin（统治）+ ate（动词）→ 在前面统治 → 占主导地位，支配

prevailing.zh: 盛行很广的；优势的；主要的；普遍的

meanings.exampleEn: The prevailing attitude among young people is that hard work still matters.
meanings.exampleZh: 年轻人中普遍的态度是努力仍然重要。

meanings.exampleEn: The prevailing wind in this region blows from the northwest.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区的主要风向是从西北吹来。

variants.zh: 盛行；获胜（第三人称单数）
盛行；获胜（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praevalere，由 prae-（在前）+ valere（强壮）构成，意为“在力量上占前”。
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ vail（强）= 力量在前，即“占优势的；盛行的”。

meanings.exampleEn: Presumably, the committee will reach a consensus after further deliberation.
meanings.exampleZh: 推测起来，委员会在进一步商议后将会达成共识。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praesumere（预先取，假定），由 prae-（前）+ sumere（拿）构成
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ sum（拿）+ ably（可…地）→ 预先拿定想法 → 推测上，大概

meanings.exampleEn: He used a headache as a pretext for leaving the meeting early.
meanings.exampleZh: 他以头疼为借口提前离开了会议。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praetextum，由 prae-（在前）+ texere（编织）构成，原指“编织在前面的东西”，引申为“借口”。
etymology.tip: pre（提前）+ text（编织）= 提前编好的话，就是借口。

meanings.exampleEn: The printer carefully adjusted the press to ensure the colors matched perfectly.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位印刷工仔细调整印刷机，以确保颜色完美匹配。

meanings.exampleEn: The office printer ran out of toner right before the annual report was due.
meanings.exampleZh: 就在年度报告截止前，办公室的打印机 toner 用完了。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 preinte，意为“压印的痕迹”，后演变为 print；-er 为表人或物的后缀。
etymology.tip: print（印）+ er（人或物）→ 印刷的人或打印的机器。

poll.zh: 投票；民意测验；选举投票；投票数

meanings.exampleEn: The poll for the new chairman will take place next Monday.
meanings.exampleZh: 新主席的投票将于下周一举行。

meanings.exampleEn: The latest poll shows that the incumbent candidate has a slight lead.
meanings.exampleZh: 最新民意测验显示现任候选人略微领先。

meanings.exampleEn: The poll was conducted in a peaceful atmosphere across the country.
meanings.exampleZh: 全国各地的选举投票在和平的氛围中进行。

meanings.exampleEn: The poll in rural areas was surprisingly higher than expected.
meanings.exampleZh: 农村地区的投票数出乎意料地高于预期。

meanings.exampleEn: The winning candidate polled over 60 percent of the votes in the election.
meanings.exampleZh: 获胜的候选人在选举中获得了超过60%的选票。

meanings.exampleEn: They polled a random sample of residents about the proposed new policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们就拟议的新政策对随机抽取的居民进行了民意测验。

meanings.exampleEn: The residents will poll on the proposed tax increase next month.
meanings.exampleZh: 居民们下个月将对拟议的增税进行投票。

variants.zh: 获得（选票）；对…进行民意测验；投票（第三人称单数）
获得（选票）；对…进行民意测验；投票（过去式/过去分词）
获得（选票）；对…进行民意测验；投票（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自中古低地德语 polle，意为“头、头顶”；因古代按人头计数投票，引申为“投票”
etymology.tip: 人头(poll)计数，投票(poll)按人头

meanings.exampleEn: The tiny pores on the leaf surface allow the plant to exchange gases with the atmosphere.
meanings.exampleZh: 叶子表面的微小气孔使植物能与大气进行气体交换。

meanings.exampleEn: She spent hours poring over the ancient manuscripts in the library.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在图书馆花了数小时仔细研读那些古代手稿。

variants.zh: 仔细阅读；凝视；沉思（第三人称单数）
仔细阅读；凝视；沉思（过去式/过去分词）
仔细阅读；凝视；沉思（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 名词源自希腊语 poros（通道、孔）；动词词源不明，与名词同形
etymology.tip: por=孔，通过；毛孔(pore)是物质通过的微小通道，pore over 则是目光“通过”文字仔细研读。

meanings.exampleEn: The invading army plundered the coastal villages and seized all the valuables.
meanings.exampleZh: 侵略军洗劫了沿海村庄，抢走了所有贵重物品。

meanings.exampleEn: The plunder of the ancient temple by the barbarians shocked the entire nation.
meanings.exampleZh: 野蛮人对古神庙的掠夺震惊了整个国家。

meanings.exampleEn: The thieves hid their plunder in a cave deep in the forest.
meanings.exampleZh: 盗贼把掠夺品藏在森林深处的洞穴里。

etymology.origin: 来自中古荷兰语 plunderen，意为“掠夺”；与德语 plündern 同源。
etymology.tip: plunder 发音像“破烂的”，掠夺后只剩破烂。

meanings.exampleEn: The primary objective of this project is to reduce carbon emissions by 30% before 2030.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个项目的主要目标是在2030年前将碳排放量减少30%。

meanings.exampleEn: Red, green, and blue are the primaries used in digital displays to create the full color spectrum.
meanings.exampleZh: 红、绿、蓝是数字显示屏中用来生成完整色谱的原色。

variants.zh: 最主要者（复数）；原色（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 primarius，源自 primus（第一）
etymology.suffix: -ary = 形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”
etymology.tip: prim（第一）+ ary（形容词后缀）→ 排在第一位的 → 主要的；最初的

meanings.exampleEn: The primate delivered a powerful sermon that moved the entire congregation.
meanings.exampleZh: 大主教发表了一篇强有力的布道，感动了全体会众。

meanings.exampleEn: The primate's ability to use tools demonstrates its remarkable cognitive intelligence.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种灵长目动物使用工具的能力展现了其非凡的认知智力。

variants.zh: 灵长目动物（复数）；大主教（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 primas（首领），由 primus（第一）派生，后经古法语进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ate = 表示具有某种身份或性质的人/物
etymology.tip: prim（第一）+ ate（人）→ 地位居首的人 → 大主教；灵长目动物也被视为动物界中最高等的类群。

meanings.exampleEn: The princess renounced her royal privileges to pursue a career in scientific research.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位公主放弃王室特权，投身于科学研究事业。

meanings.exampleEn: She is regarded as the reigning princess of the global fashion industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 她被视为全球时尚界 reigning 的女巨头。

phrases.zh: 公主方切割（钻石的一种切割方式）
长公主（英国王室的一种头衔）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 princesse，由 prince（王子/君主）加阴性后缀 -ess 构成；最终源自拉丁语 princeps（第一公民，首领）
etymology.tip: prince（王子/君主）+ ess（女性后缀）= 公主/王妃

meanings.exampleEn: Justice will prevail over tyranny in the end.
meanings.exampleZh: 正义终将战胜暴政。

meanings.exampleEn: This custom still prevails in some rural areas of the country.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一习俗在该国一些农村地区仍然盛行。

variants.zh: 获胜；流行（第三人称单数）
获胜；流行（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praevalere（更强大），由 prae（在前）+ valere（强壮）构成
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ vail（强壮）→ 强者在前 → 获胜、盛行

pregnancy.zh: 怀孕；丰富；多产；意义深长

meanings.exampleEn: Her pregnancy was complicated by high blood pressure.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的怀孕因高血压而变得复杂。

meanings.exampleEn: The pregnancy of the landscape's colors overwhelmed the painter.
meanings.exampleZh: 风景色彩的丰富性令画家惊叹。

meanings.exampleEn: The pregnancy of the soil ensured a bountiful crop.
meanings.exampleZh: 土壤的多产确保了丰收。

meanings.exampleEn: The pregnancy of her silence spoke louder than words.
meanings.exampleZh: 她沉默的意义深长胜过千言万语。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praegnans，由 prae-（前）+ gnatus（出生）构成，原义为“出生前的”。
etymology.tip: pre（前）+ gn（出生）+ ancy（状态）→ 孩子出生前的状态 → 怀孕

meanings.exampleEn: The fundamental principle of democracy is that all citizens are equal before the law.
meanings.exampleZh: 民主的基本原则是法律面前所有公民一律平等。

meanings.exampleEn: This device operates on the principle of electromagnetic induction.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个装置利用电磁感应原理运行。

meanings.exampleEn: He remained faithful to the socialist principle throughout his political career.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在整个政治生涯中始终忠于社会主义。

variants.zh: 原则；原理；主义（复数形式）

phrases.zh: 按照原则；依据道德准则

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 principium（开始，起源），由 primus（第一） + capere（拿取）演变而来
etymology.tip: princip（首要）+ le（名词）→ 首要的准则 → 原则；原理

meanings.exampleEn: In the preface, the author explains why she wrote the book.
meanings.exampleZh: 在序言中，作者解释了她写这本书的原因。

meanings.exampleEn: The famous critic prefaced the young writer's first novel.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位著名评论家为这位年轻作家的第一部小说作了序。

meanings.exampleEn: She prefaced her speech with a brief introduction.
meanings.exampleZh: 她以简短的介绍开始了她的演讲。

variants.zh: 为…作序；以…开始（过去式/过去分词）
为…作序；以…开始（现在分词）
为…作序；以…开始（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praefatio，由 prae-（前）+ fari（说）构成
etymology.tip: pre（前）+ face（说）→ 在前面说的话 → 前言

meanings.exampleEn: The gardener transferred the seedlings into a larger pot to allow their roots to expand.
meanings.exampleZh: 园丁把幼苗移栽到更大的盆里，让根系得以伸展。

meanings.exampleEn: The archaeologist unearthed an ancient pot filled with carbonized grain.
meanings.exampleZh: 考古学家挖出了一个装满碳化谷物的古罐。

meanings.exampleEn: She brewed a fragrant pot of oolong tea for the distinguished guests.
meanings.exampleZh: 她为贵客沏了一壶芳香的乌龙茶。

meanings.exampleEn: The artisan heated the alloy in a pot until it emitted an intense glow.
meanings.exampleZh: 工匠在坩埚中加热合金，直到它发出炽热的光芒。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

priest.zh: 祭司；牧师；神父；神质人员

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient priest performed the sacred ritual at dawn.
meanings.exampleZh: 古代祭司在黎明时分执行神圣的仪式。

meanings.exampleEn: The priest delivered a moving sermon that resonated with the congregation.
meanings.exampleZh: 牧师发表了一篇感人的布道，引起了会众的共鸣。

meanings.exampleEn: The priest heard the confession of the penitent sinner.
meanings.exampleZh: 神父听取了忏悔者的告解。

meanings.exampleEn: As a priest, he devoted his life to serving the community.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名神职人员，他献身于服务社区。

variants.zh: 祭司；牧师；神父；神职人员（复数）
祭司的；牧师的；神职人员的
神职界；牧师身份；祭司职位

phrases.zh: （旧时天主教神父的）藏身密室

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 presbyter，源自古希腊语 presbyteros（长老），经古法语 prestre 演变而来
etymology.tip: 长老（presbyter）在宗教中逐渐演变为祭司、牧师等神职角色

prior.zh: 更重要的；较早的；在先的

meanings.zh: 更重要的；较早的；在先的
meanings.exampleEn: Prior to the meeting, we need to review all the relevant documents carefully.
meanings.exampleZh: 在会议之前，我们需要仔细审阅所有相关文件。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 prior（前面的，较前的），是 primus 的比较级
etymology.tip: pri（在前）+ or（比较级）= 更靠前的，即较早的、更重要的

meanings.exampleEn: For the prevention of disease, regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential.
meanings.exampleZh: 为了预防疾病，定期锻炼和均衡饮食至关重要。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praevenire，由 prae（前）+ venire（来）构成，意为‘走在前面、预先采取行动’
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: pre（前）+ vent（来）+ ion = 提前来到，提前防范

meanings.exampleEn: The producer of the film won an award for its innovative storytelling.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部电影的制作人因其创新的叙事方式而获奖。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 producere（向前引出，产生），由 pro-（向前）和 ducere（引导）组合而成。
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ duc（引导）+ er（人）→ 把东西向前引出来的人 → 生产者/制作人。

meanings.exampleEn: The primitive tribe still uses tools made of stone and bone.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个原始部落仍使用石头和骨头制成的工具。

meanings.exampleEn: The living conditions in the remote village were quite primitive, with no electricity or running water.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个偏远村庄的生活条件相当简陋，没有电也没有自来水。

meanings.exampleEn: The primitives of the region left behind cave paintings that reveal their daily life.
meanings.exampleZh: 该地区的原始人留下了揭示他们日常生活的洞穴壁画。

meanings.zh: 早期艺术家（尤指文艺复兴前的艺术家）
meanings.exampleEn: The exhibition showcases works by the Italian primitives, including Giotto.
meanings.exampleZh: 展览展出了包括乔托在内的意大利早期艺术家的作品。

variants.zh: 原始人；早期艺术家（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 primitivus，意为“最早的、最初的”，源自 primus（第一）
etymology.tip: prim（第一）+ itive（性质）→ 第一时期的 → 原始的

meanings.exampleEn: Probably the most significant factor is the lack of adequate funding for research.
meanings.exampleZh: 大概最重要的因素是缺乏足够的研究资金。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 probabilis，由 probare（证明）派生，后经古法语和英语演变而来
etymology.tip: prob（证明）+ able（能…的）+ ly → 能证明的 → 大概的

meanings.exampleEn: The artist's presentation of urban decay challenged conventional aesthetic norms.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家对城市衰败的呈现挑战了传统的审美规范。

meanings.exampleEn: Her presentation on climate change was both informative and persuasive.
meanings.exampleZh: 她关于气候变化的报告既信息丰富又具有说服力。

meanings.exampleEn: The presentation of the award was followed by a standing ovation.
meanings.exampleZh: 颁奖之后全场起立鼓掌。

meanings.exampleEn: His presentation of the facts was deliberately misleading.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对事实的描述故意具有误导性。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praesentatio(n-)，由 praesentare（呈现、展示）派生，最终源自 prae-（在前）+ esse（存在）。
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ sent（存在）+ ation（行为）→ 把事物呈现在眼前 → 展示、介绍

meanings.exampleEn: Your presence at the conference is essential for the final decision.
meanings.exampleZh: 你出席会议对于最终决定至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: He felt uneasy in the presence of his strict supervisor.
meanings.exampleZh: 在严厉的主管面前，他感到不自在。

meanings.exampleEn: The presence of toxic chemicals in the river has alarmed local residents.
meanings.exampleZh: 河流中有毒化学物质的存在令当地居民感到震惊。

meanings.exampleEn: The young actor's stage presence captivated the entire audience.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位年轻演员的舞台仪态迷住了全场观众。

phrases.zh: 使别人感到自己的存在；彰显存在感

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praesentia，由 prae-（在前）+ esse（存在）构成
etymology.tip: pre（前）+ ess（存在）+ ence（名词）→ 存在于前 → 出席、面前

productive.zh: 能生产的；有生产价值的；多产的

meanings.zh: 能生产的；有生产价值的
meanings.exampleEn: The government is investing heavily in productive industries to boost the national economy.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府正在大力投资有生产价值的产业以促进国民经济。

meanings.exampleEn: She is one of the most productive writers of her generation, publishing a novel every year.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是同代人中最具多产的作家之一，每年都出版一部小说。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 producere（向前引出，产生），由 pro-（向前）+ ducere（引导）构成
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ duct（引导）+ ive（形容词后缀）→ 向前引导出成果的 → 多产的，有生产价值的

meanings.exampleEn: The experiment was conducted with great precision to ensure reliable results.
meanings.exampleZh: 实验以极高的精确度进行，以确保结果可靠。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praecisio(n-)，由 prae- "before" + caedere "to cut" 构成。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为或结果
etymology.tip: pre-前 + cis切 + ion名词 → 预先切准 → 精确

privilege.zh: 特权；特别恩典；基本权利；特免

meanings.zh: 特权；特别恩典；基本权利；特免
meanings.exampleEn: The diplomat claimed diplomatic privilege to avoid prosecution.
meanings.exampleZh: 该外交官声称享有外交特权以免于起诉。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy privileges those who have worked in the company for over a decade.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策给予在公司工作十年以上的人以特权。

variants.zh: privilege 的过去式和过去分词

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 privilegium（针对个人的法律），由 privus（私人的）+ lex（法律）构成
etymology.tip: 私人（priv）的法律（leg）就是特权（privilege）

meanings.exampleEn: The new safety procedure must be followed by all employees before entering the laboratory.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有员工在进入实验室前必须遵守新的安全程序。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 procedere（pro-向前 + cedere 走），意为“向前走”，后引申为“程序、过程”。
etymology.suffix: -ure = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ ced（走）+ ure（名词）→ 向前走的步骤 → 程序、过程。

meanings.exampleEn: The new surveillance system was criticized for violating citizens' privacy.
meanings.exampleZh: 新的监控系统因侵犯公民隐私而受到批评。

meanings.exampleEn: The famous author moved to a remote village to enjoy the privacy of rural life.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位著名作家搬到偏远的村庄，享受乡村生活的隐居之乐。

meanings.exampleEn: The meeting was held in strict privacy to avoid media attention.
meanings.exampleZh: 会议在严格保密的情况下举行，以避免媒体关注。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 privatus（私人的），经由古法语 privete 进入英语，后缀 -acy 表示性质或状态。
etymology.tip: priv（私人）+ acy（状态）→ 私人状态 → 隐私

meanings.exampleEn: I presume you are familiar with the basic principles of economics.
meanings.exampleZh: 我假定你熟悉经济学的基本原理。

meanings.exampleEn: The presence of a large number of police officers does not presume that a crime has been committed.
meanings.exampleZh: 大量警察的出现并不意味着发生了犯罪。

meanings.exampleEn: He presumed to question the professor's conclusion in front of the whole class.
meanings.exampleZh: 他擅自在全班面前质疑教授的结论。

meanings.exampleEn: She presumed on her friendship with the manager to get a promotion.
meanings.exampleZh: 她利用与经理的友谊获得了晋升。

phrases.zh: 利用；滥用（某人的好意等）
擅自做某事；胆敢做某事

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praesumere（预先拿取），由 prae-（前）+ sumere（拿取）构成
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ sume（拿取）= 预先拿取结论，即“假定、推测”

plot.zh: 小块土地；地区图；图；阴谋

meanings.exampleEn: The old farmer cultivated a small plot of land behind his cottage.
meanings.exampleZh: 老农夫在农舍后面耕种了一小块土地。

meanings.exampleEn: The architect drew a detailed plot of the new district.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑师绘制了新城区详图。

meanings.exampleEn: The police uncovered a plot to assassinate the prime minister.
meanings.exampleZh: 警方揭露了一个刺杀首相的阴谋。

meanings.exampleEn: The novel's intricate plot keeps readers engaged until the final page.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部小说错综复杂的情节让读者一直读到最后一页。

meanings.exampleEn: The rebels plotted to overthrow the government.
meanings.exampleZh: 叛乱者密谋推翻政府。

meanings.exampleEn: The navigator plotted the ship's course on the chart.
meanings.exampleZh: 领航员在海图上标绘了船的航线。

etymology.origin: 源自古英语 plot，意为小块土地；后引申出地图、阴谋、情节等义。
etymology.tip: 联想：一块小土地(plot)上，有人绘制图(plot)并策划阴谋(plot)。

meanings.exampleEn: The premier announced a series of economic reforms during the press conference.
meanings.exampleZh: 总理在新闻发布会上宣布了一系列经济改革。

meanings.exampleEn: The premier research institution in the country has made significant breakthroughs in artificial intelligence.
meanings.exampleZh: 该国首屈一指的研究机构在人工智能领域取得了重大突破。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 primarius（第一的），经法语 premier 进入英语
etymology.suffix: -ier 表示“与……有关的”或比较级后缀
etymology.tip: prim 是第一，premier 就是“第一的”；国家第一人即总理。

probable.zh: 很可能的；大概的；可信的

meanings.zh: 很可能的；大概的；可信的
meanings.exampleEn: It is probable that the economic recession will persist for another year.
meanings.exampleZh: 经济衰退很可能会再持续一年。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 probabilis，由 probare（证明、测试）派生而来
etymology.tip: prob（证明）+ able（可...的）→ 可被证明的 → 很可能的

meanings.exampleEn: Her proficiency in English enabled her to negotiate with international clients confidently.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对英语的精通使她能够自信地与外国客户谈判。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 proficere（前进，取得进展），由 pro-（向前）+ facere（做）构成
etymology.suffix: -iency = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ fic（做）+ iency（状态）→ 不断向前做、取得进展 → 精通、熟练

meanings.exampleEn: The company's success is primarily due to its innovative marketing strategy.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司的成功主要归功于其创新的营销策略。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 primus（第一），经由法语/英语演变为 primary，再加副词后缀 -ly。
etymology.tip: prim 是“第一、首要”，primarily 就是“首要地、主要地”。

meanings.exampleEn: She is proficient in three foreign languages, which gives her a competitive edge in the job market.
meanings.exampleZh: 她精通三门外语，这在就业市场上给了她竞争优势。

meanings.exampleEn: As a proficient in ancient Chinese calligraphy, he was invited to lecture at several universities.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为中国古代书法的专家，他受邀在多所大学讲学。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 proficere（前进，取得进展），由 pro-（向前）+ facere（做）演变而来
etymology.suffix: -ient = 具有……性质的（形容词后缀）
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ fic（做）+ ient → 能向前做出成绩的 → 熟练的、精通的

profitable.zh: 有利润的；有利益的；赚钱的

meanings.exampleEn: The company managed to turn the struggling division into a profitable business within two years.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司在两年内成功将亏损部门转变为盈利业务。

meanings.exampleEn: Negotiating a mutually profitable agreement requires patience and strategic thinking.
meanings.exampleZh: 达成互利的协议需要耐心和战略思维。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 proficere（前进，获益），由 pro-（向前）和 facere（做）组合而成，后经古法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ fit（做）+ able（可……的）→ 能向前做出收益的 → 有利润的

meanings.exampleEn: The detective discovered a crumpled note in the suspect's coat pocket.
meanings.exampleZh: 侦探在嫌疑人外套口袋里发现了一张皱巴巴的纸条。

meanings.exampleEn: In medieval times, travelers carried coins in a leather pocket tied to their belts.
meanings.exampleZh: 中世纪时，旅行者把硬币装在系在腰带上的皮钱袋里。

meanings.exampleEn: The unexpected medical expenses put a considerable dent in his pocket.
meanings.exampleZh: 意外的医疗费用让他的钱包大为缩水。

meanings.exampleEn: The geologists struck a pocket of natural gas while drilling the arid plateau.
meanings.exampleZh: 地质学家在干旱高原钻探时发现了一个天然气囊。

meanings.exampleEn: He pocketed the receipt after glancing at the total.
meanings.exampleZh: 他瞥了一眼总额后把收据放进了口袋。

meanings.exampleEn: The corrupt official pocketed a substantial portion of the public funds.
meanings.exampleZh: 那名腐败官员侵吞了相当一部分公共资金。

meanings.exampleEn: The pocket edition of the encyclopedia is convenient for quick reference.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部百科全书的袖珍版便于快速查阅。

variants.zh: 把…装进口袋（第三人称单数）
把…装进口袋（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古北法语 poque（袋子）的指小形式，后缀 -et 表示小
etymology.tip: pocket = pock(袋子) + et(小) → 小袋子 → 口袋

meanings.exampleEn: The company hired a professional consultant to improve its marketing strategy.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位专业顾问来改进其营销策略。

meanings.exampleEn: As a seasoned professional, she knows how to handle the most demanding clients.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名经验丰富的专业人士，她知道如何应对最苛刻的客户。

variants.zh: 不专业的；不符合职业规范的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 professio（公开声明），由 pro-（向前）+ fateri（承认，声明）演变而来
etymology.suffix: -ional = 形容词后缀，表示“与……有关的”
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ fess（说）+ ional → 公开宣称自己擅长某事的 → 专业的

meanings.exampleEn: His prejudice against people from other cultures prevented him from making friends.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对其他文化背景的人的偏见使他无法结交朋友。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy operated to the prejudice of the local farmers.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策的实施损害了当地农民的利益。

meanings.exampleEn: The media coverage prejudiced the jury against the defendant.
meanings.exampleZh: 媒体报道使陪审团对被告产生了偏见。

meanings.exampleEn: His careless remarks prejudiced his chances of promotion.
meanings.exampleZh: 他轻率的言论损害了他晋升的机会。

phrases.zh: 无偏见地；在不损害…的前提下

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praejudicium（预先审判），由 prae-（在前）+ judicium（审判）构成
etymology.suffix: -ice = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: 预先（pre）下判断（jud）就是偏见

private.zh: 私人的；秘密的；私立的；隐蔽的

meanings.exampleEn: The CEO's private jet is equipped with state-of-the-art communication systems.
meanings.exampleZh: 总裁的私人飞机配备了最先进的通信系统。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee held a private session to discuss the classified intelligence report.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会举行了一次秘密会议讨论机密情报报告。

meanings.exampleEn: Many parents prefer private schools because they offer smaller class sizes and more extracurricular activities.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多家长偏爱私立学校，因为它们提供更小的班级规模和更多的课外活动。

meanings.exampleEn: The detective discovered a private entrance concealed behind the bookshelf.
meanings.exampleZh: 侦探发现了书架后面一个隐蔽的入口。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 privatus，意为“私人的”，源自 privus “单独的、自己的”
etymology.suffix: -ate（形容词后缀，表示“具有…性质的”）
etymology.tip: priv（个人）+ ate（形容词后缀）→ 个人的、私人的

meanings.exampleEn: The adoption of artificial intelligence has significantly boosted productivity in the manufacturing sector.
meanings.exampleZh: 人工智能的采用显著提升了制造业的生产率。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 producere（向前引出，产生），由 pro-（向前）+ ducere（引导）构成，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -ivity = 表示性质、状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ duct（引导）+ ivity（性质）→ 向前引导出成果的能力 → 生产力

meanings.exampleEn: The progressive development of technology has transformed the way we communicate.
meanings.exampleZh: 技术的渐进发展改变了我们的交流方式。

meanings.exampleEn: As a progressive, she advocated for sweeping social reforms.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名进步人士，她主张进行全面的社会改革。

phrases.zh: 进步时代（美国历史上的改革时期）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 progredi（向前走），由 pro-（向前）+ gradi（行走）构成，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ gress（走）+ ive（的）→ 一直向前走的 → 进步的、渐进的。

meanings.exampleEn: The prevalence of remote work has transformed urban commuting patterns.
meanings.exampleZh: 远程工作的普遍性改变了城市通勤模式。

meanings.exampleEn: The prevalence of this disease among the elderly calls for immediate public health intervention.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种疾病在老年人中的流行需要立即的公共卫生干预。

meanings.exampleEn: The prevalence of smartphones in daily life has raised concerns about digital addiction.
meanings.exampleZh: 智能手机在日常生活中的广泛使用引发了人们对数字成瘾的担忧。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praevalere（占优势），经由中世纪拉丁语 praevalentia
etymology.suffix: -ence = 名词后缀，表示状态、性质
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ val（强）+ ence（名词）→ 力量在前 → 盛行、普遍

meanings.exampleEn: The government decided to prolong the deadline for filing tax returns due to the pandemic.
meanings.exampleZh: 由于疫情，政府决定延长报税截止日期。

variants.zh: 延长；拖延（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 prolongare，由 pro-（向前）+ longus（长）构成
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ long（长）→ 向前拉长 → 延长

profound.zh: 极深的；深厚的；深刻的；渊博的

meanings.exampleEn: The diver explored the profound depths of the ocean trench.
meanings.exampleZh: 潜水员探索了海沟极深的深处。

meanings.exampleEn: Their friendship developed into a profound bond over the years.
meanings.exampleZh: 多年来，他们的友谊发展成了一种深厚的纽带。

meanings.exampleEn: The philosopher's lecture had a profound influence on the students' thinking.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位哲学家的讲座对学生们的思想产生了深刻的影响。

meanings.exampleEn: She is a scholar of profound learning in ancient Chinese history.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是一位在中国古代史方面学识渊博的学者。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 profundus，由 pro-（向前）+ fundus（底部）构成，原意“深到底的”。
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ fund（底）= 探到底，引申为“深刻的、渊博的”。

meanings.exampleEn: The young artist gained prominence in the international art scene after her solo exhibition.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位年轻艺术家在举办个人展览后，在国际艺术界崭露头角，变得引人注目。

meanings.exampleEn: The surgeon carefully examined the bony prominence on the patient's wrist before making a diagnosis.
meanings.exampleZh: 外科医生在做出诊断前仔细检查了病人手腕上的骨性突起。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 prominere（向前突出），由 pro-（向前）+ minere（突出）构成
etymology.suffix: -ence = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ min（突出）+ ence（名词）→ 向前突出 → 显著、突起

meanings.exampleEn: The prince renounced his claim to the throne in order to marry a commoner.
meanings.exampleZh: 王子为了娶一位平民女子而放弃了王位继承权。

meanings.exampleEn: The prince of the principality presided over the grand ceremony.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公国的亲王主持了盛大的典礼。

meanings.exampleEn: The prince of the small kingdom sought alliances with neighboring states to ensure its survival.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个小国的国君寻求与邻国结盟以确保其生存。

meanings.exampleEn: In medieval Europe, a prince could wield significant political influence beyond his own domain.
meanings.exampleZh: 在中世纪的欧洲，贵族在其领地之外也能施加重大的政治影响。

variants.zh: 王子；亲王；国君；贵族（复数）

phrases.zh: 威尔士亲王（英国王储的封号）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 princeps（第一公民，首领），由 primus（第一）和 capere（拿取）组合演变而来。
etymology.tip: prince = prin（第一）+ ce（拿）→ 拿第一的人 → 首领、王子

meanings.exampleEn: The industrial pollution in the river has rendered the water undrinkable for thousands of residents.
meanings.exampleZh: 河流中的工业污染已使数千居民无法饮用该水。

meanings.exampleEn: The scandal was a pollution of the politician's previously unblemished reputation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻玷污了那位政客原本清白的名声。

etymology.root: lut = 洗（来自拉丁语 luere）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 polluere（弄脏），由 por-（=per-，彻底）与 luere（洗）组合而成
etymology.tip: 彻底洗(lut)出脏东西，就是污染

proceed.zh: 继续进行；进行；开始；发出

meanings.exampleEn: After the brief interruption, the speaker proceeded with his lecture.
meanings.exampleZh: 短暂中断后，演讲者继续他的讲座。

meanings.exampleEn: The negotiations are proceeding smoothly despite the initial disagreements.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管最初存在分歧，谈判仍在顺利进行。

meanings.exampleEn: Once the committee reached a consensus, they proceeded to implement the new regulations.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会达成共识后，他们着手实施新规定。

meanings.exampleEn: A strange noise proceeded from the abandoned warehouse at midnight.
meanings.exampleZh: 午夜时分，废弃仓库里发出一种奇怪的声音。

variants.zh: 继续进行（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 procedere，由 pro-（向前）+ cedere（走）构成
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ ceed（走）→ 向前走 → 继续进行

prominent.zh: 卓越的；显著的；突出的；凸出的

meanings.exampleEn: She is a prominent scientist whose research has transformed the field of genetics.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是一位卓越的科学家，其研究改变了遗传学领域。

meanings.exampleEn: The prominent increase in online learning has reshaped traditional education.
meanings.exampleZh: 在线学习的显著增长重塑了传统教育。

meanings.exampleEn: He played a prominent role in the international peace negotiations.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在国际和平谈判中发挥了突出的作用。

meanings.exampleEn: The prominent cheekbones of the sculpture gave it a striking, modern look.
meanings.exampleZh: 雕塑凸出的颧骨赋予其引人注目的现代感。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 prominere（向前突出），由 pro-（向前）+ minere（突出）构成
etymology.suffix: -ent = 形容词后缀，表示“具有……性质的”
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ min（突出）+ ent（的）→ 向前突出的 → 显著的、卓越的

meanings.exampleEn: She won the first prize in the national English speech contest.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在全国英语演讲比赛中获得了一等奖。

meanings.exampleEn: I prize my friendship with you above everything else.
meanings.exampleZh: 我珍视与你的友谊胜过一切。

meanings.exampleEn: The farmer exhibited his prize bull at the agricultural fair.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位农民在农业博览会上展出了他获奖的公牛。

variants.zh: 奖赏；奖金；奖品；战利品（复数）
珍视；高度重视（第三人称单数）
珍视；高度重视（过去式/过去分词）
珍视；高度重视（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 pris（价值、价格），源自拉丁语 pretium
etymology.tip: prize 与 price 同源，都表示“价值”；值得珍视的东西就是 prize。

meanings.exampleEn: The new regulations prohibit smoking in all public indoor areas.
meanings.exampleZh: 新法规禁止在所有室内公共场所吸烟。

meanings.exampleEn: Lack of funding prohibits the research project from proceeding.
meanings.exampleZh: 资金匮乏阻碍了该研究项目的推进。

variants.zh: 禁止的；抑制性的；（价格等）高得令人望而却步的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 prohibere，由 pro-（向前/在前）+ habere（持有）构成，原意为“向前拦住”，引申为“阻止、禁止”。
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ hibit（握住）→ 在前面一把拦住 → 禁止、阻止。

meanings.exampleEn: Regular vaccination can prevent the outbreak of infectious diseases.
meanings.exampleZh: 定期接种疫苗可以预防传染病的爆发。

meanings.exampleEn: Effective measures should be taken to prevent environmental pollution.
meanings.exampleZh: 应采取有效措施防止环境污染。

meanings.exampleEn: The security guard prevented the unauthorized visitors from entering the restricted area.
meanings.exampleZh: 保安阻止了未经授权的访客进入限制区域。

meanings.exampleEn: Lack of sleep may prevent the brain from functioning at its full capacity.
meanings.exampleZh: 睡眠不足可能妨碍大脑充分发挥功能。

phrases.zh: 阻止某人做某事；防止某事发生

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praevenire（prae- 在前 + venire 来），经古法语 prevenir 进入英语
etymology.tip: pre（提前）+ vent（来）= 提前来到，提前应对，即预防

meanings.exampleEn: The company's success is principally due to its innovative marketing strategy.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司的成功主要归功于其创新的营销策略。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 principalis，源自 princeps（首领，第一人），由 primus（第一）+ capere（拿取）构成
etymology.tip: principal（主要的）+ -ly → 主要地；记住 principal 是“主要的”，加 ly 变副词。

meanings.exampleEn: She chose medicine as her profession after years of deliberation.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过多年深思熟虑，她选择了医学作为自己的职业。

meanings.exampleEn: His profession of love was met with an awkward silence.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的爱情表白换来了一阵尴尬的沉默。

meanings.exampleEn: The politician's public profession of support for the reform surprised many voters.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位政治家公开声明支持改革，令许多选民感到惊讶。

phrases.zh: 专门职业（尤指律师、医生等）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 professio，由 pro-（向前）+ fateri（承认）构成。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为或状态
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ fess（说）+ ion（名词）→ 向前公开说出 → 职业（公开宣称的使命），也可指表白、声明。

meanings.exampleEn: The production of electric vehicles has increased significantly over the past decade.
meanings.exampleZh: 过去十年间，电动汽车的生产量显著增加。

meanings.exampleEn: This film is a remarkable production that combines stunning visuals with a compelling story.
meanings.exampleZh: 这部电影是一部出色的作品，将震撼的视觉效果与引人入胜的故事相结合。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 producere（pro-向前 + ducere 引导），经由古法语和英语演变为 production。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 名词后缀，表示行为、过程或结果
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ duct（引导）+ ion（名词）→ 向前引导出东西 → 生产、制造。

meanings.exampleEn: The gazelle, as the natural prey of the cheetah, relies on its speed for survival.
meanings.exampleZh: 瞪羚作为猎豹的自然猎物，依靠速度生存。

meanings.exampleEn: Many small businesses fall prey to economic recessions.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多小企业成为经济衰退的牺牲品。

meanings.exampleEn: Some deep-sea creatures prey on organisms that are considerably larger than themselves.
meanings.exampleZh: 一些深海生物捕食比自身大得多的生物。

meanings.exampleEn: During the Middle Ages, pirates preyed on merchant ships in the Mediterranean.
meanings.exampleZh: 中世纪时期，海盗在地中海掠夺商船。

meanings.exampleEn: The fear of failure preyed on her mind throughout the entire competition.
meanings.exampleZh: 对失败的恐惧在整个比赛期间折磨着她的心灵。

variants.zh: 捕食；掠夺；折磨（第三人称单数）
捕食；掠夺；折磨（过去式/过去分词）
捕食；掠夺；折磨（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 成为…的牺牲品；深受…之害

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 preie，源自拉丁语 praeda（战利品，猎物）
etymology.tip: prey 音似“捕猎”，被捕食者就是猎物。

meanings.exampleEn: The government has taken measures to promote economic growth in rural areas.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已采取措施促进农村地区的经济增长。

meanings.exampleEn: She was promoted to manager after only two years with the company.
meanings.exampleZh: 她进入公司仅两年就被晋升为经理。

meanings.exampleEn: The organization was promoted by a group of environmental activists in 2010.
meanings.exampleZh: 该组织由一群环保活动人士于2010年创办。

meanings.exampleEn: The company launched a global campaign to promote its latest smartphone.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司发起了一场全球活动来推销其最新款智能手机。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 promovere，由 pro-（向前）+ movere（移动）构成
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ mot（移动）+ e → 使事物向前移动 → 促进、推动；引申为晋升、推销。

meanings.exampleEn: The notorious criminal was sentenced to ten years in prison for his involvement in the fraud scheme.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名臭名昭著的罪犯因参与诈骗计划被判处十年监禁。

meanings.exampleEn: The dictator sought to prison any journalist who dared to criticize his regime.
meanings.exampleZh: 该独裁者试图监禁任何敢于批评其政权的记者。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语prehensio（抓住），经古法语prisun进入英语
etymology.tip: prehens=抓住，prison就是“抓人、关人的地方”

meanings.exampleEn: The new engine design is expected to propel the spacecraft to unprecedented speeds.
meanings.exampleZh: 新的发动机设计有望将航天器推进到前所未有的速度。

variants.zh: 推进；驱使（过去式/过去分词）
推进；驱使（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 propellere，由 pro-（向前）+ pellere（推）构成
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ pel（推）= 向前推，即“推进；驱使”

meanings.exampleEn: The engineer preset the machine's parameters before the production run.
meanings.exampleZh: 工程师在生产运行前预先调整了机器参数。

meanings.exampleEn: The device operates according to a preset schedule.
meanings.exampleZh: 该设备按照预设的时间表运行。

variants.zh: 预先设置（第三人称单数）
预先设置（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 由前缀 pre-（预先）与英语动词 set（设置）组合而成，源自古英语 settan
etymology.tip: pre（预先）+ set（设置）= 预先设置

meanings.exampleEn: The progress of the project was hindered by a lack of funding.
meanings.exampleZh: 项目的进展因缺乏资金而受阻。

meanings.exampleEn: As the semester progressed, her academic performance improved steadily.
meanings.exampleZh: 随着学期的推进，她的学业成绩稳步提高。

variants.zh: 进步；进展；前进（过去式/过去分词）
进步；进展；前进（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 progressus，由前缀 pro-（向前）和动词 gradi（行走）构成
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ gress（走）= 向前走 → 进步、前进

meanings.exampleEn: The university's long history has earned it considerable prestige in academic circles.
meanings.exampleZh: 这所大学的悠久历史为其在学术界赢得了相当的声望。

meanings.exampleEn: She drove a prestige car that attracted admiring glances from passers-by.
meanings.exampleZh: 她开着一辆名贵轿车，引来路人羡慕的目光。

etymology.root: stig = 刺，点（来自拉丁语 stinguere/stigare）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 praestigiae（幻术、骗术），由 prae-（在前）+ stig-（刺）构成，原指变戏法者的障眼法，后引申为魅力、声望。
etymology.tip: pre（在前）+ stig（刺）→ 在众人面前留下深刻“刺”点 → 声望

meanings.exampleEn: The prophecy of the ancient seer finally came true after centuries.
meanings.exampleZh: 古代先知的预言在数百年后终于应验了。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 propheteia，由 pro（预先）+ phetes（说话者）组合而成，意为“预先说出的话”。
etymology.suffix: -y = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果或状态
etymology.tip: pro（提前）+ phet（说）+ y（名词）→ 提前说出的话 → 预言

meanings.exampleEn: In academic writing, the excessive use of pronouns can sometimes obscure the clarity of the argument.
meanings.exampleZh: 在学术写作中，过度使用代词有时会削弱论证的清晰度。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pronomen，由 pro-（代替）+ nomen（名字/名词）构成
etymology.tip: pro（代替）+ noun（名词）→ 代替名词的词，就是代词

meanings.exampleEn: You must learn to express your ideas properly in academic writing.
meanings.exampleZh: 你必须学会在学术写作中恰当地表达自己的观点。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy has properly upset a large number of citizens.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项新政策相当地激怒了大量市民。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 proprius，经古法语 proper 进入英语，原意为“自己的、特有的”，后引申为“适当的”。
etymology.tip: proper（适当的）+ ly = 适当地；记住“proper”是“适当”，加-ly就是“适当地”。

meanings.exampleEn: The safety of employees is the top priority in any industrial operation.
meanings.exampleZh: 员工安全在任何工业运营中都是最高优先权。

meanings.exampleEn: In emergency situations, saving lives takes priority over all other considerations.
meanings.exampleZh: 在紧急情况下，挽救生命优先于所有其他考虑。

meanings.exampleEn: The government has made education a priority in its policy agenda.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府已将教育列为政策议程中的优先事项。

phrases.zh: 最高优先事项；最优先的事

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 prior（先前的，优先的），由 prior + -ity 构成
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: prior（先前的）+ ity（名词后缀）→ 优先权；联想：先前的（prior）事情拥有优先权（priority）

proper.zh: 适当的；固有的；高尚的；专属的

meanings.exampleEn: It is not proper to interrupt others while they are speaking.
meanings.exampleZh: 在别人说话时打断是不恰当的。

meanings.exampleEn: The proper meaning of this ancient symbol has been lost over time.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个古老符号本身的含义已随时间的流逝而失传。

meanings.exampleEn: She always behaved in a proper manner at formal gatherings.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在正式场合总是表现得体、高尚。

meanings.exampleEn: This custom is proper to the indigenous tribes of the region.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种习俗是该地区土著部落所特有的。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 proprius，意为“自己的、特有的”，后经古法语 proper 进入英语。
etymology.tip: proper 的核心是“属于自己的”，所以引申为“适当的、固有的、专属的”。

meanings.exampleEn: The rapid propagation of the invasive species has threatened the local ecosystem.
meanings.exampleZh: 入侵物种的快速繁殖已威胁到当地生态系统。

meanings.exampleEn: The propagation of scientific knowledge is essential for social progress.
meanings.exampleZh: 科学知识的传播对社会进步至关重要。

variants.zh: 繁殖；传播（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 propagare（扩展，繁殖），由 pro-（向前）+ pangere（固定）演变而来
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ pag（固定）+ ation → 向前固定枝条 → 繁殖、传播

meanings.exampleEn: The committee rejected the proposal to cut funding for the research program.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会否决了削减研究项目资金的提议。

meanings.exampleEn: Her proposal for urban renewal includes building more affordable housing.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的城市更新计划包括建造更多经济适用房。

meanings.exampleEn: He knelt down and made a romantic proposal to his girlfriend on the beach.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在海滩上跪下，向女友进行了浪漫的求婚。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 proponere（向前放置），由 pro-（向前）+ ponere（放置）构成，后经法语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -al = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ pos（放置）+ al（名词）→ 把想法放到前面 → 提议、计划。

meanings.exampleEn: The development of nuclear propulsion has revolutionized modern submarine design.
meanings.exampleZh: 核推进技术的发展彻底改变了现代潜艇的设计。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 propellere（向前推），由 pro-（向前）和 pellere（推）组合而成，其过去分词词干为 puls-。
etymology.suffix: -ion = 表示行为、状态或结果的名词后缀
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ puls（推）+ ion（名词后缀）→ 向前推的力量 → 推进力。

prone.zh: 俯伏的；面向下的；有...倾向的

meanings.exampleEn: The soldier lay prone on the ground to avoid enemy fire.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵俯伏在地以躲避敌人的火力。

meanings.exampleEn: People who are prone to anxiety often overthink simple decisions.
meanings.exampleZh: 容易焦虑的人常常对简单的决定想得过多。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 pronus（向前倾斜的，俯伏的）
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ ne（呢）→向前趴着→俯伏的；引申为有...倾向的

meanings.exampleEn: The aircraft's propeller spun rapidly as the pilot prepared for takeoff.
meanings.exampleZh: 飞行员准备起飞时，飞机的螺旋桨快速旋转。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 propellere，由 pro-（向前）和 pellere（驱赶）组合而成
etymology.suffix: -er = 表示物（或执行动作的事物）
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ pel（推）+ ler（物）→ 向前推的东西 → 螺旋桨

meanings.exampleEn: She promptly replied to the urgent email, demonstrating her efficiency.
meanings.exampleZh: 她迅速回复了那封紧急邮件，展现了她的高效。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 promptus，由 pro-（向前）+ emere（拿取）构成，原义“现成的、迅速的”。
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ em（拿）+ -ly → 向前一把抓，动作利落 → 敏捷地。

meanings.exampleEn: Her prose is so vivid that readers feel as if they are living inside the story.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的散文如此生动，读者仿佛置身于故事之中。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 prosa oratio，意为“直白的语言”，由 pro-（向前）和 vertere（转）演变而来。
etymology.tip: pro（向前）+ vers（转）→ 直截了当转述的文体，即散文。

plump.zh: 圆胖的；丰满的；直接下落的；直率的

meanings.exampleEn: The plump cushions on the sofa made the reading nook look inviting.
meanings.exampleZh: 沙发上的圆胖靠垫让这个阅读角落显得很诱人。

meanings.exampleEn: Her plump refusal left no room for further negotiation.
meanings.exampleZh: 她直率的拒绝没有留下任何进一步协商的余地。

meanings.exampleEn: She plumped up the cushions before the guests arrived.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在客人到来之前把靠垫拍得鼓鼓的。

meanings.exampleEn: The dried apricots plumped up after being soaked in warm water.
meanings.exampleZh: 杏干在温水浸泡后变得饱满起来。

meanings.exampleEn: Exhausted, he plumped onto the bed without even removing his shoes.
meanings.exampleZh: 他筋疲力尽，连鞋都没脱就扑通一声倒在床上。

meanings.exampleEn: She plumped the heavy suitcase down on the scale at the airport.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把沉重的行李箱猛地放在机场的秤上。

meanings.exampleEn: The car ran plump into the guardrail, startling all the passengers.
meanings.exampleZh: 汽车径直撞上护栏，吓坏了所有乘客。

meanings.exampleEn: He told her plump that her proposal was impractical.
meanings.exampleZh: 他直率地告诉她，她的提议不切实际。

variants.zh: 使丰满；变丰满；突然落下
使丰满；变丰满；突然落下
使丰满；变丰满；突然落下

etymology.origin: 拟声词，源自中古荷兰语 plompen（重落），后引申为‘圆胖的’；无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: 无词根词缀，联想‘扑通’一声落下，或‘胖胖的’样子。

meanings.exampleEn: The surgeon inserted a thin probe into the patient's artery to measure blood flow.
meanings.exampleZh: 外科医生将一根细探针插入病人的动脉以测量血流。

meanings.exampleEn: NASA's space probe sent back detailed images of Jupiter's icy moons.
meanings.exampleZh: 美国宇航局的太空探测器传回了木星冰卫星的详细图像。
