etymology.tip: 本义刺痛，刺痛感让人清醒，引申为聪明

meanings.exampleEn: Soy sauce is an essential condiment in many Asian cuisines.
meanings.exampleZh: 酱油是许多亚洲菜肴中必不可少的调味品。

meanings.exampleEn: The farmer cultivated soy as a primary cash crop.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位农民将大豆作为主要经济作物种植。

etymology.origin: 来自日语shōyu（醤油），后经荷兰语soya进入英语，最初指酱油，后引申指大豆。
etymology.tip: 借词无词根，联想“soy sauce”酱油即可记住soy。

spark.zh: 火花；火星；闪光；无线电报务员

meanings.exampleEn: The spark from the campfire ignited the dry leaves.
meanings.exampleZh: 篝火溅出的火花点燃了干枯的树叶。

meanings.exampleEn: A stray spark flew onto the carpet and burned a small hole.
meanings.exampleZh: 一粒火星飞溅到地毯上，烧了一个小洞。

meanings.exampleEn: The diamond emitted a brilliant spark in the sunlight.
meanings.exampleZh: 钻石在阳光下发出璀璨的闪光。

meanings.exampleEn: The ship's spark sent distress signals throughout the night.
meanings.exampleZh: 船上的无线电报务员整夜发送求救信号。

meanings.exampleEn: The faulty wires sparked dangerously in the damp basement.
meanings.exampleZh: 潮湿的地下室里，有故障的电线危险地冒着火花。

meanings.exampleEn: The economic crisis sparked widespread social unrest.
meanings.exampleZh: 经济危机引发了广泛的社会动荡。

variants.zh: 发出火花；引发（第三人称单数）
发出火花；引发（过去式/过去分词）
发出火花；引发（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The scientist examined the specimen under a microscope before drawing any conclusions.
meanings.exampleZh: 科学家在得出结论之前，用显微镜仔细检查了该标本。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 specere（看），后经拉丁语 specimen（样本、范例）演变而来
etymology.tip: spec（看）+ -imen（名词后缀）→ 用来看的东西 → 样品、标本

sober.zh: 未醉的；稳重的；节制的；严肃的

meanings.exampleEn: He was still sober after drinking three glasses of wine.
meanings.exampleZh: 喝了三杯葡萄酒后，他仍然没有醉。

meanings.exampleEn: The manager is a sober and reliable person who never acts on impulse.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位经理稳重可靠，从不冲动行事。

meanings.exampleEn: She leads a sober life, avoiding excessive eating and drinking.
meanings.exampleZh: 她过着节制的生活，避免过度饮食。

meanings.exampleEn: The article gives a sober assessment of the current economic situation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这篇文章对当前经济形势作出了严肃的评估。

variants.zh: 使人清醒的；令人警醒的

phrases.zh: 非常清醒的；严肃稳重的

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 sobrius（清醒的），由 se-（无）+ ebrius（醉的）构成，经古法语 sobre 进入英语。
etymology.tip: se（无）+ ebrius（醉）→ 不醉的 → 清醒的；节制的

slot.zh: 水沟；细长孔；硬币投币口；缝

meanings.exampleEn: The torrential rain carved a deep slot along the hillside, washing away the topsoil.
meanings.exampleZh: 暴雨在山坡上冲出一条深沟，冲走了表土。

meanings.exampleEn: Insert the coin into the narrow slot on the vending machine.
meanings.exampleZh: 把硬币投入自动售货机的细长孔中。

meanings.exampleEn: The slot on the telephone was jammed, so the call could not be connected.
meanings.exampleZh: 电话机的投币口卡住了，电话无法接通。

meanings.exampleEn: He peered through the slot in the door to see who was knocking.
meanings.exampleZh: 他从门缝里往外看，想看清是谁在敲门。

meanings.exampleEn: The new program occupies a prime time slot on Saturday evening.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个新节目占据了周六晚上的黄金时段。

meanings.exampleEn: Please slot the disk into the drive before restarting the computer.
meanings.exampleZh: 请将光盘放入驱动器，然后重启电脑。

variants.zh: 把…放入狭槽；安排（第三人称单数）
把…放入狭槽；安排（过去式/过去分词）
把…放入狭槽；安排（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: Scientists speculate that the mysterious signal may originate from a distant pulsar.
meanings.exampleZh: 科学家推测这个神秘信号可能来自一颗遥远的脉冲星。

meanings.exampleEn: He made a fortune by speculating in real estate during the economic boom.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在经济繁荣时期通过投机房地产赚了一大笔钱。

meanings.exampleEn: Philosophers often speculate on the nature of consciousness and free will.
meanings.exampleZh: 哲学家常常深思意识与自由意志的本质。

phrases.zh: 投机于……（如股票、房地产等）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 speculari（观察、窥探），由 specula（瞭望台）派生而来
etymology.tip: 用“看”的眼光去“推测”未来，或“看”准时机进行“投机”

slope.zh: 倾斜；斜坡；斜率；扛枪姿势

meanings.exampleEn: The house is built on a gentle slope overlooking the valley.
meanings.exampleZh: 房子建在俯瞰山谷的缓坡上。

meanings.exampleEn: The slope of the line on the graph indicates the rate of change.
meanings.exampleZh: 图表上直线的斜率表示变化率。

meanings.exampleEn: The slope of the roof is designed to allow snow to slide off easily.
meanings.exampleZh: 屋顶的倾斜度设计成便于积雪滑落。

meanings.exampleEn: The soldier stood at the slope with his rifle on his shoulder.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵扛着枪，保持持枪姿势站立。

meanings.exampleEn: The terrain slopes gently towards the river.
meanings.exampleZh: 地形向河流微微倾斜。

meanings.exampleEn: He sloped the board against the wall to create a makeshift ramp.
meanings.exampleZh: 他把木板斜靠在墙上，做成临时坡道。

variants.zh: 倾斜；使倾斜（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 滑坡；无法控制的危险局面

etymology.origin: 源自古英语 slopen（滑倒），与 slip 同源，引申为倾斜
etymology.tip: slope 与 slip（滑）同源，滑落的地方就是斜坡

meanings.exampleEn: The contract specifies the terms and conditions of the agreement in great detail.
meanings.exampleZh: 合同详细列出了协议的条款和条件。

meanings.exampleEn: Please specify the exact location where the meeting will be held.
meanings.exampleZh: 请指定会议举行的确切地点。

meanings.exampleEn: The regulations specify that all employees must wear safety helmets.
meanings.exampleZh: 条例说明所有员工必须佩戴安全帽。

variants.zh: 指定（specify的过去式和过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 specificare，由 specere（看）和 -ficare（使成为）构成
etymology.tip: spec（看）+ ify（使）→ 使被看见 → 明确指定、说明

spinal.zh: 针的；尖刺的；尖刺状突起的；脊骨的

meanings.exampleEn: The spinal column consists of a series of vertebrae that protect the delicate nerve tissue.
meanings.exampleZh: 脊柱由一系列椎骨组成，保护着脆弱的神经组织。

meanings.zh: 针的；尖刺的；尖刺状突起的
meanings.exampleEn: The cactus has spinal outgrowths that deter herbivores from approaching.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种仙人掌长有尖刺状突起，以阻止食草动物靠近。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 spina（刺，脊柱）
etymology.tip: spin（刺/脊柱）+ al（……的）→ 与脊柱或尖刺相关的

meanings.exampleEn: The prism splits white light into a continuous spectrum of colors.
meanings.exampleZh: 棱镜将白光分解成连续的光谱颜色。

meanings.exampleEn: The policy has attracted support from a wide spectrum of political groups.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项政策赢得了各种政治团体的广泛支持。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 spectrum（外观、影像），源自 specere（看）
etymology.tip: spect（看）+ -um（名词）→ 看到的光带 → 光谱；引申为“范围、系列”

meanings.exampleEn: He drove the spade into the frozen ground, determined to dig out the stubborn root.
meanings.exampleZh: 他把铲子用力扎进冻土，决心挖出那顽固的树根。

meanings.exampleEn: She played the ace of spades and won the final trick of the game.
meanings.exampleZh: 她打出了黑桃A，赢得了牌局的最后一墩。

meanings.exampleEn: The gardener spaded the compost into the flower beds to enrich the soil.
meanings.exampleZh: 园丁用铲子把堆肥翻进花坛，以肥沃土壤。

variants.zh: 用铲子铲（第三人称单数）
用铲子铲（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 艰苦的准备工作；基础工作

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 spadu，与希腊语 spathē（宽刃、铲）同源
etymology.tip: spade 音似“撕胚”：用铲子撕开土胚；黑桃的形状也像一把铲子。

meanings.exampleEn: The diver used a sponge to collect samples from the coral reef.
meanings.exampleZh: 潜水员用海绵从珊瑚礁上采集样本。

meanings.exampleEn: The cake has a light sponge texture that absorbs the syrup quickly.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种蛋糕质地松软如海绵，能迅速吸收糖浆。

meanings.exampleEn: She sponged the stain off the silk fabric with gentle care.
meanings.exampleZh: 她小心翼翼地用海绵擦去丝绸面料上的污渍。

meanings.zh: 白吃白拿；依赖他人生活
meanings.exampleEn: He has been sponging off his relatives for years instead of finding a job.
meanings.exampleZh: 多年来他一直依赖亲戚生活，而不是去找工作。

variants.zh: 用海绵擦拭（过去式/过去分词）
用海绵擦拭；白吃白拿（现在分词）

phrases.zh: 依赖某人生活；白吃白拿

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 spongia，源自古希腊语 spongia，本义为“海绵”。
etymology.tip: sponge 音似“死胖之”，海绵吸水后鼓胀如胖，记住“海绵”即可。

related.zh: 海绵状的（尤指组织病变）

meanings.exampleEn: The sparkle of the diamond caught everyone's attention.
meanings.exampleZh: 钻石的闪光吸引了所有人的注意。

meanings.exampleEn: Her eyes were full of sparkle and enthusiasm.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的眼中充满了活力和热情。

meanings.exampleEn: The sparkle in the champagne made it look festive.
meanings.exampleZh: 香槟中的气泡使它看起来充满节日气氛。

meanings.exampleEn: The stars sparkled in the clear night sky.
meanings.exampleZh: 星星在晴朗的夜空中闪烁。

meanings.exampleEn: She sparkles with wit and charm at every social gathering.
meanings.exampleZh: 每次社交聚会上她都展现出机智与魅力，充满活力。

meanings.exampleEn: The mineral water sparkles when poured into a glass.
meanings.exampleZh: 矿泉水倒入玻璃杯时会冒泡。

variants.zh: 闪耀；闪烁（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 sparklen，源自古英语 spearca（火花），-le 为反复动词后缀
etymology.tip: spark（火花）+ -le（反复）→ 像火花一样不断闪耀

meanings.exampleEn: The teacher gave us specific instructions on how to conduct the experiment.
meanings.exampleZh: 老师就如何做实验给了我们具体的指导。

meanings.exampleEn: This herbal remedy is a specific for chronic cough.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种草药是治疗慢性咳嗽的特效药。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 specificus，由 specere（看）和 -ificus（产生……的）组合而成，原意为“使可见的、特别的”。
etymology.tip: spec（看）+ ific（使……的）→ 能让人一眼看明白的 → 具体的、明确的。

meanings.exampleEn: The government spokesman refused to comment on the ongoing negotiations.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府发言人拒绝对正在进行的谈判发表评论。

etymology.origin: 由 spoke（speak 的变体/过去式）+ man 构成，原指代表他人说话的人
etymology.tip: spoke（说话）+ man（人）= 替别人说话的人 → 发言人

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy is somewhat controversial among the employees.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策在员工中有些争议。

meanings.exampleEn: He is somewhat of a genius in mathematics.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在数学方面有几分天才。

etymology.origin: 古英语复合词：sum（某个）+ hwæt（什么），无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: some（某个）+ what（什么）→ 某个程度 → 稍微、有点。

specialize.zh: 使特殊化；列举；特别指明；限定...的范围

meanings.exampleEn: After years of general practice, the physician decided to specialize in oncology to better combat cancer.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过多年的全科实践，这位医生决定专攻肿瘤学，以更好地对抗癌症。

meanings.exampleEn: The curriculum was specialized to meet the demands of the emerging artificial intelligence industry.
meanings.exampleZh: 该课程被特殊化，以满足新兴人工智能行业的需求。

meanings.exampleEn: The contract specializes the exact conditions under which the parties may terminate the agreement.
meanings.exampleZh: 合同特别指明了双方可以终止协议的确切条件。

variants.zh: 专攻；使特殊化（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 specialis（特别的），源于 specere（看）；-ize 为动词后缀，表示'使...化'。
etymology.tip: special（特别的）+ -ize（使...化）→ 使成为特别的，即'专门化'；看到（spec）特别之处，使其专门化。

meanings.zh: 西班牙的；西班牙人的；西班牙语的
meanings.exampleEn: The Spanish government has implemented new economic reforms to boost employment.
meanings.exampleZh: 西班牙政府已实施新的经济改革以促进就业。

meanings.exampleEn: The Spanish are famous for their love of festivals and social gatherings.
meanings.exampleZh: 西班牙人以热爱节日和社交聚会而闻名。

meanings.exampleEn: Learning Spanish opens up opportunities across Latin America and Europe.
meanings.exampleZh: 学习西班牙语为拉丁美洲和欧洲带来机会。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 Hispania（西班牙），经由古英语/中古英语演变；后缀 -ish 表示'...的'。
etymology.suffix: -ish = 属于...的，有...性质的（形容词后缀）
etymology.tip: Spain（西班牙）+ -ish（...的）= Spanish 西班牙的；注意不是 Spainish。

meanings.exampleEn: The crystal sphere glittered on the mantelpiece, reflecting the firelight.
meanings.exampleZh: 水晶球在壁炉架上闪闪发光，反射着火光。

meanings.exampleEn: The points on a sphere are all equidistant from its center.
meanings.exampleZh: 球面上的所有点到球心的距离都相等。

meanings.exampleEn: The Earth is a sphere, slightly flattened at the poles.
meanings.exampleZh: 地球是一个球体，两极稍扁。

meanings.exampleEn: Ancient astronomers believed the stars were fixed to a celestial sphere.
meanings.exampleZh: 古代天文学家认为恒星固定在天球上。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 sphaira（球），经拉丁语 sphaera 进入英语
etymology.tip: sphere 就是球，想象一个球体，记住“斯菲亚”就是球

smash.zh: 打碎；粉碎；打碎时哗啦声；猛击

meanings.exampleEn: The vandal smashed the shop window with a brick, scattering glass fragments across the pavement.
meanings.exampleZh: 破坏者用砖头砸碎了商店橱窗，玻璃碎片散落在人行道上。

meanings.exampleEn: The champion smashed his rival with a powerful uppercut, ending the match in the third round.
meanings.exampleZh: 冠军用一记有力的上勾拳猛击对手，在第三回合结束了比赛。

meanings.exampleEn: The sudden smash of a falling vase startled everyone in the silent library.
meanings.exampleZh: 花瓶突然落地的哗啦声惊动了寂静图书馆里的所有人。

meanings.exampleEn: Her backhand smash was so fierce that the opponent could hardly react in time.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的反手猛击非常凶猛，对手几乎来不及反应。

phrases.zh: 巨大的成功；热门歌曲（或电影）

etymology.origin: 拟声词，模仿物体打碎时发出的哗啦声；可能源自中古英语 smashen。
etymology.tip: 听声音记单词：smash 的发音就像东西被猛击打碎时“哗啦”的声响。

meanings.exampleEn: Her spelling has improved dramatically since she started reading every day.
meanings.exampleZh: 自从她开始每天阅读以来，她的拼写能力显著提高了。

meanings.exampleEn: He is spelling the difficult word letter by letter.
meanings.exampleZh: 他正在一个字母一个字母地拼写那个难词。

variants.zh: 拼写（过去式/过去分词，英式）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 espeller，源自日耳曼语 *spellon（意为讲述、拼读）
etymology.tip: spell（拼写）+ ing = 拼写的行为，记住“拼写”就是“spell + ing”。

meanings.exampleEn: The company provides health insurance coverage for employees and their spouses.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司为员工及其配偶提供医疗保险。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 sponsus（订婚者），是 spondere（承诺）的过去分词
etymology.tip: spons（承诺）+ e → 互相承诺终身的人 → 配偶

meanings.exampleEn: The garden is at its most beautiful in the springtime, when all the flowers are in full bloom.
meanings.exampleZh: 春天是花园最美的时候，所有的花都盛开了。

meanings.exampleEn: The springtime of the internet era was marked by both excitement and uncertainty.
meanings.exampleZh: 互联网时代的初期充满了兴奋与不确定性。

etymology.origin: 古英语复合词，由 spring（春天）与 time（时间）组合而成
etymology.tip: spring（春天）+ time（时间）= 春天的时光，即春季、初期

meanings.exampleEn: The government is striving to solve the pressing issue of urban unemployment.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府正在努力解决城市失业这一紧迫问题。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 solvere（松开，解开，支付）
etymology.tip: solv 表示“松开”，把问题“松开”就是解决。

meanings.exampleEn: As a professional sportsman, he has to maintain strict discipline in training.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一名职业运动员，他必须在训练中保持严格的纪律。

meanings.exampleEn: The intrepid sportsman ventured into the uncharted jungle in search of rare species.
meanings.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的冒险家深入未知丛林寻找珍稀物种。

variants.zh: 有体育精神的；光明正大的

phrases.zh: 真正的运动员；有体育精神的人

etymology.origin: 由 sport（运动）与 man（人）组合而成；sport 源自古法语 desporter，意为“娱乐、消遣”。
etymology.tip: 运动（sport）的人（man）就是运动员。

meanings.exampleEn: The local soviet approved the construction of a new factory.
meanings.exampleZh: 地方苏维埃批准了建造新工厂的计划。

meanings.exampleEn: Many Soviets took pride in their country's achievements in space exploration.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多苏联人为国家在太空探索方面的成就感到自豪。

meanings.exampleEn: The Soviet government implemented a series of economic reforms in the 1980s.
meanings.exampleZh: 苏联政府在20世纪80年代实施了一系列经济改革。

variants.zh: 苏维埃（复数）；苏联人（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自俄语совет（sovet），意为“会议、委员会”；20世纪初随俄国革命进入英语，特指苏维埃制度及苏联。
etymology.tip: soviet音译“苏维埃”，原意是“代表会议”，联想苏联的苏维埃代表大会。

meanings.exampleEn: The stadium was filled with thousands of spectators cheering for their favorite team.
meanings.exampleZh: 体育场里挤满了成千上万为心爱球队加油的观众。

meanings.exampleEn: A spectator at the scene reported the accident to the police immediately.
meanings.exampleZh: 现场的一名目击者立即向警方报告了这起事故。

meanings.exampleEn: He remained a passive spectator while the argument escalated into a fight.
meanings.exampleZh: 当争吵升级为打斗时，他仍然是一个被动的旁观者。

variants.zh: 观众；目击者；旁观者（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 spectator，源于 spectare（观看）
etymology.tip: spect（看）+ -ator（人）→ 看的人 → 观众/旁观者

meanings.exampleEn: The politician's speech on climate change was both eloquent and persuasive.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位政治家关于气候变化的演讲既雄辩又具有说服力。

meanings.exampleEn: His speech was slow and deliberate, as if he were weighing every single word.
meanings.exampleZh: 他说话缓慢而谨慎，仿佛在斟酌每一个词。

meanings.exampleEn: Their brief speech over the phone was interrupted by a sudden power cut.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们在电话中的简短谈话被突然的停电打断了。

meanings.exampleEn: Freedom of speech is regarded as a fundamental right in many democratic societies.
meanings.exampleZh: 言论自由在许多民主社会中被视为一项基本权利。

variants.zh: 说不出话的；哑口无言的

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 spæc，与 speak 同源
etymology.tip: speech 是 speak 的名词形式，把 speak 中的 ea 变成 ee 即可联想记忆

meanings.exampleEn: The new stadium can accommodate over 80,000 spectators for international matches.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座新的大型运动场可容纳8万多名观众观看国际比赛。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 stadium，源自希腊语 stadion，原为长度单位，后指赛跑场；与印欧词根 *sta-（站立）相关。
etymology.tip: sta（站立）+ ium（场所）→ 观众站立观看比赛的露天大型运动场。

meanings.exampleEn: The stability of the financial system is crucial for economic growth.
meanings.exampleZh: 金融体系的稳定对经济增长至关重要。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 stabilis（稳定的），由 stare（站立）派生而来
etymology.suffix: -ity 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: sta（站立）+ bility（能力）→ 能站立不倒 → 稳定

meanings.exampleEn: The eagle soared effortlessly above the mountain peaks, riding the thermal currents.
meanings.exampleZh: 那只鹰乘着热气流，轻松地翱翔在山峰之上。

meanings.exampleEn: Stock prices soared to record highs after the central bank announced a new stimulus package.
meanings.exampleZh: 央行宣布新的刺激方案后，股价飙升至历史新高。

meanings.exampleEn: The cathedral's spire soars into the sky, visible from every corner of the city.
meanings.exampleZh: 大教堂的尖顶高耸入云，从城市的每个角落都能看到。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 essorer，源自通俗拉丁语 *exaurare，由拉丁语 ex- + aura 构成
etymology.tip: ex（向上）+ aura（空气）→ 冲向空气 → 翱翔

spontaneous.zh: 自然的；自发的；未经琢磨的

meanings.exampleEn: Her spontaneous offer of help surprised everyone.
meanings.exampleZh: 她主动提出帮忙，让大家很惊讶。

meanings.exampleEn: The children's spontaneous laughter filled the room.
meanings.exampleZh: 孩子们自然的笑声充满了房间。

meanings.exampleEn: His spontaneous writing style is refreshing but lacks polish.
meanings.exampleZh: 他未经琢磨的写作风格令人耳目一新，但不够精炼。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 sponte（自愿地）+-aneous
etymology.suffix: -aneous = 形容词后缀，表示具有...性质的
etymology.tip: spont（自愿）+aneous（...的）→ 自愿的、自发的

special.zh: 专辑；专车；号外；特别的东西

meanings.exampleEn: The committee has been convened to address this special issue.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会已被召集来处理这个特殊问题。

meanings.exampleEn: She received special training in emergency medicine.
meanings.exampleZh: 她接受过急诊医学的专门训练。

meanings.exampleEn: The supermarket is offering a special on organic vegetables this week.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家超市本周对有机蔬菜进行特价促销。

meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper published a special to commemorate the anniversary.
meanings.exampleZh: 该报发行了一份特刊以纪念周年。

meanings.exampleEn: A special was arranged to transport the delegates to the conference center.
meanings.exampleZh: 安排了一辆专车运送代表们前往会议中心。

meanings.exampleEn: The chef prepared a special for the honored guest.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨师为贵宾准备了一道特别的东西。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 specialis，意为“特别的”，源自 species “外观、种类”
etymology.tip: spec=看，看到特定种类的事物，就是“特别的”

meanings.exampleEn: The new technology dramatically increases the speed of data transmission.
meanings.exampleZh: 这项新技术极大地提高了数据传输的速度。

meanings.exampleEn: The ambulance arrived with remarkable speed.
meanings.exampleZh: 救护车以惊人的速度赶到。

meanings.exampleEn: The car sped down the highway.
meanings.exampleZh: 汽车在高速公路上疾驰。

meanings.exampleEn: He was fined for speeding in a residential area.
meanings.exampleZh: 他因在住宅区超速行驶而被罚款。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy will speed the recovery of the economy.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策将加速经济复苏。

variants.zh: speed 的第三人称单数形式
speed 的过去式和过去分词
speed 的过去式和过去分词（尤用于 speed up）
speed 的现在分词；超速行驶

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

spiritual.zh: 精神上的；神圣的；崇高的；高尚的

meanings.exampleEn: Meditation is a spiritual practice that helps people connect with their inner selves.
meanings.exampleZh: 冥想是一种精神上的修行，帮助人们与内在自我连接。

meanings.exampleEn: The cathedral is not only an architectural marvel but also a spiritual sanctuary for believers.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座大教堂不仅是建筑奇迹，也是信徒们神圣的庇护所。

meanings.exampleEn: Her spiritual devotion to the cause of charity inspired countless volunteers.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对慈善事业崇高的奉献精神激励了无数志愿者。

meanings.zh: 灵歌（尤指美国黑人的宗教民歌）
meanings.exampleEn: The choir performed a traditional spiritual that echoed through the ancient hall.
meanings.exampleZh: 合唱团演唱了一首传统灵歌，歌声回荡在古老的大厅中。

variants.zh: 使精神化；赋予……精神意义

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 spiritualis，源于 spiritus（呼吸、灵魂、精神）
etymology.tip: spir（呼吸）+ it + ual → 精神如呼吸般贯穿生命，记住 spiritual 为“精神的”

meanings.exampleEn: The warrior thrust his spear into the enemy's shield.
meanings.exampleZh: 战士将矛刺入敌人的盾牌。

meanings.exampleEn: The cavalryman couched his spear and charged at full gallop.
meanings.exampleZh: 骑兵平端长枪，全速冲锋。

meanings.exampleEn: The spears stood motionless along the palace corridor.
meanings.exampleZh: 持矛者沿宫殿走廊纹丝不动地站立着。

meanings.exampleEn: The gardener cut a tender spear from the asparagus plant.
meanings.exampleZh: 园丁从芦笋植株上切下一根嫩枝。

meanings.exampleEn: The fisherman speared a large salmon in the rushing river.
meanings.exampleZh: 渔夫在湍急的河里用矛刺中了一条大鲑鱼。

variants.zh: 用矛刺（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 spere，来自原始日耳曼语 *speri
etymology.tip: 联想：spear 形似“刺破”，一矛刺出。

shed.zh: 车棚；小屋；脱落之物；分水岭

meanings.exampleEn: The gardener stored his tools in a small wooden shed at the end of the garden.
meanings.exampleZh: 园丁把工具存放在花园尽头的一间小木棚里。

meanings.exampleEn: The old locomotive was kept in a large shed at the railway yard.
meanings.exampleZh: 那台旧机车被存放在铁路调车场的一个大车棚里。

meanings.exampleEn: The ridge is the shed between the two river basins.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条山脊是两个流域之间的分水岭。

meanings.exampleEn: The tragic news made everyone shed tears of profound sorrow.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个悲惨的消息让每个人都流下了深切的泪水。

meanings.exampleEn: Many reptiles shed their skin periodically as they grow.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多爬行动物在成长过程中会定期蜕皮。

meanings.exampleEn: The company shed a large number of employees during the economic downturn.
meanings.exampleZh: 在经济低迷时期，这家公司裁减了大量员工。

meanings.exampleEn: The lamp shed a dim light over the entire room.
meanings.exampleZh: 那盏灯在整间屋子里散发出昏暗的光。

variants.zh: 流出；脱落（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 古英语 sceadan（分离，分开）；名词'棚屋'可能源自古英语 'scead'（遮蔽）
etymology.tip: 联想：shed 与 shade 相近，棚屋遮阴；动词意为分离、脱落。

meanings.exampleEn: The old mansion had a grand stairway leading to the second floor.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古老的大宅有一条通往二楼的宏伟楼梯。

phrases.zh: 成功之路；通往成功的阶梯

etymology.origin: 古英语 stæger（楼梯）与 weg（道路）构成的复合词
etymology.tip: stair（楼梯）+ way（路）→ 楼梯之路，即“阶梯”。

meanings.exampleEn: The fertile soil of the valley supports a wide variety of crops.
meanings.exampleZh: 山谷肥沃的土壤滋养着多种作物。

meanings.exampleEn: The farmer worked the soil from dawn to dusk to ensure a good harvest.
meanings.exampleZh: 农民从早到晚在土地上劳作，以确保好收成。

meanings.exampleEn: He felt a deep attachment to his native soil after years of exile.
meanings.exampleZh: 流亡多年后，他对祖国怀有深深的眷恋。

meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers vowed to defend every inch of the sacred soil of their motherland.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵们誓言保卫祖国神圣国土的每一寸。

meanings.exampleEn: She refused to soil her hands with such a dishonest scheme.
meanings.exampleZh: 她拒绝让这种不诚实的阴谋玷污自己的双手。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 solum（地面，土壤），经古法语 soil 进入英语
etymology.tip: sol（地面）+ 联想：土壤（soil）就是地面（sol）的一部分

source.zh: 来源；水源；根源；原始资料

meanings.exampleEn: The journalist refused to reveal the source of her information.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位记者拒绝透露她信息的来源。

meanings.exampleEn: The river is the primary source of drinking water for the entire region.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条河是整个地区饮用水的主要水源。

meanings.exampleEn: Lack of communication is often the source of conflict in a relationship.
meanings.exampleZh: 缺乏沟通往往是关系中冲突的根源。

meanings.exampleEn: Historians must evaluate the reliability of primary sources before drawing conclusions.
meanings.exampleZh: 历史学家在得出结论之前必须评估原始资料的可靠性。

meanings.exampleEn: The company sources high-quality coffee beans from small farms in Ethiopia.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司从埃塞俄比亚的小型农场采购高品质咖啡豆。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 surgere（升起），经古法语 sourse（上升、起源）演变而来
etymology.tip: 水从地下向上涌出（surge）的地方就是源头（source）

spectacular.zh: 公开展示的；惊人的；壮观的

meanings.zh: 壮观的；惊人的；公开展示的
meanings.exampleEn: The fireworks display was absolutely spectacular, drawing cheers from the crowd.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场烟花表演极为壮观，赢得了人群的欢呼。

meanings.zh: 壮观的场面；盛大的演出
meanings.exampleEn: The charity gala was a spectacular attended by celebrities and philanthropists.
meanings.exampleZh: 这场慈善晚会是一场众星云集、慈善家齐聚的盛大演出。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 spectaculum（景象，表演），源自 spectare（看）
etymology.suffix: -acular（形容词后缀，表示“具有...性质的”）
etymology.tip: spect=看，-acular=...的；看到令人惊叹的景象，就是spectacular（壮观的）。

meanings.exampleEn: The horses were led into the stable before the storm struck.
meanings.exampleZh: 暴风雨来临前，马被牵进了马厩。

meanings.exampleEn: The patient's condition remains stable after the surgery.
meanings.exampleZh: 手术后病人的情况保持稳定。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 stabilis（稳定的），由 stare（站立）派生；名词“马房”亦与拉丁语 stabulum（住所，马厩）同源。
etymology.tip: sta（站）+ able（可…的）→ 能站得住的 → 稳定的

sophisticate.zh: 久经世故的人；精于...之道的人

meanings.zh: 久经世故的人；精于...之道的人
meanings.exampleEn: As a seasoned diplomat, he is a sophisticate who understands the nuances of international relations.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一位老练的外交官，他是久经世故的人，深谙国际关系的微妙之处。

meanings.exampleEn: The new regulations will sophisticate the approval process, making it more difficult for small businesses.
meanings.exampleZh: 新法规将使审批流程复杂化，使小企业更难操作。

meanings.exampleEn: The editor was accused of trying to sophisticate the author's original manuscript.
meanings.exampleZh: 该编辑被指控试图篡改作者的原稿。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 sophos（智慧）和 sophistes（智者），经拉丁语 sophistica 进入英语
etymology.tip: soph（智慧）+ -icate（使...）→ 用智慧处世，成为老练的人

meanings.exampleEn: He was regarded as one of the greatest statesmen of the 20th century.
meanings.exampleZh: 他被认为是20世纪最伟大的政治家之一。

etymology.origin: 由 state（国家）和 man（人）组合而成，原指“治国之人”
etymology.tip: state（国家）+ man（人）= 为国家做事的人，即政治家

meanings.exampleEn: The forensic team collected a sample of spit from the crime scene for DNA analysis.
meanings.exampleZh: 法医小组从犯罪现场采集了一份唾液样本用于DNA分析。

meanings.exampleEn: A sudden spit of rain caught the hikers off guard as they traversed the exposed ridge.
meanings.exampleZh: 一阵突如其来的小雨让正在穿越开阔山脊的徒步旅行者措手不及。

meanings.exampleEn: The chef skewered the whole lamb on a massive iron spit and began to roast it over the open flame.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨师将整只羊穿在一根巨大的铁炙叉上，开始在明火上烤制。

meanings.exampleEn: The old man spat contemptuously on the ground as he denounced the corrupt officials.
meanings.exampleZh: 老人轻蔑地往地上吐了一口唾沫，痛斥那些腐败官员。

meanings.exampleEn: It is spitting outside, so you might need a light jacket if you are going for a walk.
meanings.exampleZh: 外面正在下小雨，如果你要去散步，可能需要一件薄外套。

meanings.exampleEn: They spitted the marinated chicken pieces and grilled them over the charcoal fire.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们用炙叉叉住腌好的鸡块，在炭火上烤制。

variants.zh: 吐唾沫；下小雨；用炙叉叉住（第三人称单数）
吐唾沫；下小雨；用炙叉叉住（现在分词）
吐唾沫；下小雨（过去式/过去分词）
用炙叉叉住（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 spittan，拟声词，模拟吐唾沫的声音
etymology.tip: 联想：吐口水时发出的声音就是 /spit/，记住 'spit' 为 '吐'

meanings.exampleEn: The silver spoon passed down through generations symbolized the family's enduring wealth.
meanings.exampleZh: 这把代代相传的银匙象征着家族持久的财富。

meanings.exampleEn: She spooned the fragrant coconut milk over the steaming rice, creating a delicate balance of flavors.
meanings.exampleZh: 她用匙将芳香的椰奶浇在热气腾腾的米饭上，营造出微妙的风味平衡。

variants.zh: 用匙舀取（第三人称单数）
用匙舀取（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.en: born with a silver spoon in one's mouth

etymology.origin: 古英语 spon（木片、碎片），后指匙；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

sore.zh: 悲伤的；痛的；引起痛苦的

meanings.exampleEn: After the intense workout, his muscles were so sore that he could hardly lift his arms.
meanings.exampleZh: 剧烈锻炼后，他的肌肉酸痛得几乎抬不起胳膊。

meanings.exampleEn: She felt sore about being overlooked for the research grant despite her outstanding contributions.
meanings.exampleZh: 尽管她贡献突出，却在研究经费申请中被忽视，她对此感到恼怒。

meanings.exampleEn: The ill-fitting boots rubbed a painful sore on his ankle during the long trek.
meanings.exampleZh: 长途跋涉中，不合脚的靴子在他脚踝上磨出了一个疼痛的疮。

etymology.origin: 古英语 sār，意为疼痛、痛苦；属基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers divided the spoils of war among themselves.
meanings.exampleZh: 士兵们瓜分了战争战利品。

meanings.exampleEn: The thieves hid their spoils in an abandoned warehouse.
meanings.exampleZh: 窃贼们把赃物藏在一个废弃的仓库里。

meanings.exampleEn: The champion carried off the spoils of victory with pride.
meanings.exampleZh: 冠军自豪地捧走了胜利的奖品。

meanings.exampleEn: The grandparents tend to spoil their grandson with too many gifts.
meanings.exampleZh: 祖父母往往用太多礼物宠坏他们的孙子。

meanings.exampleEn: A sudden downpour spoiled our outdoor picnic.
meanings.exampleZh: 一场突如其来的大雨破坏了我们的户外野餐。

meanings.exampleEn: Milk will spoil quickly if it is not refrigerated.
meanings.exampleZh: 牛奶如果不冷藏很快就会变质。

variants.zh: 宠坏；破坏；变质（过去式/过去分词）
宠坏；破坏；变质（过去式/过去分词，英式）
宠坏；破坏；变质（现在分词）
宠坏；破坏；变质（第三人称单数）

phrases.zh: 摩拳擦掌想打架；蓄意寻衅

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 spoliare（剥去，掠夺），其名词 spolium 意为‘剥下的兽皮、战利品’
etymology.tip: spoil 源于‘掠夺’；掠夺来的东西是战利品，掠夺过度会宠坏/破坏，食物被‘掠夺’了新鲜就变质。

meanings.exampleEn: The Internet has spread information across the globe at an unprecedented speed.
meanings.exampleZh: 互联网以前所未有的速度在全球传播信息。

meanings.exampleEn: Rumors about the merger were spread by anonymous employees within the company.
meanings.exampleZh: 关于合并的谣言是由公司内部匿名员工散布的。

meanings.exampleEn: The eagle spread its wings and soared gracefully above the mountain peaks.
meanings.exampleZh: 雄鹰展开双翅，在山峰上空优雅地翱翔。

meanings.exampleEn: The rapid spread of the virus has prompted governments to implement strict quarantine measures.
meanings.exampleZh: 病毒的迅速蔓延促使各国政府实施严格的隔离措施。

variants.zh: 传播；散布；伸展（第三人称单数）
传播；散布；伸展（现在分词）
传播；散布；伸展（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 sprædan，意为展开、伸展；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The spray from the crashing waves soaked the tourists on the cliff.
meanings.exampleZh: 拍岸的浪花溅起的水沫打湿了悬崖上的游客。

meanings.exampleEn: She used a nasal spray to relieve her allergy symptoms.
meanings.exampleZh: 她使用鼻喷雾剂缓解过敏症状。

meanings.exampleEn: Farmers spray pesticides on crops to protect them from insect damage.
meanings.exampleZh: 农民在农作物上喷洒杀虫剂以防虫害。

meanings.exampleEn: Water sprayed out from the burst pipe, flooding the basement.
meanings.exampleZh: 水从爆裂的管道中喷出，淹没了地下室。

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 spraien，可能与 spread（散布）有关；无明显词根词缀。
etymology.tip: spray 与 spread 相近，想象喷洒就是把液体“散布”开来。

spite.zh: 恶意；怨恨；使人烦恼的事物

meanings.exampleEn: Her seemingly casual remark was actually made in spite, intended to wound his pride.
meanings.exampleZh: 她看似随意的评论实际上是出于恶意，意在伤害他的自尊。

meanings.exampleEn: Years of betrayal had planted a deep spite in his heart that he could not easily forgive.
meanings.exampleZh: 多年的背叛在他心中种下了深深的怨恨，使他难以轻易原谅。

meanings.exampleEn: The incessant barking of the neighbor's dog became a spite to the entire community.
meanings.exampleZh: 邻居家狗不停的吠叫成了整个社区的一件烦心事。

meanings.exampleEn: He spited his colleagues by withholding crucial information from the project.
meanings.exampleZh: 他故意隐瞒项目关键信息，以此刁难同事。

variants.zh: 故意刁难（过去式/过去分词）
故意刁难（第三人称单数）

phrases.zh: 不由自主地；尽管自己不愿意

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 despit，最终源自拉丁语 despectus（轻视），由 de-（向下）+ specere（看）构成，原义为“向下看、蔑视”。
etymology.tip: spite 源于“向下看”（de+specere），即蔑视他人，从而产生恶意与怨恨。

meanings.exampleEn: The squirrel darted across the lawn and scampered up the oak tree.
meanings.exampleZh: 那只松鼠飞奔过草坪，又敏捷地爬上橡树。

meanings.exampleEn: The trader sold squirrel pelts to the fur merchants in the city.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个商人把松鼠毛皮卖给了城里的皮毛商。

meanings.zh: 贮藏，储存（常与 away 连用）
meanings.exampleEn: She squirreled away a portion of her salary every month for a rainy day.
meanings.exampleZh: 她每月把一部分工资储存起来，以备不时之需。

variants.zh: 贮藏（过去式/过去分词，美式）
贮藏（过去式/过去分词，英式）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 esquirel，源自希腊语 skiouros（阴影尾巴），因松鼠常用尾巴遮阳，如同在树荫下乘凉。
etymology.tip: 松鼠的尾巴像一把“遮阳伞”，在树荫下乘凉，所以叫“阴影尾巴”。

meanings.exampleEn: The spider spun an intricate web between the branches, patiently awaiting its prey.
meanings.exampleZh: 蜘蛛在树枝间织了一张复杂的网，耐心等待猎物。

meanings.exampleEn: The con artist was a spider who lured his victims into a web of deceit.
meanings.exampleZh: 那个骗子是个设圈套者，引诱受害者进入欺骗之网。

variants.zh: 蜘蛛似的；细长而凌乱的

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 spīthra，意为“纺织者”，与 spin（纺）同源
etymology.tip: 蜘蛛是“纺”织网的高手，spider 与 spin 同源。

spectacle.zh: 引人羡慕的东西；景象；眼镜；场面

meanings.exampleEn: The total solar eclipse was a breathtaking spectacle that drew thousands of observers.
meanings.exampleZh: 日全食是令人叹为观止的景象，吸引了成千上万的观测者。

meanings.exampleEn: The opening ceremony of the Olympic Games was a magnificent spectacle watched by billions worldwide.
meanings.exampleZh: 奥运会开幕式是一场壮观的场面，全球数十亿人观看。

meanings.exampleEn: He adjusted his spectacles and peered at the intricate blueprint.
meanings.exampleZh: 他调整了一下眼镜，仔细查看复杂的蓝图。

meanings.exampleEn: The celebrity's arrival at the premiere was a spectacle that the paparazzi eagerly captured.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位名人在首映式上的亮相是一个引人注目的场面，狗仔队争先恐后地拍摄。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 spectaculum（景象），源自 spectare（观看），是 specere（看）的反复动词
etymology.suffix: -acle = 名词后缀，表示事物（源自拉丁语 -culum）
etymology.tip: spect（看）+ -acle（东西）→ 供人看的东西 → 景象；眼镜

meanings.exampleEn: There has been a dramatic shift in the global economic landscape.
meanings.exampleZh: 全球经济格局发生了巨大变化。

meanings.exampleEn: A slight shift of the furniture made the room look more spacious.
meanings.exampleZh: 稍微移动一下家具，房间看起来更宽敞了。

meanings.exampleEn: He works the night shift at the hospital to support his family.
meanings.exampleZh: 他在医院上夜班以养家糊口。

meanings.exampleEn: They tried various shifts to raise the necessary funds.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们尝试了各种手段来筹集所需资金。

meanings.exampleEn: She shifted the heavy suitcase from one hand to the other.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把沉重的手提箱从一只手换到另一只手。

meanings.exampleEn: The company shifted its focus to renewable energy to stay competitive.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司把重心转移到可再生能源以保持竞争力。

meanings.exampleEn: Public opinion has shifted significantly after the scandal.
meanings.exampleZh: 丑闻发生后，公众舆论发生了显著改变。

meanings.exampleEn: You should shift gears when you hear the engine straining.
meanings.exampleZh: 当你听到发动机吃力时，应该换挡。

variants.zh: 变化；移动；轮班；手段（复数）
移动；转移；改变；换挡（第三人称单数）
移动；转移；改变；换挡（过去式/过去分词）
移动；转移；改变；换挡（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语 sciftan，意为安排、分配；无明显词根词缀。

meanings.exampleEn: The stab of the knife left a deep wound in his arm.
meanings.exampleZh: 刀刺在他手臂上留下深深的伤口。

meanings.exampleEn: She felt a sudden stab of pain in her chest.
meanings.exampleZh: 她突然感到胸口一阵剧痛。

meanings.exampleEn: He decided to have a stab at solving the complex equation.
meanings.exampleZh: 他决定尝试解决这个复杂的方程。

meanings.exampleEn: The assailant stabbed the victim repeatedly with a broken bottle.
meanings.exampleZh: 袭击者用破瓶子反复刺伤受害者。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

staff.zh: 全体人员；工作班子；棍棒；杆

meanings.exampleEn: The entire staff was commended for their unwavering commitment to the project.
meanings.exampleZh: 全体人员因对项目的坚定承诺而受到表扬。

meanings.exampleEn: The editorial staff convenes every Monday to review the upcoming issue.
meanings.exampleZh: 编辑班子每周一开会审阅即将出版的一期。

meanings.exampleEn: The shepherd leaned on his wooden staff while watching the flock.
meanings.exampleZh: 牧羊人倚着木棍看着羊群。

meanings.exampleEn: The flag fluttered atop the tall metal staff.
meanings.exampleZh: 旗帜在高高的金属旗杆上飘扬。

meanings.exampleEn: The hospital is inadequately staffed to handle such a large number of patients.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家医院人员配备不足，无法处理如此大量的病人。

variants.zh: 为…配备工作人员（过去式和过去分词）
为…配备工作人员（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 stæf，意为棍棒、杆；后引申为支撑物，进而指工作班子。
etymology.tip: staff 本义是“棍棒”，一根棍子撑起一个团队，所以也有“全体人员”之意。

meanings.exampleEn: The spy infiltrated the government agency to obtain classified information.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名间谍潜入政府机构以获取机密情报。

meanings.exampleEn: He was suspected of spying on his neighbors for years.
meanings.exampleZh: 他被怀疑多年来一直暗中监视邻居。

meanings.exampleEn: She spied a familiar figure in the crowd and waved eagerly.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在人群中看到一个熟悉的身影，便急切地挥手。

variants.zh: 暗中监视的第三人称单数形式
spy 的过去式和过去分词

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 espier，源于日耳曼语，与‘看、观察’相关
etymology.tip: spy 就是暗中‘看’（spy on），联想‘间谍用眼睛盯梢’

statistical.zh: 统计的；统计上的；统计学的

meanings.zh: 统计的；统计上的；统计学的
meanings.exampleEn: The statistical analysis of the survey data revealed a significant correlation between exercise and mental health.
meanings.exampleZh: 对调查数据的统计分析揭示了锻炼与心理健康之间的显著相关性。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 status（状态），经意大利语 statista 和德语 Statistik 演变而来
etymology.tip: stat（站立）+ ist（人）+ ical（的）→ 基于“状态”数据的 → 统计的

meanings.exampleEn: He placed the books in a neat stack on the desk.
meanings.exampleZh: 他把书整齐地堆放在桌子上。

meanings.exampleEn: She has a stack of work to finish before the deadline.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在截止日期前有大量工作要完成。

meanings.exampleEn: The rare manuscripts are kept in the library's stack.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些珍贵的手稿存放在图书馆的书库里。

meanings.exampleEn: The workers stacked the boxes in the warehouse.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们把箱子堆放在仓库里。

meanings.exampleEn: The dirty dishes stacked up in the sink.
meanings.exampleZh: 脏盘子在水槽里堆了起来。

etymology.origin: 来自古诺尔斯语 stakkr（干草堆），后泛指任何堆叠之物
etymology.tip: stack 本身即词根，联想“石头（st）堆成一摞（ack）”。

meanings.exampleEn: The government took measures to stabilize the economy after the financial crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 金融危机后，政府采取措施稳定经济。

meanings.exampleEn: After a few days of turbulence, the patient's condition finally stabilized.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过几天的病情波动，病人的情况终于稳定下来。

variants.zh: 使稳定；变得稳定（过去式/过去分词）
使稳定；变得稳定（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 stabilis（稳定的），源于 stare（站立）
etymology.tip: sta（站）+ -ize（使……）→ 使站稳 → 使稳定

steadily.zh: 稳定地；无变化地；有规则地

meanings.zh: 稳定地；无变化地；有规则地
meanings.exampleEn: The company's profits have been steadily increasing over the past five years.
meanings.exampleZh: 在过去的五年里，该公司的利润一直在稳定增长。

phrases.zh: 稳定地工作；有条不紊地工作

etymology.origin: 来自中古英语 stedy，由 stead（位置）+ -y 构成，意为固定不动的；后加副词后缀 -ly 形成 steadily。
etymology.tip: stead（固定位置）+ -ly → 稳稳地待在原处 → 稳定地。

status.zh: 状态；情形；地位；要人身份

meanings.exampleEn: The researchers observed the status of the ecosystem after the wildfire.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究人员观察了野火后生态系统的状态。

meanings.exampleEn: We need to assess the current status of the negotiations before making any decision.
meanings.exampleZh: 在做出任何决定之前，我们需要评估谈判的当前情形。

meanings.exampleEn: Education has long been regarded as a key indicator of social status.
meanings.exampleZh: 教育长期以来被视为社会地位的关键指标。

meanings.exampleEn: His status as a celebrity often made it difficult for him to enjoy a private life.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的名人要人身份常常使他难以享受私人生活。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 status（状态、地位），源于动词 stare（站立）
etymology.tip: stat（站立）+ us（名词后缀）→ 站立的姿态 → 状态、地位

meanings.exampleEn: The red wine left a permanent stain on the white tablecloth.
meanings.exampleZh: 红葡萄酒在白色桌布上留下了永久的污渍。

meanings.exampleEn: The carpenter applied a dark wood stain to enhance the grain of the oak.
meanings.exampleZh: 木匠涂了一层深色木材着色剂，以突出橡木的纹理。

meanings.exampleEn: The scandal stained the politician's reputation irreparably.
meanings.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻不可挽回地玷污了那位政客的名誉。

meanings.exampleEn: Scientists stained the tissue sample to observe the cells under a microscope.
meanings.exampleZh: 科学家给组织样本染色，以便在显微镜下观察细胞。

meanings.exampleEn: This fabric stains easily, so handle it with extra care.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种织物容易沾上污渍，所以要格外小心处理。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 desteindre，最终源自拉丁语 tingere（染色）
etymology.tip: stain 与拉丁语 tingere（染色）同源，联想“染色留下污点”即可记住。

meanings.exampleEn: The bread had gone stale after being left on the counter for a week.
meanings.exampleZh: 面包在柜台上放了一周后变得不新鲜了。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor criticized the student's stale arguments, which lacked any original insight.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授批评了那个学生陈腐的论点，缺乏任何独到见解。

meanings.exampleEn: After working overtime for months, she felt stale and unmotivated in her job.
meanings.exampleZh: 连续加班数月后，她感到工作倦怠且缺乏动力。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 estale（静止的），源自日耳曼语，与 stand 同源
etymology.tip: 站(sta)久了就陈腐(stale)了

meanings.exampleEn: The static image on the screen failed to capture the dynamic nature of the performance.
meanings.exampleZh: 屏幕上的静态图像未能捕捉到表演的动态之美。

meanings.exampleEn: The radio signal was interrupted by sudden bursts of static from the storm.
meanings.exampleZh: 收音机信号被暴风雨带来的突然静电干扰所打断。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 statikos（使静止的），源于 histanai（使站立）
etymology.tip: sta（站立）+ ic（...的）→ 站着不动的 → 静态的

meanings.exampleEn: The chef grilled the steak to perfection, earning praise from every diner at the table.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨师把牛排烤得恰到好处，赢得了桌上每位食客的称赞。

meanings.exampleEn: For a healthier option, she ordered a grilled salmon steak instead of fried chicken.
meanings.exampleZh: 为了更健康的选择，她点了烤三文鱼排而不是炸鸡。

meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant serves a thick pork steak with a rich mushroom sauce.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家餐厅供应厚切猪肉排，配以浓郁的蘑菇酱。

phrases.zh: 鞑靼牛肉（生牛肉末配调料）

etymology.origin: 来自古诺斯语 steik，意为烤肉，经中古英语进入现代英语。
etymology.tip: steak 音似“死待客”，客人等着吃牛排，别把牛排烤得太老。

span.zh: 指距；全长；跨距；一段时间

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient tailor measured the cloth using the span of his hand as a rough unit.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位古代裁缝用手掌的指距作为粗略单位来量布。

meanings.exampleEn: The total span of the Great Wall is approximately 21,000 kilometers.
meanings.exampleZh: 长城的全长约为两万一千公里。

meanings.exampleEn: The bridge has a main span of 1,280 meters, making it one of the longest suspension bridges in the world.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座桥的主跨距为1280米，使其成为世界上最长的悬索桥之一。

meanings.exampleEn: In the span of a decade, the small village has transformed into a bustling metropolis.
meanings.exampleZh: 在十年的时间里，这个小村庄已变成繁华的大都市。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient Roman aqueducts span the valleys with remarkable engineering precision.
meanings.exampleZh: 古罗马高架水渠以惊人的工程精度跨越山谷。

meanings.exampleEn: Her academic career spanned over thirty years and produced numerous influential papers.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的学术生涯持续了三十多年，产出了大量有影响力的论文。

meanings.exampleEn: The course curriculum spans literature, philosophy, and history, offering a comprehensive liberal arts education.
meanings.exampleZh: 该课程体系包括文学、哲学和历史，提供全面的文科教育。

variants.zh: span 的过去式和过去分词

phrases.zh: 注意力持续时间；注意广度

etymology.origin: 古英语 spann，意为“跨度”；属基础词汇，无明显词根词缀
etymology.tip: span 与 spread 都以 sp- 开头，含有“伸展”之意，可联想为“跨越一段距离或时间”

meanings.exampleEn: He stammered nervously when asked to introduce himself.
meanings.exampleZh: 当被要求自我介绍时，他紧张得口吃起来。

meanings.exampleEn: She managed to stammer an apology before leaving the room.
meanings.exampleZh: 她离开房间前结结巴巴地道了歉。

meanings.exampleEn: His stammer became more noticeable under pressure.
meanings.exampleZh: 在压力下他的口吃变得更加明显。

variants.zh: 口吃；结结巴巴地说（过去式/过去分词）
口吃；结结巴巴地说（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 stamerian，与 stutter 同源；无明显词根词缀
etymology.tip: 无词根词缀，可整体记忆：stammer 发音类似“死大么”，紧张到说不出话

meanings.exampleEn: From an economic standpoint, the policy is feasible, but it may cause social inequality.
meanings.exampleZh: 从经济学的立场来看，这项政策是可行的，但可能会造成社会不平等。

phrases.zh: 从某人的立场/观点来看

etymology.origin: 由 stand（站立）和 point（点）组成的复合词，字面意为“站立之点”，引申为“立场、观点”。
etymology.tip: 站在（stand）某个点（point）上看问题，就是你的立场/观点。

meanings.exampleEn: The scandal left a permanent spot on his otherwise impeccable reputation.
meanings.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻在他原本无可挑剔的名声上留下了一个永久的污点。

meanings.exampleEn: This quiet spot by the lake is ideal for reading and reflection.
meanings.exampleZh: 湖边这个安静的地点非常适合阅读和沉思。

meanings.exampleEn: The leopard's spots serve as camouflage in the dappled forest light.
meanings.exampleZh: 豹子的斑点在其斑驳的森林光线中起到伪装作用。

meanings.exampleEn: The teacher asked the students to mark the exact spot where the two lines intersect.
meanings.exampleZh: 老师让学生们标出两条线相交的那个点。

meanings.exampleEn: It took me a while to spot the subtle error in the complex equation.
meanings.exampleZh: 我花了一会儿才在复杂的方程中认出那个细微的错误。

meanings.exampleEn: The malicious rumor spotted the politician's public image irreparably.
meanings.exampleZh: 恶意的谣言不可挽回地玷污了那位政客的公众形象。

variants.zh: 认出；发现；玷污（第三人称单数）
认出；发现；玷污（过去式/过去分词）
认出；发现；玷污（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

speciality.zh: 专长；擅长；特种技能；详细说明

meanings.exampleEn: Her speciality is ancient Chinese literature, and she has published several papers on it.
meanings.exampleZh: 她的专长是中国古代文学，并就此发表了几篇论文。

meanings.exampleEn: Public speaking is not his speciality; he prefers to communicate in writing.
meanings.exampleZh: 公开演讲不是他的擅长，他更喜欢书面交流。

meanings.exampleEn: The speciality of the rescue team includes underwater operations and high-altitude climbing.
meanings.exampleZh: 救援队的特种技能包括水下作业和高空攀爬。

meanings.exampleEn: The specialities of the negotiation were recorded in the minutes.
meanings.exampleZh: 谈判的详细说明被记录在会议纪要中。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 specialis（特别的），源于 species（外观，种类）
etymology.suffix: -ity = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: special（特别的）+ -ity（名词后缀）→ 特别擅长的领域，即专长

meanings.exampleEn: Her stainless reputation made her the ideal candidate for the position.
meanings.exampleZh: 她无瑕疵的名声使她成为这个职位的理想人选。

meanings.exampleEn: The kitchen counter is made of stainless steel, which is durable and easy to clean.
meanings.exampleZh: 厨房台面由不锈钢制成，耐用且易于清洁。

etymology.origin: 由中古英语 steinen 演变而来，与古法语 desteindre 相关；本词为 stain + -less 派生词
etymology.tip: stain（污点）+ less（无）= 没有污点的，即不锈的、无瑕疵的

meanings.exampleEn: The old mansion boasted a magnificent marble staircase that spiraled up to the third floor.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古老的豪宅拥有一个宏伟的大理石楼梯，盘旋而上直至三楼。

meanings.exampleEn: A narrow metal staircase served as a fire escape attached to the exterior wall.
meanings.exampleZh: 一个狭窄的金属梯子作为消防通道依附在外墙上。

meanings.exampleEn: The upper staircase was roped off during the renovation for safety reasons.
meanings.exampleZh: 翻新期间，出于安全考虑，上部的楼梯部分被用绳索隔开。

meanings.exampleZh: 他作为朋友签证申请的保证人，担保其在逗留期间的经济支持。

meanings.exampleEn: She stirred the coffee slowly, watching the cream swirl into the dark liquid.

meanings.exampleZh: 这位高管因从自己公司窃取机密文件而被捕。

meanings.exampleEn: Many middle-class families prefer to live in the suburb to escape the noise and congestion of the city center.
meanings.exampleZh: 许多中产阶级家庭宁愿住在郊区，以避开市中心的噪音和拥堵。

meanings.exampleEn: The nationwide strike brought the public transportation system to a standstill.

meanings.exampleZh: 艺术家将阁楼改造成宽敞的工作室，在那里她可以在自然光下作画。

meanings.exampleEn: The board has already chosen a successor to the retiring CEO.

meanings.exampleEn: She submerged herself in her research to forget the pain.
meanings.exampleZh: 她让自己沉浸在研究中以忘记痛苦。

meanings.exampleZh: 潜艇静静地潜入水中以避免被发现。

meanings.exampleEn: Superficially, the two theories seem to be completely different, but they share a common core.
meanings.exampleZh: 表面上看，这两种理论似乎完全不同，但它们有一个共同的核心。

etymology.tip: super（上面）+ fic（面）+ ally → 只在面上 → 表面地

subtle.zh: 敏锐的；精细的；狡猾的；稀薄的

meanings.exampleEn: His subtle analysis of the poem revealed layers of meaning that others had missed.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对这首诗敏锐的分析揭示了其他人忽略的深层含义。

meanings.exampleEn: The artist uses subtle brushstrokes to create a sense of depth in the painting.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位艺术家用精细的笔触在画作中营造出深度感。

meanings.exampleEn: The politician employed a subtle strategy to win the debate without appearing aggressive.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位政客采用狡猾的策略，在不显得咄咄逼人的情况下赢得了辩论。

meanings.exampleEn: The subtle mist hanging over the lake made the scene look ethereal.
meanings.exampleZh: 湖面上漂浮的稀薄薄雾使景色显得空灵缥缈。

variants.zh: 更敏锐的；更精细的；更狡猾的；更稀薄的

etymology.tip: sub（下面）+ tela（织）→ 织在下面的细密纹理 → 精细的、微妙的

surprisingly.zh: 使人惊奇；出人意外；惊人；令人惊讶

variants.zh: 令人惊讶的；出人意料的

phrases.zh: 令人惊讶的是；出乎意料的是

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 surprendre，由 sur-（在上/超）和 prendre（抓住）组成，意为“突然抓住”，引申为“使惊讶”。
etymology.tip: sur（超）+ prise（抓住）→ 超出预期地被抓住 → 令人惊讶地

meanings.exampleEn: The meager rations will not suffice for the long expedition.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些微薄的口粮不足以维持漫长的远征。

meanings.exampleEn: A brief explanation should suffice the committee.
meanings.exampleZh: 简短的说明应该能满足委员会的要求。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 sufficere，由 sub-（在下面）+ facere（做）构成

etymology.tip: suf（下面）+ fic（做）= 在下面做支撑，足以满足

meanings.exampleEn: Her unique style of painting has earned her international acclaim.
meanings.exampleZh: 她独特的绘画风格为她赢得了国际赞誉。

meanings.exampleEn: She always dresses in the latest style.
meanings.exampleZh: 她总是穿着最新时尚的服装。

meanings.exampleEn: The author's concise style makes the novel easy to read.
meanings.exampleZh: 作者简洁的文体使这部小说易读。

meanings.exampleEn: He handled the crisis with great style.
meanings.exampleZh: 他以极大的风度处理了这场危机。

meanings.zh: 设计；把…设计成某种样式
meanings.exampleEn: The architect styled the building to blend with its surroundings.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑师将这座建筑设计得与周围环境融为一体。

meanings.exampleEn: He styles himself as a modern artist.
meanings.exampleZh: 他自称现代艺术家。

etymology.root: styl = 尖笔，书写（源自拉丁语 stilus）
etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 stilus（尖笔），经古法语 estile 进入中古英语，后演变为 style
etymology.tip: 用尖笔（stylus）写字，形成个人风格（style）

meanings.exampleEn: The army's supply of ammunition was running low after the prolonged battle.
meanings.exampleZh: 长时间战斗后，军队的弹药补给已所剩无几。

meanings.exampleEn: The new pipeline is designed to supply clean water to the entire region.
meanings.exampleZh: 这条新管道旨在向整个地区供应清洁用水。

variants.zh: 供给；供应（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.tip: sup-（在下面）+ ply（plere 填满）→ 从下面填满 → 补给、供给

meanings.exampleEn: The surgeon closed the incision with five stitches.
meanings.exampleZh: 外科医生用五针缝合了切口。

meanings.exampleZh: 我肋部突然一阵刺痛，使我停下了跑步。

meanings.exampleEn: The model posed for the painting without a stitch of clothing.
meanings.exampleZh: 模特一丝不挂地摆姿势供人作画。

meanings.exampleEn: She stitched the two pieces of leather together.
meanings.exampleZh: 她把两块皮革缝在一起。

etymology.tip: stitch 像 stick（刺），一针一针地刺入布料，就是缝纫

meanings.exampleEn: The farmer found his stray in the neighbor's field.
meanings.exampleZh: 农夫在邻居的田里找到了他走失的家畜。

meanings.exampleEn: After years of reckless living, the stray returned home and was welcomed by his father.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过多年放荡的生活，浪子回到家中，受到父亲的欢迎。

meanings.exampleEn: The dog strayed from its owner during the thunderstorm.
meanings.exampleZh: 狗在雷雨中与主人走散了。

meanings.exampleEn: The discussion strayed from the main topic and became irrelevant.
meanings.exampleZh: 讨论偏离了主题，变得毫无关联。

meanings.exampleEn: He strayed through the empty streets late at night.
meanings.exampleZh: 深夜他在空旷的街道上游荡。

meanings.exampleEn: The rescue team found a stray cat hiding under the abandoned car.
meanings.exampleZh: 救援队发现一只走失的猫躲在废弃汽车下面。

meanings.exampleEn: Stray clouds dotted the clear blue sky.
meanings.exampleZh: 零星的白云点缀着湛蓝的天空。

meanings.exampleEn: The stray arrow hit the target by accident, surprising everyone.
meanings.exampleZh: 偏离的箭意外射中靶子，令所有人惊讶。

variants.zh: 走失；偏离；游荡（第三人称单数）

走失；偏离；游荡（现在分词）

meanings.exampleEn: The development of supersonic aircraft has revolutionized international travel, reducing flight times dramatically.

meanings.exampleEn: The carpenter crafted a sturdy three-legged stool from oak, which became the centerpiece of the rustic kitchen.
meanings.exampleZh: 木匠用橡木制作了一张坚固的三脚凳，它成了乡村厨房的焦点。

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor asked the patient to provide a stool sample for laboratory analysis to detect any gastrointestinal infection.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生要求病人提供大便样本用于实验室分析，以检测是否有胃肠道感染。

meanings.exampleEn: The presence of blood in the stool is often an alarming indicator of underlying digestive disorders.
meanings.exampleZh: 粪便中带血通常是潜在消化系统疾病的警示信号。

meanings.exampleEn: In some rural areas, people still use an outdoor stool as a simple toilet.
meanings.exampleZh: 在一些农村地区，人们仍然使用户外便桶作为简易厕所。

meanings.exampleEn: The police surrounded the building to prevent the suspect from escaping.
meanings.exampleZh: 警察包围了那栋大楼，以防止嫌疑人逃跑。

meanings.exampleEn: Her performance in the final exam surpassed all expectations.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在期末考试中的表现超越了所有人的预期。

meanings.exampleEn: The whale sucks in huge amounts of water and plankton while feeding.
meanings.exampleZh: 鲸鱼进食时会吸入大量的水和浮游生物。

meanings.exampleEn: The baby was sucking on a pacifier to calm himself down.
meanings.exampleZh: 婴儿吮吸着安抚奶嘴让自己平静下来。

meanings.exampleEn: She gave the straw a quick suck, but the milkshake was too thick to flow.
meanings.exampleZh: 她快速地吸了一下吸管，但奶昔太稠了，流不上来。

meanings.exampleEn: Scientists suppose that the universe began with a massive explosion.
meanings.exampleZh: 科学家推想宇宙始于一次大爆炸。

meanings.exampleZh: 假设你有机会出国留学，你会接受吗？

meanings.exampleEn: I suppose she will arrive before noon, given the early train she took.
meanings.exampleZh: 我以为她会在中午前到达，因为她乘坐的是早班火车。

meanings.exampleEn: It is difficult to suppose a world without the internet in modern society.
meanings.exampleZh: 很难想像现代社会没有互联网的世界。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 supponere，由 sub-（在下面）+ ponere（放置）构成，意为“放在下面”，后引申为“假设、推想”。
etymology.tip: sup（在下面）+ pose（放）→ 把想法“放在下面”作为基础 → 假设、推想。

meanings.exampleEn: The survival of the species depends on its ability to adapt to changing environments.
meanings.exampleZh: 该物种的生存取决于其适应不断变化的环境的能力。

meanings.exampleEn: These ancient customs are a survival from the pre-industrial era.
meanings.exampleZh: 这些古老习俗是前工业时代的一种残存。

meanings.exampleEn: The only survival of the shipwreck was found clinging to a piece of debris.
meanings.exampleZh: 那次沉船事故的唯一幸存者被发现紧抓着一块残骸。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 supervivere（sur- 超过 + vivere 活），经由古法语 survivre 进入英语，后加名词后缀 -al 形成 survival。
etymology.suffix: -al = 名词后缀，表示行为、状态
etymology.tip: sur（超过）+ viv（活）+ al → 活得比别人久 → 幸存

meanings.exampleEn: The police are investigating the circumstances surrounding his suicide.
meanings.exampleZh: 警方正在调查他自杀的相关情况。

meanings.exampleEn: The suicide left a detailed note explaining the reasons for the act.
meanings.exampleZh: 那名自杀者留下了一张详细的纸条解释其行为的原因。

meanings.exampleEn: The surge of the ocean waves threatened the coastal village.
meanings.exampleZh: 海洋巨浪的汹涌威胁着沿海村庄。

meanings.exampleEn: The company's profits surged by 20% last quarter.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司利润上个季度激增了20%。

etymology.tip: sur-（向上）+ -ge（引导）→ 向上引导 → 涌起、激增

meanings.exampleEn: This new model is superior to its predecessor in both performance and energy efficiency.
meanings.exampleZh: 这款新型号在性能和能效方面都优于其前代产品。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee must seek approval from the superior authorities before implementing the new policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会在实施新政策前必须获得上级部门的批准。

meanings.exampleEn: He was promoted to a position where he could report directly to his superior.
meanings.exampleZh: 他被提升到一个可以直接向他的上级汇报的职位。

meanings.exampleEn: In the debate competition, she proved herself the superior through her compelling arguments.
meanings.exampleZh: 在辩论赛中，她通过令人信服的论点证明了自己是优胜者。

meanings.exampleEn: He subscribed a large sum to the relief fund.
meanings.exampleZh: 他向救济基金捐了一大笔钱。

meanings.exampleEn: He subscribed his name to the contract without hesitation.
meanings.exampleZh: 他毫不犹豫地在合同上签了名。

meanings.exampleEn: The superiority of this method lies in its simplicity and efficiency.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种方法优越性在于其简单和高效。

meanings.exampleEn: His air of superiority made him unpopular among his colleagues.
meanings.exampleZh: 他那高傲的态度使他在同事中不受欢迎。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 superior，是 superus 的比较级，意为“较高的、上级的”

etymology.tip: super（超级）+ ior（比较级）+ ity（名词）→ 超过别人之上 → 优越

meanings.exampleEn: The sturdy young man carried the heavy furniture up the stairs without any difficulty.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个强健的年轻人毫不费力地把沉重的家具搬上了楼。

meanings.exampleEn: The engineers designed a sturdy bridge that can withstand earthquakes.
meanings.exampleZh: 工程师们设计了一座能抵御地震的坚固桥梁。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 estourdi，原义为“猛烈的、鲁莽的”，后演变为“强健的、坚固的”

susceptible.zh: 易受影响的；易感动的；容许...的

meanings.exampleEn: Young people are often susceptible to peer pressure.
meanings.exampleZh: 年轻人往往容易受到同伴压力的影响。

meanings.exampleEn: She is a susceptible girl who cries at every sad movie.
meanings.exampleZh: 她是个易感动的女孩，看每部悲伤电影都会哭。

meanings.exampleEn: The wording of the contract is susceptible to multiple interpretations.
meanings.exampleZh: 这份合同的措辞容许有多种解释。

etymology.tip: sus（下面）+ cept（拿）+ ible（能）→ 能被拿下的 → 易受影响的

meanings.exampleEn: Chronic stress can lead to a variety of health problems.
meanings.exampleZh: 慢性压力会导致各种健康问题。

meanings.exampleZh: 形势的紧迫要求立即采取行动。

meanings.exampleEn: The teacher laid great stress on the importance of vocabulary.
meanings.exampleZh: 老师非常强调词汇的重要性。

meanings.exampleZh: 在单词 "present" 中，重音落在第一个音节上。

meanings.exampleZh: 该报告强调需要更严格的环境法规。

meanings.exampleEn: You should stress the second syllable in this word.
meanings.exampleZh: 你应该重读这个单词的第二个音节。

meanings.exampleEn: The constant noise from the construction site stressed the residents.
meanings.exampleZh: 建筑工地持续的噪音使居民们感到焦虑不安。

动词 stress 的过去式和过去分词
动词 stress 的现在分词

phrases.zh: 在压力下；处于紧张状态

meanings.exampleEn: The suspension of the bridge is designed to withstand strong winds.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座桥的悬挂结构设计得能够抵御强风。

meanings.exampleEn: The athlete received a two-year suspension for violating the anti-doping rules.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名运动员因违反反兴奋剂规定被禁赛两年。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 suspendere（悬挂），由 sub-（下）+ pendere（悬挂）构成，其名词形式为 suspensio。
etymology.tip: sus（向下）+ pend（悬挂）+ sion（名词）→ 向下悬挂 → 悬挂；引申为暂停。

meanings.exampleEn: The judge summoned the witness to give testimony in court.
meanings.exampleZh: 法官传唤证人在法庭上作证。

meanings.exampleEn: The president summoned an emergency meeting to address the crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 总统召集紧急会议以应对危机。

meanings.exampleEn: The leader summoned the nation to unite against the common threat.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位领导人号召全国团结起来对抗共同的威胁。

meanings.exampleEn: She summoned all her courage to speak out against the injustice.
meanings.exampleZh: 她鼓起全部勇气，公开反对这种不公正。

variants.zh: 召唤；召集（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 summonere（暗中提醒），由 sub-（暗中）+ monere（提醒）构成，经古法语 somondre 进入英语。
etymology.prefix: sub-（在 m 前同化为 sum-，表示“暗中、从下”）
etymology.tip: sub（下）+ mon（提醒）→ 在下面悄悄提醒你 → 召唤

meanings.exampleEn: The new evidence is a valuable supplement to the existing research.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一新证据是对现有研究的有力补充物。

meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper published a special supplement on the economic crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 该报纸就经济危机出版了一期特刊增刊。

meanings.exampleEn: Vitamin D is an essential supplement to a balanced diet.
meanings.exampleZh: 维生素D是均衡饮食的必要补充。

meanings.exampleEn: The supplement at the end of the book lists all the references.
meanings.exampleZh: 书末的补遗列出了所有参考文献。

meanings.exampleEn: She supplements her income by teaching part-time.
meanings.exampleZh: 她通过兼职教学来补充收入。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 supplementum，由 sub-（在下面）+ plere（填满）+ -mentum（名词后缀）构成，原意为“从下面填满使其完整”。
etymology.suffix: -ment = 名词后缀，表示行为、结果或工具
etymology.tip: sub（下面）+ ple（填满）+ ment（名词）→ 从下面填满 → 补充、增补

meanings.exampleEn: The executive summary at the beginning of the report provided a concise overview of the entire project.
meanings.exampleZh: 报告开头的执行摘要提供了整个项目的简明概述。

meanings.exampleEn: He gave a summary account of the meeting, omitting all unnecessary details.
meanings.exampleZh: 他对会议作了概括性的说明，省略了所有不必要的细节。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 summa（总和，要点），源自 summus（最高的）
etymology.suffix: -ary（形容词/名词后缀，表示“与……有关的”）
etymology.tip: “sum（总和）+ -ary” → 把总和提炼出来的内容就是“摘要”。

meanings.exampleEn: The morning sunshine streamed through the window, dispelling the gloom of the night.
meanings.exampleZh: 清晨的阳光透过窗户倾泻而入，驱散了夜晚的阴郁。

meanings.exampleEn: Her warm smile was a ray of sunshine in the otherwise dreary office.
meanings.exampleZh: 她温暖的笑容是这间沉闷办公室里的一缕光明。

meanings.exampleEn: After days of continuous rain, the sunshine finally returned, lifting everyone's spirits.
meanings.exampleZh: 连续几天降雨之后，晴天终于回来了，让大家精神振奋。

phrases.zh: 一线阳光；给人带来快乐的人或事物

etymology.origin: 古英语 sunne（太阳）+ scinan（照耀）
etymology.tip: 太阳（sun）照耀（shine）即为阳光（sunshine）

meanings.exampleEn: The surprising outcome of the experiment challenged the prevailing theory.
meanings.exampleZh: 实验令人惊讶的结果挑战了主流理论。

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 surprise，由 sur-（在上，超过）+ prise（抓住，拿）构成，原义为“突然抓住”，引申为“使惊讶”。
etymology.suffix: -ing = 形容词后缀，表示“令人…的”
etymology.tip: sur（超过）+ prise（抓住）→ 超出预期地抓住注意力 → 令人惊讶的

meanings.exampleEn: To calculate the net profit, you must subtract all operating expenses from the total revenue.
meanings.exampleZh: 要计算净利润，你必须从总收入中减去所有运营费用。

meanings.exampleEn: The bank will subtract a service charge from your account if the balance falls below the minimum requirement.
meanings.exampleZh: 如果余额低于最低要求，银行将从你的账户中扣掉一笔服务费。

meanings.exampleEn: Excessive stress can subtract years from one's life expectancy.
meanings.exampleZh: 过度的压力会减少人的预期寿命。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 subtrahere（sub- 在下面 + trahere 拉），其过去分词为 subtractus
etymology.tip: sub（向下）+ tract（拉）= 向下拉走，即减去

sweater.zh: 毛衣；毛线衫；运动衫；出汗者

meanings.exampleEn: She wore a cashmere sweater to the interview to make a professional impression.
meanings.exampleZh: 她穿了一件羊绒毛衣去面试，以留下专业的印象。

meanings.exampleEn: The athletes were required to wear the team sweater during the award ceremony.
meanings.exampleZh: 运动员在颁奖典礼上被要求穿着队服运动衫。

meanings.exampleEn: As a heavy sweater, he always carried a towel during his morning jog.
meanings.exampleZh: 作为一个容易大量出汗的人，他晨跑时总是带着一条毛巾。

variants.zh: 毛衣；运动衫；出汗者（复数）

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 swætan，意为出汗；后加后缀 -er 表示人或物
etymology.tip: sweat（出汗）+ -er（者/物）→ 让人出汗的衣物或出汗的人。

meanings.exampleEn: The Supreme Court is the highest judicial body in the United States.
meanings.exampleZh: 最高法院是美国最高司法机构。

meanings.exampleEn: It requires supreme effort to climb the world's highest peak.
meanings.exampleZh: 攀登世界最高峰需要付出极大的努力。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 supremus，是 superus 的最高级，意为‘最高的’
etymology.suffix: -reme（拉丁语最高级后缀 -imus 的变体）= 最…的
etymology.tip: sup(在上) + reme(最) = 在最上面的，即至高无上的

meanings.exampleEn: The police found several suspicious packages near the entrance of the building.
meanings.exampleZh: 警方在大楼入口附近发现了几件可疑的包裹。

meanings.exampleEn: Her suspicious nature made it difficult for her to trust even her closest friends.
meanings.exampleZh: 她多疑的性格使她连最亲密的朋友都难以信任。

meanings.exampleEn: The manager was suspicious of the employee's sudden resignation after the audit.
meanings.exampleZh: 经理对那名员工在审计后突然辞职一事感到怀疑。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 suspicere（偷偷看、怀疑），由 sub-（在下面）+ specere（看）构成
etymology.prefix: sus- = 在下面，偷偷地（sub- 的变体）
etymology.tip: sus（向下）+ spic（看）+ ious（的）→ 偷偷向下看 → 怀疑的

summit.zh: 顶点；最高阶层；最高级会议

meanings.exampleEn: The climbers finally reached the summit of Mount Everest after weeks of arduous trekking.
meanings.exampleZh: 经过数周艰苦跋涉，登山者们终于到达了珠穆朗玛峰的顶峰。

meanings.exampleEn: The decision was made at the summit of the party leadership.
meanings.exampleZh: 这一决定是在党的领导层最高层做出的。

meanings.exampleEn: World leaders gathered at the summit to address climate change.
meanings.exampleZh: 世界各国领导人齐聚峰会，共同应对气候变化。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 summus（最高的），经古法语 sommet 进入英语
etymology.tip: summ（最高）+ it（它）= 它是最高点，即顶点

meanings.exampleEn: His strange behavior aroused suspicion among his colleagues.
meanings.exampleZh: 他奇怪的行为引起了同事们的怀疑。

meanings.exampleEn: She had a suspicion that the project would fail without proper planning.
meanings.exampleZh: 她觉察到如果没有妥善规划，这个项目将会失败。

meanings.exampleEn: The police arrested him on suspicion of theft.
meanings.exampleZh: 警方因盗窃嫌疑逮捕了他。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 suspicio（怀疑），由 sub-（在下）+ specere（看）演变而来
etymology.tip: sus（向下）+ spic（看）+ ion → 从下往上偷偷看，暗中观察，产生怀疑

meanings.exampleEn: The symmetry of the building's design reflects the architect's pursuit of classical beauty.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座建筑设计的对称性反映了建筑师对古典美的追求。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 symmetria，由 syn-（一起）和 metron（测量）组合而成，意为“按同一尺度测量”，引申为“对称”。
etymology.suffix: -y = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: sym（一起）+ metr（测量）+ y（名词）→ 测量结果一致 → 对称

meanings.exampleEn: The orchestra performed Beethoven's Ninth Symphony to a packed concert hall.
meanings.exampleZh: 管弦乐团在座无虚席的音乐厅演奏了贝多芬的第九交响曲。

variants.zh: 交响乐；交响曲（复数形式）

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 symphonia，由 sym-（一起）+ phonē（声音）组合而成，原指“和声、协和音”，后指交响乐。
etymology.suffix: -y = 名词后缀，表示状态、结果
etymology.tip: sym（一起）+ phon（声音）+ y → 各种声音合在一起 → 交响乐

meanings.exampleEn: The evidence is sufficiently strong to convince the jury.
meanings.exampleZh: 证据足够有力，足以说服陪审团。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 sufficere（供应，足够），由 sub- + facere 构成
etymology.prefix: suf- = 在下面，向上（sub- 在 f 前的同化形式）
etymology.tip: suf（在下面）+ fic（做）+ ient + ly → 在下面做足功夫，自然就足够充分了

meanings.exampleEn: The sweetness of their reunion moved everyone present to tears.
meanings.exampleZh: 他们重逢的甜蜜感动了在场的每一个人。

meanings.exampleEn: The sweetness of jasmine filled the quiet garden at dusk.
meanings.exampleZh: 黄昏时分，茉莉花的芳香弥漫在宁静的花园里。

meanings.exampleEn: She captured the sweetness of the melody in her gentle piano performance.
meanings.exampleZh: 她用温柔的钢琴演奏捕捉到了旋律的美妙。

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 swete，意为甜的、愉快的
etymology.suffix: -ness = 名词后缀，表示性质、状态
etymology.tip: sweet（甜的）+ ness（名词后缀）→ 甜蜜、芳香、美妙

meanings.exampleEn: The professor asked us to summarize the key arguments of the article in no more than 200 words.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授要求我们用不超过200个词概述这篇文章的主要论点。

variants.zh: 概述；总结（第三人称单数）
概述；总结（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 summa（总和，要点），经英语 summary 加动词后缀 -ize 形成
etymology.tip: summ（总和）+ ize（使）→把要点总和起来→概述、总结

meanings.exampleEn: The authoritarian regime brutally suppressed any form of political dissent.
meanings.exampleZh: 专制政权残酷镇压任何形式的政治异议。

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor prescribed a special syrup to suppress the child's severe cough.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生开了一种特殊糖浆来止住孩子严重的咳嗽。

meanings.exampleEn: The government suppressed the publication of the controversial article.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府禁止了那篇有争议文章的发表。

meanings.exampleEn: She struggled to suppress her laughter during the solemn meeting.
meanings.exampleZh: 在严肃的会议期间，她努力抑制住笑声。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 supprimere，由 sub-（向下）+ premere（压）构成，经古法语和英语演变而来
etymology.tip: sub（向下）+ press（压）→ 向下压住 → 镇压、抑制

meanings.exampleEn: He swore to uphold the constitution and defend the nation's sovereignty.
meanings.exampleZh: 他发誓维护宪法，捍卫国家主权。

meanings.exampleEn: The angry driver swore at the reckless cyclist who had cut him off.
meanings.exampleZh: 愤怒的司机咒骂那个突然抢道的鲁莽骑车人。

meanings.exampleEn: The chief justice swore the president into office at the ceremony.
meanings.exampleZh: 首席大法官在仪式上使总统宣誓就职。

variants.zh: 发誓；咒骂；使宣誓（第三人称单数）
发誓；咒骂；使宣誓（过去式）
发誓；咒骂；使宣誓（过去分词）
发誓；咒骂；使宣誓（现在分词）

etymology.origin: 古英语swerian，原始日耳曼语*swarjanan，基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: We all sympathize with the victims of the devastating earthquake.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们都对这场毁灭性地震的受害者深表同情。

meanings.exampleEn: I sympathize with your point of view, though I cannot fully endorse it.
meanings.exampleZh: 我同意你的观点，尽管我不能完全赞同它。

variants.zh: 同情；同意（第三人称单数）
同情；同意（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 sympatheia（共同感受），经拉丁语进入英语；由 sym-（共同）+ pathos（感情）+ -ize（动词后缀）构成。
etymology.tip: sym（共同）+ path（感情）+ ize（动词化）→ 与他人有共同感受 → 同情、体谅。

meanings.exampleEn: The nuclear submarine surfaced near the Arctic ice cap, demonstrating its stealth capability.
meanings.exampleZh: 核潜艇在北极冰盖附近浮出水面，展示了其隐身能力。

meanings.exampleEn: The mysterious submarine, first discovered in the Mariana Trench, remains largely unknown to science.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种首次在马里亚纳海沟发现的神秘海底生物，对科学界来说在很大程度上仍是未知的。

meanings.exampleEn: Submarine volcanic eruptions can create new islands over time.
meanings.exampleZh: 海底火山喷发随着时间的推移可以形成新的岛屿。

phrases.zh: 潜艇三明治（一种长条形三明治）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 submarinus，由 sub-（在下面）+ marinus（海的）构成，原义为‘海面下的’
etymology.tip: sub（下面）+ marine（海）→ 海面下的 → 潜水艇；海底的

meanings.exampleEn: The company was acquired by a rival firm; subsequently, its headquarters were moved to New York.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家公司被一家竞争对手收购；随后，其总部迁至纽约。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 subsequi（跟随在后），由 sub-（在...之后）+ sequi（跟随）构成
etymology.tip: sub（下面）+ sequ（跟随）+ ent + ly = 跟在后面 → 随后

meanings.exampleEn: She felt deep sympathy for the victims of the earthquake.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对地震灾民深感同情。

meanings.exampleEn: The workers went on strike in sympathy with the dismissed colleagues.
meanings.exampleZh: 工人们举行罢工，以声援被解雇的同事。

meanings.exampleEn: His cold eyes showed no sympathy for the beggar.
meanings.exampleZh: 他冷漠的眼神对那个乞丐毫无怜悯。

meanings.exampleEn: The president sent a letter of sympathy to the bereaved family.
meanings.exampleZh: 总统向遇难者家属发去了慰问信。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 sympatheia，由 syn（共同）+ pathos（感情）组合而成，经拉丁语进入英语。
etymology.suffix: -y = 名词后缀，表示状态或性质
etymology.tip: sym（共同）+ path（感情）+ y → 与他人有共同感受 → 同情、共鸣。

meanings.exampleEn: The synthesis of art and technology has created a new form of digital expression.
meanings.exampleZh: 艺术与技术的综合创造了一种新的数字表达形式。

meanings.exampleEn: Protein synthesis is a fundamental process in all living cells.
meanings.exampleZh: 蛋白质合成是所有活细胞中的基本过程。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 synthesis，由 syn-（一起）+ thesis（放置）构成，意为“放在一起”。
etymology.suffix: -sis = 表示过程或状态的名词后缀
etymology.tip: syn（一起）+ thesis（放）= 把东西放到一起，就是“综合”。

meanings.exampleEn: The bridge was designed to sustain the weight of heavy trucks.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座桥的设计旨在承受重型卡车的重量。

meanings.exampleEn: A balanced diet is essential to sustain good health.
meanings.exampleZh: 均衡饮食对于维持健康至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: He had to work two jobs to sustain his family.
meanings.exampleZh: 他不得不打两份工来供养家庭。

meanings.exampleEn: She sustained her interest in science throughout her career.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在整个职业生涯中一直保持着对科学的兴趣。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 sustinere（支撑，承受），由 sub-（在下面）+ tenere（持有）构成
etymology.prefix: sus-（sub-的变体）= 在下面，向上
etymology.tip: sus（在下面）+ tain（握住）= 在下面托住，引申为支撑、维持

sweeten.zh: 使变甜；加糖于；使悦耳；使温和

meanings.exampleEn: Adding honey to the tea will sweeten it naturally without refined sugar.
meanings.exampleZh: 往茶里加蜂蜜可以使其自然变甜，无需精制糖。

meanings.exampleEn: She decided to sweeten the homemade lemonade with a touch of maple syrup.
meanings.exampleZh: 她决定用少许枫糖浆给自制的柠檬水加糖。

meanings.exampleEn: The gentle melody of the flute sweetened the otherwise somber atmosphere of the hall.
meanings.exampleZh: 长笛的柔和旋律使原本沉闷的大厅气氛变得悦耳动听。

meanings.exampleEn: His apology was intended to sweeten her anger and restore harmony between them.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的道歉意在平息她的怒气，并恢复他们之间的和睦。

variants.zh: 使变甜；加糖于；使悦耳；使温和（第三人称单数）
使变甜；加糖于；使悦耳；使温和（过去式/过去分词）
使变甜；加糖于；使悦耳；使温和（现在分词）
甜味剂；用以拉拢或讨好的人/物

phrases.zh: 增加赌注；使事情更有吸引力

etymology.origin: 来自古英语 swēte，加上动词后缀 -en 构成，表示“使变得……”。
etymology.tip: sweet（甜的）+ en（使）→ 使变甜；引申为使悦耳、使温和。

related.zh: 甜味剂；用以拉拢或讨好的人/物

meanings.exampleEn: Only those who persevere in the face of adversity are likely to succeed in their long-term endeavors.
meanings.exampleZh: 只有那些在逆境中坚持不懈的人，才有可能在长期的努力中获得成功。

meanings.exampleEn: The eldest son is legally entitled to succeed his father's estate under the ancient customary law.
meanings.exampleZh: 根据古老的习惯法，长子依法有权继承其父亲的遗产。

meanings.exampleEn: As the night wore on, one dramatic event succeeded another, leaving the audience breathless.
meanings.exampleZh: 随着夜色渐深，一个又一个戏剧性的事件接连发生，令观众屏息凝神。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 succedere，由 sub-（下，接近）+ cedere（走）组成，原义为“走到下面”，后引申为“接替、随后发生”，再引申为“成功”。
etymology.prefix: suc-（= sub- 的变体，表示“下，接近”）
etymology.tip: 从下面走到上面，就是“成功”；跟在后面走，就是“继承/继续”。

meanings.exampleEn: The resort is nestled in breathtaking natural surroundings.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个度假村坐落在令人叹为观止的自然环境中。

meanings.exampleEn: She was so lost in thought that she remained oblivious to her surroundings.
meanings.exampleZh: 她陷入沉思，对周围的事物浑然不觉。

etymology.origin: 源自拉丁语 superundare（溢出），后受古法语 suronder 及英语 round（圆）的影响演变为 surround；-ings 为名词复数后缀。
etymology.tip: sur-（外）+ round（圆）+ -ings（名词后缀）→ 外面一圈的事物 → 环境；周围的事物。

meanings.exampleEn: She handled the delicate situation with remarkable tact, avoiding any offense.
meanings.exampleZh: 她以非凡的机智处理了这一微妙的局面，避免冒犯任何人。

variants.zh: 不机智的；不圆滑的；不得体的
不机智地；不圆滑地；不得体地

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 tactus（触摸），引申为得体、老练
etymology.tip: tact 是“触摸”人心，说话办事得体有分寸

meanings.exampleEn: A narrow strip of land along the coast was designated as a nature reserve.
meanings.exampleZh: 沿海的一条狭长地带被划为自然保护区。

meanings.exampleEn: The nightclub's main attraction was a strip performed by a renowned dancer.
meanings.exampleZh: 这家夜总会的主要节目是一位著名舞者表演的脱衣舞。

meanings.exampleEn: The scandal stripped the once-respected politician of all his credibility.
meanings.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻使这位曾经受人尊敬的政治家完全丧失了信誉。

meanings.exampleEn: The athlete had to strip for a routine medical examination in the locker room.
meanings.exampleZh: 这名运动员不得不在更衣室里脱光衣服接受常规体检。

variants.zh: 剥去；脱衣（第三人称单数）
剥去；脱衣（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

substantial.zh: 重要材料(或事物)；有实际价值的东西

meanings.exampleEn: The company has made a substantial investment in renewable energy.
meanings.exampleZh: 该公司在可再生能源方面进行了大量投资。

meanings.exampleEn: The bridge is supported by substantial concrete pillars.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座桥由坚固的混凝土桥墩支撑。

meanings.exampleEn: There is substantial evidence to support the theory of climate change.
meanings.exampleZh: 有实质性的证据支持气候变化理论。

meanings.exampleEn: She made a substantial contribution to the success of the project.
meanings.exampleZh: 她对项目的成功做出了重要贡献。

phrases.zh: 充分的证据；实质性的证据

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 substantia（实体，本质），由 sub-（在下）+ stare（站立）构成，原义为'站在下面的东西'，引申为'实质的'。
etymology.tip: sub-在下 + st站 + -al的 → 站在下面的基础 → 实质的、坚固的

meanings.exampleEn: The design of the building is perfectly symmetrical, creating a sense of balance and harmony.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座建筑的设计完全对称，营造出一种平衡与和谐的感觉。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 symmetria，由 syn-（一起）和 metron（测量）组合而成，意为‘按同一尺度测量’，引申为‘对称’。
etymology.tip: sym（一起）+ metr（测量）+ ical（的）→ 一起测量尺寸相同 → 对称的

meanings.exampleEn: The janitor sweeps the corridor every morning before the students arrive.
meanings.exampleZh: 管理员每天早晨在学生到达之前打扫走廊。

meanings.exampleEn: The new policy aims to sweep away the outdated regulations that hinder innovation.
meanings.exampleZh: 新政策旨在扫除阻碍创新的过时法规。

meanings.exampleEn: The government launched a campaign to sweep the region of insurgents.
meanings.exampleZh: 政府发起了一场运动以肃清该地区的叛乱分子。

meanings.exampleEn: From the summit, the entire valley lay within a single sweep of the eye.
meanings.exampleZh: 从山顶望去，整个山谷尽收眼底。

etymology.origin: 基础词汇，无明显词根词缀

meanings.exampleEn: The laboratory developed a synthetic material that mimics the properties of natural silk.
meanings.exampleZh: 该实验室开发出一种模仿天然丝绸特性的合成材料。

meanings.exampleEn: This fabric is a synthetic, so it is more durable and easier to wash than natural fibers.
meanings.exampleZh: 这种织物是合成纤维，因此比天然纤维更耐用且更容易洗涤。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 synthetikos，由 syn-（一起）+ tithenai（放置）演变而来
etymology.tip: syn（一起）+ thet（放置）+ ic（的）→ 把东西放在一起制成的 → 合成的

surgery.zh: 外科；手术；手术室；换球术

meanings.exampleEn: She decided to specialize in surgery after completing her medical degree.
meanings.exampleZh: 她完成医学学位后决定专攻外科。

meanings.exampleEn: The patient underwent emergency surgery to remove the tumor.
meanings.exampleZh: 病人接受了紧急手术以切除肿瘤。

meanings.exampleEn: The doctor's surgery is open from Monday to Friday.
meanings.exampleZh: 医生的诊所周一至周五开门。

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 kheirourgia（手工操作），由 kheir（手）+ ergon（工作）组成，经拉丁语 chirurgia、古法语 surgerie 进入英语。
etymology.tip: 医生用手（chir）做工作（erg）就是手术。

meanings.exampleEn: The calligrapher's final stroke gave the whole work a sense of vitality.
meanings.exampleZh: 书法家的最后一笔赋予了整个作品一种生命力。

meanings.exampleEn: With one stroke of his sword, the knight severed the rope.
meanings.exampleZh: 骑士用剑一击斩断了绳子。

meanings.exampleEn: A stroke can cause lasting damage to the brain if not treated promptly.
meanings.exampleZh: 如果不及时治疗，中风可能对大脑造成永久性损伤。

meanings.exampleEn: He stroked the cat's back while reading a book.
meanings.exampleZh: 他一边看书一边抚摸猫的背。

etymology.origin: 古英语 strācian（抚摸），与 strike 同源
etymology.tip: strok- 擦触，轻抚为 stroke；同源 strike 表重击，一轻一重

systematic.zh: 有系统的；分类上的；体系的

meanings.exampleEn: The researcher adopted a systematic approach to collect and analyze the data.
meanings.exampleZh: 该研究者采用了系统的方法来收集和分析数据。

meanings.exampleEn: Botanists use systematic classification to organize the vast diversity of plant species.
meanings.exampleZh: 植物学家利用分类学上的分类方法来整理植物物种的巨大多样性。

phrases.zh: 系统的方法；有条理的处理方式

etymology.origin: 来自希腊语 systema，由 syn-（一起）+ histanai（放置）构成，意为“放在一起、组合成的整体”
etymology.tip: syn（一起）+ system（体系）+ atic（的）→ 放在一起成体系的 → 系统的

related.zh: 全身的；系统的（指影响整体）

tabulate.zh: 作成表；作成一览表；使成平面

meanings.zh: 制成表；作成一览表；列表显示
meanings.exampleEn: The researcher spent hours tabulating the survey responses to identify clear patterns.
meanings.exampleZh: 研究人员花了数小时将调查回复制成表格，以找出清晰的规律。

variants.zh: 制成表（过去式/过去分词）

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 tabula（木板、书写板、表格），经英语借入后加动词后缀 -ate 构成。
etymology.tip: tabula（表格）+ -ate（使做）→ 使成表格 → 制成表。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee was appointed to supervise the election process to ensure fairness and transparency.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会被指派监督选举过程，以确保公平和透明。

meanings.exampleEn: She supervises a team of twenty engineers in the research and development department.
meanings.exampleZh: 她在研发部门管理着一个由二十名工程师组成的团队。

meanings.exampleEn: The professor supervises graduate students in their thesis writing and academic research.
meanings.exampleZh: 教授指导研究生进行论文写作和学术研究。

phrases.en: supervise the implementation of the plan

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 supervidere，由 super-（在上）+ videre（看）构成
etymology.tip: super（在上）+ vis（看）= 在上面看，即监督

meanings.exampleEn: The surgeon carefully removed the tumor while preserving the surrounding healthy tissue.
meanings.exampleZh: 外科医生小心翼翼地切除肿瘤，同时保留了周围的健康组织。

etymology.origin: 源自希腊语 kheirourgos（用手工作的人），由 kheir（手）+ ergon（工作）构成，经拉丁语 chirurgia、古法语 surgien 演变而来
etymology.tip: 外科医生靠‘手’（chir）做手术，记住 surgeon 是手艺人

meanings.exampleEn: The tall trees swayed violently in the strong wind.
meanings.exampleZh: 高大的树木在强风中猛烈地摇摆。

meanings.exampleEn: His speech swayed the audience to support the new policy.
meanings.exampleZh: 他的演讲影响了听众，使他们支持新政策。

meanings.exampleEn: The sway of the boat made her feel dizzy.
meanings.exampleZh: 船的摇摆使她感到头晕。

meanings.exampleEn: The old king still held great sway over the council.
meanings.exampleZh: 老国王对议会仍然拥有很大的影响力。

variants.zh: 摇摆；影响（第三人称单数）
摇摆；影响（过去式/过去分词）

phrases.zh: 占支配地位，具有影响力

etymology.origin: 来自古诺尔斯语 sveigja，意为弯曲、摆动
etymology.tip: s + way，想象在道路上（way）被风刮得左右摇摆（s）

meanings.exampleEn: The company suffered huge losses in the financial crisis.
meanings.exampleZh: 公司在金融危机中遭受了巨大损失。

meanings.exampleEn: The city has suffered many vicissitudes over the centuries.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座城市几个世纪以来经历了许多兴衰变迁。

meanings.exampleEn: I cannot suffer such insolence any longer.
meanings.exampleZh: 我再也无法忍受这种无礼了。

meanings.exampleEn: She suffers from chronic back pain.
meanings.exampleZh: 她患有慢性背痛。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 sufferre，由 sub-（在下面）和 ferre（承受，携带）组成；经古法语 suffrir 进入中古英语。
etymology.prefix: suf-（sub- 的变体，在 f 前同化）= 在下面
etymology.tip: suf（在下面）+ fer（承受）= 在下面承受，即遭受、忍受。

meanings.exampleEn: The tailor measured him for a new suit with meticulous precision.
meanings.exampleZh: 裁缝以极其精确的尺寸为他量身定做了一套新西装。

meanings.exampleEn: We can tailor the training program to meet each employee's specific needs.
meanings.exampleZh: 我们可以调整培训方案，以满足每位员工的具体需求。

variants.zh: 裁制；调整（第三人称单数）

etymology.origin: 来自古法语 tailleor，源自拉丁语 taliare（切割），指切割布料的人。
etymology.tip: tail（切割）+ or（人）= 切割布料的人，即裁缝。

related.zh: 零售（重新切割，引申为分售）
细节；详述（de-分开+tail切割，切成细部）

meanings.exampleEn: Surely the government's economic policies will be subject to rigorous scrutiny.
meanings.exampleZh: 确实，政府的经济政策将受到严格的审查。

meanings.exampleEn: The heavy luggage was surely fastened to the roof rack before the long journey.
meanings.exampleZh: 在长途旅行前，沉重的行李被安全地固定在车顶架上。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 securus（无忧的，安全的），由 se-（无）+ cura（忧虑）构成，经古法语 seur 进入英语。
etymology.tip: se（无）+ cur（忧虑）+ ly（地）→ 无忧虑地 → 安全地；确实地。

meanings.exampleEn: The committee unanimously supported the motion to reform the electoral system.
meanings.exampleZh: 委员会一致支持改革选举制度的动议。

meanings.exampleEn: The ancient temple's roof is supported by massive stone columns carved with intricate patterns.
meanings.exampleZh: 这座古庙的屋顶由雕刻着复杂图案的巨大石柱支撑。

meanings.exampleEn: The charity organization supports underprivileged children by providing educational scholarships.
meanings.exampleZh: 该慈善组织通过提供教育奖学金援助贫困儿童。

meanings.exampleEn: After his father's death, he had to support his younger siblings by working part-time.
meanings.exampleZh: 父亲去世后，他不得不通过兼职工作来供养弟弟妹妹。

meanings.exampleEn: The new environmental policy has gained considerable support from the younger generation.
meanings.exampleZh: 新环保政策获得了年轻一代相当大的支持。

meanings.exampleEn: The support of the central pillar is essential to the stability of the entire structure.
meanings.exampleZh: 中央柱子的支撑对整个结构的稳定性至关重要。

meanings.exampleEn: International support poured in after the earthquake devastated the coastal city.
meanings.exampleZh: 地震摧毁这座沿海城市后，国际援助纷至沓来。

meanings.exampleEn: The elderly couple relied on their son for financial support in their declining years.
meanings.exampleZh: 这对老夫妇晚年依靠儿子的经济供养。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 supportare，由 sub-（在……之下）+ portare（携带）构成
etymology.tip: 从下面托住（sup-下 + port-运）→ 支撑、支持

meanings.exampleEn: The blacksmith forged a sturdy sword, which served as both a tool and a weapon in the wilderness.
meanings.exampleZh: 铁匠锻造了一把坚固的刀，在荒野中既当工具又当武器。

meanings.exampleEn: The fencer's swift sword thrust impressed the judges at the international competition.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位击剑选手敏捷的剑刺给国际比赛的评委留下了深刻印象。

meanings.exampleEn: The nation resorted to the sword to settle the long-standing border dispute.
meanings.exampleZh: 该国诉诸战争来解决长期存在的边界争端。

meanings.exampleEn: The dictator ruled by the sword, suppressing any form of dissent with brutal force.
meanings.exampleZh: 独裁者靠武力统治，用残暴的力量压制任何异议。

variants.zh: 刀；剑；战争；武力（复数形式）

phrases.zh: 与某人交锋；与某人争论
达摩克利斯之剑；迫在眉睫的危险

etymology.origin: 古英语 sweord，意为“剑”；基础词汇，无明显词根词缀。

submit.zh: 使服从；使受到；委托；提交

meanings.exampleEn: He submitted himself to the strict discipline of the monastery.
meanings.exampleZh: 他使自己服从于修道院的严格戒律。

meanings.exampleEn: The residents were submitted to constant noise from the construction site.
meanings.exampleZh: 居民们不断受到建筑工地噪音的侵扰。

meanings.exampleEn: The two parties agreed to submit their dispute to an independent arbitrator.
meanings.exampleZh: 双方同意将争议委托给独立仲裁员处理。

meanings.exampleEn: All candidates must submit their applications before the end of this month.
meanings.exampleZh: 所有候选人必须在本月底前提交申请。

meanings.exampleEn: The young man refused to submit to the pressure from his family.
meanings.exampleZh: 这个年轻人拒绝屈服于来自家庭的压力。

etymology.origin: 来自拉丁语 submittere，由 sub-（向下）+ mittere（送）构成，原义为“向下送”，后引申出“提交、屈服”等义。
etymology.tip: sub（向下）+ mit（送）= 向下送；把文件“送”到上级那里就是“提交”，把自己“送”到别人之下就是“屈服”。

systematically.zh: 有系统地；有组织地；有条理地

meanings.zh: 有系统地；有组织地；有条理地
meanings.exampleEn: The researcher systematically collected and analyzed data from over 200 sources to ensure the reliability of the conclusions.
meanings.exampleZh: 这位研究者有系统地收集并分析了200多个来源的数据，以确保结论的可靠性。

variants.zh: 系统的；有计划的；有条理的

etymology.root: system = 系统（源自希腊语 syn- 一起 + sta 站立/放置）
